status=source_derived_unreviewed; type=curated_claim; source claims/derivations, not external certification.
Interface: proper characteristic-zero recognizable series f on n symbols, hidden-state bound m; exact FULL matrix-output oracle, not passive samples. Explicit Volterra T_i dimension2nm; f≠0⇒f(ℓT_1,…,ℓT_n)≠0 for someℓ∈{1,…,m}. Direct-sum dimension2nm²; acyclic full-output case one unscaled2nm tuple suffices. Joint strict triangularity makes evaluations legal.
Proof mechanism: released116 finite-word hyperlog independence→bivariate Volterra kernel→covariant rational row span detects a nonzero diagonal derivative before m→degree bounds/Cauchy interpolation→small scalar grid. Exact alias AB−B(I+A)^−1A(I+B) has leading commutator but vanishes at unscaled J_1,J_2 at EVERY truncation; greater dimension alone fails.
Learner: minimal r≤m realization, ≤m(1+nr) exact matrix queries of dimension≤2nm(r+1), feature length4n²m³. Residual combinations share transitions (m bound); unrelated hypothesis comparison may need2m. Independent batched width2n: maxdimension2n(m+r)≤4nm, calls≤m+nm²r. Charge full output entries, coefficient heights, elimination, execution/stability; field arithmetic≠bit time; no positive stochastic realization guarantee.
Critical novelty correction: release116+routine truncation/unrolling/length marker ALREADY implies polynomial proper-cyclic capability at O(nm^5) query dimension. Increment=compactness/charged query tradeoff, not first post-release polynomial learnability. Pre-release comparator quasipolynomial; scaling/output-only learning old. Practical useful oracle acquisition and independent proof/priority remain open.
Evidence reported:9adversarial fixtures×2modes,18 exact all-word/minimal-rank checks,1230 queries/1847592 returned field entries; cyclic rank4:45calls/dim80 vs205calls/dim32,batched slower. Other3fixtures75queries14.40s;14-query discriminator1.516s/75264inputbits/42359responsebits. Not a universal execution benchmark.

Actual terminal QND measurement followed by ancilla discard yields 4*2^m positive logical-error/syndrome task weights even with continuing quantum memory. Declared complete weak QND instruments, actual local Pauli/routing/isolation/buffers, selectable native entangling port and real forward quantum carriers. Terminal ancillas do not reinteract before discard. Current private frame/axis/role settings are hidden from the macro and decoder; keys are retired. Known likelihood kernel and bounded padded schedules are essential.

The fitted calibration-history mixture need not predict arbitrary future environments. Adaptive regret is a model-average statement, not a uniform per-record guarantee; the actual capped record has gap about .33348. The outer beta bound is accepted error WEIGHT with the same accepted environment filter, not conditional accepted error <=1/64. Equally informed conventional Bayesian controllers can use the same weights and policy. The reported calibration worst-case l1 radius is about .514, too loose as a small standalone prediction certificate. For six ancillas the model has 256 dyadic weights; dependence is exponential in boundary size. Source-reported adaptive control uses 252,786 inner marks over 8,192 macros (mean 30.857666), but padded duration does not shrink. It also pays 147,456 native CNOTs, 57,344 carriers, 2,824,306 total weak marks and fresh private coordination. A rejected unknown input is consumed. Finite counter/precision/key and reset costs remain; no hardware throughput or universal efficiency advantage follows.

NEXT OBLIGATION
No general fault-tolerance threshold, arbitrary future-model compression or infinite-stream guarantee is established. Response complexity can require 2^m[1-h2(error)] retained bits even for a memoryless device; reacquisition is a different paid interface. body:
N1002-oxygen-hydraulic-bounds-and-periodic-transmission | Oxygen-conditioned flow control needs explicit spatial, sensing, work and mechanical interfaces
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the named conditional hydraulic and constitutive derivations; synthetic benchmark outcomes remain source-reported, and no tissue or device operation is acquired.

EXACT CLAIM
In the locally Newtonian extraction-bed model, p/kappa=q*A(M/q), and nondecreasing oxygen-dependent viscosity gives differential gain1<=E=2-g/A<=2; uniform low viscosity dominates at fixed pressure. Spatially localized resistance can change that bound but raises separate pressure/information requirements. The successor is a proposed periodically driven Maxwell transmission H=i*omega*tau/[beta+i*omega*tau*(1+beta)] with opposed metering ports. Static-preload creep cannot reopen a gate; the periodic device needs real sensing, balanced forces, delivery floor, work and reset/cyclic stability.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Known fixed geometry and uptake law, nonnegative locally Newtonian viscosity and declared resource budget for the hydraulic result. The successor assumes the explicit Maxwell/output-spring topology, pressure-balanced port law, periodic drive, actual local/downstream-to-upstream oxygen information and acquired oxygen conversion kinetics, rather than substituting stress-relaxation time for ligand response.

BOUNDARIES
These models omit major biological vessel/injury effects. Oxygen extraction alone cannot distinguish latent recoverability. Desired-sign rheology and hydrogel valves have antecedents; no broad novelty claim. The published very-low-oxygen material threshold is not a healthy-tissue setpoint. Thin ribbons preserve ideal axial stiffness and shorten diffusion paths but cannot remove ligand kinetic floor or oxygen inventory. An ordinary powered sensor/actuator has a different topology and need not obey the direct-transmission volume bound. No reopening of blocked vessels or tissue-recovery/clinical capability.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
For direct transmission, V>=4*F*A_y/(G*epsilon_max^2) and oxygen charge>=B_max*Delta_s*V. Finite oxygen stores appear in work bounds. Static pressure-area mismatch, friction, membranes, gross clock work and sensor charging remain inclusive. The selected synthetic candidate buys its18/24 threshold count at about2.02times hydraulic power; informed ordinary valves support19/24 under the original power budget versus the candidate's12/24 continuous final-window count. Objectives differ and no practical advantage follows. Delay-sensitive regimes can lose continuous adequacy despite acceptable averages.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire an oxygen-to-stroke unit with threshold, ligand kinetics, load/force balance, total work, inventory and cyclic drift measured separately. Preserve source-reported benchmark/correction/delay failures; do not promote the mathematical oxygen threshold into a biological viability criterion or claim replay of absent physical data.

N1003-expiring-source-cohort-certified-transfer | Fresh cohort guards certify a reusable finite-field family before old sources expire
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified; actual root whole reconstruction and the present scoped source-exposed author review accept the conditional operation. No new benchmark, general intelligence or exclusive advantage is claimed.

EXACT CLAIM
Actually fit independent native polynomial programs G_i of degree<=D on F_p^n, p>2(D+1), while each fixed real basis source f_i remains available for its own fresh guards. Let C_r mean all guards through the stopped cohort match and e_i=disagreement(f_i,G_i). The joint bound is Pr[C_r AND sum_i e_i>eta]<=exp(-q*eta). On C_r outside that bad event, the common error union has mass<=eta and all actual/program linear combinations agree outside it simultaneously. Rejected cohorts receive no certificate. For an accepted cohort outside the bad event, after old sources expire, actual random-line correction on a new source within tau of that family recovers its coefficients using r(D+1)L source values when eta+tau<=1/[8(D+1)]. New tolerant target guards retain open-world soundness; useful coverage remains conditional.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Declared paid fitter, finite polynomial language and independent known-program rank tests, actual uniform native sampling and fresh independent guards. Each source is fixed throughout acquisition and survives through fitting/validation. Future source near-family distance is a separate coverage condition; the soundness guard does not assume it.

BOUNDARIES
The earlier strict r+1-value expiry contract does not supply these guards. Aggregate soundness and tolerant power are joint bad-acceptance/rejection events; conditional-on-acceptance accuracy needs a yield bound. The complement of bad acceptance also contains rejected runs and grants them no certificate. A one-point corruption can destroy raw anchor fitting despite tiny average error; native correction is essential. No unseen global rank exhaustion, arbitrary future task coverage, real-coefficient L2 extension or unbounded concentrated interactive reuse. Concentration/self-correction have established stronger conventional counterparts.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Zero-failure guards cost r*q values with q>=ln(1/delta)/eta; tolerant guards use q>=12*ln(1/min(delta,zeta0))/eta per source. Near-family transfer costs r(D+1)L with odd L>=32*ln(r/zeta)/9, plus fresh target guards. Language dimension M=binom(n+D,D), pivot search up to M*r known evaluations, inversion O(r^3), target solve O(r^2), code evaluation, field bit arithmetic, sampling/rejection caps, failed cohorts and fits all remain paid. r versus M is not total-runtime superiority.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire a useful language and related future tasks with actual return power and full amortized costs. Longer interactive use needs deterministic finite-horizon input-domination/risk caps. No physical learning system, new primitive priority or universal scientific discovery capability is established.

STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the scoped effect/closure/current-transfer constructions; finite controls are source-reported computer-model records, not hardware measurements or a protected output stream.

EXACT CLAIM
Matched retired Pauli frames yield positive port effects F_s with sum F_s=I. Scalar effects p_s*I give exact fixed-schedule logical Pauli renewal under arbitrary intervening memory-only channels; F_bad<=q*I instead gives specified-fault-set probability<=q^|S| and current half-diamond allowance q without requiring memory to forget. For the separate exchange-plus-bounded-single-site-bath class, synchronized pair Pauli pulses retain Heisenberg transfer while bounding full joint closure by (kappa/4+v^2/2)*T^2/N+4*N*delta_pair. Actual weak transfer records select unknown duration with reported q_current<37/1000 at99% calibration confidence, conditional on those design bounds.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
A genuinely closed bounded coherent port during each declared call, trusted full weak instruments and outer framing, private current controls, isolated past/future logical wires and references, upstream mixed preparation for general effect tomography. The exchange alternative supplies a different conditional boundary: actual exchange, bounded single-site nuisance strength/interaction-picture Lipschitz constant, synchronized finite pulse profiles and actual receiver extraction at output.

BOUNDARIES
A small port is an architectural premise/construction, not inferred from finite good tests. General qubit effects need16 coefficients per setting; multi-qubit port width is exponential. Exact centrality concerns each effect and a fixed/exogenous schedule, not fine-record-dependent fixed iid laws. Bad-weight envelopes do not automatically transfer through future postselection or untrusted coherent framing. Bath-modulated exchange lies in the control commutant and is not suppressed. Current transfer is distinct from protected repeated outputs, and native model operations are not hardware.

N cycles use4N pair/8N local pulses, with finite width4N*w<=T and uniform pulse/gap errors paid; increasing N eventually increases error. The source's five-duration acquisition reports40960 calls,737280 weak marks,10485760 pair pulses and private frame/input mixing. It retains finite scores/controller rather than a bath posterior. Calibration and deployment closure are charged separately. Known J permits direct SWAP timing with the same design allowance; equally informed conventional control uses the same data/pulses.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Justify actual interaction class, uniform pulse/isolation/trusted-instrument bounds and output routing. A fresh independent Bell input with isolated reference witnesses entanglement under q<1/2, but no quantum capacity, fault-tolerance threshold, practical advantage, uncut environment simulator or unlimited service follows.

STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the named theorem/audit versions and actual mathematical scopes; no physical decoder or unrestricted WH3 completion.

EXACT CLAIM
For any positive block B with rank-one lower x and arbitrary PSD noise b, the audited calibrated spectral-moment/filter receiver proves2*C([[a,-z/2],[-z*/2,x/4+3b/8]])-C(B)<=k*Tr(x-3b/2)_+, k=log(32/27)/2, retaining arbitrary finite upper dimension and Schur remainder. Separately, for PSD H,V with H+V<=beta*(beta-2)*I, beta>=4, positive resolvent transport proves K_1>=2*K_beta in Loewner order and its exact rectangular block-log receiver, without requiring H,V to commute.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Rank-one lower source for the calibrated coherence theorem; actual spectral weights, including a missing zero atom, satisfy both exact mean and reciprocal moments. The operator theorem instead requires the explicit Loewner resource cap, faithful environmental V for the block pencil and actual Schur normalization. Binary balanced entropy transfer uses N993's compatible two-source interface.

BOUNDARIES
Arbitrary PSD noise does not remove the rank-one source restriction. The operator integral theorem is higher rank but equal trace alone does not imply its operator cap; nonflat sources and general singular/faithful active-cap endpoints remain outside the receiver. Mathematical filters may be noncontractive positive congruences, not physical operations. Scalar transport sign proof covers beta>=4; failure of that proof below4 is not a counterexample. The unrestricted coherent WH3 target remains open.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Exact finite-dimensional entropy in nats and norm-convergent operator integrals; no runtime, state acquisition, instrument, physical implementation or practical advantage cost is supplied. Arbitrary dimension is a theorem quantifier, not computational efficiency.

N1006-dots-wh3-compatible-input-classes-and-pinching-obstruction | WH3 entropy receivers cover specific spectral and support classes while forbidding free pinching
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the completed scoped theorem/audit versions; their union does not establish the unrestricted target.

EXACT CLAIM
For N=W3 tensor id, W3(X)=(Tr(X)*I-X^T)/2 and E(X)=I3/3 tensor Tr_A(X), the deficit Delta=D(X||EX)-2D(NX||EX) is nonnegative for every normalized projector, every actual affine-projector input aI+bP with a,b>=0, every flat reference marginal, every input commuting with its own reference marginal, and every matched maximally-correlated support input. The last class has the stronger homogeneous bound Delta(X)>=3*lambda_min(X_block)*log(4/3). Each is a proved compatible receiver; arbitrary spectra/support/marginal coherence are not automatically covered.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
The actual W3 channel and conditional expectation. Spectral classes refer to the actual product support; modular commutation must be with the input's own marginal. The correlated-support theorem requires a matched orthonormal physical/reference basis and its audited anchored-source envelope.

BOUNDARIES
Two positive spectral levels plus an additional nonproduct kernel may have three levels and are outside aI+bP. Purification duality is a special exact identity, not monotonicity under discarding a reference. The exact marginal-pinching example locally lowers Delta when coherence is added, defeating free pinching but not producing a WH3 counterexample. General three-or-more-level nonaligned inputs remain open. No physical decoder, acquisition, capacity advantage or full target claim.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Finite-dimensional exact source inequalities, supported logarithm limits and exact audit imports. The complement index and unmatched shifted interval are paid in the proof; there is no claimed efficient testing procedure, measured device or total runtime bound.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Retain the actual margin and coherent cost outside the proved classes. A layer-cake decomposition, convex mixture, purification or reference discard needs its own signed entropy argument. Do not silently turn the union of proper classes into all states.

STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the completed principals/root mathematical scopes and current source-exposed author review; no photon identification, acquired device, new physical prediction or practical advantage.

EXACT CLAIM
The selected assessment preserves the exact172-record multiplicities79,48,42,3 and denominator31104, with r=(79+48sqrt2+42sqrt3+3sqrt6)/31104, and the conditional selector at its stipulated grammar. A Bell join has far coefficient proportional to M^T*W*N; its actual rank/singular spectrum determines admissibility, not endpoint dimensions alone. Canonical paths have bottleneck rank and an exact tree-superlevel criterion. A complete success/failure flagged instrument supports an actual N994 binary entropy transfer; at success prior1/6 and record flip1/4, its sharp coefficient is log2/(2log5). Separately, fixed finite residue/current/norm data admit a free gauge-kinetic coefficient, and finite graph holonomy data do not determine a two-dimensional Chern number.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual support isometries and their join connection, complete flagged CPTP operation and declared record prior/noise for the information receiver. Finite arithmetic/selector uses the author's explicit read grammar, survival weighting and normalized functional. Physical claims require an additional current-to-current/propagator/measurement map; Chern transport requires a gapped two-parameter occupied-projector family.

BOUNDARIES
The3->2->3join countermodel defeats unrestricted closure but does not refute the narrower read-end rule or canonical2->3->2count. Gauge-coordinate changes must transform the connection; arbitrary physical support rotations are different. LOCC cannot raise Schmidt rank across the actual full cut, but extra crossing resources and approximate/mixed catalysis change the assumptions. The normalized success branch is not the complete channel. The balanced-prior proof does not establish the sharp actual-prior1/6constant; the looser1/4bound is not asserted false. Conditional effective-field completions are not complete models of every microscopic axiom. No finite count, Lorentz algebra or graph winding supplies a measured electromagnetic coupling or material phase.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Postselection success probabilities, failure flags, residual quantum outputs, support/connection data, added entanglement and noisy record must be retained. Canonical path success is m/[(product edge ranks)*(product internal dimensions)]. Complete Bell testing alone has contraction coefficient1; only the retained noisy flag has the stated strict coefficient. The finite register's preparation/readout is additional; an observable expectation is not a single-shot alpha measurement. No procedure/device efficiency advantage is established.

NEXT OBLIGATION
For a physical reopening, derive a source-faithful current amplitude fixing normalization or a new observable/measurement map. For network use, establish an actual procedure/resource advantage beyond conventional tensor-network/entanglement methods. The existing mathematics remains useful without sustaining the failed physical identification.

EXACT CLAIM
The completed first methods report distinguishes same-output evidence reduction, a different useful operation and an improved proxy that damages the next task. Its selected allocation model exposes a tradeoff between counting gates and completing capability lines at equal action credits. Its prompt pilot has12responses on THREE retrospective cases, six per condition: a small descriptive scaffold-score edge without executed next actions, held-out cases, strict compute parity or causal discovery evidence.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual source information, output tests, access/cost contracts and comparator context must be held explicit. Distinguish constructive success, valid rejection and a useful changed-output operation. The next proposed exact-indistinguishable-pair treatment is a hypothesis to test, not a supplied effective method.

Eight selected trajectories and37passages do not estimate programme frequencies. The synthetic model's equal nine action credits omit planning/calibration/computation, and its adaptive index uses exact-DP fallback. The12starts are not12independent problems. The reported pilot means are expert7.33/7.50versus scaffold7.83/7.83out of8 across the two judges, not a statistically established discovery effect. A finite lock attaining a fixed fraction of B needs barrier order E_R log^2(B/B0), attained by an explicit positive two-harmonic lock. A stronger b=R log^2 R lock gives the full equilibrium real-time/spectral limit; a positive heat deficit follows only under the stated inclusive KMS/scattering contract. The actual bare momentum pY=P-gL, unlike helical P, has a divergent kinetic lower bound in this family. Literal H=pY^2/(2B0)+L^2/(2I)+V(phi-gY), compact angle, finite smooth periodic V, counted translating/rotating mass; added spring k=kappa/B and actual finite-band Rubin leads where specified. Fixed-I large-g family, finite pinned regulators before local lead/gain limits. Isolated response additionally needs the declared fresh cosine packet/N=0 stock, isolation switch, controlled normal ramp, finite hold and calibrated finite-aperture qubit meter. Band curvature, prepared isolated packet and full Gibbs state are different claims. The sharp response barrier is not proved sufficient for the stronger live dynamical limit. The earlier fixed-P small-flux preparation gate is not automatically valid at b=R log^2 R. EXACT CLAIM
For the complete finite periodic helical rotor with positive counted masses, the actual ground-band inertia obeys 1/B_eff=f/B0+(1-f)/B, B=B0+Ig^2. A finite lock attaining a fixed fraction of B needs barrier order E_R log^2(B/B0), attained by an explicit positive two-harmonic lock. Finite isolated preparation/response/readout and isolated/full loaded Gibbs range are proved as distinct operations/ensembles. A stronger b=R log^2 R lock gives the full equilibrium real-time/spectral limit; a positive heat deficit follows only under the stated inclusive KMS/scattering contract. The actual bare momentum pY=P-gL, unlike helical P, has a divergent kinetic lower bound in this family.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Literal H=pY^2/(2B0)+L^2/(2I)+V(phi-gY), compact angle, finite smooth periodic V, counted translating/rotating mass; added spring k=kappa/B and actual finite-band Rubin leads where specified. Fixed-I large-g family, finite pinned regulators before local lead/gain limits. Isolated response additionally needs the declared fresh cosine packet/N=0 stock, isolation switch, controlled normal ramp, finite hold and calibrated finite-aperture qubit meter.

Band curvature, prepared isolated packet and full Gibbs state are different claims. The sharp response barrier is not proved sufficient for the stronger live dynamical limit. The earlier fixed-P small-flux preparation gate is not automatically valid at b=R log^2 R. Heat requires equilibrium KMS input/output completeness and no unassigned persistent bound memory; those premises and finite Gibbs/NESS preparation remain unproved here. Third-party ancestry is cited by the proofs, not republished or independently novelty-cleared.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
At fixed I,B0, low-band response pays recoil E_R proportional to R, barrier O(R log^2 R), force/stiffness and shrinking pitch. The sufficient live-dynamical choice pays barrier O(R^3 log^4 R), normal reference energy O(R^2 log^2 R), force O(R^(7/2) log^4 R), curvature O(R^4 log^4 R), pitch O(R^-1/2). Actual bare kinetic lower orders are R log R at the logarithmic equilibrium lock and R^2 log^2 R at the stronger lock. Preparation, hold of order B, finite readout amplitude/slew, fresh stock and confidence are paid; neither ground energy nor equilibrium kinetic fluctuations are a per-use dissipation claim.

STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the exact completed mathematical audit versions. Earlier pending words in the frozen proofs are historical: the final root/physical-owner whole reconstructions explicitly close those versions. Cold transport remains OPEN; no acquired hardware or finite preparation is claimed.

EXACT CLAIM
An odd finite C2 aperture w_L(Y) preserves exact canonical J/C memory sectors and a nonzero full-ladder static dipole at fixed L, E_R and force resources. Its nonlinear curvature contact c=<lambda*w_L"*Q> changes the full KMS covariance identity; complete host kinetic/spring EXCESS remains bounded, while exact linear momentum domination is not inherited. Separately, a finite detuning pulse has actual all-mode transition probability A^2/64<=P<=K_*A^2 under declared state-moment/control premises. Fixed-gap full-charge Schur elimination supplies an explicit normal-tail bound and a relative eta transverse correction, with common selfenergy and reconstruction metric retained. None is a canonical cold-heat theorem.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual full canonical charge ladder and Gaussian host/leads, fixed positive port spring and masses, symmetry/offset contract; finite far-pinned and charge regulators before the stated limits. Aperture w_L=Y*chi(Y/L) with actual force/curvature bounds. Finite response uses the linear-force full-ladder model, declared joint reference Y,D moments, supplied sector preparation and actual finite eta/readout controls. Low-energy resolvent needs its explicit form/spectral-region and q<=1/2 conditions.

BOUNDARIES
The finite-aperture static/resource proof, linear-profile finite-pulse theorem and low-energy resolvent have different hypotheses. Do not silently apply the latter two unchanged to the finite-aperture profile. Curvature may have either sign, so Gamma_p<=Gamma_p,G is not a nonlinear-profile conclusion. A finite-pulse spectrum/moment bound does not control infrared weight or a joint eta,T remainder. Schur inverse equality is not equality of thermal ensembles, generators or observables; an extensive finite-T reservoir is not a fixed global-energy window. No free TLS, Gaussian bath vertex, inclusive-current completeness, finite Gibbs/NESS preparation, measured flux/force/readout or practical advantage follows.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Choose fixed E_R and L^2>46M2 for static memory; active extent4L, forceF0=19lambda/2 and curvatureD0=(15lambda/2+40lambda/sqrt3)/L are paid. Nonlinear absolute host excess bounds retain C*F0^2/8 and curvature terms. Finite pulse pays actual offset peak/slew, joint moments and state-induced source work; actual sector-sensitive detection is not supplied. Normal resolutionN costs a q^(2N)/(E_R(1-q)) operator tail plus Gaussian matrix/integration work; the common energy-dependent correction and metric are real resources, not discarded errors.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Determine the actual finite-temperature infrared/cold response with its preparation/current/material interfaces. Fixed-resource static memory, finite response and UV relative control are reusable premises; they do not settle transport or the mission.

N1016-covalent-packet-assembly-and-reset-costs | Covalent packet repair trades wrong-partner access against multivalent clearance and discarded correct links
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the stated conditional race, time-change, birth-death and rooted-prefix counting arguments. Packet assembly/reset remains a proposal; all rates and reported computational examples are hypothetical, not acquired chemistry.

EXACT CLAIM
An all-to-all irreversible matching race among n desired handle pairs gives Pcorrect=product_{j=0}^{n-1}(1+j*beta/k)^(-1), while a uniform bound D*beta on each remaining site's wrong-partner hazard gives Pcorrect>=(1+D*beta/k)^(-n). Independent multivalent rebinding can make perfect-sink clearance exponential in arm count. Ideal whole-prefix reset has E[R]=1+L*(1-p)/p rounds but wastes (1-p)*L*(L-1)/2 successful downstream bonds. Independently rooted b-edge packets reduce within-packet waste, excluding fusion. Equal total catalyst exposure alone gives no repair advantage in the common-rate-scaling model.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual registered reactive handles, constant intended/wrong hazards or their explicitly bounded spatial alternative; for reset, independent identical per-edge success, no wrong bonds/damage, complete unrooted-island clearance and retained rooted product in the original register. Multivalent clearance assumes independent arms and an absorbing wash sink. These are model premises, not demonstrated CuAAC reset capabilities.

BOUNDARIES
This differs from N992's imine checkpoint and does not supersede its reader/reset obstructions. Root connectivity, full mass and end identifiers do not certify sequence: ((m-1)!)^2 alternating orders share those observations for2m distinct monomers with fixed endpoint types/identities. That count does not imply the alternatives occur. Irreversible wrong rooted bonds pass a connectivity filter. The quadratic race law requires all-to-all constant rates; bounded access is a different and favorable interface. Packet isolation, reliable fusion/root removal, preserved recognition adapters and repeated re-registration remain unacquired. Cleaving coding adapters can destroy positional information needed for another retry. Source-cited component chemistry is not independently reverified, and reported simulations are not replayed.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Every reaction, discarded correct bond, reset, clearance time, root damage and connector is charged. E[within-packet waste]=(1-p)*L*(b-1)/2 for b dividing L excludes fusion. Independent connector failure q gives model Ptotal=Pcorrect(b)^(L/b)*(1-q)^(L/b-1), not a physical optimum. Complete clearance of N required tethers has probability c^N under independent per-tether cleavage probability c in its stringent topology; alternative release changes that model. Actual time is not determined by round counts; wash/reagent/damage and code/preparation costs remain.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire small-system missed-junction repair with retained correct bonds, complete multivalent clearance, permanent register, mixed-program wrong-link control and separately qualified fusion. Compare matched uninterrupted exposure; no integrated factory, measured selectivity or practical advantage is established.

N1017-two-sided-cellulose-grafts-and-shared-shutdown | Preanchored one-hit weld models change shared-window scaling but retain contact and load-survival gates
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the specified one-hit window, independent/shared association-loss and single-end counting arguments; prior two-hit models retain their own acceptance. Actual wet welding remains unacquired and the hybrid optimum has missing governing code.

EXACT CLAIM
The earlier symmetric four-arm two-hit shared-window model retains its N^-1/2 tail. A mechanically useful preanchor changes the required operation to one additional old-side graft. With k=d and X=N*a*eta*theta*S, independent thinning under T~Exp(d) gives one-hit no-link failure(1-exp(-X))/X and fixed-m failure asymptotic m/X. This is a changed interface, not a refutation of the two-hit law. Correlated loss of every preanchor in a region imposes a ceiling that abundance cannot remove. A single usable terminus per chain also makes useful sites per mass proportional to a*e*theta*S/M when other kinetic/retention factors are held fixed. Neither a physical weld nor a cost advantage is acquired.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual old/new contact and a mechanically effective preanchor; fixed positive graft/shutdown rates; Poisson candidate count and independent candidate outcomes conditional on the common window. The product a*eta*theta*S must represent justified association, donor retention, old-side targeting and later individual service survival, distinct from shared regional delamination. Single-end mass accounting requires one usable terminus per chain and comparable end kinetics.

BOUNDARIES
Earlier two-hit/time-floor/contact results remain valid at their own interfaces. Cotton cellulose-I/II activity ratios cannot supply a native wet bacterial-interface rate. AFM adhesion energy is not bulk strength. Shared association loss cannot be folded into independent service survival. The reported hybrid221-versus332 reaction-site optimum remains source-reported: astra_xh2_hybrid_weld_test.py is unavailable, so its optimization/stochastic validation is not accepted. Reaction-site counts are not equal mass, energy or manufacture costs. Source-cited biochemical precedents are not newly primary-validated; correct xyloglucan production, sustained association and donor-safe wet load transfer remain unacquired.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge actual preassociated macromer mass, accessible termini, enzyme/reactants/water, correct-side access, catalytic time and retained load paths. More surviving molecular links are not necessarily independent structural paths. Longer chains reduce termini per mass unless association/access/survival improve enough. Contact-before-shutdown still costs its own opportunity; a guaranteed catalytic time floor needs all actual reaction prerequisites, not merely retained enzyme.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire old-side catalytic access, useful preassociation and service survival, actual rates on native wet interfaces, donor-safe sustained load transfer and comparable material costs. Hybrid backup needs its missing governing support and genuinely distinct failures before optimization acceptance. Regeneration and practical advantage remain separate open claims.

STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the specified deterministic mathematical frontier, exact-interval transfer, forward reduction and information-loss proofs. Numerical outputs remain producer-reported; source contracts and instruments are supplied, not physically acquired.

EXACT CLAIM
For the whole real symmetric ball ||S-S0||op<=R and arbitrary unit real probes returning S*q with adversarial Euclidean error<=eta, the deterministic adaptive minimax radius for tr(T*S) after at most k vector calls is eta*||T||_*+(R-eta)*tail_k(T) for0<=eta<=R. The tail omits the k largest positive and k largest negative eigenvalue magnitudes separately; eta>=R gives the prior radius R*||T||_*. A complete exact Loewner interval supports a transformed noiseless inertia theorem; an outer interval only gives a certificate. Two native nonlinear forward calls can implement a bounded approximate Jacobian action under supplied symmetry/smoothness/error promises. A genuine scalar bilinear instrument ties one-task precision but can discard future-use information.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
A fixed finite real symmetric source, the actual whole norm-ball prior, late symmetric task T, freely selectable unit real inputs and the declared per-call worst-case error contract. Exact-interval and native nonlinear/scalar transfers each require their separately supplied geometry, smoothness, detector and error interfaces; they are not inferred from finite source records.

BOUNDARIES
N997's general operator/history and fixed-menu results remain valid and distinct; N996's vector/transpose grammar is not imported. Restricted/rational-only inputs, extra source structure, additional joint noise restrictions or noncentral history can change the sharp value. Outer noisy posteriors do not inherit the full-family lower bound. Nonlinear reduction is sound, not globally minimax over all native nonlinear procedures. A C5 strongly convex bump defeats unguarded derivative transfer from finite gradient data. Programmable scalar readout is an actual additional native interface, not free compression of a previously measured vector. Same-information optimal-recovery/retaining procedures tie; no device, physical calibration, lifetime advantage or historical priority is established.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge each full-vector call as n returned coordinates; scalar bilinear calls return one number only if that detector is genuinely available and calibrated. Nonlinear response actions cost two actual forward calls each. Pay eigendirections, arithmetic, real-input precision/preparation, retained records and actual error/prior acquisition. The source-reported six-port examples use four nonlinear forward calls/24 coordinates and two scalar calls versus twelve vector coordinates for one task; these are conditional software workloads, not measured hardware savings. Four original result JSONs are preserved as raw reports, not independently replayed numerical evidence.

NEXT OBLIGATION

Calibrate physical costs and future-task objectives before claiming instrument or learning advantage; preserve uncertain/outer-family gaps instead of inheriting sharpness.

N1020-qualified-chemical-commit-and-receipt-limits | Chemical commitment: distinguish hydrolysis protection, replacement damage and actual wrong-bond selectivity
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the exact conditional written models in scoped reviews; chemical integration, unavailable-code numerical claims and barcode performance remain unresolved.

EXACT CLAIM
Postbond rejection can improve conditional purity without restoring original-root yield: with correct/wrong irreversible attempt probabilities p,w and ideal readers, correct L-step yield is at most[p/(p+w)]^L. Endless iid false reads of a persistent wrong product eventually admit it. Complete donor-owned reset and no premature chemistry give precommit wrong/correct odds (lambda_W/lambda_C)*[(k+u_C)/(k+u_W)]^n; any fixed premature-coupling hazard changes the large-n limit. Any receipt test has alpha-beta<=TV(P_C,P_W) for its actual observation laws. Clearance of unjoined donors and preservation of registered roots obey a separate wash-time feasibility bound; it does not distinguish stable wrong covalent bonds. Two99% factors multiply to98.01%, not99%, under the declared product model. In a shielded/reactive two-register model, harmless shielded hydrolysis hS cancels from per-encounter wrong/correct odds at fixed other hazards. With immediate independent harmless same-parent replenishment it also cancels from eventual correct-root yield and mean time to any permanent decision. With per-encounter C,W,H,Droot and replacement loss delta, correct-root yield becomes C/[C+W+Droot+delta*H]; successful-recovery time tau changes mean decision time.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual correct/wrong chemical classes and rooted parent competence; identical renewal attempts or the separately declared exponential checkpoint model; full reset on donor departure, chemically latent intermediate states and a counted terminal commitment. Receipt laws must concern the same actual product/nuisance class as the proposed acceptance test. Wash model needs no rebinding, exponential loss and retained register. The two-register model additionally requires fixed exponential hazards, q,k>0 and chi in[0,1]; replacement returns to the same competent shielded start.

BOUNDARIES
A continuity-only DNA signal, full mass or donor activation does not establish bond site or sequence. Wrong stable covalent product and unjoined donor are different observation classes: the wash nuisance decay cannot be assigned to wrong rooted bonds. Long-chain products use the specified independent/identical stage or conditional product law. All rates, memory-retention CTMC thresholds and joint optimizations are hypothetical/producer-reported; current code is missing. Source-cited DNA proofreading, associative-toehold and latent furan-PNA components are not an acquired integrated assembler, serial masked-growth route or new priority result. N992 and N1016 retain their distinct accepted versions and chemical/reset gaps. Permanent decision includes root death; mean decision time is not time to correct manufacture. The new checkpoint source counts premature matched-donor chemistry as wrong, unlike the earlier leak model; their limits cannot be blended. The full note includes dA in DA, while the abbreviated response omits it.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Count starting roots, correct-root yield, full-length output fraction and conditional purity separately. Precommit qualification pays rejected arrivals, reset/fuel, residence time and actual commitment chemistry. Premature reactions and activated-donor escape are additional hazards. Wash pays time and irreversible register loss. For product reliability target Ftotal, allocate factors with product>=Ftotal under an actual justified product model; adding two99% factors is insufficient. A matched staged masked NHS-PNA process remains the source-proposed comparator; no measured improvement or source-code replay is supplied. Ideal replenishment omits dead time, damage, waste poisoning and rate changes. Count donor encounters and paid recovery; a hydrolysis-protection factor is not a selectivity factor.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire donor-owned reset, chemically latent preauthorization states, actual site/sequence-sensitive covalent receipt, compatible masked next terminus, activated-donor clearance and register handoff. Measure the joint physical error/time/yield law before combining separately favorable components.

body:
N1021-interface-work-and-fatigue-inheritance | Budget interface work, inherited repair seams and fast sacrificial-network recovery separately
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the exact specified ideal force/work, series-exposure/reset and deterministic recovery arguments; synthetic numerical reports and integrated wet-material performance are separate.

EXACT CLAIM
In the ideal equal-load one-scission interface with nu effective paths per area, peak traction=nu*f and scission work/area=nu*U_b, so their ratio is U_b/f. Required traction alone supplies no general fracture-work bound. Ideal constant-traction pullout gives work/area=sigma*ell and pays aligned fibre packing/material plus consumed sliding inventory. If each repair adds a seam that remains in series, n repairs create n(n+1)/2 independent seam-interval exposures. For periodic deep resets, n,k are positive integers,1<=k<=n, q=ceil(n/k), m_j=k for j<q and m_q=n-k*(q-1). With E=sum_{j=1}^q m_j*(m_j+1)/2, survival=(1-h)^E*(1-s)^q pays every actual deep connection, including the first, and requires complete unloading of old seams. Arbitrary partitions with blocks at most k are excluded. A constant-damage/first-order-recovery map gives a separate steady post-load active fraction; slow biological matter replacement does not acquire that fast recovery rate.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Declared load path, useful path density/force/work, deformation geometry and actual material inventory; for reliability, an exact series stack or explicitly resetting architecture and independent fixed hazards. Recovery uses constant disabled fraction p and one first-order inactive-site recovery law. None is inferred from click conversion, chemical-site renewal or initial tensile recovery. Periodic schedule ONLY: n,k are positive integers,1<=k<=n; q=ceil(n/k), m_j=k for j<q and m_q=n-k*(q-1), for j=1,...,q. Arbitrary partitions with blocks at most k are outside this contract.

BOUNDARIES
These are conditional models, not universal material laws. Stored elastic energy sigma^2*h/(2E) is geometry-specific, not a measured crack energy-release rate. Path densities computed from required traction are minimally sufficient in the toy equal-load model, not a general cap on actual path count or toughness. Ideal alignment/constant sliding/complete utilization need physical support. Deep reconnection must actually unload old seams; correlated/common failures and aging alter product reliability. A recovered active fraction is not a fatigue-threshold or joint-survival certificate. N1017 initial graft/window results remain unchanged; this return does not recover missing predecessor renewal/helper code. Continuous reinforcement allocation/numerical optima and cited component materials are source reports, not a measured molecular optimum or integrated living reconstruction. Extraction correction: U1021 reset v1 allowed arbitrary blocks at most k while charging ceil(n/k); v0002 replaces that overbroad reset clause with the periodic schedule only. Producer bytes and the other two models are unchanged.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge actual fibre volume/mass, irreversible pullout length, load-path topology, every deep connection and host anchor inventory, fast network recovery and slow matter replacement separately. Reset block count includes initial establishment in the stated model. Material/work/rate estimates are hypothetical, not measured cellulose interface values. Pay supplied feedstock, oxygen, adapter, staging, activation, support and wet load transfer; compare an equally supplied nonliving cellulose/material repair. No practical advantage, autonomous lifetime or historical priority is established.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire a wet old-to-new junction with actual load transfer, fracture work, fatigue behavior and a second repair; establish durable host renewal/unloading and recovery on the loading clock. Test useful regeneration beyond equally supplied premanufactured material without importing chemical-site renewal into mechanical reliability.

EVIDENCE

Represent retained product-guide obstruction by simultaneous blocking sets at each reaction port. Three sites can each tolerate either earlier product alone yet always jam the final reaction when both guides remain. A safe alternate port makes completion possible but gives only1/3 success under identical independent simultaneous reaction clocks. For prerequisite-free single-port pairwise obstruction between distinct sites, minimum exact immediate safe guide releases equal directed feedback-vertex-set size; this does not extend automatically to cooperative blocks. INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Known monotone retained-guide blocker sets and actual ports. Outcome-aware release needs an observed successful bond and exact harmless guide removal preserving product. Pairwise FVS requires one port, no prerequisites and i!=j. Blind equal-order probabilities need independent simultaneous identical per-site first-success clocks. Retry products must self-inactivate; competent misses and constant probabilities are supplied, with independence for product yields.

BOUNDARIES
Feasible scheduling does not acquire blind reliability or a bond receipt. Pairwise FVS excludes cooperative blocks, prerequisites and self arcs. Cleanup and across-site/motif independence require separate support. Donor-link cleavage does not eject duplexes, restore register or prevent wrong acylation. STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the written conditional topology/resource/port/clock arguments and the complete finite address-library properties. Original studies were statically read, not run; no integrated assembler, measured rates, throughput or priority acquired.

EXACT CLAIM
A covalently attached donor handle retained after a complete denaturing wash can witness a new covalent connection under the stated graph/isolation assumptions, but wrong-site bonds and orientation still alias. With IID rebuilt children and node acceptance q=p+f independent of size/protocol, balanced L=2^k fusion has expected consumption(2/q)^k leaf units before processing overhead; accepted-product purity needs independent correct-junction factors(p/q)^(L-1). Product-length-dependent q can restore exponential cost. Odd A-ended completed AA/BB fragments cannot terminally CuAAC-cyclize, yet the unmasked bridge has only1/6 correct endpoint pairs in the symmetric toy. Independent-clock clean-completion bounds and a verified1023-label code provide separate conditional tools, not a physical writer.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Covalent identifier/root attachment, no independent path or persistent nonspecific retention, complete noncovalent stripping, stable competent intended ports, correct leaves and known orientation. Rebuild models additionally supply IID per-node attempts, child destruction/rebuilding, explicit p/f and costs, and size/protocol-independent acceptance when invoking polynomial scaling or the boundary-only DP. Port/hazard/coding models each retain their separate assumptions.

BOUNDARIES
Connectivity and mass do not certify site, sequence or orientation. Safe completed fragments do not supply a safe fusion reaction. Correct two-end selection probability is not total accepted-product q without a specified reader/false-acceptance law; two-bond bridge success cannot be imported from one-junction rates. The source phrase n-monomer fragments is ambiguous: code uses total new product n, so child-length convention changes the exponent by two. No measured constant long-fragment q, outer-end masking, compatible label removal, integrated device or equal-resource advantage is acquired. Full demo imports absent astra_chemistry_distributed_edge_assembly; no result JSON/replay log supplied.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
C denotes EXPECTED consumption, not a hard or worst-case budget; q<1 permits arbitrarily many retries. Rejections consume both rebuilt children plus every join attempt; material per accepted product differs from verified-correct product, time, solvent, wash, feed and controller cost. Purity loses a factor p/(p+f) per independent junction. Odd fusion adds a B connector on every attempt and q concerns both required bonds. All rates and long-chain illustrative yields/costs are hypothetical model inputs. Established iterative exponential growth/orthogonal-chemistry comparators remain source-cited, not newly audited here.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire junction/orientation-sensitive acceptance, competent masked ends and recovery/label chemistry; measure whole-bridge p,f and their size dependence against an informed IEG comparator before claiming scalable manufacture.

EXACT CLAIM
For a>0 and independent exponential correct/wrong races at each correctly reached stage j, B_j=sum_(k=1)^j b_k gives F_L=product_(j=0)^(L-1) a/(a+B_j). The accumulated hazard exposure is S_L=sum_j B_j/a=sum_(k=1)^(L-1)(L-k)b_k/a. Power-law contact assumptions give the source O(L^2),O(L log L),O(L) exposure cases; these are not generic exact asymptotics for -log F_L outside small hazards. A separate active/trapped model has P_j=a/[a+d_A+j*b*(x+d_T)/(r_esc+x+d_T)]. With no irreversible terms and r_esc>0, every stage eventually succeeds but E[T_L]=L/a+b*L*(L-1)/(2*a*r_esc). Thus retained sites can cause time cost without necessarily causing wrong products.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Supplied constant nonnegative rates, a>0, integer L>=1 and stage-specific exponential race/reset premises. B_j must count actual irreversible wrong joining for the first model. In the second model trapping returns the same competent active state, r_esc+x+d_T>0, and the lossless eventual-success/time result additionally requires r_esc>0. Actual polymer contacts, donor selection/escape and chemical processing are not acquired by the formulas.

The absorption law explicitly reuses U1025-retained-product-diversion under a scoped rate/failure mapping. A positional-contact law is supplied, not measured for the proposed construct. For u_j=B_j/a, -log F_L=sum log(1+u_j), while S_L=sum u_j: linearization needs small hazards. For any b_1>0, F_L<=(a/(a+b_1))^(L-1), so even summable positional interference does not give nonvanishing long-chain fidelity at fixed rates. Reversible capture is not an irreversible error by definition; the effective hazard preserves absorption probability, not the full waiting-time law. Zero escape can make trapping permanent even with no chemical damage. Aging, correlated/nonexponential rates, changing competence and additional losses need a changed model. Old irreversible-mask survival remains valid at its own killing/initial-state interface. N1035-thermal-pulse-capacity-and-switch-frontiers | Choose between reciprocal-tree capacity cost and an ideal conductance-switch timing frontier
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the exact conditional mathematical/model or descriptive scope below, supported by completed substantive internal reviews. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

EXACT CLAIM
For N>=2 fixed positive reciprocal thermal-tree lumps, source-only initial energy and R=C_total/C_source>1, CV²>=1/[1+(N-1)tanh(log(R)/(2(N-1)))], sharply attained by positive ladders. Arbitrarily many lumps still require R>=exp(2(epsilon^-2-1)) for CV<=epsilon. A different autonomous single-reservoir memoryless curve g_min<=G(T)<=g_max with K=g_max/g_min>1 has optimum CV²=v, where 2(atanh(v)-v)=-log(1-1/K)-1/K; its low-to-high conductance threshold attains the bound in the measurable class.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Linear fixed reciprocal tree, one initially excited source, fixed-temperature bath and positive capacities/conductances for the first theorem. The second requires one constant-capacity reservoir, local memoryless G(T), finite contrast, no subsequent input and all leakage counted.

BOUNDARIES
Tree theorem does not cover loops, narrow-window concentration, nonlinear/scheduled switches or multiple excited nodes. RMS waveform width differs from timing jitter. Thermal ladder optimization maps to established OU optimal design. The continuum realization requires actual geometric regime: fixed capacity/material/delay do not independently make the slenderness parameter small. Physical switch examples do not supply the ideal local G(T); two-temperature closure/ON regimes cannot be blended. QP trajectory did not reproduce identically, although saved feasible objectives were checked. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Tree precision charges capacity ratio; timescale scaling is not precision. Switch CV scales K^-1/3 but needs actual conductance contrast, transition width, hysteresis/storage and threshold calibration. Fixed C,g_min,g_max do not allow independent mean-delay choice. The specified constant-power loading protocol needs P>g_max*theta and costs charging/reset.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the whole compatible reservoir–switch–bath response, geometry, loading/reset and matched ordinary comparator before using the ideal frontier as a physical timing claim.

N1036-switched-diffusion-routing-and-reverse-floor | Separate useful switched diffusion routing from cooling gain and perfect isolation
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the exact conditional mathematical/model or descriptive scope below, supported by completed substantive internal reviews. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

EXACT CLAIM
For fixed SPD storage and periodic reciprocal contacts, let Y be averaged terminal response and Y_* the static Kron reduction of the averaged graph. On terminal contrasts, Y_*-sym(Y)=<Z^T A Z>, a positive semidefinite matrix and Y^T Y_*^-1 Y<=sym(Y). Routing can be nonreciprocal but cannot improve total hot-subset cooling for two-level terminal temperatures in the admissible mean-conductance comparator class. With diagonal positive capacities, nonzero offdiagonal response occurs exactly along terminal-avoiding union-graph paths; forward and reverse zero patterns coincide.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Finite reciprocal bounded nonnegative periodic conductances, constant storage and unique stable periodic solution. Static comparison admits general SPD storage; positive-sign/support theorem additionally requires diagonal positive capacities. All terminal offsets constant, full repeated cycle, no internal sources/advection.

BOUNDARIES
A path through another clamped terminal is not a transmitting path. General SPD storage cannot inherit compartment positivity. The comparator requires feasible mean contacts; no assertion for every nonconvex actuator budget or every individual current at distinct temperatures. Finite isolation is possible; Float64 zero is not exact zero. At z800 reverse1.5282810767e-351 survives while the saved Float64 coefficient underflows. No universal approximate-router no-go. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Keep full period and cold preparation, parasitic/actuator heat, clock, contacts and resetting. Directionality trades against normalized symmetric loss. At extreme isolation the reported cooling is0.001875 of the matched static star; throughput and isolation targets differ.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Construct and calibrate compatible contacts and compare matched full-cycle cooling/routing costs; finite mathematical circulation is not a completed practical advantage.

body:
N1038-classical-channel-umegaki-finite-formula | Evaluate conditional Umegaki channel comparison by exact covariance and three small LMIs
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the specified mathematical, computational or descriptive scope of the completed substantive internal reviews. No physical advantage or historical priority established; mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

EXACT CLAIM
For strictly positive rational column-stochastic 3x3 classical channels K,L, with L injective on zero-sum inputs, the all-finite-quantum-reference conditional-Umegaki coefficient has an exact three-LMI global certificate. K may be singular. A denominator-only operator covariance removes inverse K. Above one, scalar vertex certificates suffice; below one, a common rational center gives an exactly checkable upper bound and real active dimension at most two suffices in closure. The Umegaki active/vacuum lift needs one additional reference dimension. The selected portable evaluator returns exact rational upper certificates and lower witnesses; both reviewed implementations passed ten frozen asymmetric cases and three controls.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Explicit positive rational K,L at a classical/dephasing input boundary; L must be informative (rank two on zero-sum inputs). Arbitrary finite complex noncommuting reference effects are allowed. Conditional/equal-reference semantics and free formula are inherited N965/N970/N1038 priors.

BOUNDARIES
No extension to zero channel entries, noninjective L or general coherent quantum-input channels. Tight width/runtime for every rational bit length is not proved. Adversarial anisotropic L leaves X68 a valid wide interval; selected X13 passed the nineteen reviewer probes. Frozen X68 batch checker accepted missing/duplicate coverage; separately credited post-review repair passed ten independent regressions and does not rewrite frozen outcomes. Generic free-convex/SOS machinery is historical prior; specialization priority UNKNOWN. Earlier SN-N1038-REVIEWED-SCOPE-20261026 records the former in-principle formula: its algorithmic gap is now closed only at this 3x3 interface, not uniformly for arbitrary alphabets.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Numerical optimization proposes; exact rational PSD minors and inverse quadratic witnesses establish bounds. Charge startup/imports, acquisition, checking, conditioning and serialization. Local reviewed thirteen-case process observations do not imply a uniform time/precision guarantee. Active-two is not total reference-two; faithful vacuum realization may converge slowly. No state-preparation or physical advantage acquired.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Improve certificate acquisition under extreme conditioning and compare with historical SOS including independent lower acquisition and full setup/checking costs. Preserve earlier equality/binary/finite-formula/refinement credit.

For standard magic blocks with exact decompositions rho_i=(1+R_i)sigma_i^+-R_i sigma_i^-, convex-Gaussian terms,independent signs and Gaussian output sampler,absolute mass Gamma=prod_i(1+2R_i). For any efficiently computable |f(X)|<=1, signed estimator Y=Gamma*s*f(X) is unbiased and |Y|<=Gamma;Hoeffding sample cost O(Gamma² epsilon^-2 log(2/alpha)) for additive epsilon,failure alpha. This logarithmic regime is stronger for ESTIMATION than positive mixture's full-law condition n eta^4=O(epsilon).

N1040-hidden-relaxation-and-tolerance-certificates | Distinguish finite-time tolerance evidence from proof of permanent material rigidity
STATUS | accepted_internally_verified at the exact conditional mathematical/model or descriptive scope below, supported by completed substantive internal reviews. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

EXACT CLAIM
With bounded strain and common white Gaussian stress noise, a permanent spring and arbitrarily slow passive Maxwell alternatives become indistinguishable on every finite horizon while equilibrium modulus differs. Without a rate floor the fixed-horizon uniform minimax squared error is A²/4. Even unbounded random stopping cannot uniformly certify permanence at finite time more often than its allowed false-solid probability. A conventional one-sided mixture confidence sequence under a step does give upper bounds on g converging pointwise, eventually certifying any positive tolerance gamma>g on the coverage event without a uniform duration.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Initially equilibrated linear passive positive relaxation measure, g>=0, g+mass(mu)=A, calibrated common additive Gaussian noise sigma and bounded causal strain. Binary step dominance requires nonnegative contrast kernel; passivity alone is insufficient. Rate-floor minimax test requires an independently known positive lower relaxation rate.

BOUNDARIES
A finite fitted spectrum does not acquire a rate floor. Tolerance upper bound cannot certify exact g=0 or positive permanent rigidity. Pointwise convergence is consistent with uniform impossibility; the slow alternative in a lower-bound proof can depend on horizon. Half-normal mixture statistics are established Howard et al. machinery. All-window ordinary comparator won30/32 final comparisons, with two uninformative ties; empirical coverage fractions are not universal guarantees. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay horizon, peak strain, readout noise, preparation/reset and actual work. Strain-squared exposure is not mechanical work. Finite thermal acceleration preserves the missing rate floor. Continuous-time confidence and finite64-readout all-window correction have different interfaces.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Independently exclude slower alternatives or acquire a supported additional observable for exact long-term claims. Use valid upper tolerance certificates where that weaker task is sufficient.

STATUS | accepted_internally_verified for the explicitly reconstructed conditional mathematics below. Unacquired producer programs/numerical claims and physical interfaces remain separate; historical priority UNKNOWN; mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

EXACT CLAIM
For the declared scalar lossless Fano source, cancelling D through its third derivative requires positive auxiliary moments mu0=g*A-1,mu1=g*B,mu2=g*C. Under strict upper-pole support inequalities at most two positive-residue modes suffice. When A,B,C>0 and AC>B^2, the sharp unconstrained coupling threshold is C/(AC-B^2); the hard-band Ohmic specialization forces g>=5/(5log3-4) and Omega=12/5 at equality. An exponential Ohmic source fails the necessary moments for every cutoff/coupling. Smooth-edge perturbation is a separate conditional transfer from an actual baseline band certificate.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Specified scalar one-port lossless continuum, finite positive-energy positive-residue emitter-side auxiliary modes with no pole at E0, ordinary real self-energy derivatives and a declared phase frame. The constructive upper-pole criterion includes strict support inequalities; full Hamiltonian positivity is checked separately.

BOUNDARIES
Not a universal passive/active/multiport or all-smooth-spectrum no-go. Local zero derivatives do not certify a finite wavepacket band. Tight C2/C-infinity band errors,1200-cell/80-digit results and finite-mode spectra remain source-reported: current code/cell data/JSONs are unacquired. No Maxwell source, physical advantage or priority established. Earlier matrix-residue control and energy/charge principles retain their scopes.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay source-spectrum acquisition, two poles/residues, support and Schur checks, conditioning and memory-selective controls. Emitter-only hard-band detuning obeys chi>=pi*g*E0*sqrt(4/epsilon^2-1); source chi4000B/5000B are supplied resources. A different controlled coupling/port changes the interface.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire actual numerical certificate objects before accepting tight smooth-band figures; realize and calibrate the spectrum with all ports and finite-time preparation/capture/reset costs.

One shared scalar source across all modules and times, independently warranted global constants and sensor-error contract; affine virtual evaluation expressions. EXACT CLAIM
A simultaneous differential meter has a correctable scalar accepted Z_L action; for lambda>=J two sign-reversed windows exactly reject the code in the non-click branch and return a known unitary byproduct on click. A complete conserved X_L Z_a symmetry restricts successful branches to Y/Z bath operators. Fresh-Bell completed teleportation yields positive I/X bath paths only at the stated coarse, retired-Bell-record boundary. Uniform herald availability needs an independent interaction-picture regularity bound. Coherent averaging over commuting R,S enforces accepted symmetry; classical randomization or leaked check flags does not. A late nondemolition XX check is not destructive local X parity and needs a nonlocal/entanglement port when separated.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Declared P/Q code and complete physical boundary, matched simultaneous controls or actual complete conserved symmetry, fresh isolated resources, trusted Bell/readout/correction and retired fine records. Deterministic pulse proof uses constant scalar J,lambda and a common logical-independent bath generator; Q must preserve ancilla Z. Coherent group filtering requires ideal controlled involutions and coherent flags or an independently bounded whole-process deviation.

BOUNDARIES
Three current full governing proofs, all producer scripts/results/archives and staged8/10-gate netlists are unacquired. This review reconstructs only the stated algebraic/conditional claims from actual native equations. No arbitrary ancilla disturbance, universal pulse control, normalized-success/full-channel guarantee or automatic liveness. Fine Bell labels can retain input-dependent interference. Source numerical ensembles, extra three-window family and broader resource-equivalence/netlist claims remain source-only; no physical or priority advantage.

body:
N105-conditional-fermion-code-bound | Conditional loss-dependent fermionic code-preparation lower bound
status=source_derived_unreviewed;COMPLETE supplied Y evidence package;branch-specific internal proof/audit status below,external correctness/priority unresolved;checks SOURCE-REPORTED unless marked otherwise.
Notation local.

This is the one main result with an external mathematical premise: Tang et al., arXiv:2609.15059v1, Theorem 2 at zero non-Gaussian gates (only stated specialization imported;full proof not independently certified). For m-mode code with k>0 logical qubits, Majorana distance d_F>=3, F_G(C)<=[1-H2^-1(k/m)]^floor((d_F-1)/2),H2^-1 on [0,1/2], bounding overlap with any Gaussian mixture. If only non-Gaussian inputs are lossy standard blocks rho_i and Gaussian processing succeeds p with fidelity>=1-epsilon to specified pure codeword, positivity and tensor robustness domination imply p(1-epsilon)<=[prod_i(1+R_i)]F_G(C). Thus sum_i log(1+R_i)>=floor((d_F-1)/2)*[-log(1-H2^-1(k/m))]+log[p(1-epsilon)];at constant rate/success/fidelity,uniform small eta, n=Omega(d_F/eta^4).
Scope is that input-loss/Gaussian-processing architecture. No code-preparation achievability, arbitrary extra non-Gaussian gates/noisy hardware, or loss record. Theorems A-D do not depend on Tang or Chen-Liu; source says no new OpenAI math-release manuscript is a premise.

R(s,q)=s²C/q+(1-s)²D/(1-q); F(q)=max(R(a,q),R(b,q)) convex in q and exact worst cost because R convex in s. Interior continuous optimum among q_a=a sqrtC/[a sqrtC+(1-a)sqrtD], q_b similarly, q_c=(a+b)C/[(a+b)C+(2-a-b)D]; certain branches forced. C=D=1,0<a+b<2: q*=(a+b)/2,F(q*)=1+(b-a)²/[4q*(1-q*)]; local quadratic penalty worsens near deterministic branches, not global dimension-free bound.
Implemented q=k/2^r,1<=k<2^r. Float analytic candidates NEVER trusted: exact rational neighboring-cost checks certify grid optimum by convex discrete slopes. Failed/overflowed heuristic triggers exact slope binary search O(r) rational objective evaluations. Store exact q and upward-rounded exact worst cost; continuation enclosures acquired by positive recurrence/outward dyadic rounding. Code compiler specifically binary nearest-neighbor finite chain, not arbitrary graph implementation. Fraction arithmetic/denominator storage charged; dyadic2^-M may cost O(M) bits, not O(logM).

Claim: For one material with local resistivity rho(T)=a+bT, b>0, a fixed uniformly positive symmetric geometry tensor M, independent local Johnson sources, and frozen temperature fluctuations, the dissipation-weighted noise temperature obeys T_N=T_R+(R/b)E, where E=integral grad(u-u*)^T M grad(u-u*) >= 0. If T_- <= T(x) <= T_+, then the sharp class-wide upper bound is T_N <= T_R + b(T_R-T_-)(T_+-T_R)/(a+bT_R).
Interface: The affine law, common material, stated boundary conditions, local Ohmic model, independent Johnson sources, quasistatic electrical response, and a frequency band where mean temperature fluctuations are frozen are required. Mixed materials, arbitrary nonlinear resistivity, thermoelectric terms, and endpoint attainability in every fixed geometry are excluded.
Proof spine: The source compares the physical potential with the terminal-calibrated potential in a weighted Dirichlet energy; the energy defect is nonnegative. Two-temperature series and parallel configurations establish sharpness over the allowed class.
Costs: A structural identity and bound; no inference algorithm or experimental acquisition cost is claimed.
Failure: It constrains a stated local transport class. It does not establish that a particular strange metal obeys that class or identify a microscopic mechanism.
Closest comparator: Established dissipation-weighted local-noise thermometry is cited; the candidate contribution is the affine-law identity and scoped sharp interval.
Open verification: Independently reconstruct the variational identity and boundary hypotheses, then test them against controlled device measurements before making a material-level inference.

Claim: For a finite connected resistor network at uniform bath temperature, symmetric positive-definite thermal conductance A and heat capacity C, and a common positive fractional resistance slope c, the leading linearized Gaussian Langevin model defines H(omega)=q^T(A+i omega C)^(-1)q and H_0=H(0)>0. Near zero current, R(I)=R_0+c H_0 I^2+O(I^4) and Z(I,omega)=R(I)+2c I^2 H(omega)+O(I^4); the source also derives an eliminated leading-order relation for excess noise.
Interface: Finite connected network, uniform reference temperature, positive-definite A and C, common positive local fractional resistance derivative, current bias, independent equilibrium electrical and thermal noises, and the stated leading-order linearized Gaussian Langevin approximation. Thermoelectric effects, intrinsic field dependence, and nonlinear fluctuation-loop corrections are excluded.
Proof spine: Linearize the coupled electrical and thermal equations around zero bias, represent deposited Joule power by q, solve the thermal response with (A+i omega C)^(-1), and retain the quadratic current terms.
Costs: Finite-dimensional network formulas; no asymptotic algorithm or measurement-acquisition cost is asserted.
Failure: The relation is model-specific and leading-order, not an empirically validated microscopic bath model or a universal electrothermal feedback law.
Closest comparator: Noise thermometry and bolometer feedback are established topics; this is a relation inside a specified network Langevin model.
Open verification: Rebuild the covariance elimination independently and identify precise frequency and bias remainder bounds before applying it to material data.

Claim: For finite-dimensional H, any pure-state family F, and one full-domain channel C:H->H tensor H whose marginals approximate every family member within half-trace error b, the report constructs one EB channel with uniform half-trace error at most kappa(b)+(1-kappa(b))14b for 0<=b<=1/4096. Here delta=4 sqrt(b), eta=(3/2)((1-4delta)^(-1/2)-1), a=delta+eta, kappa=(sqrt(a eta)+sqrt(2b))^2, and f(b)=(208+16 sqrt(6))b+O(b^(3/2)); linear order is optimal.

Proof spine: A Stinespring dilation yields an approximate Schur idempotence relation. A convergent binomial correction gives an idempotent Schur mask; its norm forces an equivalence-relation partition. One common POVM distinguishes blocks, and representative-state preparation gives the EB channel and modulus.
Costs: For an explicitly supplied rational list of n states in dimension d, overlap formation costs O(n^2 d^2); the SDP has O(k d^2) real variables and k PSD blocks of order d. Unknown-state acquisition and device costs are excluded.
Failure: Does not cover general mixed families or establish dimension-free runtime or experimental access. Supplied finite SDP checks are not proof validation or external review.

Claim: For each integer s>=1, h=4s^2, let B0=[[1/4,0],[0,0]] and B1=[[1/4,1/(4s)],[1/(4s),0]] define normalized pure Gaussian states. Both formulas are known but label i is hidden. For independent unconditional copies, an always-output procedure realizing exactly the second-mode count law conditional on first-mode count h for either source has minimum fixed budget N*=ceil(log Z_h/(-log F_h)), where A_j=product_{r=0}^{j-1}(1-2r/h)^2, Z_h=sum_{j=0}^{h/2} A_j/(2j)!, and F_h=sqrt(1-(8h-1)/(15h^2)) is the SQUARED pure-state overlap. N*/h -> (15/4)log(cosh 1)=1.626678... . P0=delta_0; P1(2j)=A_j/((2j)!Z_h).
Interface: Unknown label; copies are the only source-dependent resource. Arbitrary collective/adaptive measurements are allowed; label-bearing advice, preparation-unitary access and conditional-state oracles are excluded. Output law is assessed unconditionally, charging failures. TV(P,Q)=1/2 sum|P-Q| and quantum trace distance=1/2||rho-sigma||_1. Integer h is restricted to 4s^2.
Proof spine: The zero-output effect must fix source 0, forcing F_h^N<=1/Z_h. Vacuum/nonvacuum detection in mode 2 has no-click probability F_h^N under source 1; rebalancing positive output mass attains the criterion. Integer boundaries reduce to the rational inequality [1-(8h-1)/(15h^2)]^N Z_h^2<=1. Geometric proposals for the known positive law use rational acceptance 2^J A_J/(2J)!.
Costs: Unconditional input mean photon count <=1/4; conditional output mean <=sinh(1). With label supplied, exact sampling uses <=4/3 expected proposals and expected bit work polynomial in log h. Exact acquisition rebalancing setup is polynomial in h, with O(h log h)-bit operands; copy optimality is not classical-runtime optimality. At TV<=1/12 fixed copies need N>=5h/96; almost-sure termination with adaptive count needs max_i E_i T>=5h/9216. Exact fair-bit algorithms have no bounded worst-case random-bit claim.
Failure: One heralded attempt can use one copy; its success probability cannot be discarded. The fixed-budget exact optimum does not apply to expected-copy budgets or arbitrary devices without this promise. Sufficiency assumes ideal independent preparations and ideal vacuum detection. No quantum hardware or physical acquisition was demonstrated.
Closest comparator: Two-state quantum discrimination/fidelity mechanisms are established prior art. The exact Gaussian operational witness and complete interface have unresolved historical priority.
Open verification: Obtain independent expert or formal review of the exact fixed-copy criterion, algebraic rebalancing coin and expected-bit sampler; determine priority of the exact witness without claiming novelty of discrimination.

Here R=2sqrt(a)+2sqrt(b), D_k(r)=(b/(a+b))r^(2k+2)(1+r^2)/(1-r^(2k+2)), H_k(r)=3sqrt(D_k(r))/sqrt(a)+E_k(r), E_k(r)=r^(2k+1)(1+r^2)/(sqrt(a)(1-r^(2k+2))). At fixed a,b,r the bound is O(r^k).
