N706-orientation-uniform-geometric-phase-control | Transit-compensated geometric phase control gives conditional orientation-uniform initial-rate suppression
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported conditional models, circuit constructions, oracle proofs and producer diagnostics only. No transformative technological capability, physical experiment, atomistic simulation or net device advantage established. Intake validates source preservation and repository structure; it does not independently validate mathematics, citations, novelty or implementation.

Input is a prepared donor population, weak coupling J to one resonant acceptor with exponential amplitude memory exp(-kappa s), and a differential Stark vector d=d0 u with one supplied nonzero norm d0 and arbitrary fixed u in S^2. For periodic primitive Theta'=E, f_u=exp(i d0 u.Theta), Fourier coefficients c_n(u), and Omega=2pi/T, the model gives Gamma(u)=2J^2 sum_n |c_n|^2 kappa/(kappa^2+n^2 Omega^2), Gamma0=2J^2/kappa and A=d0 E_rms. These are initial leakage rates, not demonstrated molecular lifetimes or chemical yields. For scalar finite-RMS modulation, Jensen gives Gamma>=2J^2 kappa/(kappa^2+A^2), attained by static detuning. Static orientation-averaged Gamma/Gamma0=atan(x)/x, x=A/kappa. Its frozen-ensemble mean lifetime is instead (1+x^2/3)/Gamma0, and its worst-orientation lifetime remains 1/Gamma0.

Representation change: take R=pi/d0, positive degree-2t Gauss–Legendre/azimuth cubature on S^2 with (t+1)(2t+1) nodes, a closed latitude/meridian path of length L<=2pi R(t+2), normalized traversal measure nu, and degree-t Legendre kernel K_t. Set delta=1/[2(t+1)^2], h_t(n)=integral K_t(n,x)dnu(x), and dwell weights a_k=w_k(1-delta h_t(n_k))>=w_k/2. The combined traversal/dwell occupation measure integrates spherical polynomials through degree t exactly. Travel consumes fraction delta at speed E_rms/sqrt(delta), so T=L/(E_rms sqrt(delta)); no instantaneous jumps or free traversal. Uniformly for every fixed u, |c0(u)|<=2 pi^(t+1)/(t+1)! and Gamma(u)/Gamma0<=4[pi^(t+1)/(t+1)!]^2+(kappa/Omega)^2. Peak/RMS=sqrt(2)(t+1), and Omega/A>=1/[pi sqrt(2)(t+1)(t+2)]. This is a source-reported conditional proof, unreviewed by intake.

Fejer filtering Theta to degree K keeps RMS and peak from increasing but adds carrier error: |c0,K(u)|<=2 pi^(t+1)/(t+1)!+A/[Omega(K+1)]<=2 pi^(t+1)/(t+1)!+A/B, B=K Omega. Hence Gamma_K/Gamma0<=(2 epsilon_t+A/B)^2+(kappa/Omega)^2. A bandwidth as large as A Omega/kappa may be needed for the illustrative quadratic regime. Smoothing does not preserve exact design moments for free. Existing Ehler–Grochenig t-design curves supply stronger existence length scaling; the underlying averaging principle and its existence claim are not new mathematical discoveries here.

Producer numerical benchmark: degree-2 Fejer-64 waveform at 100-fold orientation-averaged initial-rate suppression uses A_rms/kappa=91.764 and A_peak/kappa=368.127, versus static 156.440 for each, with B/kappa=445.465. Thus RMS is 1.70 times lower but peak is 2.35 times higher. It loses in RMS at 10-fold suppression. The 200-orientation, 32768-time-point computation, quadrature/aliasing bounds and peak-grid correction are preserved; it is not the orientation-uniform analytic theorem, an independent replay, interval-roundoff certification or a measured instrument advantage. The source's 3.42 s OS receipt times one NumPy diagnostic process, not the research inference budget.

Acquisition remains unclosed: same-species calibrated d0/kappa, weak transfer, one resonant Lorentzian bath, frozen orientation over cycles, common nonzero slope norm, linear Stark law over the full peak/bandwidth, preparation, competing channels, heating/ionization and damage. Source example Stark slopes and IVR rates come from different systems and cannot be combined as an achieved molecular operating point. No arbitrary multiple-channel norm coverage or bond-selective consequence is established. A separate retained finite-retention proofreading/latch model (HL6) supplies another negative boundary, not a validated manufacturing or geometric-control application. No transformative capability, originality or experimental validation was established.

Next decisive obligation: Independently review the model proof and known design-curve comparator. Acquire a same-species nonzero differential Stark-vector norm and Lorentzian decay parameter in the actual weak-transfer regime; then calibrate a three-axis finite-bandwidth field and compare initial leakage against equally prepared static and strongest admissible control under matched RMS, peak, bandwidth and delivery energy. Rotation, multiple channel norms, competing resonances, damage, preparation, lifetime and chemical yield remain separate gates.

N707-confined-solid-iron-export-and-collection-cost | Confined solid-iron export remains an admission hypothesis with explicit collection and energy costs
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported conditional models, circuit constructions, oracle proofs and producer diagnostics only. No transformative technological capability, physical experiment, atomistic simulation or net device advantage established. Intake validates source preservation and repository structure; it does not independently validate mathematics, citations, novelty or implementation.

Candidate: reduce fine ore upstream with H2, admit Fe atoms from a continually renewed source into a confined transport path, retain gangue, and reconstruct/harvest solid Fe downstream. The preferred representation is an independently conducting CNT wall with a moving/regrowing solid Fe plug; the permanent 3 nm hot-Fe shell is an optimistic calculator model with unclosed dewetting/continuity premises. Existing prepared pure-Fe nanoscale transport and biased collection are credited antecedents, not a demonstrated raw-ore process or novelty certificate.

Stipulated molar model J=(2f/a) Ds Gamma_s/(RT) [Z*F E-partial_x mu], mu=mu0+gamma Vm curvature+Vm sigma_h+RT log activity. It assumes connected uniform mobility, an admitted Fe source and an open maintained product sink. For T=1163 K, a=L=30 nm, f=0.2, 0.3 nm mobile layer, 3 nm conducting shell, sigma=1e6 S/m and Z*=10, the imported clean-free-Fe law gives Ds=5.75274e-10 m^2/s. Target 10 kg/m^2/h gives E~1536 V/m, active v~46.09 microvolt, projected j~64.53 MA/m^2, optimistic active electricity ~0.297 MWh/t. Assumed contact RA=1e-12 ohm m^2 adds ~0.416 MWh/t. These are conditional arithmetic, not measured flux, a validated ore coefficient or atomistic simulation. A full Fe plug changes conducting area and can raise modeled electricity ~4.76-fold; CNT conductivity, shell Z* and hot-free-Fe diffusion cannot be mixed without a new contract.

Supply cannot be hidden: integral export<=integral fresh admission+initial Fe inventory. The modeled initial shell holds only 9.92 mg/m^2 and discharges in 3.57 ms without replenishment. A gangue cage admitting H2/H2O but disconnected from the metal path can fully metallize yet export no Fe; recovery<=accessible connected Fe fraction f_acc, so grade/metallization do not acquire f_acc>=0.94. EM work ~44.47 J/mol can be cancelled by ~6.27 MPa backstress; assumed curvature terms ~236–473 J/mol can exceed it. Coarsening, source-root stoppage, purity and product detachment are unclosed. Geometric exclusion of gangue fragments does not reject surface-mobile or dissolved impurities/carbon/scaffold species.

Electrical construction divides total online area A into N cells of area A/N, electrically in series but materially supplied/collected in parallel, with isolated batch cavities. I_terminal=jA/N, V_terminal=Nv and P_ideal=jAv: terminal current decreases, local current density and ideal power do not. Contact dissipation per active area obeys sum rho_c j^2/kappa_contact independent of N. A common conducting Fe product manifold shorts the circuit. For N_gap connections spanning H, conductivity<=sigma and allowed extra heat fraction eta, V_gap/A >= j H^2/(sigma eta v) (N_gap/N)^2. Product/feed storage requires H>=m tau(1/rho_Fe+1/C_Fe); the combined lower bound grows as batch time tau^2. At 10 kg/m^2/h, 100 micrometre product space fills in ~283 s. The illustrative 1 m^2, 300000-cell, 200 A/9 V layout requires ~80 L gap-spanning conductor for 10% extra heat, in addition to ports, barriers, insulation and material-access volumes. Duty D at fixed installed area increases contact/active ohmic heating by at least 1/D, or more area must be installed. These are scoped circuit/resource derivations, not a universal architecture impossibility.

On the source's illustrative 45% Fe grade and 94% export-recovery basis, one tonne exported Fe needs 2.364 t ore and leaves ~0.843 t gangue. At 97% metallization ~31.9 kg metallic and ~31.9 kg unreduced Fe remain. H2 floor ~54.15 kg/t exported Fe or ~55.87 kg at the stated metallization. Avoided 890-to-1600 C gangue heating/fusion is ~0.260 MWh/t, while whole-ore preheating is ~0.454 MWh/t before recuperation. The optimistic ~0.297 MWh/t active drive already matches/exceeds that avoided duty. Include all H2 production, heat/recovery, contacts/leads, feed renewal, scaffold/carbon, finishing, waste/lost Fe, and final product melting when matching a molten-output comparator. No net energy or economic advantage survives as an established claim.

Decisive gate: a <=1 cm^2 supported coupon with isotope-labelled oxide/quartz, all contacts metered, matched temperature/total-power bias-off/reversed/blocked/no-ore/pure-Fe controls. Require isotope-resolved feed-derived product >100 times all accessible preloaded inventory, repeated source replenishment/harvests, mass and scaffold/carbon balance, impurity assay, actual mobility/drive response, and simultaneous V/I/T/net-product measurements. Only after admission move to untreated real ore. The >=94% recovery/metallization, steel-usable chemistry, 10 kg/m^2/h and lower complete cost targets are exploratory and unmet. No device, physical experiment, durable ore transport or transformative capability was established.

Next decisive obligation: Review the stipulated transport/circuit laws and run a frozen <=1 cm^2 isotope-labelled oxide/quartz admission test with all contacts inside a measured V/I/temperature/power boundary. Require feed-derived Fe export beyond 100 times all accessible preloaded inventory, sustained replenishment and repeated harvests, full Fe/carbon/scaffold balance and impurity assay against matched bias-off, reversed, blocked, no-ore and pure-Fe controls. Only then assess untreated real ore, recovery, lifetime and full-process economics.

Finite reversible CTMC family with M=2^d and states {A,B,u_j,v_j}: q(A,u_j)=q(B,v_j)=1/M, q(u_j,A)=q(v_j,B)=1, q(u_j,v_j)=q(v_j,u_j)=theta_j>0. All topology, endpoints and pi_A=pi_B=1/4, pi_u=pi_v=1/(4M) are known. An adaptive unit-cost local query reveals theta_j (even the full unknown row); equilibrium samples and endpoint evaluation are free. Listing all M neighbors still costs M output entries. This is an unstructured local-rate oracle contract, not an atomistic force oracle.

Set f(theta)=theta/(1+2theta), S=sum_j f(theta_j). The source derives committors h_u=f, h_v=(1+theta)/(1+2theta), capacity S/(4M), reactive route weights f(theta_j)/S, mean first-passage time E_A tau_B=2M/S, and exact Laplace transform E_A exp(-s tau_B)=B(s)/[s(s+2)+B(s)] with B(s)=(1/M)sum_j theta_j/(s+1+2theta_j). These identities are source-reported proofs, not independently reconstructed by intake.

Source-reported candidate theorem: for every integer r>=1, an explicit rational finite continuous-time Markov chain Q_r with 4r<=n<=16r, uniform stationary law and balanced binary observation Y_t=f(X_t) has an exponentially hard passive distinction from a stationary equilibrium binary chain of flip rate 1/2, but a polynomial-duration test under a specified conservative-field rate law. All statements use ordinary stationary time reversal with every microscopic state even under physical reversal. Independent correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN; no device or transformative technological capability is established.

The positive Walsh lift is Q_r=J-I+epsilon A, epsilon=1/(16r), A^3=0, rank(A)=2r and ||A||_(2->2)=1. With ell=2r-1 and distinct Walsh characters {1,f,c_1,...,c_ell,d_1,...,d_ell}, d_j=f c_j, set Af=d_1, A c_j=d_(j+1) for j<ell, A c_ell=f, and A zero on other characters. A1=A*1=0, ||A||_F^2=2r and ||A-A*||_F^2=4r. The explicit state-basis construction gives 7/(8n)<=q_ij<=9/(8n), exit rate <9/8, reverse-rate ratio <=9/7, total-variation mixing <=exp(-t/2), and all nonzero eigenvalues -1 with Jordan blocks of size at most three. An actual label-preserving state permutation R satisfies RQR=Q*, ensuring an exactly time-reversal-invariant observed path law. R is an auxiliary symmetry, not an alternative physical reversal convention. The source bounds sigma(Q_r) between 1/(144r) and 1/(112r).

Multiplication Dg=fg switches 1 with f and c_j with d_j. A scalar observation word containing A needs at least 2r A-insertions and 2r+1 observations. All joint distributions at <=2r times match the binary equilibrium reference, including C(t)=exp(-t). The first odd moment at t_0<...<t_(2r) is epsilon^(2r) exp[-(t_(2r)-t_0)] product_j(t_j-t_(j-1))>0. This observation-depth statement alone is not the full passive lower bound.

For full continuous records, Q_r=(J-I)/2+B with B=(J-I)/2+epsilon A a valid uniform-stationary generator. Give the observer the independent rate-1/2 reset times as extra information. On each segment the projection/Duhamel series has no contributions of orders 1,...,2r-1, and the state-basis row norm K<=2r bounds the remaining signed terms. The source obtains TV(P_Q^[0,T],P_eq^[0,T])<=(2/3)(1+T/2)16^(-r), covering exact jump times and unlimited processing. Equal-prior success >=2/3 therefore requires the fixed observation horizon T>=16^r-2. This is not a lower bound on expected sequential stopping time. For M independently acquired stationary windows of total length T the bound becomes (2/3)(M+T/2)16^(-r); stationary starts are not free resources. Scaling both generators by r gives sigma in [1/144,1/112], passive horizon >=(16^r-2)/r, controlled unit trial duration 1/r and exit rates O(r).

Essential active interface: q_ij^(h)=q_ij exp[h(f_j-f_i)/2], with diagonal row sums restored, initial zero-field stationarity and symmetric kinetic factors fixed. This law is not determined by passive observations or guaranteed by simply naming a field. The source derives chi_r(t)=1-exp(-t)-(epsilon^2/2)[1-(1+t)exp(-t)], versus chi_eq(t)=1-exp(-t). At t=1 the gap is c_* epsilon^2, c_*=(1-2/e)/2>1/8. Take h=epsilon/100 and finite difference D(h)=[m(h)-m(-h)]/(2h); a third-derivative bound <500 yields bias <=500h^2/6 and a finite-field gap >=13epsilon^2/120>epsilon^2/10. The equilibrium mean is tanh(h)[1-exp(-cosh(h))].

To acquire that distinction rather than assume a susceptibility oracle, estimate each endpoint mean to a=epsilon^3/8000 using N=ceil[(2/a^2)log(8/zeta)] samples per sign. Before every trial, switch the field off and wait L>=2log(8N/zeta); regeneration coupling charges dependent-trial error. The claimed total experiment duration is O(r^6 log(1/zeta)[1+log(r/zeta)]), including the waits, with inverse-polynomial absolute field/timing tolerances epsilon^3/10^8 and polynomially many precision bits. The constants are conservative and large. The archive contains no Monte Carlo implementation of this full sampling protocol. A bound of 2|h| on field-switch work per trial excludes actuator, sensor, calibration and model-construction costs and establishes no total energy advantage.

To exclude a dispensable hidden dissipative subsystem, the source constructs F_+=product_(j=1)^r Y_j and F_-=product_(j=1)^r Y_(-j) with conditional covariance -tau_r given Y_0=-1, tau_r=epsilon^(2r)exp(-2r). Finite reversible hidden deterministic-observation models have nonnegative conditional past/future covariance. For any finite stationary all-even exact hidden realization G, additive reversibilization G_rev=(G+G^dagger)/2 has the same stationary law and exit rates and KL(P_G^L||P_Grev^L)<=L sigma(G)/4. A bounded covariance witness and Pinsker imply sigma(G)>=epsilon^(4r)exp(-4r)/(16r)>0, uniformly over finite hidden dimension and rates. This floor is not sharp and does not estimate the actual dissipation to fixed relative error.

For a finite stationary generator and bounded f under the same rate-perturbation law, the note proposes |chi(t)-[C(0)-C(t)]|^2<=(M^2/2)sigma t Var(f), M=(max f-min f)/2. Balanced binary observations give sigma>=2|response defect|^2/t; the constructed t=1 response supplies an inverse-polynomial floor 2c_*^2 epsilon^4 for models matching both correlation and susceptibility. Promoting finite differences to this derivative certificate also requires a controlled Taylor remainder. This is neither a universal response oracle nor a universal hidden-system inference algorithm.

Resources and robustness: a dense explicit generator uses O(n^2 log(r+2)) bits and O(r n^2) character operations to construct; output and acquisition are charged, not polylogarithmic in r. The exporter uses signed 64-bit integer arrays with overflow guards and quadratic dense output. Reflection-paired ladder amplitudes in [1/2,1] preserve the stated separation up to constants; generic microscopic errors can create shorter observation loops. Realizing the dense rates, justifying the field response, measuring small signals, calibrating errors, optimizing sample complexity and characterizing broad efficient observable/control algebras remain unresolved.

Prior credits are preserved explicitly: Skinner--Dunkel arXiv:2011.08765 for dissipation inference from apparently time-symmetric coarse graining; Cugliandolo--Dean--Kurchan cond-mat/9705002 for response/entropy-production connections; Shiraishi arXiv:2609.34352v1 for the eigenvalue-only counterexample; and the unreviewed ipitchford/hidden-dissipation-floor research candidate v1.1 for additive reversibilization and conditional past/future comparisons. The latter tools are reproved here; its broader claims are not imported as independently established theorems. No Astra or OpenAI/math theorem is a premise, and no topical link is promoted to a proof dependency. Combined historical priority has not been established.

N710-finite-seed-correlated-noise-channel-simulation | Finite-query noise bridges propose a paid finite-seed simulator for correlated-noise channels
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. Intake checked byte preservation and repository structure; no independent proof reconstruction, scientific-code replay, citation verification, formal proof, quantum circuit execution, or experimental validation was performed. External correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN.

Source-reported computational candidate: for an n-qubit H_X(t)=H_0+sum_(a=1)^r X_a(t)A_a with arbitrary Hermitian noncommuting supplied operators, independent stationary classical OU and/or symmetric telegraph modes, and an input initially independent of the noise, implement the complete noise-averaged channel to diamond error epsilon. With p supplied instruments at prescribed times, adaptive choices based on retained outcomes are allowed, uniformly over controllers unable to inspect the private seed. This is a derived unreviewed construction, not a demonstrated quantum circuit, physical quantum-bath model or universal speedup.

OU modes have dX=-lambda X dt+sqrt(2lambda)dW and covariance exp(-lambda|t-s|), with lambda=0 a static Gaussian. Telegraph modes switch at lambda/2 and have the same covariance, but their joint laws differ. Physical amplitudes belong in A_a. Actual controlled, inverse and indexed implementations of H_0/alpha_0 and A_a/alpha_a, parameter acquisition, selection, coefficient loading and finite precision are charged in C_sel(b). Set S=sum alpha_a and action Acal=1+p+T(alpha_0+S). The proposed gate bound is O-tilde(Acal C_sel+Acal^2)+C_ctrl, hiding fixed polynomials in parameter bits and logarithms of r+2, 1+lambda_max T, 1+Acal and 1/epsilon, with no grid-size power. It does not promise preparation of a full density matrix or fine trajectory.

On M=2^m grid cells, stationary OU endpoints and conditional midpoints are generated by a binary bridge. For half-width h and a=exp(-lambda h), X_mid=a(X_left+X_right)/(1+a^2)+sqrt[(1-a^2)/(1+a^2)]Z_node. Opposite telegraph endpoints give an unbiased midpoint; equal endpoints x give -x with probability (1-a)^2/[2(1+a^2)]. A queried value visits at most m+2 innovations, consistently addressed by mode/tree node, with stable Gaussian recursion 2a/(1+a^2)<=1. This constructs joint laws, not merely covariance; classical virtual Brownian trees are credited prior work.

For coupled paths, diamond error <=2 integral sum alpha_a E|X_a-Y_a| dt, including instruments before conditioning. Let C_G=sum_G alpha_a sqrt(lambda_a), C_R=sum_R alpha_a lambda_a and Delta=T/M. Left-grid error <=2sqrt(2)T sqrt(Delta)C_G+2T Delta C_R. A sufficient grid has M>=C[1+T^3 C_G^2/epsilon^2+T^2 C_R/epsilon], plus M>=C Lambda T(1+p/epsilon) for segmentation/control rounding. The huge grid is represented by log M bits. Finite Gaussian quantiles use antisymmetric rounding, truncation and polynomial-bit inverse-CDF evaluation with mean-zero squared approximation error <=eta^2; unit l2 coefficient sums keep each grid-value error bounded by eta. Finite telegraph thresholds charge log(rM/epsilon) bits without visiting all nodes. A final deterministic Gaussian cap B=ceil(sqrt[2log(64(1+ST)/epsilon)]) gives Lambda=alpha_0+B sum_G alpha_a+sum_R alpha_a. All channel-error estimates are first proved under fully independent innovations.

For piecewise constant cells in a segment d, the ordered k-fold Dyson integral equals d^k/k! times the expectation of the sorted-cell product, including repeated cell indices; no noise differentiability is assumed. Established truncated-Dyson simulation, uniform binary time registers, reversible sorting and oblivious amplification yield q=O[(1+p+Lambda T)log((1+p+Lambda T)/epsilon)] Hamiltonian calls. Padded intervals do not advance the physical noise clock. Including bridge computation and uncomputation gives a fixed innovation-query bound Q=8q(m+2), chosen before the seed family, avoiding a random-budget circularity.

The established bounded-query replacement lemma, also proved in the report by degree-2Q output-density polynomials, says a Q-query quantum circuit has exactly the same averaged output channel under a 2Q-wise independent uniform innovation function as under a fully independent table. It retains references and measurement records, but does not approximate the complete path distribution. A degree-(2Q-1) polynomial over F_(2^b) supplies the function on D=O(r(M+1)) addresses. Uniform coefficient registers remain private; reversible Horner evaluation costs O(Q poly(b)) per call and O(Q^2 poly(b)) total, with O(Qb) seed/workspace. A deterministic quadratic field tower with trace-one elements pays finite-field construction. Scratch is uncomputed so it leaks no extra information outside the query model. Short-seed values need not be globally Gaussian or Markovian; exact circuit-output equality is applied only after the independent-law approximation proof.

Precision b=O[B_in+m+log((r+2)(q+1)(1+ST)/epsilon)] is rounded to a power of two with enlarged arithmetic/synthesis constants. The explicit gate cost is O[q C_sel(b)+Q^2 poly(b)]+C_ctrl, workspace n+O(q a_sel+Q poly(b))+W_ctrl. Coefficient reading, selector compilation and expanded circuit output are charged. For O(n) bounded-locality terms/modes a scan selector costs O(n poly(b)); at T=O(1/J), sigma=O(J), p=O(n), the proposed bound is O-tilde(n^2)+C_ctrl. No QRAM or fine-noise array is assumed. This is a many-body workload, not an exponential advantage inferred from a single-excitation state space.

The same seed persists through interventions, retaining outcome-conditioned future noise memory. With coherent input preparation/inverse cost C_in and bounded effect implementation cost C_F, additive-delta estimation costs O-tilde[(G(delta)+C_in+C_F)delta^-1 log(1/zeta)]; copies-only access instead incurs delta^-2 sampling. Bell preparation/readout for control entanglement fidelity costs O(n) plus the ideal control/inverse. Amplitude estimation acts on the already compiled accurate circuit, not an unlimited noise service. Tiny conditional outputs and full classical tomography remain separately charged.

Competent comparators are explicit: amplitude encodings of stochastic paths are not free coherent binary-value oracles; Gaussian pseudomodes may be preferable and do not automatically reproduce non-Gaussian telegraph laws. Telegraph noise has an exact r-qubit Markovian embedding with H_ext=H_0+sum A_a tensor Z_a and L_a=sqrt(lambda_a/2)X_a, with general normalized Lindblad time T(alpha_0+S+sum lambda_a/2). The candidate trades quadratic Hamiltonian action for removal of leading switching-rate cost in its uniform upper bound. Moderate rates or certified fast-noise averaging can favor specialized methods. No lower-bound separation or superiority over all specialized algorithms is proved.

Independent signs and (a,b,ab) have identical one/two-variable marginals but three commuting sign pulses give order-one channel discrepancy; resetting a static Gaussian each cell removes dephasing; a short-seed full table can be far from the independent law; and fixed integrated white-noise strength makes amplitudes grow as sqrt(lambda). These failures delimit the operation. Prescribed classical noise is not a finite-temperature quantum bath with backreaction/detailed balance. Parameter learning, hardware-oracle certification, full circuit execution and formal verification remain absent. The exact prompt/process/report and recovered citation targets are preserved without repairing the pasted source. Reported small diagnostics are not independent general-proof or priority evidence. Earlier N701/N704 investigations are retained conversation capital, explicitly not proof premises; the exploratory impurity-spectroscopy remark is process history, not a promoted separate discovery.

N711-global-thermal-information-localized-adjoint-anticancellation | A localized-adjoint argument proposes global thermal conditioning under bounded candidate incidence
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. Intake checked byte preservation and repository structure; no independent proof reconstruction, scientific-code replay, citation verification, formal proof, quantum circuit execution, or experimental validation was performed. Source-reported global theorem candidate: distinct canonical-sign nonidentity Pauli strings P_a on n qubits, support size <=k and candidate incidence max_i #{a:i in supp P_a}<=Delta (including zero-coefficient candidates), H(h)=sum h_a P_a with max_i sum_(a:i in supp P_a)|h_a|<=g, beta>0 and an unrestricted full-rank Gibbs state rho_h. For every real u, A=sum u_aP_a and A_c=A-Tr(rho A)I, the manuscript proposes centered KMS norm squared >=c||u||_2^2 and therefore BKM covariance >=c||u||_2^2, c=exp[-C_(k,Delta)(1+beta g)^2]. C is finite/constructive, independent of n,m, signs, gaps and mixing, but potentially extremely conservative. No commutation, frustration exclusion, high temperature or correlation-decay assumption is made. This is an unreviewed derivation with unknown independent correctness/priority, not a validated new physical law or end-to-end learning advantage.

This directly follows up N705's recorded global cancellation obstruction. The earlier local spectral-multiplicity theorem is reproved in the new manuscript; the N705 unreviewed card is not assumed as a proof premise. A reciprocal continuation notice exposes the candidate follow-up while preserving N705's original source, claim status and historical unresolved gate. The newer proposed proof does not certify closure of that independent-review obligation and does not invalidate the earlier local theorem or its dimension counterexample.

With Hhat=H/g and b=beta g (the g=0 case handled directly), one-site Pauli commutators are supported on at most s=1+Delta(k-1) sites. The reconstructed local input gives kappa_b=4exp(-4bs)/(9*2^s), and Pauli orthogonality yields sum_(i,alpha)||[Q_(i,alpha),A]||_K^2>=8 kappa_b||u||_2^2. This gradient floor alone does not prevent global cancellation.

Gaussian-filtered B_(j,omega)=(2pi)^(-1/2)integral exp(-t^2/2-iomega t) exp(it Hhat)Q_j exp(-it Hhat)dt satisfy exp(zHhat)B_omega exp(-zHhat)=exp(zomega+z^2/2)B_(omega+z). The exact KMS adjoint of partial_omega(X)=[B_omega,X] is exp(-bomega/2+b^2/8)B_(-omega+b/2)Y-exp(bomega/2+b^2/8)Y B_(-omega-b/2). With w_b=exp[-(1+b)|omega|], G_j=integral w_b partial^sharp partial and G=sum_j G_j are exactly KMS self-adjoint, positive in that inner product and annihilate I. -G need not be completely positive, physical or rapidly mixing; those properties are not used to infer information.

On the bounded-degree candidate graph, Gaussian-filtered operators have radius-r approximants with arbitrarily fast fixed exponential spatial decay, at large size-independent prefactor. Short-imaginary-time nested-commutator bounds combine with spatial estimates to give joint shells <=C exp(-mu r)exp(-a|omega|), a=1/(8k). A Schur bound on K_(ia)=exp[-mu dist(i,S_a)] gives the coefficient-l2 residual sum_j||[R_(j,Omega),A]||_K^2<=T_const^2 exp(-2aOmega)||u||_2^2, without an n||u||_infinity^2 loss. Choosing Omega_b=O_(k,Delta)(1+b) yields D(A)=<A,GA>_K>=eta_b||u||_2^2 with eta_b=2kappa_b/L_(b,Omega_b)^2, L^2=(exp[(1+b)Omega]-1)/(pi(1+b)).

The decisive image lemma controls G on the bounded-incidence local interaction space. In <G_iP_a,G_jP_c>_K move the exact thermal adjoint first, giving <P_a,G_iG_jP_c>_K, then replace by disjoint local approximants whose product on P_c vanishes. Spatial errors and bounded graph volume make the transformed Gram rows summable; ordinary thermal covariance decay is not assumed. The proposed bound is ||GA||_K^2<=B_0 exp(b^2/4)||u||_2^2. Cauchy--Schwarz with GI=0 gives ||A_c||_K^2>=eta_b^2||u||_2^2/[B_0 exp(b^2/4)] and BKM dominates KMS by logarithmic/geometric means. The manuscript supplies explicit tail/image estimates, disconnected-component treatment and a sequential constant-construction recipe; intake has not independently verified them. The image lemma does not bound G on all operators.

Weighted-strength-only obstruction: for fixed beta,h,lambda>0, H_N=-h sum_(i=0)^N Z_i-(lambda/N)Z_0 sum_(j=1)^N Z_j, with all displayed couplings nonzero and incident strength <=h+lambda. Set t=tanh(beta h), A_N=N^-1 sum Z_0Z_j-tZ_0. Its coefficient norm squared is t^2+1/N, while commuting BKM variance <=1/N+(beta lambda)^2/N^2. The ratio tends to zero. This is a classical two-local counterexample with growing center incidence; it excludes weighted strength alone, not the bounded-candidate-incidence theorem.

On a convex coefficient domain satisfying the common strength bound, F=log Tr exp(-beta H) has Hessian >=beta^2 c I, ||h-h'||_2<=||m(h)-m(h')||_2/(beta c), and D(rho_h||rho_h')>=beta^2 c||h-h'||_2^2/2. The original local moments jointly identify coefficients with no additional system-size inverse-Lipschitz loss. Candidate overlap coloring chi<=k(Delta-1)+1 allows disjoint Pauli supports to be measured together with single-qubit basis measurements. Total l2 coefficient error <=epsilon is proposed with O[chi*m/(beta^2 c^2 epsilon^2)log(2m/p)] independent Gibbs copies; for RMS coefficient error m^(-1/2)||hhat-h||_2<=epsilon the m factor disappears. This is not a uniform per-coefficient infinity-norm guarantee.

Acquisition, computation and bit costs remain separate. Gibbs copies must actually be prepared independently and readout/model bias controlled. Dense F/gradient evaluation uses dimension 2^n, illustrative O(8^n+m4^n) arithmetic operations and O(4^n) memory, not a bit-complexity advantage. Inexact gradients need an error budget tied to beta^2 c epsilon. A polynomial count of ideal gradient calls for fixed physical parameters can still require exponentially expensive calls. No generic efficient preparation, complete reconstruction or superiority over current arbitrary-temperature algorithms is established.

The source compares only specified bounds: the 2021 Anshu--Arunachalam--Kuwahara--Soleimanifar geometric-lattice Hessian with 1/m loss, and Learning SYK Hamiltonians Appendix D/Theorem D.1 with 1/[m(1+log(2m))] loss for bounded incidence, not dense SYK. It credits prior commuting/high-temperature conditioning, arbitrary-temperature learning, KMS/Fourier technology and finite-range Lieb--Robinson arguments. Bergamaschi's stationarity entropy-production Fisher information is a different functional from equilibrium BKM covariance. Exact literature versions and applicability are preserved in the original bibliography, not independently cleared by intake.

One-qubit sech^2(beta h) suppression forbids temperature-independent or polynomial-beta universal floors; the quadratic exponent is not claimed optimal. The theorem neither bounds the largest covariance eigenvalue nor proves clustering or absence of phase transitions. A fixed-charge sector has exact null directions outside the unrestricted Gibbs interface. Growing degree, constrained systems and better coefficient geometry need new theorems. The original recovered ZIP, LaTeX, PDF, script and recorded six algebraic/quadrature, 24 covariance and seven analytic-star checks remain exact producer artifacts. Floating tolerances and archive integrity are not proofs, independent review, physical validation or novelty clearance; no archived scientific script was executed.

N712-local-readout-thermal-information-loss-and-variance-certificate | Fixed local Pauli readout has bounded additive thermal-information loss and a variance-only certificate
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. Candidate scope: H(h)=H_bg+sum_a h_a P_a, with distinct canonical nonidentity Pauli parameter strings, support<=k and candidate incidence<=Delta including zero coefficients. At the operating point the full H has support<=ell and per-site incident operator-norm strength<=g; the fixed background need not have bounded combinatorial degree. The state is an unrestricted full-rank Gibbs state at known beta>0. No commutation, lattice, high-temperature, clustering, gap or mixing hypothesis is imposed. The result concerns equilibrium Hamiltonian-parameter Fisher information, not unitary phase encoding or simultaneous multiparameter SLD attainability.

One fixed parameter-independent protocol measures independent uniformly random X/Y/Z bases on each independent Gibbs copy, retaining bases and outcomes. Detector sign errors must be independently calibrated across sites and copies, with visibility eta_i>=eta>0 and no parameter dependence; quantum outcomes need not be independent. The unbiased feature is Y_a=product_{i in S_a}(3 s_i/eta_i)1{basis_i=(P_a)_i}. Let C be BKM covariance, V=Cov(Y), F_loc the full recorded classical Fisher matrix and F_Q the SLD matrix. For nu=[1+k(Delta-1)] [(3/eta^2)^k-1]+(beta g/3)k(k+ell)Delta, the source derives 0<=V-C<=nu I, beta^2 C(C+nu I)^(-1)C<=F_loc<=F_Q<=beta^2 C, and 0<=beta^2 C-F_loc<=beta^2 nu I, hence 0<=F_Q-F_loc<=beta^2 nu I. All inequalities use positive-semidefinite order. The constants are size-independent at fixed structural/physical parameters, not optimized.

Proof spine: measurement covariance excess N=V-V_q is positive and exactly zero between disjoint supports, preserving long-range quantum correlations; overlap counting bounds its row sums. The established Brooks-Harris inequality bounds V_q-C by beta/12 times the thermal double commutator. Support/weighted-strength Schur counting gives W<=4g k(k+ell)Delta I. Gibbs response Cov(Y,score)=-beta C and a Schur complement transfer covariance to actual information. C(C+R)^(-1)C-(C-R)=R(C+R)^(-1)R>=0 needs no commutation. These ingredients are credited prior work; the assembled theorem and its priority remain unreviewed. The main proof uses no Gaussian locality or covariance-floor lemma from N711.

For u with ||u||_2^2=O(n), additional optimal quantum readout information is at most O(n). If u^T F_Q u/||u||^2 diverges with beta,g,k,ell,Delta,eta fixed, the local/optimal information ratio tends to one; enhanced scaling itself is not guaranteed. With f=u dot Y, v=Var(f), q=||u||^2, (v-nu q)_+<=u^T C u<=v. Thus beta^2(v-nu q)_+^2/v<=u^T F_loc u<=u^T F_Q u<=beta^2 v, lower endpoint zero if v=0. The same variance gives static-susceptibility bounds. The scalar sample mean is asymptotically competitive at enhanced response, with the displayed locally unbiased estimator requiring separately acquired reference mean and slope; finite-displacement bias is outside its variance formula.

Acquisition: |f|<=L_u=(3/eta)^k||u||_1. Paired independent samples Z=(f_1-f_2)^2/2 estimate v; M>=2 L_u^4 zeta^(-2) log(2/p) pairs suffice for additive variance error zeta at failure p. Each copy costs n actual single-qubit measurements and O(n+km) arithmetic; streaming scalar processing is possible. Independent Gibbs preparation, equilibration, calibration, preparation bias, correlated sampling, model/temperature/strength verification and global fitting remain separate costs. The theorem supplies no inexpensive Gibbs sampler or efficient global likelihood optimizer.

Failures delimit the theorem: a single common detector flip bit on a low-temperature mean-field commuting family keeps positive marginal visibility but loses Omega(n^2) Fisher information. A one-qubit H=xX+zZ example has an indefinite observed negative-log-likelihood Hessian despite positive covariance. Independent maximally mixed Z-field qubits have fixed-readout loss proportional to n. Positive additive protection does not prevent a poorly conditioned direction from remaining poorly conditioned.

Only the all-directions corollary depends on the unreviewed N711 floor: if, in its exact original bounded-incidence setting, C>=c I with c=exp[-C_(k,Delta)(1+beta g)^2], then F_loc>=[c/(c+nu)] beta^2 C>=[c/(c+nu)] F_Q. This is a conditional scoped transfer, not a dependency of the main readout result or independent validation of N711. Existing classical shadows, noisy shadows, thermal inequalities, quantum variance and learning algorithms are credited. No physical sensing demonstration, formal proof, priority clearance or matched superiority is established.

One success event covers all supports and rational severities, hence unlimited adaptive queries even inspecting the sketch. For a finite undirected signed multigraph with n vertices, m>=1 edges, edge signs in F2 and explicitly supplied independent rational retention probabilities p_e, the source proposes a relative-error FPRAS for U=Pr[retained graph contains an odd-sign cycle]. Total probability encoding length B is charged. Initially 0<p_e<1; deterministic endpoint handling and negative loops/parallel edges are described on page 7. A balanced full graph is detected separately as U=0. This is an internally derived, unreviewed proof candidate, not a demonstrated approximation implementation.

Global saturation is the essential interface: labels are 0, o and (u,v,s), u<v, s in F2, with N=2+2 binom(n,2). E_0 is all edge sets, E_o the odd-cycle event, and E_(u,v,s) is the union of that event with existence of a simple u-v path of sign s. An odd cycle anywhere, including in a remote component, makes every label feasible. In a balanced edge set a feasible pair must be connected with its unique path sign. These are signed-equation logical entailment sectors; this is not an unsaturated affine-fiber chain or a general XOR-system result. With q_a=Pr(E_a), valid label sums satisfy E_a intersect E_b subset E_(a+b) and q_(a+b)>=q_a q_b. If b=a+A_e then q_b>=p_e q_a and q_a>=p_e q_b.

Candidate mechanism: pi(a,F)=mu(F)/(N q_a), K=I/2+K_edge/6+K_walk/6+K_hub/6. Edge heat bath, tagged edge/mode involutions with Metropolis–Hastings acceptance and an odd-sector hub are specified; parallel physical edge identity is retained. Deterministic BFS paths and DFS odd fundamental cycles are peeled in reverse inspection order to an independent product-law zero-label anchor, length <=m+1. An omitted-edge complementary hybrid replays the adaptive inspection and reconstructs both source and anchor. The erased certificate has valid syndrome a+b, giving encoded mass <=q_(a+b)<=q_a/q_b without a rank/nullity correction. Odd-source demands are merged before encoding. Reported channel congestion R=24Nm and length m+1, together with an imported root-layer flow lemma, yield the candidate gap >=1/[96Nm(m+1)]. These universal inequalities require independent proof review; finite route checks do not certify them.

Acquisition and implementation: no conditional rare-event sampling oracle is assumed. Positive weights c_a within factor four of 1/q_a define the implementable chain; the source invokes an imported comparison lemma with gap loss <=4096. Independent draws restart at (0,F), F~mu, warmness <=16N. Annealing p_e^(k)=max{p_e,beta^k}, beta=1-1/(2 max{1,n}), uses L=O(nB) levels and no chain at the all-one level. Label-frequency ratios q_a=r_a/(c_a r_0), c_0=1, normalize absolute probabilities at each level; errors do not telescope multiplicatively. For relative error epsilon and failure delta, M=O(N(L+epsilon^-2) log(N(L+1)/delta)) draws use O(MNm(m+1) log(NM/delta)) transitions plus M product initializations. Each transition charges O(n+m) graph operations and rational arithmetic; initialization O(Mm). Per-draw total variation <=delta/(4M), concentration <=delta/2 and capped random/arithmetic error <=delta/4 are separately budgeted. Page 6 supplies polynomial rational bit lengths and an explicit conservative bit-work bound, with zero-count abort and capped rejection or finite-precision alternative. Exact Bernoulli generation has expected polynomial cost; strict polynomial runtime requires the stated cap/failure accounting. The probabilities, their independent-law promise and any needed planar embedding are supplied/computational inputs; physical failure-probability acquisition/calibration is outside this bound.

Planar corollary, conditional on the main candidate: for a finite plane graph and two terminals, sign dual edges by crossing a fixed primal s-t path and retain dual edges with the physical failure probabilities. Disconnection is equivalent to an odd-sign dual cycle, including dual loops for primal bridges. This would approximate rare planar unreliability directly with relative error, rather than subtract an approximate reliability from one. Embedding supply/construction is charged. The elementary reduction is not claimed novel. It does not establish general nonplanar or correlated-failure unreliability.

Reported diagnostics: page 8 summarizes 143,528 base paths and 517,912 transition encodings in a first campaign; a second summarizes 157,956 routes over 12 cases, including U=10^-15. They cover gauge-inequivalent K4 signings, remote odd components, loops, parallel edges and small-probability examples. Reported congestion ratios stay below 24Nm. No scripts, raw receipts, random seeds or full annealed sampler outputs accompany this PDF; none were replayed. These summaries are not independent reproduction, all-input verification, practical acceleration or an established technological capability.

Imported premises: Feng, Fu and Guo, “Approximating two-terminal network reliability”, arXiv:2608.02523, specifically Lemma 17 (root-layer flow) and Lemma 16 (comparison). The PDF cites Lemmas 16–20 as its framework. The cited paper/theorem hypotheses and constants have not been independently checked in this intake. Originality remains open. For a fixed universal Turing machine U, the source proposes a fixed finite canonical phase space, homogeneous quartic K with computable coefficients, homogeneous quadratic observable O and effective exact initial encoding w->z_w. For every rational 0<eta<1, an effectively chosen rational epsilon>0 yields H_eta(z)=||z||^2/2+epsilon K(z)/(1+||z||^2)^2 with global Hessian bounds (1-eta)I <= Hess H <= (1+eta)I. The flow is complete and radius-conserving. All encoded inputs have common radius 1<R^2<2 and common energy R^2/2. Along them O lies in [0,1] and tends to the halting bit: nonhalting inputs always have O<=64/1025<1/8; halting inputs eventually have O>=3/4. This is a complete source-reported constructive proof candidate relative to one published simulator theorem, not independently established correctness or originality.

Mechanism: a polynomial field satisfying x dot Y(x)=0 globally is written Y=A(x)x with polynomial skew A from homogeneous derivatives. The unsymmetrized feature map Psi=(1,x,...,x^tensor L), N=sum_{j=0}^L n^j, gives an exact quadratic skew system Q(v)=B(v)v with fixed anchor. K(q,p)=p dot F(q)-q dot F(p), F(v)=v_0 Q(v), is quartic, Poisson-commutes exactly with the isotropic oscillator, and carries F on p=0. The bounded rational radial factor gives ||Hess[K/(1+r^2)^2]||<=72C for coefficient absolute-sum bound C. The exact trajectory is (v(lambda t) cos t,-v(lambda t) sin t), lambda=epsilon/(1+R^2)^2. Quadratic anchor decoders q_0q_i+p_0p_i recover features without an averaging remainder. The embedded object is a circle extension; the original dynamics are an exact observable factor, not an embedding without the extra phase.

The undecidability corollary imports CMP21 Theorem 3.1 (crediting GCB08), constructs coordinatewise circle compactifications with positive time changes, a fixed-gap halting pulse and a bounded polynomial latch/logistic bit which always tends to zero or one. No infinite computation is collapsed into finite time. After another bounded time change and normalization the tangent polynomial system fits the lift. The input-to-limit map and long-time average are noncomputable even though every encoded limit exists and is binary. This is noncomputability of the input-dependent map, not of each individual binary number. No total computable event-time bound/convergence modulus or sound, complete, terminatingly checkable all-input safety-certificate system is proposed to exist; finite-horizon computable simulation is not excluded.

A separate quartic-polynomial alternative H=r^2/2+a r^4+epsilon K, a>3epsilon C_bar, remains globally strongly convex with pointwise Hessian condition-number bound (3a+3epsilon C_bar)/(a-3epsilon C_bar), at most 4 for a=15epsilon C_bar. Its Hessian is unbounded at infinity: this is not the analytic variant's global near-identity smoothness bound. It has cubic Hamiltonian vector field, a different fixed common energy and the same decoder. Coefficients are computable, not all asserted rational; the clock includes pi.

Scope/resources: dimension and tensor compiler may be enormous; no efficient universal coefficient table, memory advantage or practical speedup is supplied. Initial points are exact computable recipes, not rational-only or fixed-resolution preparations. The coordinate/time changes can be slow and eta->0 slows simulation. The invariant encoding is exceptional and lower-dimensional; no positive-volume basin, fault tolerance or persistent-noise bound is proved. The sufficient finite-horizon error estimate e^(eta t)||delta z(0)||+(nu/eta)(e^(eta t)-1) is not an infinite-horizon robustness theorem or precision lower bound. General mixed position-momentum Hamiltonians are allowed; the subclass |p|^2/2+V(q) for convex V is not covered. No new physical law, buildable device, quantum result or super-Turing technology follows. Published cotangent/universal dynamics are credited; the proposed conjunction and historical priority remain open.

A query chooses |S|<=k and an explicit rational polyhedron in (C_Sx,a,z), with a nonnegative objective psi having an explicit convex-QP formulation, to minimize x^T Hx+psi subject to Ax=Fa. Arbitrary nonlinear functions are not free optimization oracles. The source proposes q=O([k log(eM/k)+log(1/delta)]/epsilon^2) random response rows plus d load responses, giving one simultaneous 1-delta guarantee for every support and adaptive query: exact local feasibility, relative optimal value and near-optimal feasible extension. Online arithmetic is O(qk^2+kd+d^2) plus one QP in O(k+d+dim z) variables, with its bit complexity charged. This remains a derived unreviewed algorithmic candidate, not a general nonlinear mechanics or unrestricted topology solver.

Mechanism: K=H^-1-H^-1 A^T(AH^-1 A^T)^-1 A H^-1, X=H^-1 A^T(AH^-1 A^T)^-1 F, Q0=X^T H X. The partial energy is a^T Q0 a+(y-D_S a)^T Gamma_S^+(y-D_S a), exactly on y-D_S a in range(Gamma_S), with D_S=C_S X and Gamma_S=C_S K C_S^T; elsewhere it is infinite. This established minimization identity is not the proposed novelty. Random rows are acquired through the unchanged constrained host solver and repaired via jhat=v-TAv with exact rational AT=I before forming stored products. Charged power-of-four normalization, rounding, repair and precision preserve homogeneous constraints exactly and give a relative PSD geometry bound with exact nullspace even near singularity. Independently rounding the stored final products would destroy the promise.

Multiple loads require a repaired frame A Xhat=F and (Xhat-X)^T H(Xhat-X)<=eta^2 Q0. A certified positive lower bound for Q0 and sufficient column-solve precision are acquired at preprocessing; near-dependent loads cost bits. Individual feasible column solves alone fail for cancelling combinations. With repaired Dhat, Qhat and Gammahat, the full affine feasible domain is unchanged and Ehat/E is between (1-eta-2eta^2)/(1+theta) and (1+eta+2eta^2)/(1-theta), uniformly over every feasible a,y. Parameterizing y=Dhat_S a+Gammahat_S t gives an explicit possibly degenerate convex QP without regularization. Nonnegative psi preserves relative guarantees through minimization. A separate origin-feasible passive force-driven value obeys V/kappa<=Vsafe<=V, kappa=(1+theta)/(1-theta); exact active sets/forces near transitions are not certified.

Full-state output is a separate task: sketch vectors alone need not minimize physical energy. Baseline residual refinement with exact conservation repair, followed by exact sketch correction, is claimed to yield a near-optimal state with both constraints exact. Additional work is O(log((p+2)/zeta)[T_base(zeta)+nnz(C_S)+k^2]+Nq+Nd), plus small rational systems and output bits. Every large solve uses the unchanged host; outputting N entries remains paid. General preprocessing charges fixed-host factorization P_base, exact repair P_T and (q+d)[T_base+T_T+nnz(G)+nnz(C)] plus p d^2; local storage O(M(q+d)+d^2), with additional O(N(q+d)) for field recovery. Online randomness is absent; preprocessing uses pq fair signs. Stored-number bit lengths, right inverses, small eigenvalues/output multiplier bits and local QP description size are not assumed constant.

A source-model application is an elastic truss in complementary force variables, H=diag(ell_e/(E_e a_e)). Local queries include tension-only/capacity/removal constraints, nonnegative additional compliance, squared-hinge responses and continuous convex capacities. It does not simulate plastic history, infer uncertain geometry/parameters or search all binom(M,k) supports. For specified two-dimensional bounded-range separator layouts and an inexpensive exact equilibrium repair, the reported arithmetic preprocessing is O-tilde(N^(3/2)+Nq), using specialized nested-dissection costs rather than a dense baseline. Fixed known interfaces should use ordinary condensation; the intended advantage requires many adaptive interfaces, q<<M and mostly local outputs. High accuracy may eliminate any crossover.

Failure boundary: exact rational model feasibility is not exact physical feasibility under uncertain inputs. Negative quadratic corrections that cancel baseline energy can magnify error by theta/rho even when the final model remains convex; globally changing constitutive geometry and nonconvex instability require another representation. The supplied diagnostics report largest reduced-design true-objective ratio about1.00814, feasibility residual about1.3e-16, one recovery energy ratio about1.0000000246 and worst sketch geometry distortion about35.9%. The 64-row sketch is larger than the six-state host. Floating optimization diagnostics are distinct from exact algebra; no compression/performance at scale, full tolerance guarantee, independent correctness or major established capability is demonstrated.

For a bounded hidden row generator Q, visible indicators E, repeatable possibly nonstationary preparation nu and visible masses>=rho>0, define R=diag(nu), M=diag(nu E), A=E^T R Q E, L=M^-1 A and Gamma_nu=(QE-EL)^T R(QE-EL). Full support makes Gamma=0 equivalent to strong lumpability, not merely one stationary observed law being Markovian. The source proposes acquiring this residual without reconstructing Q or calibrating individual kinetic gains. This is a research proof candidate with supplied internal finite diagnostics; no physical experiment, independent correctness or historical priority is established.

Load-bearing interface: actual settings K_u have off-diagonal q_ij g_u(i,j), arbitrary nonnegative unknown heterogeneous gains, baseline g_0=1 and product settings with q_ij g_u g_v. A product setting is actuator composition, not a sequence of two pulses. Sequential pulses separately acquire mixed derivatives. Selective mode S requires all within-label gains exactly1 and sum w=0. Activity-complete mode A instead measures all microscopic jump events without identifying their endpoints and allows internal actuation. Visible changes alone are not an all-event counter. Every used primitive/product setting needs a supplied finite exit-rate bound; thermodynamic ratios do not supply the access assumptions.

Product moments make the hidden flux norm observable: E_a(w)=w^T H w-2b_a^T w+c_a=sum nu_i q_ij[sum w_u g_u(i,j)-(e_a(j)-e_a(i))/2]^2. H is measured from product cross-label activity in S or total microscopic activity in A; b,c from ordinary visible statistics. The synthesis error bounds |nu(W_a-V_a)Qe_b|<=2Lambda^(3/2)sqrt(E_a), for signed zero-row-sum mathematical response V_a and W_a=sum w_u K_u; no signed-rate physical generator is requested. With mixed-time T_ab and C''_ab, <Qe_a,Qe_b>_nu=T_ab-C''_ab-2nu V_a Qe_b. Thus ||sym(Gammatilde)-Gamma||_op<=4k Lambda^(3/2) max_a sqrt(E_a). The T term is essential outside stationarity.

Control adequacy is acquired by a p-dimensional convex quadratic program minimizing E_a over ||w||_1<=W (zero sum in S). A PSD-inflated noisy upper certificate remains valid uniformly for data-fitted coefficients and returns inconclusive when requirements fail; nearly dependent controls and large W increase cost. For arbitrary finite monomial products of compact gain signatures Z, the best completion error is flux mass times conditional variance of the target given Z. In S the Z=1 atom contributes its full target square. This exactly characterizes this polynomial completion operation, not all possible experimental identification. Gain collisions cannot be repaired by degree. Separated scalar gain bands admit an explicit filter with D=O(g^-2 log(1/(g delta))), but coefficients grow like5^((D+1)/2) and product rates like2^(2D); polynomial accuracy cost at fixed band gap is not a joint polynomial bound in inverse gap.

Acquisition is finite, not a derivative oracle: corrected indicators require a known full-rank sensor channel, independent readout noise across times and magnitude<=kappa; repeated-time products use one indicator. Normalize a supplied common rate Rmax, choose tau=eta^2 rho^2/[10^6(p+1)k^4(1+W)^2], h=tau/(100k), beta=tau h^2/(100k), and use finite differences and O(p^2 k^2 kappa^4 beta^-2 log(pk/(zeta beta))) preparation trials. The roughly eta^-12 dependence is conservative and potentially enormous. Preparation/mixing waits, TV reproducibility bias, timing/switching, product rates and finite precision are charged. No minimum hidden-state mass or hidden size enters that stated sample bound. Approximate product flux error xi adds xi||w||_1^2 to squared certificates; unobserved internal residual adds W^2 eps_int^2 and must be bounded or measured.

A finite tested action library Q^j has acquired L^j,Gamma^j. Exact zero plus full support yields visible-history feedback closure for those actions and their convex mixtures. For approximate closure, every deployed hidden marginal must be dominated by C nu; then whole observed-path TV<=C T sqrt((k-1)sum_j tr Gamma^j), with rate/initial errors added. Coverage is supplied, not inferred from a small residual, and unprobed actions are not covered. A uniform path bound epsilon gives bounded-reward optimal-value error<=epsilon and reduced-policy regret<=2epsilon+beta; policy computation remains a separate task. Bounded pure-jump Borel kernels extend the algebra with nu-almost-everywhere closure and dominated deployments, not arbitrary diffusions or exploding rates.

The producer exact example fits degree4 coefficients of l1 norm105/2 from visible moments, giving zero synthesis residual and Gamma=(5/384)[[1,-1],[-1,1]] under nonstationary nu. The gain-collision residual is117/880; source-clock false cross-only closure is exposed by all-event access with residual1/24. The note preserves passive-equivalence/source-clock impossibility: arbitrary observed-only source clocks cannot distinguish matched passive laws. Finite examples and six floating mixed-time diagnostics do not instantiate the full noisy sampler or a laboratory control protocol. Next gates are actuator/product/event-access validation, sample-cost practicality, independent proof/priority review and deployment coverage.

For an explicitly represented finite source-target DAG with independent exponential activity durations, strictly positive rational rates and a rational deadline T supplied exactly in binary, the manuscript proposes a randomized polynomial-bit algorithm for U=Pr(longest source-target duration >=T). For rational epsilon>0 and 0<delta<1 it would output a binary rational ell with Pr[|ell-ln U|<=epsilon]>=1-delta when U>0, in time/bit work polynomial in graph size, total input bits, 1/epsilon and log(1/delta). It outputs -infinity for U=0 and ell=0 for T<=0 when a path exists. Missing path means U=0 by convention; for T>0 zero-only paths do not contribute. It computes log U without materializing a potentially enormous probability denominator. This is a proof candidate, not validated software or an established algorithmic advance.

Mechanism: order relevant activities by (rate,index), partition paths by their minimum-rate anchor, and use a topological skip/select scan rather than scanning in rate order. At most 2n union components comprise anchored overruns A_i with all other class coordinates <T, and single-activity tails B_j={X_j>=T}. For anchor rate lambda, integrate X_i exactly: Pr(A_i)=exp(-lambda T) product_j C_j * p_i, C_j=lambda_j integral_0^T exp[-(lambda_j-lambda)x]dx. The remaining independent q_j densities on [0,T] are decreasing (uniform at equal rates). With S the sum of class non-anchor coordinates and L the longest class path excluding the anchor, R=S-min(L,T)>=0 and p_i=E_q exp(-lambda R)=Pr[omitted path cost<=E AND S<=T+E], E~Exp(lambda). For m non-anchor coordinates p_i>=rho=1/[4 max(1,m lambda T)^m]; rho has polynomial encoding length, not necessarily inverse-polynomial numerical size. m=0 is handled directly.

The crucial smoothing is Pr_q[D(ae,ab)]>=a^m Pr_q[D(e,b)] for 0<a<=1, where D is the downward event with omitted and total resource budgets. It uses decreasing continuous densities and simultaneous scaling BEFORE atomization. It is not a theorem for arbitrary finite-atomic two-budget laws or the original heterogeneous tail. Comparator discretization has step tau/lambda and polynomially many cells from log(1/(tau rho)). Atomization clamps below ell_grid=tau rho/(m d_max), uses g=1+tau/[10m(m+1)] exactly, and rounds both cumulative resources upward. Each resource is bounded by g^(m+1) times its exact value outside the charged small-coordinate event. Retain the first resource point >=2mT, plus zero and absorbing overflow rejection. Endpoint, anchor phase and zero-connector epsilon-elimination preserve path legality and one read per independent activity; no path enumeration or subset determinization is assumed.

Dyadic coordinate laws need polynomial ABSOLUTE precision depending on log(1/rho); use disjoint integer-interval binary decoders with a common denominator 2^b. An ordinary polynomial-size NFA at a polynomial unary word length counts accepted words ONCE, not nondeterministic accepting runs. The sole stated external algorithmic theorem is Arenas–Croquevielle–Jayaram–Riveros #NFA FPRAS (JACM 2021). Conditional generation may self-reduce prefix counts. Jitter accepted atoms under original truncated densities and comparator cells, then set X_i=(T-L)_+ +Z, Z~Exp(lambda), and draw outside-class coordinates from their original laws. A component-weighted union estimator averages 1/M(X) over true containing components, at most K<=2n; log-scale weights avoid huge denominators. Approximate counts, conditional laws, membership failures, concentration and final logarithms have separate budgets. The K symbol for comparator cells in Section 4 is distinct from the union-component K elsewhere.

Finite-bit guards: a rational sampled vector is not asserted close in total variation to a continuous law. Dyadic/word errors couple at word level; conditional jitter uses finite enclosures coupled to ideal continuous variables. Density/conditioning bounds and a union bound over at most 2^n path edge sets give u=zeta rho/[100 n 2^n D] of polynomial bit length for unambiguous membership outside charged exceptions. Coordinates, longest paths and shifted anchors use enclosing intervals; inverse CDF, exponent/log cutoffs, tails, near-equal rates and confidence amplification are charged. If a comparison remains ambiguous or M=0, use a bounded fallback charged to the failure budget. Optional negligible-component omission requires a guarded K-dependent log-gap cutoff and retained-component membership throughout. These all-input precision and runtime guarantees require independent reconstruction.

Scope/acquisition: edge activities or standard vertex splitting with deterministic zero connectors are allowed. Each independent activity occurs at most once per DAG path. Excluded are cycles, correlated durations, repeated physical activities at multiple positions, positive deterministic offsets, arbitrary implicitly specified path families and general finite-atomic two-budget problems. Graph, exact rates and independence/model validity are supplied promises; empirical rate acquisition/calibration, model uncertainty and real project performance are not established. No practical speed or technological readiness follows from the asymptotic candidate.

Evidence: page 6 reports 15,625 exact anchored-union assignments on one six-edge DAG with tied/unequal rates and 10,000 four-coordinate/select-pattern rounding combinations, all assertions passed. No verifier, raw outputs or full sampler implementation accompanies the PDF; nothing was replayed. Page 1 says a separate mathematical check reported no fatal gap after guards, but no review artifact, reviewer identity or external certification is supplied. Preserve these as author reports, not independent verification. Initiating prompt, conversation relation, model, workers and inference expenditure remain UNKNOWN. No novelty claim is made by the manuscript; priority is unresolved.

Family fit: this belongs in the existing algorithms/combinatorics/complexity/networks/probability navigation with a distinct mechanism card. The manuscript explicitly says it is independent of the earlier saturated-transport candidate. N715-saturated-signed-entailment-odd-cycle-probability treats signed undirected product edge-retention, saturated entailment flows and planar unreliability; this draft treats exponential DAG duration tails through decreasing-density rounding and #NFA. It neither depends on, supersedes nor repairs N715. N171/N172 stopped-path/first-passage records concern different stochastic observations and birth-death regimes; they do not supply this finite-DAG counting theorem. Shared rare-event/network vocabulary is not a proven transfer.

An arbitrary final state rho (not assumed Gaussian) has N_ij=Tr(rho a_j^dagger a_i), N_ii=n. A balanced rank-r orthogonal projector P has P_ii=r/k, 1<=r<k, and PNP<=nu P for 0<=nu<n. Put b=(kn-r nu)/(k-r) and g(x)=(x+1)ln(x+1)-x ln x. The source internally proves S(rho)<=r g(nu)+(k-r)g(b) and the exact minimum free-energy increase W_bal=k_B T[k g(n)-r g(nu)-(k-r)g(b)]. The bound is attained by a gauge-invariant Gaussian state N_star=nu P+b(I-P), with hot thermal local marginals. Historical novelty of this specialization of established principles is UNKNOWN.

Proof spine: in an adapted mode basis t=Tr(PN)<=r nu; one-mode Gibbs relative entropy, subadditivity and concavity bound the entropy by r g(t/r)+(k-r)g((kn-t)/(k-r)). This increases up to t=r nu. The constructed independent collective thermal states followed by passive equal-frequency mixing attain it, and initial/final mean energies agree. W_bal is an average preparation-work lower bound and an ideal global quasistatic reversible-work infimum, not a finite-time/bounded-control work equality. Exact vacuum nu=0 requires a limiting preparation. For direct cooling of r modes with the others left at n, W_cold/(k_B T)=r[g(n)-g(nu)+(nu-n)ln(1+1/n)]; W_bal-W_cold=(k-r)k_B T D(tau_b||tau_n)>=0. The compared final local-port contracts differ; complete converters are not compared and engineering routing benefits are not excluded.

Delivery/acquisition: equal independent warm loss eta gives selected occupation eta nu+(1-eta)n. For one selected direction u and converter v, the occupation is nu+(b-nu)(1-|u^dagger v|^2). Equal carrier frequencies and ideal global controls are load-bearing; pumped frequency conversion, bath access, preparation, synchronization, phase stability and losses are paid interfaces. Common-bath dark modes, feedback, squeezed ancillas and alternative encodings change the contract and are not prohibited. Correlating past outputs does not automatically prepare fresh future Markov inputs.

The companion physical audit reconstructs a hot/cold splitter source b=(h+v)/sqrt(2), c=(h-v)/sqrt(2): both local occupations are n while their difference is the supplied cold mode. A favorable thermal attenuator with eta=0.8, n=100 and chi=0.999 has source-reported single-rail entanglement fidelity 0.86445 versus 0.02385 with independent hot inputs; 1% warm delivery loss reduces it to 0.62842. These are conditional model calculations, not acquired parameters or experiments, and establish no quantum capacity. The source explicitly retains unresolved causal return/delay and intrinsic bath access. Strong comparators are direct cooling using the same cold port and existing squeezed-ancilla feedback, with matched bandwidth, duty cycle, signal energy and total resources.

In a finite undirected network with supplied c_e>0 and terminals A,B, an admissible potential u_A=0,u_B=1 orients an exactly conserved unit flow j_e>=0 along strictly positive drops Delta_e. No incoming flow at A or outgoing flow at B is allowed; zero-drop edges require zero flow. Discrete integration by parts gives sum j_e Delta_e=1. Draw a path by normalized outgoing flows, then a uniform potential level: its crossing edge has q_e=j_e Delta_e. Acquiring/checking the graph, outgoing tables, conservation, monotonicity and paths is charged; explicit input generally costs O(|E|). This reconstructs classical principles, not a new variational theorem.

Only if every positive Dirichlet-energy edge has q_e>0 do a_e=c_e Delta_e/j_e and b_e=j_e/(c_e Delta_e) satisfy E_q a=E(u), E_q b=R(j), ab=1, giving 1/E_q b<=cap(A,B)<=E_q a. With two parallel edges c=(1,M), u=(0,1) and j=(1,0), q is normalized but sampled E_q a=1 misses cap=1+M. Feasibility and normalization do not certify the upper bound. In the continuum both Dirichlet and resistance energy measures require absolute continuity under q=j dot grad u, plus feasible traces/fluxes and tractable surface/streamline sampling. Globally certified bounds a<=A_*, b<=B_* yield Hoeffding enclosures; useful relative width still requires a small primal-dual gap and domination bounds relative to the means. Capacity is distinct from a transition rate (basin normalization needed) and from a pointwise committor probability.

Berman-Konsowa supplies the relevant stronger existing path-flow baseline cap>=E_path[(sum j_e/c_e)^(-1)], at least the Thomson endpoint by Jensen. The source compares series and parallel examples and reports no advantage. Zero-variance harmonic fields do not supply cheap field acquisition or certify an approximate sampler's coverage. The remaining opening is a specified structured model with acquired exact feasible flows, global overlap and tail bounds, not an unspecific rarity-independent promise.

Separate exact oracle obstruction: M parallel two-edge channels each have both conductances w_i. Known gamma>0 and 0<epsilon<1 promise all w_i=gamma/M or one hidden J at gamma/M+2 epsilon gamma. Unit-cost named-channel queries return w_i; aggregate exit rates, weighted-neighbor samples and a full listing are NOT supplied. cap=sum w_i/2, so null/alternative capacities differ by 1+2epsilon. Any adaptive randomized random-stopping algorithm returning [L,U], L>0, U/L<=1+epsilon, with success >=1-alpha on every instance (0<alpha<1/2), needs E_0 Q>=M(1-2alpha). Shared-randomness coupling agrees until J is queried, bounding transcript TV by E_0|D|/M; disjoint correctness intervals force TV>=1-2alpha. A reversible CTMC realization exists, but the lower bound is for this declared oracle.

Family fit: this is a scoped sibling in N708's hidden-kinetic-acquisition family. N708 hides internal corridor rates with fixed known equilibrium/endpoints and targets means/routes/full first-passage laws; this result hides a two-edge channel conductance and targets relative-width capacity intervals. Here aggregate endpoint rates would reveal the answer; N708's stronger-looking endpoint facts cannot be silently transferred. N713/N718 controlled-closure/product-intervention access is another distinct interface. No prior card is a premise, correction or supersession. The bound is linear in explicitly listed channel count; there is no generic atomistic impossibility, inverse-rarity lower bound or refutation of structured globally certified models.

An acquisition oracle supplies iid X in R^d with a known certified almost-sure bound ||X||<=R and unknown mu=E X. Each acquisition costs C_X including generation and reading all coordinates; ideal Gaussian/uniform reals and exact arithmetic are explicit primitives. For 0<epsilon<1, the source constructs Y with entire-law TV(Law(Y),N(mu,I_d))<=epsilon, expected oracle count <=2e^2 m, O(dm) arithmetic and O(d) memory, where m=ceil[64(1+R^2)ln(64(1+R^2)/epsilon)]. The ideal expected acquisition-inclusive cost is O((C_X+d)(1+R^2)ln((1+R^2)/epsilon)); R=0 needs no oracle calls. This is internally reconstructed known mathematics, not a fresh capability claim.

Generate m independent accepted factors: propose y~N(0,I_d/m), draw J~Poisson(2), acquire J fresh X_j, and accept with product_j (1+clip[-1,1](y dot X_j))/2. The empty product is one. Averaging J gives acceptance exp(w_hat(y)-1), w_hat=E clip(y dot X). Thus accepted density is proportional to q_m exp(w_hat), acceptance >=e^-2 and expected acquisitions <=2e^2 per factor, without assuming J independent of acceptance. The unclipped tilt is N(mu/m,I_d/m). Gaussian projection tail estimates yield factor TV<=10 exp[-m/(8R^2)] and product/convolution contraction gives total TV<=10m exp[-m/(8R^2)]<=epsilon. Positivity, almost-sure termination, exact normalization and full-law scope are part of the source argument.

Novelty stop: the report identifies Chen–Chewi–Daskalakis–Rakhlin's 2026 stochastic FORS linear-Gaussian-tilt specialization and positive exponential factory as the strongest same-oracle baseline. A sample-mean plug-in comparison alone would manufacture a prompting/research advantage. The source makes no asymptotic improvement claim against FORS. Its initial Poisson event-pivotal sensitivity idea was also stopped against existing sensitivity identities, retaining history acquisition and rare successful-history cost.

Known R cannot be certified for arbitrary unknown laws from finitely observed samples; iid source generation/burn-in and vector read costs are paid. The theorem is expected-cost ideal random-real computation. The float program does not certify continuous TV: a finite-support output vector has TV one from a continuous Gaussian. It needs a rounded target or exact-real representation and certified acceptance arithmetic. Independently bounded oracle rounding controls mean bias only. Producer diagnostics have 4,000 outputs and root replay has 800 at a different seed using the SAME implementation; empirical KS/quadrature are not full-law proofs or independent reimplementation.

Family fit: N687-gaussian-gradient-mean-sampler-stein-continuation is the closest existing Gaussian-mean family. It targets N(E g(G),sigma^2 I) using active whole-vector values of a globally L-Lipschitz conservative g at fixed sigma/L, with an every-execution fixed-exponent query bound and an open polylogarithmic gate. Here X is iid with a supplied almost-sure radius R and the count is expected. A globally Lipschitz g(G) need not be bounded, so this known FORS reconstruction does not close N687. A transfer needs an acquired bounded representation or truncation with certified mean/TV bias, explicit R versus dimension/sigma scaling and a cost-preserving query/precision/failure conversion. A dimension-growing R can erase the desired advantage. This is a family-level interface comparison, not a proved reduction, correction or dependency. N30/N31 compress an already sampled shifted Gaussian; N535 concerns hidden-label quantum conditional-source copies; N589/N590 condition equality fibers. Their different contracts likewise remain unchanged. The new scoped card preserves the known bounded-oracle operation without claiming resolution of the broader gradient-mean programme.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; Exact author artifacts and internal team checks preserved, not independently reconstructed/replayed at intake. No external proof/priority clearance, scientific source-experiment reproduction, practical advantage or physical validation. Campaign mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

The source rejects root's compressed garnet core plus tensile shrink-fit ring as a new mechanism: the subsequent targeted methods/SI audit reports that Cui's experiment already retains a contracting NiTiNb SMA ring during cell assembly/cycling. Earlier CTE-mismatch laminate disclosures also balance ceramic compression with tension. The original materials scout's “external fixture” premise and optimistic opening verdict remain in its historical text under a conspicuous author correction; the new card treats that correction as current. No ring/grid novelty or device advantage is established. The intake's direct Nature fetch also hit an authorization redirect; the original workers' finer access receipts are preserved, not promoted to independently reproduced source experiments.

Exact load path: in a static symmetric-stress body with div sigma=0, no body force, traction-free exterior and traction-transmitting interfaces, integral_Omega sigma_ij=0. A free single-phase separator cannot be compressive everywhere. Core fraction f compressed by P needs fP<=(1-f)S in a tensile counterpart of allowable stress S. For the ideal circular disk/ring plane-stress model, inner radius a, outer radius b and contact pressure P, ring sigma_r=A-B/r^2, sigma_theta=A+B/r^2, A=Pa^2/(b^2-a^2), B=Pa^2 b^2/(b^2-a^2). Peak inner hoop stress is P(b^2+a^2)/(b^2-a^2); with f=a^2/b^2 it requires f<=(S-P)/(S+P). This is a geometry/strength constraint, not a qualified material or useful energy advantage. Interference, strain, disk/ring contact and illustrative parameters are source-model calculations.

Transport, electrical insulation, active/inactive area, seals, edge defects, yield, buckling, thermal cycling, creep and lithium chemistry remain simultaneous requirements. Average compression can hide a connected unprotected lane. A radially contacted disk does not automatically have a simply supported transverse plate edge. A perfectly bonded stress-balanced symmetric laminate has zero total membrane resultant and lacks the simple whole-plate Euler term; local wrinkling, debonding and crack chemistry remain unresolved. The hypothetical Maxwell relaxation model and force/ASR arithmetic are not measurements of LLZO/NiTiNb.

The audit separates nominal 330 MPa cycling labels from XRD specimen stresses and short high-current sweeps from longer 10 mA/cm^2, 1 mAh/cm^2 cycling. Reported source experiments were neither performed nor reproduced in this campaign. Prior patents are technical disclosures, not legal validity/freedom-to-operate conclusions. Supplementary protocol uncertainty was corrected within the preserved original reports; no source absence implies novelty. A thinner tiled or laminated device is an open comparative manufacturing question, not a new prestress principle.

Family fit: engineering-obstruction and physical-resource topics fit, but no matching existing prestress separator card was located. N706/N707's physical invention audits concern other mechanisms and supply no premise. This distinct failure/correction record prevents reintroducing the known ring under a new label while keeping proposed comparative tests, exact model constraints and negative evidence recoverable. There is no safety certification, physical experiment or established transformative technology.
