An unknown probability measure mu on [0,1] supplies G_mu(s)=integral exp(-sx)dmu(x), A_mu(t)=integral exp(-itx)dmu(x), p_mu(t)=|A_mu(t)|^2. Each classically adaptive query s in [0,B] returns G_mu(s)+Z, or in a separate observation model log G_mu(s)+Z, with independent standard Gaussian Z on every call. A fixed worst-case budget must produce a finite description uniformly within 1/16 of p on [0,T], with success at least 2/3, uniformly over mu. Computation is unrestricted. The proposed constant-accuracy minimax law is log(1+N_*(T,B))=Theta(T log(2+T/B)) for all sufficiently large T and B>0, with universal but unoptimized exponent constants. The amplitude analogue is separately stated. No noiseless arbitrary-precision values, Hamiltonian entries, spectral-weight readout or coherent real-time access are supplied.

For odd m, n=m+1 and nodes x_j=3/8+j/(4m), mix a uniform background, a uniform even-node background and parity-conditioned Bin(m,1/2) weights to form nu_+/-; put mu_+/-=delta_0/4+3nu_+/-/4. The nominal pair has the same complete spectrum, ground gap 3/8, known ground weight 1/4, every excited weight >=3/(16n), and moments through m-1 equal. At t_m=4pi m, the source gives p_+=97/256, p_-=25/256, while Delta G=(3/4)exp(-3s/8)[(1-exp(-s/(4m)))/2]^m. G>=1/4 also controls logarithmic differences. Adaptive Gaussian relative entropy is <=N D^2/2, yielding N>=4/81[max{2,8m/B}]^(2m). Known spectrum, partition functions and the stated exact low moments do not distinguish this pair.

Inverse spectral Jacobi realization gives nearest-neighbour bulk chains with negative off-diagonals plus a known isolated reference, prepared as (1/2)e_ref+(sqrt(3)/2)e_0. The source derives |b|>=Delta sqrt(alpha)/3, hence bulk couplings >=1/(24m sqrt(m+1)). Excited-state spacings shrink as 1/m; only the ground gap is constant. Perturbations with norm <=1/(64t_m), common previously matched near-boundary coefficients and unchanged reference retain the exponential order and return-probability gap >=7/32. This is structured inverse-polynomial robustness. The nominal free common complete spectrum and spectral-weight floor are not asserted simultaneously for arbitrary perturbed pairs, and no unrestricted fixed-strength disorder result follows.

The upper construction uses M=ceil max{16T,log2(4/eps)}, a=min{B/M,1/16} and a truncated generalized-binomial polynomial in 1-exp(-ax). Expansion into G(la) values, 0<=l<=M, has l1 amplification <=S=2[2e(2+T/B)]^M and error <=2^-M+S delta. The reported sample cost is O((M+1)S^2 eps^-2 log((M+1)/zeta)); arithmetic and precision-bit costs are polynomial in the stated parameters, including log S. Statistical acquisition is exponential. Systematic bias, time-setting accuracy, preparation and decorrelation are charged separately; polynomially many precision bits can mean extremely fine absolute instrument tolerances. Fixed B gives a worst-case recoverable horizon Theta(log N/log log N); unlimited B gives Theta(log N). Individual spectra need not be hard.

This belongs to inverse-information/analytic-continuation research alongside N725, whose complete quantum snapshot interface is stronger and different. N95/N99 forward positive-kernel access and N711/N712 Gibbs/readout information are comparison routes, not imported premises or established applications. The recovered original RESULT.md, verifier, exact models, results and manifest preserve the proof candidate and a failed precision diagnostic. Binomial moment cancellation, inverse Jacobi theory, optimal recovery and engineered coherent transfer are credited prior mathematics. Historical novelty, independent correctness, major foundational completion and physical acquisition remain unresolved; no technological capability is demonstrated.

The unknown Hermitian A satisfies I<=A<=2I on a known finite-dimensional active space with known seed v; a known reference Omega is orthogonal to it. At a classically chosen tau in [0,beta], a source returns a fresh pure state Psi_A(tau)=(Omega+exp(-tau A/2)v)/sqrt(1+F_A(tau)), F_A(z)=<v,exp(-zA)v>. These are not Gibbs states. All requested/discarded/postselected copies count against a fixed worst-case budget. Adaptive classical times, quantum memory and collective measurements are allowed; computation is unlimited. A entries, arbitrary-input imaginary-time propagation and real-time access are absent. Estimating g_A(t)=F_A(it) to additive 1/4 with success 2/3 uniformly over dimensions has proposed minimax log Q(t,beta)=Theta(t log(2+t/beta)), with t/infinity=0. The exponent order is matching, not an exact leading minimax constant or efficient upper algorithm.

For odd n=2m-1, a folded tridiagonal chain has off-diagonals -sqrt((j+1)(n-j))/(2n), diagonal 3/2 except final 3/2 minus/plus m/(2n). Only that boundary bit changes. Endpoint measures are parity-conditioned binomial weights at energies 1+k/n; unlike N724 this pair is not nominally isospectral. Delta F(tau)=2 exp(-tau)[(1-exp(-tau/n))/2]^n, bounded by min{2*8^-n,2(beta/(2n))^n}. At t_n=pi n the return amplitudes are -/+1. The source bounds full snapshot trace distance using an explicit vector-tail identity, then an adaptive classically indexed pure-state fidelity lemma gives final distinguishability <=sqrt(N)d and N>=max{8^n,(2n/beta)^n}/18. Spectral-band rescaling extends the order to all sufficiently large target times.

Lagrange interpolation at real times in [0,min{beta,t}], with R=sqrt(t^2+min{beta,t}^2) and k=ceil(4eR), has error <=(2R)^(k+1)/(k+1)! and l1 amplification <=(2eR/min{beta,t})^k. Measuring the reference probability 1/(1+F) in [1/2,1], then using its Lipschitz inverse, gives the exponential-order upper copy bound. Sharper Q=Theta(sqrt(n)8^n) and fixed-beta Theta_beta(n^(3/2)(2n/beta)^n) concern the explicit binary family, not universal minimax leading constants. Snapshot preparation cost is separate from copy count; the contraction success is bounded below by 1/2 but its implementation is not supplied free.

The local bounded-coupling stoquastic free-spin realization has a unique product vacuum, constant ground gap and vacuum-plus-one-excitation trajectories of Schmidt rank at most two. [1,2] is the active one-excitation band; the full many-body bandwidth is extensive. Matched bulk rational rounding to O(1/n) norm accuracy costs O(log n) bits per entry and retains the lower-bound order with different constants. It does not preserve sharp binary constants or establish constant independent disorder tolerance. An additional last-site seed gives O(min{beta,1/64}^-2) copy discrimination independent of chain length, so the fixed-seed interface is load-bearing. A separate carefully specified coherent-preparation oracle corollary has an O(Nd) hybrid bound; copy constants and arbitrary-input propagator claims do not transfer.

This is the full-quantum-snapshot member of the inverse-information family alongside N724's noisy scalar observations. It does not resolve or depend on the near-convex Hamiltonian capital N716, N711/N712 Gibbs/readout claims or forward positive-kernel simulation interfaces. Perfect state transfer, binomial kernels, fidelity bounds, analytic continuation and imaginary-time no-fast-forwarding are credited antecedents. The original research note, code, captured diagnostics, requirements and manifest are recoverable. Independent correctness, historical originality, generic interacting/Gibbs scope, instrument feasibility and a major foundational capability remain unestablished.

Input explicitly supplies rational mu, positive-definite S_0 and independent Gaussian Fourier blocks (A_j,B_j) with covariance [[S_j,T_j],[-T_j,S_j]], symmetric S_j and skew T_j, j=1,...,d. X(t)=mu+Z_0+sum_j(A_j cos jt+B_j sin jt) is stationary on [0,2pi). A rational open full-dimensional polyhedron K={a_i^T x>b_i} has m facets; LP feasibility/redundancy checks are charged and empty-interior/full-space cases handled. Dense d counts toward complete input length L. For p=Pr{X enters K}, the source proposes relative-eps estimation with confidence 1-delta in poly(L,eps^-1,log delta^-1) bit operations without a multiplicative 1/p. Log p or a mantissa plus binary exponent is the output. Conditional trajectory samples have a coupling controlling uniform waveform error zeta except probability eta, with expected cost polynomial also in eta^-1 and log zeta^-1 and an explicit cutoff failure. Rational finite outputs are not literally total-variation close to a continuous law.

The witness W=1_{X(0) in K}+number of inward entries satisfies 1<=W<=K_*=md+1 on failure. Initial mass mu_0 and facet entry intensities mu_i sum to M=E W. The mixture Q of initial-conditioned and uniform-phase crossing-Palm laws satisfies dQ/dP=W/M, p=M E_Q(1/W), relative variance <=K_*-1 and O(K_* eps^-2 log delta^-1) proposals. Acceptance with probability 1/W gives conditional trajectories with acceptance >=1/K_*. An entry is not necessarily first; omitting initial mass breaks the event identity. For a face U=a_i^T X(0), V=a_i^T X'(0) and residual position Y conditional on U=b_i, mu_i=2pi phi_U(b_i) integral v_+ 1_other_facets g(Y,v)dYdv. Position-velocity correlations must be retained.

A height variable 0<=s<=v, v>=0 lifts each constrained flux to a Gaussian log-concave integral on a convex domain. Rational convex optimization finds q_*; write Z=exp(-q_*)J and compute in log form. The source supplies a normalized tail bound P(q-q_*>t)<=2^n exp(-t/2) and a bounded convex-body power lift with volume/2^k=integral(1-(q-q_*)/k)_+^k. With k of order t^2/eta, paid volume/sampling primitives, strict-feasibility slacks and inner/outer radii 2^+/-poly(L) are claimed to yield polynomial-bit acquisition. No supplied rare-event sampler or free warm start is assumed. This is a proof candidate with potentially large polynomial overhead; exact imported interfaces, rounding, radius, confidence and complexity proofs require independent audit.

Gaussian regression reconstructs all Fourier coefficients using c=c_0+Sigma H^T(H Sigma H^T)^-1(b-Hc_0), charging matrix work and induced correlations. Rational phase parametrization and tan(t/2) convert crossings to degree <=2d rational polynomials; Sturm root/sign isolation counts entries with the point at infinity and a planted root handled separately. There is no supplied minimum root separation. The source proposes proposal-normalized density and algebraic small-ball bounds to choose polynomial working precision, with proposal/count errors O(eps/K_*) because E_Q(1/W)>=1/K_*. Nonzero bad-polynomial, forced-degeneracy and full multivariate anti-concentration conditions remain important independent-review obligations. Reported cost is poly(L)+(m+1)I_conv+O(K_* eps^-2 log delta^-1)(S_conv+poly(D_c,m,d,b_work)); storage includes O((m+1)D_c^2) rational numbers and convex-body workspace. All convex preprocessing and output precision are charged.

This fits the acquisition-aware rare-event family near N492/N493 and the structured supplied-model probability algorithms N715/N719, while its stationary Gaussian/Palm mechanism warrants a separate card. It does not repair N493's relative-accuracy obstruction from small covariance error, solve N708/N721 hidden kinetic-channel acquisition, cover arbitrary nonstationary/infinite/singular/nonlinear models, give polylog cost in a binary maximum frequency, or provide global design optimization. Explicit unions cost their listed regions/facets; exponentially expanded Boolean geometry is not free. Covariance/data acquisition and infinite-spectrum truncation errors must be small relative to rare p. Rice/Palm, Gaussian excursion simulation, multiplicity correction, log-concave integration, minimax tilting and Sturm methods are credited antecedents. The recovered code/results concern only special-case diagnostics; general implementation, independent correctness, historical originality, practical advantage and technological readiness remain unresolved.

body:
N727-interchange-rate-saturation-endpoint-sampling | Two-sided interchange smoothing proposes polynomial-bit endpoint sampling by rate saturation
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Unreviewed source-reported mathematical proof candidate. Intake checks source bytes, derived page routes and repository integrity, not independent correctness or novelty. No scientific script execution, sampler implementation, benchmark, formal verification or physical experiment. Historical priority and external correctness UNKNOWN.

For an explicitly supplied undirected graph with n vertices and m edges, nonnegative binary-rational exchange rates w_e, deterministic initial permutation (or multicolor/exclusion configuration), nonnegative binary-rational horizon T and accuracy 0<epsilon<=1, the manuscript proposes a classical sampler of one full endpoint within total-variation epsilon of the continuous-time interchange law. At each edge clock, endpoint labels exchange without bias or configuration-dependent rate. The claimed bit cost is polynomial in n,m,input bit lengths and 1/epsilon, independent of numerical T and original rates; it does not enumerate n! states or reconstruct joint law from one-particle marginals. This is a proof candidate, not implemented or benchmarked capability. The graph and rates are supplied explicitly, not succinctly encoded or physically acquired for free.

Rescale r_e=T w_e and cap r_e^K=min(r_e,K). With c=n^2/2 and K>=2c, the proposed bound is ||mu-mu_K||_TV <= (m c^2/K)[6+2 log(K/c)], uniformly over all original rates and starting permutations. Coloring/projection transfers it to symmetric simple exclusion and multicolor endpoints. The source gives K=O((m n^4/epsilon)log(2mn/epsilon)) as sufficient, and the deliberately loose explicit K=(12m n^3/epsilon)^2 for cap error <=epsilon/4 when n>=2,m>=1. T=0, edgeless graphs and zero total capped rate are trivial. No adjacent-scale gap, recursive region equilibration, spectral-gap comparison or partition-function oracle is assumed.

The proof spine begins with the credited interchange discrepancy coupling: two configurations differing by one edge transposition are driven by common clocks except at the two discrepancy positions, where independent clocks coalesce them. The discrepancy pair follows independent weighted random walks killed on meeting. On its communicating killed domain, the source uses symmetry and the maximum principle to bound G(z,u)<=G(z,z)<=1/(2w), because the initial adjacent pair has direct killing rate 2w. Summing at most n(n-1) states gives E_z tau<=c/w, hence a_w(t)=min(1,c/(wt)) bounds edge-start total variation. Weighted coupling/domain/zero-rate details remain review obligations; the unit-rate coupling itself is acknowledged prior mathematics.

With positions-to-labels permutations, updates multiply on the right by tau_e, A_e=I-T_e, L=sum r_e A_e and P_t=exp(-tL). Group convolution and reversibility p_t(g)=p_t(g^-1) convert an endpoint row gradient to the initial-transposition gradient: ||delta_sigma P_t A_e||_1<=2a_w(t), while ||A_e P_t f||_infinity<=2a_w(t)||f||_infinity. These are different sides; generic Markov chains do not inherit the inversion step. Because A_e^2=2A_e, Duhamel sensitivity at time one has TV derivative <=integral_0^1 a_w(s)a_w(1-s)ds. For q=c/w<=1/2 this is -2q log(1-q)+2q^2 log((1-q)/q)<=q^2[4+2log(1/q)]. Integration from K to infinity gives (c^2/K)[6+2log(K/c)] per edge, uniformly in all other rates, and telescoping all edges yields the cap bound. One-sided O(1/w) smoothing alone would not give an integrable infinite-rate bound.

The constructive rational sampler has Lambda=sum r_e^K<=mK and D=ceil(max(1,4Lambda^2/epsilon)) steps. Each step stays put with probability 1-Lambda/D or exchanges edge e with probability r_e^K/D. Poisson-versus-Bernoulli comparison bounds capped endpoint discretization error by Lambda^2/D<=epsilon/4. Exact integer categorical laws, common denominators of polynomial bit length, fair-bit rejection and truncation allocate another epsilon/2. Together with capping, the total budget is epsilon. The conservative D-step polynomial can be very large; no practical speed claim follows. Optional capped uniformization has expected Lambda swaps and requires an explicit tail cutoff and finite Poisson-mass accuracy for a bounded bit implementation; it is not a free exact real-clock oracle.

The output retains full joint tracer/occupancy correlations. Efficiently evaluable bounded endpoint observables can then be estimated additively using additional independent samples. Prescribed multiple snapshots require a separate kernel approximation per time increment and summed errors. Neither result reconstructs microscopic trajectories, integrated currents or waiting-time history, supports biased/configuration-dependent exchange or reactions, nor supplies rare-event relative accuracy: TV epsilon can lose events far below epsilon. Slow-rate calibration may require absolute accuracy of order epsilon/T and long observations; only a rate certified above K/T may be capped without learning its larger value. Full microscopic model acquisition, materials applicability and technological advantage remain open.

Family fit: N593 excludes one Chebyshev signed-particle estimator mechanism on local tree walks; this is a different positive global algorithm on an explicit physical graph, so no contradiction or correction is asserted. N708/N713 concern unknown kinetic information or controlled closure, not sampling with all exchange rates supplied. N719/N726 target rare-event log/relative probabilities in different stochastic models; total-variation endpoints do not close their rare-relative gates. Interchange coupling and uniformization are credited antecedents. The four-page source makes no novelty, implementation, benchmark, independent certification or formal-verification claim. No diagnostic count or scientific code is supplied; prompt, context, model and inference expenditure remain UNKNOWN.

Unknown and candidate finite-dimensional Hermitian matrices obey the supplied spectral promise 0<=H,K<=MI, M>0; known pure psi is preparable and K is fixed before validation (or checked on fresh data). The task is E_T=sup_[0,T] D(U_H(t)|psi><psi|U_H(t)^*,U_K(t)|psi><psi|U_K(t)^*). A fresh memoryless heralded instrument has success Kraus operator exp(-hH) on a submitted system, including ancilla-entangled inputs; failed and discarded calls count. Unknown entries, real-time evolution, inverse dilation and arbitrary-flag unitary completion are absent. Arbitrary known candidate preparations/projectors are additional resources, not ordinary fixed-input snapshots or Gibbs samples.

At h=1/(4M), write B=exp(-hH), C=exp(-hK), a=exp(-1/4), b=a^2 and G_r=[(1-r)I+(r/b)C]^-1 with eigenvalues in [b,1]. Uniform independent s in [0,T], r in [0,1] specify v=G_r exp(-isK)psi/||G_r exp(-isK)psi||. Filter (|0>v+|1>psi)/sqrt(2); both branches experience H. Project the successful output onto the known corresponding C-filtered pair. Retry the SAME setting until success to avoid unknown setting bias; success>=exp(-1/2). Mean rejection pbar is proposed to certify E_T<=min{1,Cstar MT sqrt(pbar)}, Cstar=27.35248...<28. N independent successful shots with zero rejects give soundness-alpha bound 28MT sqrt(log(1/alpha)/N), not a Bayesian correctness probability. Norm-one observables then differ by <=2epsilon simultaneously on this one trajectory.

The proof aligns all filtered inputs with c=<psi,Bpsi>/<psi,Cpsi>, bounds ||(B/c-C)v|| by a constant times sqrt(p(v)), applies the exact ordered noncommutative resolvent integral for log(B/c)-log C, and bounds the residual along the proposed trajectory by Duhamel and Cauchy-Schwarz. It does not identify H outside C_K(psi)=span{psi,Kpsi,...}. For T>0, pbar=0 iff the rays agree on [0,T] iff (H-K)x=kappa x on that cyclic subspace, implying all-time agreement. The common scalar is an unobservable energy shift, not a measured unknown normalization.

At confidence 2/3, MT>=2 and 0<epsilon<=1/4, the source proposes optimal worst-case raw attempt order Theta(M^2 T^2/epsilon^2) and unknown-filter duration Theta(M T^2/epsilon^2). A two-level alternative H_theta=M I/2+theta Z versus K=M I/2, theta=2epsilon/T, gives lower constants 1/144 and 1/72. The stronger canonical FORWARD isometry exposes coherent failures but grants neither inverse nor arbitrary-input unitary completion. Raw-count lower bounds allow adaptive design/quantum memory and coherent duration control; duration-weighted proof uses classically adaptive durations and average expected exposure across the hypotheses. Upper retries have constant expected overhead and a bounded high-confidence raw cap. Preparation, known-model compilation, precision and total runtime are separate. No optimal local-system n dependence or all-confidence leading constants are claimed.

The strict test has perfect ideal completeness for exact ray agreement, not tolerant completeness: a nearby trajectory can have a persistent rejection floor. Implementation bias eta changes the certificate to 28MT sqrt(p_U+eta), demanding eta=O(epsilon^2/(M^2T^2)). Coherent many-body candidate preparation and a trusted programmable filter remain acquisition obligations; bounded inverse conditioning does not supply them. Candidate discovery, generic Hamiltonian learning and validation of all initial states are outside the result.

A separate reconstructed N724 nominal family supplies a bridge to full quantum snapshots. Common Jacobi scalar moments through m-1 imply A_+^j v=A_-^j v for j<ell=(m+1)/2 in a shared polynomial-coordinate basis. For spectra [3/8,5/8], vector-tail norm<=2 exp(-3s/8)(s/8)^ell/ell!, giving snapshot D<=2sqrt(3) min{(beta/16)^ell/ell!,3^-ell} with the original reference/normalization. Return-probability gap 9/32 at 4pi m yields N>=max{9^ell,(16ell/(e beta))^(2ell)}/108 for additive 1/16 estimation. This transfers the NOMINAL isospectral family through a proved-in-source vector interface, not scalar noise constants or arbitrary perturbed isospectrality. The active theorem does not depend on this bridge. N724/N725 retain their original sources, statuses and gates; this scoped continuation is independently unreviewed.

Coarse snapshots have a proposed sharp initial-layer 2D flow prediction law with fixed-output exceptions For smooth real divergence-free unforced 2D Navier–Stokes flow on (R/2pi Z)^2 with normalized area, viscosity nu>0 and initial L2 velocity norm <=E, the supplied information is the exact square Fourier snapshot P_K u(0), with |j|_infinity<=K including the zero mode, and K,E,nu,T. The output is the entire P_K velocity path on [0,T], measured in supremum-time L2 error; unlimited predictor computation is allowed. For integer K>=16, the source gives 1e-8 E^2 min{K^2 T,1/(nu+E)} <= minimax error <=10 E^2 min{K^2 T,1/(nu+E)}. This is a source-reported full proof with informed internal cross-reconstruction, not an independently verified theorem. An observed nonzero mean is handled by a Galilean frame.

The upper predictor uses only the heat evolution of the observed snapshot. Energy, global heat-comparison and short-time estimates are combined; the unknown tail is used in the analysis, not supplied to the predictor. The lower pair has an identical zero observed snapshot and phase-opposed high-frequency vorticity packets. Many positive second-Picard interactions reach a growing O(K) output band before diffusion removes the inputs. The proof bounds the analytic nonlinear remainder at a specified short time. The corrected packet shift -33L is retained with the earlier failed -32L case, including K=31; no source history is erased.

The scope matters: this is a growing output cutoff and supremum over a shrinking initial layer. Fixed low output P_J on a zero-snapshot energy fibre has an O(K^-2) upper bound with badly E/nu-dependent constants and a matching-power four-mode lower construction. At a fixed positive terminal time the zero-snapshot full output tends to zero at O(1/K). These are different contracts, not a claim of persistent O(1) prediction failure for arbitrary low outputs or turbulence. A common bounded-noise history transcript is constructed only for the specified zero-transcript setting; it is not an all-input causal observation theorem.

A single added phase bit helps the supplied two-packet family, at precision Theta(E/K) with O(K^2) spatial samples already comparable to an FFT baseline. It does not supply acquisition of a general initial state. Sensor bandwidth, noise, delay and physical implementation remain separate from exact Fourier access; no practical simulation advantage was demonstrated. Closest source comparisons include determining modes, data assimilation and negative-Sobolev continuity. Exact priority is UNKNOWN.

Real nonlinear conductivity pairs propose exponential sensing barriers and a conditioned finite-shell inverse On B_1 in R^n, n>=3, consider real smooth scalar conductivities in [1/2,3/2], equal to one near the boundary, with integer Sobolev index s>n/2. For a supplied smooth axisymmetric bump psi supported inside B_r away from the rotation axis, the source constructs sigma_k^±=1±a k^-s psi(rho,z) cos(k theta). Their calibrated-coordinate L2 separation is sqrt(2) a ||psi||_2 k^-s, but their nonlinear Dirichlet-to-Neumann response difference in the harmonic-energy operator norm is at most C a k^-s r^k. This is an internally reconstructed proof candidate; quantitative separation modulo a gauge is OPEN.

A rotation pi/k exchanges the two coefficients. Odd nonlinear terms couple angular blocks only across odd multiples of k. The boundary norm is ||f||_E^2=integral |grad Hf|^2=sum_(ell>=1) ell ||f_ell||_2^2 with constants quotiented out; scalar energy readouts or real/imaginary pairings are admitted (a complex pairing costs two real readouts). Interior harmonic energy decays with angular degree, and summing the full operator blocks charges multiplicities. An independent-to-target initial worker and later informed internal reconstruction give alternative energy/resolvent accounts; these are internal campaign checks, not external verification. The Schur-resolvent subtraction cancels all even powers. Linearized invisibility alone is not substituted for a nonlinear bound.

For angular band limit L with 2L<k, allowed boundary pairings coincide exactly. With adversarial absolute readout noise nu and probe energy ||f||_E^2<=Emax, Emax||Delta Lambda||<=2nu supplies a common midpoint adaptive transcript and risk at least half the pair separation. Under the stated independent Gaussian variance-nu^2 model and bounded experiment/stopping contract, the joint random-seed/data KL controls success; marginal data KL is only upper bounded by it. Success probability 3/4 below half separation requires expected sum ||f_j||_E^4 >=nu^2/||Delta Lambda||^2. This does not acquire detector noise, causal delivery or a universal excitation/energy-time law. General discontinuous adaptive policies do not inherit the continuous-transcript quantitative width bound.

The complementary positive result is for D KNOWN nonnegative smooth profiles on ordered disjoint radial shells [a_j,b_j], not arbitrary unknown media. D unit-energy harmonic probes of degrees 1..D give scalar measurements F_l(c). Their background Jacobian M_lj=(2l+n-2) integral phi_j(r) r^(2l+n-3) dr has determinant >=d_*>0 from an averaged Vandermonde formula. B=D/d_* bounds its inverse infinity norm and rho=min{1/2,1/(24B)} bounds the prior radius (further reduced to satisfy the Sobolev ball). For ||c_*||_infinity<=rho/2 and readout error zeta with B zeta<=rho/4, c_(q+1)=c_q+M^-1(y-F(c_q)) contracts and ||c_q-c_*||_infinity<=2^-q||c_*||_infinity+2B zeta. Certified forward error tau must replace zeta by zeta+tau; an inexact matrix inverse also needs an explicit certificate. Thin shells, small gaps and D make conditioning costly. The radial ODE evaluator is specified, not implemented or certified at all accuracies.

Controlled resonant actions have an exact polynomial state candidate through zero strata, without measured speedup For the supplied real controlled star i xdot_i=k_i conjugate(y_i)c, i ydot_i=k_i conjugate(x_i)c, i cdot=sum_i k_i x_i y_i with k=Kv in R^r and a fixed admitted d-dimensional control span, the source constructs an exact polynomial state for every modal action, including amplitude-zero strata. Set a=|x|^2, e=|y|^2, n=|c|^2, b_i=x_i y_i, s=a+e, p_i=Im(b_i conjugate(c)), S_ij=Re(b_i conjugate(b_j)), R=SK, P=K^T p and L=K^T(k elementwise s). Then adot=edot=-2k elementwise p, ndot=2k^T p, pdot=Rv-k elementwise s n, and Rdot_i,alpha=-k_i s_i P_alpha-L_alpha p_i. Storage and derivative work are O(rd+r), with supplied dense K already costing rd entries. No division by amplitudes is used.

Global continuation is for realizable physical product states with prescribed locally integrable controls, or locally Lipschitz feedback under the stated assumptions. Arbitrary ambient polynomial states can blow up; continuous non-Lipschitz square-root feedback permits waiting-time nonuniqueness. With nonzero K rows and an open admitted control set, equality of this state is equivalent to all-future modal-action behavior; initial, first and second action jets identify it. Generic continuous predictor dimension is at least 3r+1, or 2r when the r+1 invariants are supplied. The d=1 displayed 4r+1 state is redundant, not a minimal-coordinate claim.

An additional control ell can be recovered from existing observations exactly iff D ell=0 for every zero-diagonal symmetric D with DK=0 and positive/negative inertias at most two. This is a functional Gram-fibre criterion; full-Gram recovery at r<=3 equal coupling does not extend to r=4. Detuning grows the polynomial collective-observable Krylov hull, generically to full rank, but an O(r) globally Lipschitz nonpolynomial pair-product realization is already available. This is not a universal finite-state or simulator impossibility. A polynomial multi-center extension requires private pairs; shared passive amplitudes add missing cross terms. Its O(rmd+m^2) storage and O(rm^2d+rmd) dense work do not beat an O(rm) supplied-amplitude baseline.

The matched source NumPy derivative benchmark includes k=Kv and common initial amplitudes in both methods. The closure is 1.67–4.69 times SLOWER on the tested sizes; no computational speedup was demonstrated. Source symbolic/zero-mode/trajectory checks support only their finite/internal scope and were not rerun during intake. Classical invariant/Poisson reductions, observation algebras, low-rank Gram recovery and published AA-star loop products preempt broad new-primitive claims; the exact model-specific behavioral formula's priority remains UNKNOWN.

Acquiring coherent products or repeated action jets requires reset/repeatable preparation, calibration, multiple controls, precision, finite observation intervals and disturbance accounting. Coherent amplitude acquisition already enables an O(r) baseline. Pump/actuator energy, sign/phase access, bandwidth, delay, isolation and omitted modes remain unclosed. No device or useful control advantage is established. Family fit: existing physics/analysis/acquisition topics; N716 uses a different resonant Hamiltonian simulation/undecidable-limit contract and supplies no premise or correction here.

Constructed phase feedback has scoped cubic-root and square-root response laws with charged potential certificates On a supplied finite directed stochastic network P with local row/coordinate access, unit phases x_v update at rate one by x_v<-y x_w, w~P(v,.), using a single Brownian circle phase y with generator gamma partial_theta^2. The exact local identity L(x_v y^k)=-(1+gamma k^2)x_v y^k+sum_w P_vw x_w y^(k+1) gives h_v=sum_n y^n(P^n x)_v/product_(j=0)^n(1+gamma j^2). The source proves the generator-domain and integrated-transient interpretation, not merely a formal series. For 0<gamma<=1, response is O(gamma^-1/3), sharp on the one-site positive instance. A rational block-geometric evaluator uses O(gamma^-1/3) expected local row calls with O(gamma^-2/3) second moment, and a specified local-query lower bound matches this per-sample scale.

The underlying observable-specific inverse first acquires exact strictly graded generator relations with a factorial envelope. Rational local coefficients and geometric randomization permit exact rational unbiased outputs. Within-grade motion is implemented by a killed signed walk only when absolute diagonal dominance and a microscopic work bound hold; a block inverse is not supplied for free. A two-state transition-simulation example has work times second moment >=1/(144 epsilon); exact local probabilities are a stronger interface. Finite observable closure alone does not remove a slow inverse.

With independent symmetric y or y^-1 multipliers at each copy, the Fourier charge becomes a symmetric walk. Root's internal extension gives sharp Theta(gamma^-1/2) response, O(gamma^-1/2) expected row work and O(gamma^-1) second moment in the stated model. A deterministic (+1,-1) cancelling cycle restores Theta(gamma^-1). These operations change the stochastic dynamics; they do not accelerate inversion of the original unmodified chain.

More generally allow integer edge charges c_vw of either sign. Supply AND VERIFY a rational potential a and delta>0 with c_vw+a_v-a_w>=delta on every positive-probability edge. With B=osc(a), N0=ceil(2B/delta), L the least positive integer satisfying gamma delta^2 L^3>=4, and R0=N0+L, the source proves |h_v|<=4R0, an exact rational evaluator with fewer than 8R0 expected row calls and second moment <=64R0^2. This permits the (+2,-1) cycle and gives O(1+B/delta+(gamma delta^2)^-1/3) response/work. Explicit graph support, potential verification, coordinate queries and exact arithmetic are charged. Arithmetic is polynomial in bounded charge magnitude, not automatically its logarithm. A row sampler alone cannot verify all support edges.

Classical difference constraints/minimum cycle mean can acquire the potential on an explicitly enumerated graph, at graph-dependent cost. Qualitative positive winding alone is insufficient: a long alternating cycle retains inverse-gamma response through a neutral transient. Physically reciprocal couplings can fail the certificate. Shared Brownian phase, Hill/Airy mechanisms, duality, random Neumann series and matrix recovery are established mathematical baselines; neither broad originality nor a new physical effect is claimed. Actual control/circuit acquisition, useful end-to-end advantage and exact priority remain OPEN. All proofs and phase diagnostics are internally reported, not independently validated at intake.

Reused grammar occurrences use FRESH noise randomness. Binary repetitions compile by repeated squaring; G is compiled size and H>=1 depth. The manuscript proposes one FULL JOINT final-state sample within total variation epsilon in time polynomial in input length, D, 2^d and epsilon^-1, independent of expanded control length and numerical Poisson means apart from bit lengths. Maps need not be invertible. This is a mathematical proof candidate, not optimization of a linear program or established software/technology.

Clean composition and mark intensity obey C_AB=C_B C_A and nu_AB=(C_B)_*nu_A+nu_B. A descending-weight greedy basis peeling of an explicit vector list gives C_ell>=k_i w_i for every cut containing item i. Retention p_i=min(1,alpha/k_i) and reweighting preserve all parity-cut masses simultaneously; Bernstein and a union bound over 2^D functionals give polynomial sparse summaries without a weight-ratio promise. A nonzero degree-d Boolean polynomial has one-probability >=2^-d, providing charged leaf sampling and deterministic span zero-tests. Bottom-up merge/reduce maintains simultaneous error rho<=2H eta across reused nodes, without enumerating suffix contexts.

For every subspace W, nu(V\W)=2 E_(ell uniform W-perp) nu{v:ell(v)=1}. Thus cut summaries estimate outside-subspace mass and arbitrary linear-context preimages, even for adaptively chosen W/context. To acquire an actual conditional root mark, descend the ORIGINAL grammar with approximately weighted active branch choices, compose suffix matrices and use fresh latent rejection sampling at the selected leaf. When possible, leaf acceptance is >=2^-d. Summaries are used to count rates and branch masses; they are NEVER substituted for the physical jump law. Preserving Fourier exponents alone is not asserted to preserve endpoint TV.

Replace a mark-v jump by rate-2nu(v) proposals that add a fair zero-or-v mark. Conditional on proposed marks, the endpoint is uniform on their span. Proposals already in the span can be discarded; at most D active rank increases remain. The ideal sampler waits at rate 2nu(V\W), acquires a true mark outside W and adjoins it, stopping at time one; a uniform span vector plus clean output is the endpoint. The candidate coupling error is O(DH rho)+delta_prep+delta_caps+delta_arith; eta=c epsilon/(D H^2) allocates local accuracy. Failure fallbacks are charged to the unconditional law, not conditioned away.

Finite-bit clocks are part of this PDF's proposed theorem: rational stored weights give polynomial descriptions of maximum A and minimum positive approximate rate. Clock precision Delta=O(epsilon/[D^2 max(1,A)]), tiny-uniform tails, bounded categorical/rejection retries and logarithm evaluation are budgeted. The precision depends on log A rather than A. This differs from N735's still-open exact continuous random-bit implementation; no proof transfer between these noise interfaces is asserted.

Acquiring the grammar, explicit polynomial maps, independent calibrated rates and fresh-noise law is outside the theorem. Coherent noise, state-dependent rates, adaptive measurement feedback, full fault/measurement history and relative accuracy for exponentially rare decoder failures are excluded. A supplied polynomial-time decoder inherits additive distributional accuracy only. Clifford/Pauli-frame schedules are conditional applications, not validated quantum hardware. Existing N670/N671 Pauli positivity/exact-evaluation hardness has different queries and input promises; endpoint approximate sampling does not invalidate it. Code-sparsification literature is credited, comprehensive priority/implementation comparisons remain open. status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. For K=N=sum_x n_x, input psi=|+>_a|0>_elsewhere and one-qubit output, define E_T(H)=sup_{0<=t<=T} D(rho_H^a(t),rho_K^a(t)). A tolerant test accepts every E_T<=eta and rejects every E_T>=3/4 with probability >=2/3. A fresh sample supplies vacuum outside accessible ports S. Arbitrarily strong controls, ancillas, memory, measurements, resets and feedback are allowed only on S during total native time <=tau per sample. Splitting a coherent run does not reset this cap. Full-system terminal output and collective inter-run processing are granted; all discarded/postselected attempts count. No bath reinsertion, remote preparation or inverse unknown evolution is supplied. The Hamiltonian is fixed and memoryless across samples.

For d>=1 and 0<eta<=1/8, T=256d^2/eta^2, the source constructs two connected nearest-neighbour interacting chains on 2(d+1) qubits, all hoppings nonzero, bounded terms, positive density interactions and common unique vacuum ground state with gap>0.9. Reflection interchanges only the endpoint onsite coefficients and gives EXACT full-many-body isospectrality. The supplied alternatives differ by a single unknown assignment bit, yet E_T(Hg)<eta and E_T(Hb)>3/4. If both accessible arm prefixes end at r<d, R=d-r and 0<tau<=R/2, worst-case fresh experiment count N>=(2R+1)(R!)^2/[144 tau^(2R+1)]. For fixed eta,tau and r<=d/2 this is exp(Omega(sqrt(T) log T)). This is a lower bound, not matching minimax complexity. Expected total native duration averaged over the pair is >=(2R+1)(R!)^2/[144 tau^(2R)] when each run's duration is chosen at its start; arbitrary within-run stopping is outside that statement.

In the common ambient class, H conserves excitation, fixes vacuum and has one-excitation restriction I+C with ||C||<=2; zero hopping is allowed so exact-null models exist. Prepare psi, evolve h=min(tau,1/2)<=T, undo the candidate phase and measure X_a. For minus probability p, E_T<=min(1,(2T/h)sqrt(p)). No rejections in ceil[4T^2/(h^2 epsilon^2) log(1/alpha)] independent shots gives a sound epsilon certificate with exact completeness. It is not a tolerant-complete verifier. Reset and local operations cost N(C_reset+C_local), native time Nh; probability bias beta requires beta=O(h^2 epsilon^2/T^2) for this certificate.

Proof spine: alternating Lagrange weights on degree-2d Chebyshev-Lobatto nodes in [delta,1], delta=eta^2/(64d^2), yield positive spectral measures matching moments through 2d. The good measure has mass 1-rho at zero; the bad measure is supported >=delta with mass >=1-rho there, rho=tanh^2(2d artanh sqrt(delta))<=eta^2/9. Jacobi matrices differ only at the terminal diagonal. Reflection doubling, weak joining gamma=eta/(16T) and nonnegative density interactions make the connected isospectral pair. Target dynamics uses vacuum plus one excitation, not finite-density thermal hardness. For arbitrary active port controls the inaccessible endpoint occupation amplitude is <=2t^R/R! at t<=R/2. The overlap estimate ||I-Vg^dagger Vb||<=8u^(2R+1)/[(2R+1)(R!)^2] and adaptive quantum-memory composition give the count bound.

Matched dyadic rounding q<=min{eta/(96T),eta/(1200d^3)} preserves shared coefficients, positive hoppings, reflection and prediction margins with O(log(d/eta)) coefficient bits. The proof is an existence/precision statement; the numerical Jacobi compiler is not interval certified. The family is inhomogeneous with an inverse-polynomial weak link. Arbitrary independent bulk perturbations, fixed-noise robustness, Gibbs/finite-temperature preparation and decoherence are not covered. An additional endpoint |+> preparation and Y readout at t0=min(tau,1/32) distinguish the supplied pair in O(t0^-2 log(1/alpha)) shots; a coherent run of duration pi/delta also escapes. Neither escape is a universal Hamiltonian learner.

This continues N728 by changing the acquisition contract to active real-time local ports, without imaginary-time filtering. N728's logarithm/filter theorem and nominal Genesis bridge are not premises and remain intact. Existing local-operation learning/certification results have different spatial addressability, lifetime, preparation, norm or genericity assumptions; single readout alone is not excluded. Complete proof candidates and numerical diagnostics are preserved; independent correctness, historical priority, a practical positive tolerant certifier and technological advantage remain UNKNOWN.

N740-compatible-two-form-curvature-and-open-planar-quartic-completion | Compatible two-form completion isolates a Burkholder closedness obstruction and an open quartic gate
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-reported mathematical arguments only. For C2 rank-one-convex F on R^{2x2}, compatible jets are B1=[[a,b],[d,e]], B2=[[b,c],[e,f]], equivalently B1 e2=B2 e1. Set E_F=sum_i D2F(A)[Bi,Bi]. The source derives, at every fixed A, an algebraic two-form omega_A with E_F+omega_A(B1,B2)>=0 for all compatible jets, by imported univariate PSD matrix-polynomial SOS and the six quadratic minor relations. No smooth, polynomial or globally closed selection follows. Closed polynomial forms are exact and may integrate away in the established heat-flow interface; pointwise completion alone cannot.

In complex coordinates z=(A11+A22+i(A21-A12))/2, w=(A11-A22+i(A21+A12))/2, r=|z|,s=|w|,R=r+s, take F_p=((p-1)s-r)R^(p-1), p>2. On U={r,s>0}, Kp=2p(p-1)R^(p-2) and Omega=Kp(dz_R wedge dz_I+dw_R wedge dw_I) give the exact nonnegative square identity E_F+Omega=p(p-2)R^(p-3)[(p-1)s(a^2+b^2)+R^2((c-e)^2+(b-d)^2)/(4r)] after rotations. Nevertheless NO C1 closed two-form on all U gives such positivity for every compatible jet. Rotations and orientation-corrected conjugation reduce any candidate to rU dr wedge dtheta+rV ds wedge dtheta+sW dr wedge dphi+sZ ds wedge dphi. PSD null rows force U-V=Kp,W-Z=-Kp,Z=Kp,W=0, hence partial_r(sZ)-partial_s(sW)=2p(p-1)(p-2)sR^(p-3)>0. Constant anisotropic positive diffusion averages to the impossible isotropic certificate. This excludes that certificate class, not Burkholder quasiconvexity, nonlinear/nonlocal flows or integrated inequalities. Axis singularities do not repair an interior contradiction; p=2 gives -det A and no obstruction.

The determinant-square integrand is quasiconvex by the determinant null-Lagrangian identity and Jensen, but is not componentwise-heat monotone. On the 2pi torus h=sin x+sin y,v0=(h,h^2) has det Dv0=0. Its explicit heat evolution gives det Dvt=2e^-t(e^-2t-e^-4t)cos x cos y(sin x-sin y), with normalized mean (det Dvt)^2=0.5 e^-2t(e^-2t-e^-4t)^2>0. Thus a universal direct heat route for quartics fails, independently of exploratory numerics.

For homogeneous quartic POLYNOMIALS, Hessian reciprocity D2F(A)[H,H]=D2F(H)[A,A] makes the full Hessian PSD at rank-one matrices when F is rank-one convex. If additionally F vanishes on every rank-one matrix, divisibility and Euler identities force F=c(det A)^2,c>=0. This classifies only the rank-one-invisible ray, not all global completion obstructions. Define gamma_*(F)=inf_{rank H=1,Ddet(A)[H]!=0} D2F(A)[H,H]/[2(Ddet(A)[H])^2]. For gamma>=0, F-gamma det^2 is rank-one convex iff gamma<=gamma_*; examples gamma_*(det^2)=1 and gamma_*(|A|_F^4)=2. Determinant separation in the invariant class is credited prior work.

For quadratic-coefficient Omega, Euler/Cartan gives Omega_cl=(1/4)d(i_A Omega)=Omega-(1/4)i_A dOmega, globally exact. A sufficient positivity budget is E_G+Omega>=(1/4)|dOmega(A,B1,B2)|. Obtaining that budget, polynomial dependence or global closure is OPEN. Supplied rational J0,A,K,h and gamma satisfy 0<=J0<=(1-gamma)I, K>0, A in Q^{r x n},0<gamma<=1. For x in {-1,+1}^n, p(x) proportional exp[0.5 x^T J0 x+0.5(Ax)^T K(Ax)+h^T x]. Positive means PSD, not entrywise nonnegative; J0 need not have zero diagonal or obey a Dobrushin row-sum condition. The proposed randomized compiler outputs full-discrete TV-epsilon sampling and additive-epsilon log Z (relative partition accuracy), with preprocessing confidence 1-delta. Total rational input bits B include gamma. The recovered note's bound is [n^2{sqrt(n)+log(n/epsilon)}/epsilon]^{O(r)} poly(B,n,gamma^-1,epsilon^-1,log(1/delta)); the pasted report displays the looser n in place of sqrt(n). Polynomial-time scope requires fixed rank and inverse-polynomial residual gap. Rank reduction is charged rational linear algebra; tiny binary gamma is not free. No numerical spike/field norm or reciprocal Gaussian-cell mass appears in the claimed bound. Independent correctness and a certified full implementation are unestablished.

Classical Gaussian lifting uses ell(y)=h+A^T y and F(y,x)=exp[-0.5 y^T K^-1 y+0.5 x^T J0 x+ell(y)^T x], total mass C_K Z, C_K=(2pi)^(r/2)sqrt(det K). Hyperplanes divide each field in [-L,L] into bins of width Delta. On cell C, c_C clips to +/-L or rounds to a bin midpoint, b=n Delta/2, and D(y)=sum_i(|ell_i(y)|-L)_+=d_C^T y+e_C retains all excess energy. Q(y,x)=exp[-0.5 y^T K^-1 y+D(y)] exp[0.5 x^T J0 x+c_C^T x]. Let R=max_i sum_{j!=i}|J0ij| and rho=n exp[-2(L-R)]. Conditional wrong-sign bounds, without independence, give (1-rho)e^-b<=Z0(ell)/(e^D Z0(c_C))<=e^b. Exact ideal acceptance a=exp[(ell-c_C)^T x-D-b] obeys 0<=a<=1,Qa=e^-b F and conditional expected acceptance>=(1-rho)e^-2b.

The normalized spin envelope has TV(q_X,p)<=rho+2b and log-partition bias<=b-log(1-rho). Choose L=ceil R+ceil log2(8n/epsilon), Nbins=ceil(16nL/epsilon); b<=epsilon/16,rho<=epsilon/8. Each marginal has stationary law pi: mass1/3 at0, otherwise S2^T mod p with uniform sign and Pr(T=t)=2^{-t-1}. Modular collisions only reduce entropy. Choose a stationary law in each coset; exact generator projection makes every marginal pi without coordinate independence or joint irreducibility. Uniform coset label is determined by Z, so quotient entropy<=sum H(Z_i)<=N H(pi). No mixing time or efficient representative sampler is supplied. A conic representation may use N directions, but finding all legal directions/scalings can cost exponentially.

The F5 subspace W={(a,b,c,-a+b+2c,3a+b)} is versatile yet fails unit balance. At all-ones scaling its nonzero supports are 01011,01111,11001, with exact separator (-1,1,0,-1,0). At x'=(2,2,2,2,1) every cone vector has r1=r5; all-twos scaling has r1+r4=r2=r5, forcing r4=0 in their intersection. Two explicit states have the same A-image and those cone types, defeating even coset-specific fixed positive clocks for this subspace. Binary-tree gluing preserves versatility but forces root clock=sum of L leaf clocks, distortion>=L, N=4L-3. Conversely unit balance is constructively preserved under coordinate gluing.

These counterexamples are NOT irredundant affine covers. The five rank-two normals cannot cover F5^2 with five lines unless parallel. The OPEN gate asks whether every genuine irredundant affine cover with normal-column matrix A has 1_N in C(ker A,x) at every nonzero scaling, or at least sufficient common positive clocks. A valid falsifier must include p,A, affine offsets, full coverage, a private point per hyperplane, scaling x and an exact separator against all legal supports. Bare versatility is insufficient. If a sufficient gate holds, the exponential cover target and cited finite-abelian reduction follow; a separate conditional matrix-avoidance statement uses p>K0^{km}. No circuit-lower-bound, singularity-resolution or technological consequence follows here.

Reset-and-double dynamics already appear in Nagy-Pach-Tomon's WITHDRAWN 2022 preprint, whose invalid theorem is not used. The proposed repair is exact marginal-generator lifting with a separately unproved feasibility condition. The 2021 proofs and 2026 abstract/publication were inspected by the producer; the full 2026 PDF was not retrieved. N735 supplies a source-reported transferable generator-projection idea only: CRN rate-query, exact-variate and compiler bounds do not transfer. Source finite F5 evidence is compatible with the gate but proves no asymptotic improvement. Historical priority, independent correctness and a new foundational primitive remain UNKNOWN.

Column-generator Q(u)=Q0+sum_j u_j (nu_j-e_{a_j})e_{a_j}^T has distinct microscopic source states a_j, fixed destination laws under every combination, additive nonnegative rates and a unique normalized stationary kernel. Inference observes source indicators, bounded reward f in[0,1] and tagged added-transition counts; it is not given Q0, destinations or full stationary laws. Baseline plus k isolated probes with positive measured flux r_j give source changes F and output changes d. The exact feasible polytope is alpha>=0, z=z0+F alpha, 0<=z<=1, r_j alpha_j<=U_j z_j, objective w0+d^T alpha; recover u_j=r_j alpha_j/z_j (zero when z_j=0). A mass-one signed stationary combination is forced by kernel uniqueness to be the true positive law, closing hidden positivity constraints. This is a source-reported mathematical candidate; finite Markov perturbation response and known-model occupation LPs are established baselines.

Concrete acquisition assumes Q0=L0+rho(nu 1^T-I), rho>0, background exit<=Lambda_b, reproducible independent preparation nu, calibrated reset and detector. The reset is part of the optimized system. Prepare nu, evolve background plus controls until independent Exp(rho) stop; endpoints follow reset-stationary pi(u), and rho E C_j=u_j pi(u)(a_j). Ejection destinations outside the entire active source set ensure C_total<=N_background+1 and a geometric envelope of mean Lambda/rho, Lambda=Lambda_b+rho. Flux radius Lambda(2sqrt(t/n)+t/n), endpoint Hoeffding radius sqrt(t/(2n)), and measured positive calibration fluxes control confidence. Expected event work is independent of numerical control strength under ejection, not of slow reset or rare calibration.

With distinct sources/ejection, capping all rates at K changes reward by at most Lambda(1+Lambda/rho)/K. Finite-data outer LP and exact rational dual residual repair yield a global upper U_cert; fresh independent validation yields L, so U_cert-L certifies global regret conditionally on the model/confidence event. Source, reset, actuator, count and preparation errors are not inferred from that nominal confidence. The synthetic integer main case has 160 hidden states, four controls, original U=10^6, K=600 and cap allowance0.01. Five settings of800000 episodes plus400000 validation give L=0.399411387212, original upper0.4362237586773824, regret bound0.036812371465382424 at nominal99% conditional confidence, controls(600,0,600,0). These producer receipts are preserved, not independently reproduced.

Mixed probes acquire flux matrix R, source changes D and output changes d, giving H=D R^-1 and g=d^T R^-1. Fluxes beta>=0 obey z=z0+H beta, beta_j<=K_j z_j and sum beta<=Lambda. Coefficients R^-1 beta may be signed. The observable inverse norm and errors bound coefficient uncertainty without a free supplied response inverse. A rare pathway with isolated flux about9.22e-10 becomes accessible with mixed flux about0.49 and measured inverse norm4.08. Nevertheless its900000-episode certificate is vacuous (upper1); affordable adaptive probe discovery and nonvacuous noisy optimization remain OPEN. A five-state hidden-flag pair has identical isolated observable laws for all strengths but nearly opposite joint outputs: additive knobs alone do not establish distinct microscopic-source semantics. Pooled sources, crosstalk and controlled loops expose additional failures.

Inference storage is O(k^2), plus rational LP/count precision; the hidden simulator/system still embodies its states. The4.4million main episodes cost expected4.4million physical time units at rho=1, plus preparation, calibration, energy, reset/readout and bandwidth. Integer embedded races preserve endpoint/count laws under unbiased-bit assumptions without enumerating huge null-event counts, but do not generate realized duration. Roughly4.97s simulation and0.00255s LP are not physical performance or superiority over a known-generator LP. Actual source selectivity/ejection, useful probe coverage and acquired uniform mismatch bounds remain decisive. No unreset guarantee, unrestricted hidden-network polynomial acquisition, independently established originality, laboratory validation or transformative technological capability is claimed.

For a finite Boolean matrix M, r(M) is real rank, pi(M) the number of disjoint positive one-rectangles, and signed length s counts Cartesian rectangles with +/-1 coefficients. The general target pi(M)<=exp(polylog(s+2)) is an existing log-rank reformulation, still OPEN. The source constructs counterexamples to specific local cancellation rules, not to log-rank, arbitrary positive partitions or communication efficiency.

For every integer n,L>=1 it gives r=1+2Ln, signed length s=1+3Ln, and pi<=1+2Ln+n. The signed representation uses linearly independent actual columns in an inclusion-maximal dissociated choice; it does not insert duplicate opposite-sign rectangles. Equal sharing allocates each positive piece as U_i=1_{P_i}M/P. A chosen U_0 contains K(S,T)=1/(1+L|S intersect T|), S,T subsets of[n], with rank exactly 2^n. The source proves K=Z diag(d_|U|) Z^T, d_k=(-1)^k k!L^k/product_{j=0}^k(1+Lj). All diagonal factors are nonzero and their signs alternate: K is not asserted positive semidefinite. At L=8 and max-entry approximation error<=1/9, Sherstov/Paturi machinery gives rank>=2^{Omega(sqrt(n))}. This imported robust bound is superpolynomial, not exponential in n.

The same family has a cheap geometry-aware alternative: cancel each nested v^+-v^- pair first and retain the diagnostic predicates, giving O(n) disjoint positive rectangles for fixed L. A uniform random local priority at L=1 yields selected-label rank 2^{|I|}, mean (2^{n+1}-1)/(n+1), but a chosen global order escapes. A rank-one fixture on subset layers m,m+1 with singleton columns forces binom(2m,m+1) literal atoms, while one threshold predicate handles it. These demonstrate limitations of blind priority and literal-only refinement, not all useful predicates.

For a supplied representation with p positive and q negative rectangles, a general explicit compiler gives pi<=2^q sum_{k=1}^{min(q+1,p)} binom(p,k)<=2^q(q+1)p^{q+1}. Fixed q is polynomial, q=O(log s) quasipolynomial. This is not the general polylog-exponent theorem: q is supplied, and finding a small-negative representation is not free. Explicit-set operations and emptiness tests for succinct sets must be charged. A 4x4 Boolean cycle of rank three leaves rank three or four after removing any nonempty one-rectangle, despite an easy four-rectangle partition. Strictly monotone real-rank greedy progress therefore fails; a valid amortized potential is unproved.

The remaining capability needs global predicate synthesis and amortized control, rather than renaming the unresolved partition problem. The exact finite verifier supports debugging only. N642's Fourier result was read to preserve quantifier discipline; no FEI theorem transfers. OpenAI support/orbit hypotheses were not established. Statements, failures and prior references are source-reported, unreviewed research capital. For finite graph G with n vertices and max degree D>=1, rational real symmetric strictly row-diagonally-dominant A and symmetric C with graph-supported off-diagonals, define V(x)=x^T A x/2+a sum_i x_i^4/4+c sum_edges[(x_i+x_j)^4+(x_i-x_j)^4]/4 and W=x^T C x/2, a,c>0. Paired quartics are actual target interactions. The output is L=log[Z(i)/Z(0)] continued analytically from zero for Z(zeta)=integral exp(-V+zeta W), with absolute additive epsilon error. It is not an arbitrary principal branch; L/n is a weaker intensive output. C need not have low rank.

A rationally acquired coefficient certificate supplies an open zeta rectangle |Re zeta|<u0, |Im zeta|<v0 with v0>1 and tube |Im z_i|<=r. Set m=min_i(Aii-sum_{j!=i}|Aij|), c1=max_i sum_j|Cij|, c2^2=max_i sum_j Cij^2, m*=m-u0 c1, theta*=min(3a/(1+2D),3c). Require lambda=m*-(3a+24cD)r^2>0 and eta=m*r-(a+8cD)r^3-v0^2 c2^2/(4r theta*)>0. Concave feasibility in r^2 plus rational bracketing acquires a radius; no hidden mixing or root oracle is supplied. Failure of this sufficient certificate is not a hardness theorem.

Horizontal real-noise complex Langevin remains in the tube and is strongly accretive. The implicit resolvent R+h grad S_zeta(R)=w contracts by (1+h lambda)^-1. Finite-chain parameter holomorphy, moment bounds, stationary limits and strong order-one convergence give holomorphic observable means f_O. On a real interval the process has the positive Gibbs law. The identity theorem extends Z f_O=integral O exp(-S) without first dividing by possibly zero Z. For O=W, Z'=Z f_W proves zero-freeness and L=i integral_0^1 f_W(it)dt. Stability alone does not prove this identity; the source's contracting wrong-cycle example computes the wrong second moment. This is a source-reported proof candidate built on established complex-Langevin and analytic-continuation methods.

At bounded degree/local coefficients and fixed positive margins, analytic quadrature uses O(log(n/epsilon)) nodes, O(n epsilon^-2 log(M/delta)) endpoints per node, O(n epsilon^-1 log(n/epsilon)) steps and O(n) sparse drift cost, for ideal tilde-O(n^3 epsilon^-3) absolute-L work, with root, bit and margin factors charged. Intensive L/n has ideal tilde-O(max(n,epsilon^-2)epsilon^-1) work but does not ensure relative partition-ratio accuracy. Workspace is O(n+nnz A+nnz C+|E|+M) numbers with precision charged. Polynomial inverse margin is not polynomial in an arbitrarily small margin's bit length. A projected monotone root construction and finite-bit Gaussian reduction are described, not implemented with certified end-to-end errors. Model coefficients must still be acquired.

Producer finite checks do not supply general proof validation. Ten-site transfer quadrature takes about0.126s versus23.975s stochastic, with no demonstrated advantage. At n=2, epsilon=delta=.01 the conservative proof constants require h about1.2851e-11, 28 nodes, 128455084912 endpoints and about3.3106e23 resolvent calls before inner bit work. This is an unexecuted sufficient upper recipe, not a necessary lower bound. Floating runs at much larger h do not implement that guarantee.

Ordinary onsite quartics with generic imaginary neighbor forcing fail the displayed bounded-tube construction; whitening complexifies the quartic and fixed translations do not remove phase. Curved tubes require compatible noise and Ito/divergence corrections. A new geometry must preserve the original integral, a positive real anchor, noise tangency, nonexplosion, moments, holomorphy, mixing and fully acquired costs. General applicability, historical novelty, practical certified computation and transformative capability remain unestablished.

The target is an infinite translation-invariant one-dimensional spin chain H=-t/2 sum(XX+YY)+Hdiag, with bounded finite-range real density interactions of arbitrary strength, t!=0 and Lindbladian L O=i[H,O]+gamma sum_i(Z_i O Z_i-O), d=4gamma>0. The reference is tracial infinite-temperature half-density, susceptibility chi=1/4. Number is conserved, energy is not. Dephasing is part of the physical target, not a free regularizer. Supplied local coefficients or active constant-patch preparation/switching replace N742's passive Gibbs-copy interface. A scalar transport decision is not a universal rare-information escape.

Xi is the uniform conditional mean square local hopping detuning, conditioned on unequal neighboring occupations. For a nonempty polytope P with vertices in{0,1}^n, let k(P) be maximum Hamming length of an actual edge, zero for a singleton. For every real m-by-n A with Euclidean column norms<=1 and every x in P, the source proposes x in conv{v vertex(P):||A(v-x)||infinity<=54k(P)}. Equivalently a law on vertices has E Z=x and the bound almost surely, with at most n+1 atoms existentially. The law may depend on P,A,x; it is not one distribution for every A. For each additional linear objective c there is a good vertex with c^T v<=c^T x, not an assertion that every atom of one unbiased law has that cost property.

Define universal radius b(P) as supremum over m,A,x of the least such exact-marginal bound. The candidate gives k(P)/2<=b(P)<=54k(P), with singleton zero. N689 already records the same qualitative bounded-exchange classification, with upper4096k^3+48k. This new source proposes an O(k) quantitative refinement and a normalized proof; it is not Astra's first such classification. Original N689 proof/status remains unchanged and unvalidated. Matroid base edges have length2, giving bound108 for arbitrary matroids; a Boolean measurement matrix of column sparsity Delta scales to108 sqrt(Delta). Graphic matroids give exact edge marginals on spanning trees under this normalized measurement contract, not a general all-cut thin-tree or operator-norm sparsification theorem.

For any face F, varying coordinates s(F)<=k dim(F), proved from a spanning selection of incident edge directions. In sign variables Q=2P-1 this gives tangent dimension>=s/k at a fractional relative-interior point. Retained affine rows, deleted coefficients and offsets preserve current discrepancy; full deletion cost is bounded independently of n. A nonnegative spectral potential plus diagonal deposit and a positive ridge is normalized at the anchor point. The resolvent congruence is a quadratic-form identity on the orthogonal complement, not a general pseudoinverse transformation rule. High normalized modes and positive curvature are charged before intersection with the actual face tangent space; no alignment with a cube face is assumed.

The complete codimension budget is223s/(256k), leaving33s/(256k)>0 feasible directions after large rows, binding barriers, high modes and curvature restrictions. Concave barriers preserve both signs of a feasible direction. The tilted potential (L-1)_+^3-eta||y||^2+tau c^T(y-y0) has negative second derivative at any entirely fractional minimizer, with L<=1 handled separately. Thus each compact global minimization freezes a coordinate; at most n stages suffice existentially. Linear tilts have no curvature cost. Finite-set separation as tau tends to zero gives exact marginals; an exposed maximal edge midpoint gives the lower k/2 bound. The spectral/retained-row ingredients are explicitly credited to recent discrepancy work, not independently invented here.

Those compact constrained minima are generally nonconvex. Counting stages does not bound computation. For rational A,x, exhaustive vertex enumeration and an LP can find a law; this is exponential in n. Once supplied, n+1 vertices and rational probabilities of polynomial encoding length are exactly checkable, but finding them remains costly. The source does not implement a rounder or prove a polynomial-time sampler. N692 separately claims a polynomial-bit independence-oracle construction at constant262336, with missing standalone artifacts and unreviewed proof; it neither proves construction at108 nor validates the new normalized argument. Its progress/reset ideas are a review target, not an imported theorem.

The producer's exact dimension arithmetic and160 resolvent/24 curvature tests concern local analytic consistency only. Intermediate scouting remarks about other conjectures are preserved as process data without promotion. Independent correctness, historical priority, efficient construction at the sharper bound and a fundamental new computational capability remain UNKNOWN. The precise constructive task must charge face recovery, near-binding barriers, small coefficients, rational precision resets and total progress.

The source proposes deterministic polynomial-bit construction of r<=dim F(x)+1<=n+1 Boolean vertices in the minimal ORIGINAL face F(x), with rational probabilities, exact mean x and discrepancy strictly<B(k)=16 floor(sqrt(64k))^2+136k+1<=1161k on every supported atom. Every oracle call/objective bit length and geometric reduction is charged. For each rational cost c a favorable good vertex satisfies c^T v<=c^T x; this is not cost-favorability of every atom for every c. Arbitrary matroid bases need only an independence oracle and have B(2)=2209. Singleton/integral x is immediate. The sharper N749 existence bound54k (matroid108) is not constructed here.

Enclosing-cell repair: for z in original face F and fixed ORIGINAL-input rational slice Cy=d, choose h=2^-p and coordinate intervals[h floor(z_j/h),h floor(z_j/h)+h]. An exact rational LP returns a vertex of the nonempty intersection F intersect{Cy=d} intersect box. Its infinity distance from z is<=h and encoding is polynomial in original input plus p, using Boolean facet determinant bounds O(n log n). The repaired point need not be dyadic (y1=1/3). Temporary box facets are discarded; subsequent geometry uses the minimal original face, which may become smaller. The explicit-inequality code implements exact active-boundary pushes, not a general optimization-oracle reduction as software.

Geometry/spectral proof: N varying coordinates give dim F>=N/k from actual edge directions. In Q=2P-1 set K=64k,R=floor sqrt K,H=32R^2,eta=1/(Kn); retain p_ij=b_ij^2,q_i=sum p, delete p_ij>q_i/K, hold large rows q_i>R^2, and choose decreasing dyadic medium scales q_i<=r_i^2<4q_i. Barriers u_i,sigma=(sigma d_i-H)/r_i+R G_i/(2r_i^2)+12R-e<=0, G_i=sum p_ij(1-y_j^2). M=sum_i,sigma32K r_i^-4 exp(u/(2R))p_i p_i^T+Bdiag+eta11^T and Phi=(lambda_max(M)-8)_+^3-eta||y||^2. M is on active coordinates; the negative regularizer includes frozen coordinates. Entrywise positivity and the rank-one floor give a top spectral gap>=eta, not an unacquired eigengap promise.

The nonface codimension is<35N/K+2, leaving feasible directions for N>8k after original-face, cost, large-row, protected-barrier and spectral restrictions. U_jj<=2D_jj/R^2, a restricted trace argument for6U-D and high-mode derivative cancellation yield Phi''<=-2eta||h||^2 in an exact feasible direction. Approximate gradient/Hessian to norm error<=eta/4, impose the approximate gradient constraint exactly, and find a rational negative direction of Z^T(Htilde+eta I)Z. The physical-coordinate identity shift precedes restriction to a possibly ill-conditioned rational basis. Normalized p_i/r_i^2 and the top-gap bound support polynomial-bit projector/reduced-resolvent evaluation; tiny original coefficient bit lengths remain charged.

Progress uses B3=2^40 K^2 n^2, tau=min(1/4,eta/(8B3)),D=eta tau^2/64 and fixed precision below the accumulated margin. A full tau step decreases Phi by at least D after cell repair and row reset. A short step can increase Phi slightly but hits a proper ORIGINAL face, even when no coordinate becomes integral (a matroid rank facet). There are<=n strict face drops and<=eta n/D+1 full moves; the displayed conservative bound is2^92 K^6 n^7+1 per favorable-cost call. Phi>=-eta n and lambda_max<9 close the induction. No minimum face width is promised. With<=8k fractional coordinates, release the temporary cost equality and optimize c over the original face. Polynomial complexity here is a candidate theorem with enormous bounds, not practical efficiency.

Exact-mean extraction fixes the good set G for A,x,B(k). Every rational separator c with constraints c^T(v-x)>=1 receives a violated good vertex from the favorable routine. With x=a/Q, normals Qv-a are bounded integers; a determinant argument bounds separators of EVERY feasible collected subsystem. Doubling yields a positive-margin ball of radius1/(2n) in a known box. A rational ellipsoid run must therefore collect a finite infeasible transcript, giving x in its finite vertex hull; exact LP and affine-dependence elimination yield<=dim F+1 atoms. This is not optimization over G, compactness alone, a partition function or uniform good-base sampling. Exact sampling of non-dyadic rational probabilities has expected polynomial fair-bit cost, not bounded worst-case fair bits.

Strong optimization/separation and exact rational LP use established Boolean-facet encoding machinery. Minimal-face recovery, line endpoints and cell repair consume polynomially many original optimization calls. For matroids, weighted greedy uses independence; rank queries cost<=n independence tests and rank-minus-modular submodular minimization is explicitly charged. Boolean feasible-VERTEX membership is weaker: hiding a perfect matching on2r elements yields feasible r-subset probability p_r=2^r/binom(2r,r)=Theta(sqrt r 2^-r), and all-negative adaptive transcripts have success<=(q+1)p_r including final output, even A=0,k=2,x=1/2. This is not an obstruction for independence or strong convex optimization.

Integral base polyhedra: for integer-valued normalized submodular f and rational x in B(f), a=floor x, the known nearest-integer-cell reduction has residual rank rho(U)=min_T[f(T)-a(T)+|U minus T|]. It is reconstructed and credited, not newly invented. The candidate yields integer Z in B(f), each Z_j in{floor x_j,ceil x_j}, exact mean and hard discrepancy<2209 with input/value bit costs rather than numerical capacities. Every initially tight inequality remains tight. Gaussian convex-order domination is not asserted for this law.

Weighted edges: supply rational mu_j>=||Acol_j||2 and Gamma>0 bounding the weighted length sum mu_j|u_j-v_j| of every actual edge of F(x). With d varying coordinates, r_j=max(1,ceil(d mu_j/Gamma)) tied copies give<=d^2 coordinates, edge support<=2d and normalized copy column d Acol_j/(Gamma r_j). Lift optimization sums objectives then makes one original call. Projecting the law gives strict discrepancy<2322 Gamma, exact mean and support<=d+1. Replication does not scale with inverse minimum positive weight. An exposed-edge midpoint gives a universal weighted-radius lower Gamma/2 when Gamma is the actual maximum; computing that maximum from an arbitrary oracle is NOT claimed.

An acyclic grammar supplies deterministic linear controls on F_2^D, fresh independent additive noise at EVERY occurrence, explicit polynomial/categorical marks, exact rational rates/weights and binary nested repetition. Singular controls are allowed. This extends the N738 compressed compound-Poisson endpoint family with once-per-slot discrete faults and arbitrary-degree EXPLICIT sparse polynomials. It supplies candidate full JOINT endpoint sampling, not trajectory output, physical calibration, coherent-error simulation, adaptive feedback or a demonstrated fast program.

Center each polynomial F at F(0), compile deterministic drift once, and push remaining marks through deterministic linear suffixes. Node summaries compose C_AB=C_B C_A and S_AB=C_B S_A+S_B. For any law J, independent J,J' and an unexposed fair B, J+B(J+J') has law J. A conditional affine-uniform state C+Uniform(W) therefore updates C<-C+J, W<-span(W,J+J'). The offset MUST update even when rank does not grow. A centered coefficient span inside W allows an entire noise occurrence/subtree to be skipped. Otherwise a nonconstant scalar degree<=d polynomial has disagreement probability>=2^-d between two independent inputs. At most D innovations imply expected<=D2^d active slot visits and a polynomial cap O(2^d[D+log(1/epsilon)]). Grammar traversal/persistent path-copy deletion pays depth per visited leaf without expanding repetitions; only noise occurrences are removed, controls retained. This bounded-degree discrete theorem is exact in the ordinary expected bit model, with no ideal real clock; its capped version pays TV error.

For explicit categorical supports<=s, center at a mode with probability>=1/s. If a heavy atom of mass>=tau survives outside W, the pair update grows rank with probability>=2tau/s. Process the WHOLE slot, including its offset, then remove that occurrence from a positive residual grammar. Expected visits<=Ds/(2tau). Once every heavy direction is absorbed, each residual outside mass<=s tau. Hidden heat-bath kernels P_i=I+p_i(K_i-I) and E_i=exp[p_i(K_i-I)] have local TV<=p_i^2 a_i(W); telescoping ORIGINAL prefixes and approximate suffixes charges expected rank increases<=D. The global replacement error<=D p_max, hence<=2Ds tau for residual categorical laws. The sharper local physical Bernoulli/Poisson comparison is q(1-exp(-q))<=q^2. Choosing tau~epsilon/(Ds), with compiler/cap error budgets, yields polynomial approximate endpoint cost without an initial dominant-zero/laziness assumption. This is not operator-norm approximation on every point state or infinite divisibility of every slot.

The companion compound-Poisson proof uses all-parity positive summaries for ACTIVE-MASS COUNTING; fresh conditional draws come from the ORIGINAL leaf law, never from the sparsifier as a physical noise substitute. For bounded degree, rejection outside W succeeds>=2^-d. Summary/descent error is O(DH rho), with polynomial preprocessing and explicitly allocated caps/clock precision. Finite clocks have density bound A and discretization error O(D^2 A Delta); log A and minimum positive stored-weight bit lengths, not numerical huge rates, set precision. The provided basis-peeling, generator and repeated-control scripts implement supporting identities, not the whole compiler.

For arbitrary-degree sparse leaves with m explicitly listed nonzero monomials, the KNOWN Karpinski-Luby inequality Z_ell=sum_{ell(c_A)=1}2^-|A|<=m^2 p_ell supplies importance proposals. Choose a monomial uniformly, force its variables to1, sample others uniformly; density h=(1/m)sum_true2^|A|, weight g=1/h. On an active cut g<=m^3 p_ell. O(m^3[D+log(1/delta)]/eta^2) samples give simultaneous relative parity summaries. Rejection with fresh proposals and g/(m^3 a_up) acquires the TRUE conditional outside mark in expected polynomial work. Degrees cost encoded monomial lengths, not2^degree. Discrete sparse slots use q<=Z<=m^2q, pair innovation>=2q/(m+1), heavy coefficients w_A>=tau/m and rank-budget Poissonization error<=2D tau. This is application of established sparse-polynomial counting, not invention of its FPRAS and not arbitrary succinct Boolean circuits.

A supplied arbitrary Boolean-circuit control iterated binary-exponentially many times already contains deterministic PSPACE simulation at zero noise; a general polynomial endpoint sampler with constant TV<1/3 would imply PSPACE subset BPP. This scoped complexity consequence does not exclude all structured nonlinear physical models. Relative rare-event precision, unknown noise acquisition, shared latent randomness and random noncommuting controls remain unsupplied. Polynomial claims have not been fully implemented, externally verified or practically benchmarked.

Four supplied transport notes continue the N747 balance/current-witness and N748 artificial-monitoring families. They preserve the finite/infinite and physical/artificial generator distinctions. None establishes an economical high-accuracy interacting-current solver, invalidates the coarse transport sandwich or independently audits the complete source manuscripts. Exact model conventions matter: some notes use H_diag=U sum ZZ, whereas U(n-1/2)(n-1/2) has a factor4 conversion.

Paid continuation: with K=ker(PAQ), C=Pi(S_Q+QAQ)Pi, j=Pi J,S_Q>=dI and ||j||^2/n<=a=t^2/2, f(r)=<j,(C+rI)^-1j>/n. An interacting four-site exact example f(r)=1/[4(r+1)]+(r+1)/[4((r+1)^2+16)] has nonreal poles, rejecting a positive Stieltjes representation in r, not complete monotonicity. Standard positive-real/Herglotz machinery instead yields F(w)=integral w/(w^2+x)mu(dx), w=d+r, mu>=0,totalmass<=a. Thus f(r)/(d+r) is Stieltjes in (d+r)^2; no measure-acquisition oracle is assumed.

For c=1+r/d,0<=c f(r)-f(0)<=(a/d)(c-1)/(c+1). A legitimately acquired node estimate fhat with error<=delta gives interval[c(fhat-delta)-(a/d)(c-1)/(c+1),c(fhat+delta)], intersect[0,a/d]. At a/d=1/4,r=d/8, midpoint=(9/8)fhat-1/136 and delta=1/425 gives error exactly.01, versus prior ten-node~1.49e-10. A sharper data-dependent moment interval is also provided; it is sharp for the positive-measure information class, not every spin model. The inherited estimator still implies~1.57e45 sufficient samples at the one node.
