A specific globally preheated, optically inhibited DCPD front architecture targets a10cm/1L arbitrary-mask polymer part with10um internal features in~100s. It is a conditional screening calculation and rejected admission, not a prototype, new manufacturing capability or universal resolution impossibility. Existing frontal polymerization, photoinhibition, recuperative microcombustion and xolography are credited baselines. A hot, spatially immobile low-dose inhibition gate remains unacquired.

The supplied reaction-diffusion model rho cp T_t=kappa LaplacianT+rho H alpha_t and alpha_t=A exp(-E/RT)f(alpha)/s uses UNKNOWN effective inhibition s. F(alpha)=integral d alpha/f(alpha) gives an exact exposure reduction within this assumed model. With alpha_initial.05,on.90,off.06, F_on2594.27238,F_off.10362085. At200C the on time~.5109s;100s off holds require s>=2592 at100C,176012 at150C,4900268 at200C. Reducing the shared hot exposure to.5109s lowers s~25036: these are chosen-history requirements, not architecture-independent lower bounds or measured inhibitor properties.

Diffusion attenuates a feature-width a Fourier mode by exp[-pi^2 integralDdt/a^2].90% retention requires integralDdt<=-log(.9)a^2/pi^2;10um/100s requires D<=1.07e-14m^2/s (1um1.07e-16). No TMG diffusivity is assumed; catalyst transport can remain after inhibitor tethering. Thermal diffusivity9.57e-8m^2/s equalizes10um in~1.05ms, so chemistry must retain the hot mask.

One liter~.98kg supplies343kJ reaction heat, preheating25->200C needs274kJ before losses with recovery/startup separately charged. The cited5.4J/cm^2 dose at1.3mm corresponds41.5kJ/L; naively retaining that dose per10um slice at50% inhibited occupancy costs2.7MJ/L before wall-plug losses. This is known-dose architecture arithmetic, not an optical lower bound. An arbitrary10cm cube on10um binary grid has10^12 bits/125GB input, at1um125TB; compact CAD restricts shape families and cannot erase arbitrary-mask input/delivery cost.

The suggested co-immobilized inhibitor/catalyst class has no demonstrated joint kinetics, diffusion, optical dose or mechanical envelope. Source code/results and packaging log are preserved without replay. Reopen with chemically explicit measured/defensible gate parameters and a heat-recovery/pattern geometry outperforming matched existing methods; no physical experiment, priority or energy advantage is established.

For supplied binary-spin graph energy H(x)=-sumJ_ij x_i x_j-sumh_i x_i, retain three same-temperature replicas and reassign their sitewise spin multisets jointly. At each mixed site let majority sign s_i and minority replica label c_i in{0,1,2}; x_i^(a)=s_i[1-2 1(a=c_i)]. Local-field and unanimous-site edges stay constant; mixed edges obey sum_a x_i^(a)x_j^(a)=s_i s_j[-1+4 1(c_i=c_j)]. Conditional recombination is exactly a signed three-state Potts law with coupling K_ij=4J_ij s_i s_j. Exact conditional heat-bath resampling preserves joint equilibrium but is not generally ergodic. This is an internally derived identity and scoped primitive, not a novel general solver or measured mixing advantage.

If the OBSERVED mixed graph is a forest, established three-label dynamic programming samples in linear arithmetic work after graph/replica acquisition; treewidth t costs tables~3^(t+1). Favorable observed structure is not demonstrated for difficult frustrated systems. With multiset{+,+,-} everywhere and J=-1, total energy=-|E|+4 times monochromatic edges; reaching-|E| is exactly graph three-colorability. Thus unrestricted zero-temperature exact reassignment hides graph coloring. This excludes an assumed free conditional solver, not every useful recombination algorithm or all positive-temperature samplers.

Agreeing replicas admit no new sitewise alternatives. Increasing replica count increases conditional alphabet binom(m,k); independent unbiased mixed fractions1-2^(1-m) grow from1/2 to3/4 to1023/1024 at m2,3,11. More replicas do not automatically sparsify the conditional graph.

Charge O(mN+E) input/storage and O(mN) explicit output,3^u general three-label enumeration, forest messages or treewidth tables, and cumulative probability precision (e.g.epsilon/u conditional TV per site). No analog ground-state or free physical equilibration is assumed. Producer audit exhausts243 recombinations of an8-site10-edge instance with5 mixed sites, exact integer energy error0 and double-precision Gibbs difference0; triangle27 and K4 81 labelings expose coloring endpoints. These verify finite algebra only. The final audit output was not rerun at bundle packaging;10 earlier checks were. Nothing was executed at intake.

Replica permutation/cluster ideas and tree dynamic programming are credited; a screened autonomous decoder idea already appears in literature and is not promoted. No external correctness, historical novelty, large-system useful mixing gain or physical capability is established. The decisive missing operation is a cheap nontrivial conditional reassignment for consequential frustrated regimes, tested with matched end-to-end costs.

The source derives a continuum Fourier collision operation with retained ultraviolet cutoff K and finite maximum lag L=2T. Fourier measure is dk, without a (2pi)^-3 factor. This is a generator statement under explicitly supplied density/score regularity, not a derivation from particles. Historic-advance target NOT_ACHIEVED; novelty and external correctness UNKNOWN.

For u!=0 put r=|u|, P_u=I-uu^T/r^2, phi(x)=pi cos^2(x)/(2[(pi/2)^2-x^2]^2) with removable values, and A_T^K(u)=int_|k|<=K (P_u k)(P_u k)^T |k|^-4 T phi(T k.u) dk. Positivity, evenness and exact transversality give the standard Landau weak-form conservation of mass, momentum and kinetic energy and entropy dissipation. Angular/radial elimination yields A_T^K=(pi/r)[log(KTr)-c+epsilon(KTr)]P_u, with 0<=epsilon(a)<=pi^2/(8a^2) and c=1/2+log(pi/2)-Ci(pi)-Si(pi)/pi. A value at u=0 is irrelevant only for the stated absolutely continuous weak interface.

Finite memory regularizes the infrared integral without supplying a screening length; the ultraviolet cutoff remains. At fixed L>0, the log-K-normalized weak generator tends to pi P_u/r under the specified density, score and logarithmic-tail hypotheses. It does not prove convergence of evolved laws or collisional-time iid particles. A discrete torus and a vanishing small-mode cutoff are separate obligations. For supplied Yukawa response, the cosine angular error is O(L^-2), uniform in finite K, with both bounded-score-Hessian and bounded-density/finite-Fisher weak variants. These assumptions are not acquired from microscopic dynamics.

At equal maximum time lag, cosine minimizes frequency variance only within the stated nonnegative squared-Fourier window class. Fejer windows also recover the same leading logarithm with finite absolute logarithmic moment. Cosine improves the variance and convergence rate, not existence of this limit; its matched unscreened offset is not uniformly superior. No molecular simulation, instrument, device or CPU advantage was demonstrated. The supplied radial infinite-time tensor already has a closed-form baseline.

The raw unprojected tensor retains b_T^K(r)=pi R_phi(KTr)/r: nonzero energy defect before log normalization, although subleading in that limit. Narrow Lorentzian response ridges force memory Omega(1/width). Neither projection nor a normalized limit permits exchanging all limits or discarding physical field/potential energy.

The companion exact pair ledger mu_N=(N-1) pushforward(f_2,N) under rho=N(x1-x2) tracks close-pair energy. Its fast-scale equation retains an explicit three-particle/external-force remainder. Smooth correlated dimer preparations approach independent fixed-order marginals yet change a bounded velocity observable in O(1/N); they defeat the unweighted restart interface, not the iid target. Rutherford covariance uses an additional independent-encounter flux. The shifted echo calculation is a prescribed-field diagnostic with every derivative and field amplitude retained, not a self-consistent plasma counterexample. Energy alone does not control grazing impulse covariance. The missing operation is acquisition and control of this weighted pair/history state from iid dynamics through N/log N time.

The target is strongly polynomial arbitrary rational LP: poly(m,n) arithmetic operations/comparisons independent of coefficient magnitudes, with polynomial intermediate rational encoding length. The campaign obtains restricted block operations and scoped obstructions, not a general LP algorithm or an impossibility theorem. Completion NOT_ACHIEVED; external correctness and priority UNKNOWN.

For explicitly acquired one-negative-resource feedback bundles, exact Schur/M-matrix elimination either closes all protected coordinates in O(k^3+nk) rational operations or supplies an improving recession certificate. This resums an Omega(2^L) local-batching example without a spectral-gap search. Classical M-matrix/Leontief principles are credited. Selecting the bundle and bounding the number of changed bundles remain unpaid.

General signed resources obey x-Qu with u>=0. An acquired inverse-positive Q or nonnegative right inverse closes the protected stocks; additional guard rows must be checked and can truncate the move. Exact counterexamples show admissible full blocks without admissible two-by-two subblocks, and a rectangular right inverse without any monotone square basis. Given full row rank and an acquired v>0 with Qv=0, add suitable multiples of v to an algebraic right inverse to make it nonnegative in strongly polynomial arithmetic, with polynomial bit lengths. Checking Q1=0 can supply v=1 cheaply.

Optimizing profit among such closures still contains arbitrary feasible bounded rational LP, even with Q1=0 and this repair available. The acquisition-preserving reduction charges denominator clearing, determinant bounds and encoding lengths. Appending the objective as another protected resource breaks the repair: a strictly positive cost-neutral nullvector with finite optimum forces the objective to annihilate ker Q and hence be constant on feasible closures. Corank one with known positive nullvector is a solved restricted case; higher nullity retains facet/circulation selection.

The projective account retains unbounded cross ratios at fixed oriented matroid and shows bounded-size coordinate jumps can incur coefficient-dependent progress. Exact collective solve/sign/ratio jumps escape an acquired narrow cone, but compatible slack acquisition is itself LP, and new tight rows need not be tight at the optimum. No general scaling, basis, circuit, strong oracle or permanent-progress operation is supplied for free. The reductions and counterexamples defeat these representations and rules; they do not establish a lower bound against all strongly polynomial algorithms.

A restricted open-chain algorithm acquires a density-phase quadratic gauge directly from constant-size local hopping tables, instead of receiving the conjugating circuit. General long-time polynomial classical simulation remains unresolved and its unrestricted form would imply BQP=BPP. The recognized family uses established gauge-solvable correlated-hopping principles; no generic interacting or baseline asymptotic advantage, historic advance or cleared novelty is claimed.

Input terms are hopping tau_j(Z_{j-1},Z_{j+2}) sigma_j^+ sigma_{j+1}^- plus conjugates and real onsite potentials, with no additional terms silently ignored. O(N) recognition requires all table entries to fit tau_j(zL,zR)=a_j u_{j-1}^{zL}u_{j+1}^{-zR}, |u_l|=1, absent boundary phases one. It checks every entry, handles all-zero bonds and square-root aliases, and rejects mixed zeros, inconsistent phase/magnitude tables or artificial boundary dependence. This reconstructs H=W H0 W^dagger with W=exp(i sum theta_l Z_l Z_{l+1}) and quadratic H0. Exact arithmetic and floating residual tests are distinct.

For arbitrary mixed/pure product input, W-dressing need not be Gaussian. A width-two phase-difference contraction evaluates the needed dressed Pauli expectations in O(N), with l1 norm controlled by one-site positivity. It acquires every initial two-point covariance in O(N^3); one-particle diagonalization/preprocessing also costs O(N^3). Each selected-site occupation at one time costs O(N^2), and all occupations O(N^3). Time/precision and residual error are charged: |delta f_A(T)|<=2T||delta H||, with missing terms rejected or included in the error. Formal interval/finite-bit certificates are not supplied. Fixed-depth tensor contraction is an equivalent known baseline, and the source explicitly claims no asymptotic advantage over it.

The companion general primitive cancels a signed history pack only when its first m product-boundary response jets vanish, then retains a deterministic or unbiased tail. For g|tau|<1, W_m=Gamma sum_{r>=m}(alpha)_r(g|tau|)^r/r!, |Z|<=W_m and Var Z<=W_m^2. Jet acquisition, endpoint supports, coefficient bits, Gamma and total pack count remain charged. Positive-residue return registers reconstruct projection/Krylov machinery. Small local signals, finite matching jets and apparent equilibration do not certify erasure of future returns; volume-law entanglement alone does not certify computational hardness.

The decisive interacting gate is a polynomial total bound on sum C_acquire plus epsilon^-2 (sum W_m)^2, with its independence/sampling assumptions stated. No such theorem is established. A supplied compressed signal, influence rank, quantum-measured moment, or observable closure changes the input interface. The current recognized local-occupation algorithm is a concrete restricted operation with producer finite checks, not acquisition of generic interacting cancellation.

The source constructs a candidate finite-to-nonlocal transport certificate for hard square-lattice Kob-Andersen two-vacancy facilitation, with exactly supplied Bernoulli product equilibrium mu_p, q=1-p and chi=pq. The target is the infinite-volume collective/bulk variational coefficient D(p)=(2chi)^-1 inf_local f E sum_i c_i(a_i+G_i f)^2, a_i=(eta_0-eta_ei)1_{i=1}. This is not tagged self-diffusion or an additional hard-constraint hydrodynamic theorem. No forbidden move is softened. The L=3 module joins two blocks into a6x3 rectangle. A port-independent eight-site reservoir gate demands a vacancy on each of four outer sides and among the four center neighbors. Its154 patterns have particle-count coefficients(1,8,28,52,49,16,0,0,0), giving gamma(p)=q^8+8pq^7+28p^2q^6+52p^3q^5+49p^4q^4+16p^5q^3. Gates of disjoint blocks are independent. A legal antisymmetric configuration-space current H has source sum_b H_b=(sigma_u-sigma_v)g_u g_v. It may traverse bad intermediate gate states and is legal even with occupied exterior. This is a nonzero configuration-space defect, not a zero spatial divergence. The finite graph has262144 configurations,998400 unoriented legal edges and47432 nonzero sources. Numerical flow proposal is rounded to denominator2^40 and integer residual repaired along a forest; exact equations, not solver convergence, justify the finite witness. Overlap weights4 inside blocks and1 at interfaces enter C(p)=E_Q sum_b w_b H_b^2/(2chi gamma^2).

On the coarse lattice, closed dual-edge components C_z come from bad blocks. Average the affine height over each entire component, Psi(z)=mean_{w in C_z} w_2, and take its rotated gradient k. It is conserved and zero on closed edges. With b=1-gamma, M=[[1,2],[2,3]], A=bM and u=(1,1)^T, the source proves P(R_z>=1)<=4b and P(R_z>=r)<=16b^2 u^T A^(r-2)u for r>=2 using shortest distinct-site chordless paths. Condition Delta=1-4b-b^2>0, equivalently b<sqrt(5)-2, yields finite components and m2=4b+32b^2(3-4b+b^2)/Delta^2, Kcal=1+8m2. This supplies integrable stationary correction beta=Psi-z_2 and mean horizontal flux1 without an unknown percolation constant.

The essential lifting coefficient is F_e=k_e(Gamma^{e+}), forcing both endpoint block gates good. It depends only on reservoirs outside the module and stays fixed during every microscopic module transition. Assemble J_b^tile=sum_{e:b in Q_e} F_e H_b^e and average nine translated tilings. The gated source identity and conditional independence of ports reduce admissibility against every local corrector to a finite spatial-divergence pairing. Response is<a,J>=2chi/L and energy||J||^2<=2chi C Kcal/L^2, with c^-1 norm on legal rate-one bonds. The source obtains D>=1/(C Kcal). This preserves N751's exact-local no-go; it does not identify this nonlocal current with an exactly conserved finite-range one.

For R>=1, S=(I-A)^-1 and T_R=16b^2 u^T A^(R-1)[(R+1)^2 I+(2R+3)AS+2A^2S^2]u bound E[R_z^2 1_{R_z>R}]. Resolve beta only within radius R, otherwise zero, take the rotated gradient and clip to open edges. The resulting legal J_R generally is not conserved. The derived ensemble L2 completion bound is||J-J_R||^2<=16chi C T_R/L^2. It is not uniform pointwise error. Component averaging also completes bounded local stationary stream modifications, without a density theorem for this family or a universal defect-completion principle.

For0<p<=0.40 the source certifies Delta>0 and reports broad lower endpoints0.208740656430 atp=.10,0.077629966716 at.20,0.030189748264 at.25,0.008932514941 at.30,0.001628331275 at.35 and0.000010861655 at.40. They are rounded down; exact rational endpoints are archived. The elementary f=0 upper bound(1-p^3)^2 is not the strongest specialized upper calculation. No best-known-bound, generic speedup, dense glassy solution or newly validated physical capability follows. For F=LJ and ensemble error1e-6, sufficient radii include18 atp=.20,46 at.30 and1280 at.40; these do not demonstrate cheap exact moments.

Established Thomson duality, Shapira's nonlocal paths/coarse-percolation lower bounds, Ertul-Shapira frameability and tagged coarse-connectivity geometry, and specialized Arita-Krapivsky-Mallick primal calculations are credited. For nonzero real polynomials p_i and a latent law with density strictly positive almost everywhere on R^m, define F_i=1{p_i<0}. Collect distinct sign-changing irreducible factors q_j and masks v_j=(ord_qj p_i mod2)_i. For a regular output c0, the source claims aff_F2(supp F)=c0+span(v_j); exact constant parities are the orthogonal kernel. The crossing lemma finds a simple real root of each sign-changing irreducible away from all other factors using generic-line resultants. Sign-definite factors and even powers contribute only an offset. This extracts the affine hull, not full support or probabilities: x(x+y),y(x+y),xy attain000,101,011 but not110 although their masks span the even-parity code.

For the exact uniform law on c+C, C<=F2^n dimension k, a Gaussian polynomial-threshold generator with coordinate degrees<=d_i exists iff C has a basis B=(b_j) with ell_i(B)=sum_j(b_j)_i<=d_i. Extract independent masks for necessity; independent Gaussian signs in ptilde_i=(-1)^c_i product_{j:(b_j)_i=1}Y_j give sufficiency. The coordinatewise normal form preserves degree, not original latent dimension or circuit architecture, and uses k<=n signs. Minimum total degree equals minimum basis total Hamming weight; minimum maximal coordinate degree equals minimum maximal coordinate load. Distance d gives sum_i deg p_i>=dk and max_i deg p_i>=dk/n, hence Omega(n) for constant-rate good codes.

Exact positive-weight mixtures supported on c+C obey sum_j 2^(T_j/d)>=2^k, where T_j is component total coordinate degree. If each coordinate degree<=D and delta=d/n, log2 L+D/delta>=k. The target is easy to sample from a supplied binary generator matrix: k fair bits and O(nk) binary operations, with no numerical Gaussian sampling required. Polynomial degree is not runtime. No P!=NP, unrestricted circuit/neural-network or general sampling-hardness theorem follows.

For a target P on S subset{0,1}^n with pairwise Hamming distance>=delta n,0<delta<=1, and max_x P(x)<=2^-h, let Q be a mixture of L degree<=D Gaussian-threshold laws,D>=1, with arbitrary component dimensions, means, covariances and coefficients. Singular Gaussians are pulled back to intrinsic standard latent space, with identically-zero coordinate pullbacks treated by the chosen constant convention. For0<eta<1, K=(2/eta)^[cot^2(pi delta eta^2/(4D))], the source claims TV(P,Q)>=1-eta-LK2^-h. No component is assumed to lie in S; arbitrary leakage and bias are allowed. Imported Kane noise sensitivity and Gaussian hypercontractivity/positive semigroup correlation bound unequal versus equal pairs of light atoms, yielding q^2<=eta q/2+eta^2/2 and q<=eta; union heavy atoms across all components has at most LK points.

The explicit bound log2 K<=16D^2 log2(2/eta)/(pi^2 delta^2 eta^4) gives log2 L+(512/pi^2)D^2/delta^2>=h-2 if TV<=1/4. For good codes and polynomial mixtures, this gives only Omega(sqrt(n)) approximate degree; for fixed D,delta and L=2^o(n), eta=n^-1/8 yields TV->1. Constants can be vacuous at small n. The Omega(n) exact versus Omega(sqrt(n)) approximate gap remains OPEN. x and x-epsilon disprove literal shared-factor inference from small parity error. Probability-weighted sign-boundary geometry is proposed, not proved, as a replacement; the scalar noise/hypercontractive argument loses a square.

Acquisition: mask/kernel computation is binary linear algebra only GIVEN real factorization and sign-changing classification. No efficient general acquisition, optimum-basis solver or bit-cost guarantee is supplied. Non-affine support feasibility, atom-weight synthesis, entangled marginal consistency and a cost surviving unrestricted circuit composition remain outside this operation. Lovett-Viola already establishes approximate good-code sampling obstructions for bounded-depth Boolean circuits; Kane and hypercontractivity are established ingredients. The particular classification and mixture inequality have historical novelty UNKNOWN; source repository search and abstract comparisons are incomplete.

Auxiliary Appendix A gives a sufficient separable quantum pair completion: one-qubit states I/2 and symmetric zero-site-block coefficient matrix T,|T_ab|<=1/3; K=I+sin^circ((3pi/2)T)>=0 permits G~N(0,K), Bloch vectors r_i=sgn(G_i)/sqrt3 and Omega=E tensor_i(I+r_i.sigma)/2. The established Gaussian arcsine identity matches pair T. Compression of tensor powers bounds ||T^circ k||<=||T||^k and yields sufficient ||T||<=2 asinh(1)/(3pi) approximately.187. This is an inner certificate, not all compatibility or entanglement. The balanced four-sign slice rejects one Gaussian certificate but a three-matching antithetic mixture realizes its full law; pair data and full-law sampling differ. Floating examples are not certified PSD. This appendix is preserved as motivating construction, not an independently established invention.

The source targets chi(G)<=2h(G) for every finite simple graph, where h is complete-minor order. This universal target remains UNRESOLVED. For H on even N>=4 vertices and G=complement H, D=Delta(H), C=max_v induced-four-cycle incidence (each cycle once), set L=(1-x)^D(1-y)^C for x,y in(0,1). Conditions 1/(N-1)<=xL^2 and 1/[(N-1)(N-3)]<=yL^4 certify a pairwise-touching perfect matching of G and hence h(G)>=N/2. Uniform complete-graph matching bad events are forbidden H edges and the two diagonals of induced H four-cycles. Established canonical-event negative dependency and the lopsided local lemma are substantive imports, not a newly invented local lemma.

For Delta(H)=o(N) and limsup C/N^2<1/(4e), scalar activities x=A/N,y=B/N^2 work eventually. The 1/(4e) constant is a sufficient activity threshold, not an optimal graph threshold. Rooted extension retains connected disjoint touching bags B_i and unused even U: forbid F=complement G[U] union all K_{S_i}, S_i={u:no G-neighbour in B_i}. Use Delta(F) for first-kind events but induced cycles of complement G[U] for C. This extends the model to order r+|U|/2 only when the explicit budgets hold. No theorem acquires those budgets from high chromatic number.

An exact pin-release operation starts with uniform matching conditional on ab: choose x uniformly outside a; if x=b retain, otherwise replace ab,xy by ax,by. Its inverse is unique. Release multiple pins excluding still-pinned endpoints. New edges meet original pin support, so no disjoint-support canonical bad event is newly created. This belongs to established resampling-oracle machinery. The bijection alone proves no repeated-repair convergence or runtime bound.

For sufficiently large q=2^(2h+1), N=q^4, a modified published Suzuki-Tits line construction fixes a balanced bipartition on one parallel class and randomizes the other line labels. Source claims alpha(G_q)=2, chi(G_q)=N/2, an all-size-two K_(N/2) model, and no dominating model of order ceil((1/2-delta)N) for an absolute delta>0. The conclusion is h>=chi, not equality. Imported graph geometry and dominating-obstruction hypotheses remain explicit. Noncollinear codegrees=(1/4+o(1))q^2; at most two witnesses involve fixed lines. In triangle-free H, c_H(v)=sum_{w!=v}binom(codegree(v,w),2), with no extra factor; C<=(1/32+o(1))N^2 and D=O(q^3) satisfy the contact criterion. Balanced sides, codegree lower bounds and alpha(H)<2q^3 preserve the published deterministic obstruction. This asymptotic construction was not executed by the finite scripts.

Two K4 joined by one bridge have alpha=2,chi=h=4, nine legal perfect matchings and no pairwise-touching perfect matching. A bridge matching leaves odd unmatched sides; each legal matching has an edge away from the bridge on each side. A singleton K4 model still exists. Exhaustive pair-only coverage is strictly stronger than the desired minor theorem and cannot be repaired just by better scalar constants.

A distinct unproved proposal asks whether every vertex-chromatic-critical graph J has a partition into connected induced bipartite bags whose quotient Q is perfect. If so chi(J)<=2chi(Q)=2omega(Q)<=2h(J), and deleting chromatically redundant vertices proves the universal target. Entire-graph versions are false. For the specific Scott-Seymour-Wood recursive family A(k,r), source derives chi=omega=1+2k(k^2-1)/3+k(r-1), retaining a full-chromatic clique. Deletion removes that family's partition obstruction; the published entire-graph counterexample remains intact. Critical graphs have no nontrivial clique cutset. The property is closed under Mycielski for graphs without isolated vertices: root plus all shadows is an induced star, giving a perfect quotient cone. Neither fact classifies all critical graphs. Producer witnesses for18 critical atlas graphs and99 generated examples are finite tests, with repeated isomorphism types, not a universal proof.

The fractional-minor assertion chi(G)<=max_{J minor G}chi_f(J) is equivalent to exact Hadwiger. A minor-minimal k-chromatic nonclique J on n>k has chi_f(J)<=n(k-1)/(n-1)<k from J-v colour classes, while all proper minors have smaller chromatic number. Thus this proposed shortcut simply restates a harder target.

Priority/current-status boundary: the note source-reports Wood's7October2026 universal constant19,885,160 and an OpenAI archive claiming exact-Hadwiger counterexamples, while Wood still calls exact Hadwiger open. These accounts are unreconciled and unreviewed here; no consensus or resolution is asserted. Pin-release and contact machinery use established principles. Historical novelty and external correctness remain UNKNOWN. Process-only Kakeya Cartesian/logarithmic-loss remarks have no corresponding theorem or proof in the recovered note and receive no theorem card. No exceptional foundational resolution or technological capability is established.

Balanced strip operation: on m sites with K>=1 vacancies choose a vacant pivot uniformly and rotate it to position0. An adjacent empty strip supports original hard legal transpositions; at most m(m-1) instructions. Starting from the UNNORMALIZED Bernoulli measure restricted to nonfull strips, output density is rho_m(eta)=m/K(eta) 1{eta_0=0}. Group elements retain multiplicity even for periodic configurations. E rho_m^2=V_m=m sum_{k=1}^m binom(m,k)q^k p^(m-k)/k, with V1=q and V_m=mp/(m-1)V_(m-1)+1-p^m. The sectorwise endpoint second moment is optimal by Cauchy-Schwarz, not the full current energy. Fresh disjoint strip laws compose up to deterministic coordinate relocation; endpoint moments multiply, with additional intermediate m^2 factor. No short-program-to-low-congestion inference is made.

Source multiplicity K=m-N_total is conserved by every used exchange, so H=F/K has exact divergence 1{A empty,B nonfull}-1{B empty,A nonfull}. Dividing by changing active-front counts is invalid. On an acquired finite connected graph with fixed terminals, positive cheap reference c0 and requested expensive target coefficients c>0, source constructs two-sided conductance certification using selected coefficients or paired local responses. It is a finite known-network candidate, NOT a validated material model, atomistic pathway acquisition, nonequilibrium-rate solver or civilisation-enabling breakthrough. Scientific status source_derived_unreviewed; external correctness/priority UNKNOWN. Reference topology/model, certified coefficient envelope, sampling setup and solves are charged.

For unit-voltage reference-harmonic h0, C0=sum c0(dh0)² and p_e=c0_e(dh0_e)²/C0, r_e=c_e/c0_e. A=E_p r, B=E_p1/r give C0/B<=C(c)<=C0 A by established Dirichlet/Thomson principles. Ratio1+D, D=AB-1=(1/2)E_(e,f)[(r_e-r_f)²/(r_e r_f)] measures dispersion, not common calibration: r=rho gives zero gap. Positive target coefficients on p=0 edges need no relative envelope/query for these witnesses, but may affect the true response under mismatch. No arbitrary high-contrast solution follows from their zero reference work.

Partition EDGES into disjoint cells sharing boundary vertices; include terminals and vertices incident to other cells in each boundary. E_K0=sum_K c0(dh0)²; reference injection b_K=H_K f0_K vanishes in cell interiors. Acquire target coefficients and solve D_K=min_(h|boundary=h0)sum_K c(dh)², N_K=min_(H_K f=b_K)sum_K f²/c. Boundary-compatible potentials glue; same injection flows sum to globally conserved reference flux. Thus C0²/sum N_K<=C<=sum D_K. Fixed boundary work <dh,f>=E_K0 yields D_K N_K>=(E_K0)². For positive-work cells w=E_K0/C0,u=D_K/E_K0,v=N_K/E_K0, uv>=1 and C0/E_w v<=C<=C0 E_w u. Zero-work cells have zero energies for positive targets. Coarsening reduces both summed energies, tightening both ends; a WHOLE-network cell becomes exact only by acquiring/solving the full target. Monotonicity is not affordability.

Given justified0<a<=r<=b on positive-reference-work support, R=b/a, a<=u<=b and1/b<=v<=1/a. Set A=E_wu,B=E_wv,Delta=AB-1. Source proves Var(u)/A²<=R Delta and Var(v)/B²<=R Delta from E[(X-EX)²/X]=EX(EX E1/X-1) and uv>=1. No spatial independence/stationarity required for fixed coefficients. Delta=chi²(w||q)+A E_w(v-1/u), q=wu/A, separates between-cell redistribution from within-cell potential/flux incompatibility. More samples do not erase either intrinsic error.

Independent w-cell samples cache coefficient acquisitions but retain repetitions statistically. Established empirical-Bernstein bounds use unbiased sample variance and one-sided upper moment bounds with dyadic failure allocation alpha/[2k(k+1)] per moment. Intersect[C0/Bplus,C0 Aplus] and stop U/L<=1+epsilon or return failure/wider interval. Draw complexity ~O(R Delta/epsilon²+(R-1)/epsilon) up to logs requires intrinsic gap within accuracy budget; Delta<=epsilon/4 and controlled R give favorable~O(R/epsilon). This counts CELLS, not coefficients. Whole cost includes graph/reference/weights/sampling/statistics and every distinct cell's coefficients, TWO solves and precision; expected acquisition sum_K[1-(1-w_K)^n]T_K. Approximate general references need admissible potential and EXACTLY conserved flow, with additional U0 R0 gap; general certified backend is unimplemented.

Synthetic256² network has65536vertices,130560edges,65280positive-workedges and analytically available reference. At nominal99% confidence/5%width, favorable common1.6scale and small axial mismatch used2048draws/2014distinctreads versus matched Hoeffding32768draws/24506reads. Read ratio~12.17 and whole-input ratio~64.83 are not new-method-versus-state-of-the-art or wall-clock gains. The common-scale case is a control; small mismatch is already near reference. Transverse eight-order contrast has zero reference work. Active ratios.5or2 give intrinsic56.2477% gap and budget failure at51380reads.100seeded runs contained FLOAT64 comparator, not independent99% coverage verification. Full sparse solves took~.27-.30s, no expensive microscopic calculations executed. Initial3Dcomparators failed within limits, no3Dresult.

Separate64² strong-mismatch coarsening reduces gap56.244%->47.413%->30.141%->16.179%->6.217%->2.102% and whole-cell~1.14e-11. ALL7938retained target coefficients were acquired in every row. Four side32cells, at most2016edges each, first pass5%; repair succeeded, simultaneous cheap acquisition did not. This does not prove every coefficient necessary.3223 rational assertions on finite graphs test inequalities/variance/coarsening/whole-cell exactness, not universal formal correctness.

Separate lazy exact rational256² backend stops2014reads with rational interval[2.1503171602351814,2.2339888389129205], ratio width3.891%. Source proposes an autonomous electrically blocking capacitive chemomotor: steady chemical turnover changes occupancy/terminal polarization, voltage feeds back on reaction rates and may supply alternating work to a passive resistor. It is a CONDITIONAL physical mechanism with assumed-parameter simulations, NOT an established physical effect, identified catalyst, fabricated generator or civilisation-scale breakthrough. Source_derived_unreviewed; independent correctness, priority and technology performance UNKNOWN. No sustained ionic separator current, inductor or imposed waveform in the stipulated model. Chemical free energy supplies output and dissipation.

Two-state symmetric mean-field cycle F+0<->1<->P+0 has E1-E0=-qV. q is conjugate to MEASURED TERMINAL voltage, not automatically Bader/formal oxidation/gate charge. a=Delta_mu/(kBT),x=qV/(kBT),r=exp(-a/2),thetaF=(1-gamma)/2,thetaP=(1+gamma)/2; rates a+=k exp(thetaF x),a-=kr exp((thetaF-1)x),b+=k exp((thetaP-1)x),b-=kr exp(thetaP x). Detailed balance gives log(a+/a-)=a/2+x,log(b+/b-)=a/2-x, cycle affinity a independent of voltage. Symmetry/coarse-graining of a real reaction are assumptions, not measurements. Large-population deterministic model, not atomistic/finite-site dynamics.

p_dot=(a++b-)(1-p)-(a-+b+)p,Q=C0V+nqp,C0 V_dot=-(Gload+Gleak)V-nq p_dot. Capacitance and conductance are positive and per geometric area. At V0,p=.5,lambda=2k(1+exp(-a/2)); Cr=nq²/(4kBT)[1-gamma tanh(a/4)]. Y(omega)=Gleak+i omega C0+i omega Cr lambda/(lambda+i omega), ReY=Gleak+Cr lambda omega²/(lambda²+omega²). Negative REAL admittance, not merely negative imaginary capacitance, is the gain observable. Microscopic gain needs gamma tanh(a/4)>1; gamma=(qP‡-qF‡)/q. Strong-drive transition-state contrast must exceed state-charge contrast; if both barriers lie between state responses this symmetric model cannot gain. At equilibrium a0 Cr>0: no single-heat-bath work. This is not a universal multistate no-go.

Characteristic C0s²+[C0lambda+G+Cr lambda]s+G lambda=0 loses linear stability at -Cr>C0+G/lambda. This is LINEAR instability, not a proof of stable nonlinear oscillations or hysteresis absence. Strong-drive half-occupancy rule DeltaVoc*S>4[1+G/(C0lambda)], DeltaVoc=nq/C0,S=d log(b+/a+)/dV, expresses coupled voltage/kinetic requirements. Ordinary capacitance, leakage and useful load must all be overcome.

jF=a+(1-p)-a-p,jP=b+p-b-(1-p),Pchem=n Delta_mu(jF+jP)/2,Pload=Gload V²,Pleak=Gleak V². Source derives Pchem-Pload-Pleak-Tsigma=U_dot-T S_dot, U=C0V²/2 and nonnegative stochastic entropy production. Period average closes chemical input=load+leak+entropy. For one simple fill/empty loop W/A<=nq DeltaV Delta p<=nq DeltaV, not a universal efficiency theorem. Reported efficiency uses REACTED chemical free energy and EXCLUDES heaters, feed preparation/circulation, pressure drop, unreacted feed, electronics/fabrication. Not measured system efficiency.

All numerical parameters are hypotheses, not forecasts for identified materials. Strong-coupling T423K,n1e18/m²,q.30e,gamma3,Delta_mu12kBT~.4374eV,k50/s,C0~.02403265F/m²,Gload5S/m²,zero leakage gives source25.2675Hz,peak±.73318V,load1.00142W/m²,chemical1.81129W/m²,entropy.80986W/m²,55.2879% before auxiliaries. On1cm²:2.4033microF,2kilohm,100.14microW.100x ALL rates/load gives2.52675kHz,100.142W/m²=10.014mW/cm², merely time rescaling. Baseline elementary rates reach2.16e4/s,fast2.16e6/s;3kHz condenser data do not establish this bandwidth. Small-charge q.003e,gamma50 is also unmeasured, giving11.0079Hz,3.29microW/cm²,.2307%efficiency; detectable gain need not be useful conversion.

Earlier q.02e,n1e19/m² choice implied12.67V full-coverage swing and was REJECTED as ordinary Pt prediction, though its mathematical record survives. Measured hydrogen/Pt~.0019e is a magnitude control only; assumed gamma3 kinetics give no oscillation, not a measured hydrogen-oxidation simulation. Equilibrium,gamma1 and heavy-load controls are source negative cases.27 consistency checks cover affinity,analytic response,entropy,energy and controls; tighter tolerance/seed use SAME DOP853 solver, not independent implementation. Initial uniform-grid integration missed narrow spikes; released12point Gaussian quadrature on adaptive intervals yields residual~6.1e-8W/m². Floating arithmetic is not interval certification or material validation. Figure/traces are SIMULATED.

Decisive first experiment acquires capacitance, leakage, dielectric loss, electrode resistance, terminal charge/coverage and complex kinetic admittance under steady feed/controlled temperature BEFORE autonomous operation. Correct instrument phase and parasitics; include extra measured kinetic poles instead of post-fitting one pole to oscillation. Demonstrate negative real admittance, then remove waveform source and test sustained passive-load power against independently predicted thresholds. Hypothetical strong model1cm² gives load~579ohm and additional shunt~12.24microF at2kilohm, LINEAR boundaries not Pt expected values or nonlinear quenching proof. Retain equilibrium/reaction-blocked, matched-temperature, wiring/phase, dielectric transient and stored-electrical/chemical-inventory controls; product metrology closes free energy. Thermal/heater feedback, Faradaic shorts and hot-electron collection are alternatives, not confirmation.

Possible gas-accessible redox unit in an insulating3nm nanogap targets q~e Delta z/d~.33e for1nm displacement with effective permittivity~8. This is electrostatic geometry only; no stable catalytic chemistry with needed-.30e/+.60e barrier responses, turnover and low leakage is identified. Screening, packing, attachment, chemical access, drift, correlated domains and noise remain uncharacterized. Peakfield~.24V/nm is required, not demonstrated dielectric reliability. Porosity/thinner dielectric also change capacitance/leakage/breakdown and transport; fast modelheat~81W/m² before auxiliaries. Costs, manufacturability, supply chain, maintenance and net economics UNKNOWN.

Published catalytic condensers, terminal-charge titration, programmable energy recovery, hot-electron devices and fuel cells are source baselines; broad chemical-energy recovery is prior art.>1W/cm² fuel-cell report versus hypothetical.010W/cm² is UNMATCHED scale only. Ionomer-free catalyst layer does not eliminate whole-cell proton transport. No matched fuel/temperature/pressure/lifetime/auxiliary-power advantage. Incomplete full-text/patent access leaves novelty unresolved. No repo mathematical theorem is a load-bearing premise. Process-only rotating helical-ion-pump remark has no retained result and receives no card. New family plus a simulation-stage technology record routes the missing material/gain test; no readiness promotion from internal model consistency.

Original infinite-temperature interacting dephasing chain, t=1, U in[3.9,4.1], physical d in[1.9,2.1], V in[0,3]. Source reports a six-spin Ramsey contrast and uniform actual-model GLOBAL regret <8.7804e-5 at262144 independent shots or <4.3428e-5 at1048576 shots, with >99% probability under acquired model/bias/actuator assumptions. Same bounds separately hold on every periodic ring n>=41. No Gaussian-profile, finite-temperature, generic many-body inverse or uniform dictionary-cost theorem.

H=-(1/2)sum(XX+YY)+(U/4)sum Z_i Z_(i+1)+(V/4)sum Z_i Z_(i+2); L O=i[H,O]+(d/4)sum(Z_i O Z_i-O). D is the long-time infinite-chain density-response SECOND-MOMENT coefficient in normalized infinite-temperature product trace, all number sectors. Both interactions retained nonperturbatively; no added physical damping or supplied relaxation gap.

Fixed S_ref=S(2)+lambda I normalizes B_theta+lambda I, with Re T>=beta I, beta=min(1,d/2), and perturbation norms(V,U,d)<=(1,1,1/2). Each lower trial derivative has EXACT PA_0 f_alpha=0. Corrected output error is <r,R T^-1 r>; complete rational Gram matrices retain cross terms. Twenty mixed trial derivatives through order3 and35 full residual derivatives through order4 are retained. Footprint20 gives n>=41; positive-lambda thermodynamic limit and uniform complex neighborhoods justify scalar/derivative passage. No unregularized size/time-limit interchange.

Freeze incident hopping over six spins while preserving relevant diagonal terms/noise within calibrated bias; prepare central(|10>+|01>)/sqrt2 and neighbours(1,1,0,0). Detuning is U, independent of V. At tau=1/2, +/-1 mean mu=exp(-d/2)cos((U-4)/2+psi), cos psi=32/257,sin psi=-255/257. V_cmd=clip round_(1/2048)[1109/512+(14340421443/4294967296)Xbar-13/85]. No U,d estimate or online many-body solve. Mean bias<=1e-4; additional actuator error<=1/4096; independence and all preparation/switch/readout/timing bounds must be acquired.

Full-domain derivative signs place the unique global optimum in(2,2.5). A common tube has D_VV<=-.07592003516; deployed-gradient bounds .003651315584/.002567883056 yield regret G^2/(2mu). Local cross-Hessian rank/implicit-function compensation is established prior art and does not provide a general constructive policy theorem.

Two exact models U=4+/- .01 and d=2+2log[cos(a/2)+(255/32)sin(a/2)] have identical complete Bernoulli data laws for this contrast at EVERY shot count, while D(V0) intervals differ by>.0203442744. This is an INFORMATION-INTERFACE separation only. Additional quadratures/coarse raw observations can distinguish them. Every deterministic fixed no-observation setting has worst-case regret>=.00012390875; no strongest active-learner sample-complexity advantage is established.

Fresh enumeration/enrichment,20 derivative solves,exact packets,six anchors(two unused),and policy checks total252.14345s,peak~1.88GiB,one BLAS thread; old compiler and fixed enrichment settings reused, no prior response coefficients supplied. Research/settings exploration and physical acquisition excluded. Native fine-assay times131072/524288 plus preparations/reset/readout. Optional broad-box calibration costs2097152 shots and262144 native units; P(accept AND bad decision)<.009 is UNCONDITIONAL soundness, not a rare-acceptance conditional guarantee.

Producer one-copy locally unbiased scalar variance minimum is a specialization of quantum semiparametric estimation at fixed preparation/time, not global finite-sample sensing optimality. Modern two-quadrature/coherent Hamiltonian learning, goal-oriented reduced models and tensor-network/backflow methods remain comparators; no head-to-head strongest-specialized total-cost victory.

Ideal isothermal open reversible elementary mass action, full internal rank, gate multiplies BOTH directions, known full stoichiometry/reservoirs/positive state/gates and detailed-balance reference q. Unknown absolute rates and baseline currents cancel from the explicit controls. State-dependent objective only; no generic throughput/selectivity/global optimization or realistic saturated-enzyme advantage.

With z=(c,u),w=z/q and k_r+q^a_r=k_r-q^b_r=kappa_r, compile z_dagger=q^2/z and e_r_dagger=e_r*w^(a_r+b_r), INCLUDING reservoirs. Every elementary forward/backward flux swaps; at a native steady state d=q_internal^2/c is conjugate stationary. Both current and affinity reverse, retaining sum jA>=0. This is not thermodynamic time reversal or free preparation.

Native J,conjugate H,C=diag(c),D=diag(d) satisfy CJ^T=HD+M, M=sum j_r(y_r_prime*y_r_prime^T-y_r*y_r^T). Species balance S j=0 does NOT imply M=0. Internal-complex balance suffices; exact stoichiometric ker S subset ker R suffices for all stationary current vectors. M=0 can hold without complex balance. JC+CJ^T+B=M with B=sum(v+ +v-)ss^T; M=0 and full internal rank imply local Hurwitz stability of both reactors, not a useful settling-time bound/global basin.

At M=0, signed constant source epsilon*C*a in the conjugate reactor yields lambda=D^-1*d_prime(0), satisfying J^T lambda=-a for a=grad Phi. Two central equilibria require n-component readouts, calibrated source realization, third-derivative and settling bounds. Unknown rate magnitudes still govern time. The affinity-only gate score u_r=A_r*s_r^T lambda gives quasistatic nonnegative ascent; subtracting the gate-cost-weighted mean preserves a linear budget when ALL dynamics scale together and Phi has no direct gate dependence. Finite steps need curvature or measured backtracking.

Exact stable wrong-sign counterexample:0<->2A,A<->B,B<->0; c=(1,1),vf=(2,3,3),vb=(1,1,1). J=[[-7,1],[3,-4]],H=[[-9,3],[1,-4]],M=diag(2,0). For Phi=A+3B/5, true A<->B log-gate derivative=-6/125 while naive conjugate prediction=2/55. Current reversal and stability are insufficient.

Finite relocation c_prime=c*exp(h) uses rho=(1-exp(-A))/(exp(y.h)-exp(-A+y_prime.h)), when current direction persists. Then j_prime=j without knowing magnitudes. Normalization E/B(h) preserves a single total gate budget and scales all currents equally. Every admissible target in that affinity-sign cell is already stationary under this budget-only model. This simpler ECM-like operation undermines the adjoint necessity for the favorable task. No dynamical reachability or changed flux-selectivity claim.

Saturation counterexample Z=1+s/Ks+p/Kp at(s,p,e)=(2,1,1): models K=1,kappa4 and K=10,kappa13/10 have SAME baseline one-way fluxes(2,1) but conjugate currents -8/5 and -26/23 instead of -1. Denominator ratio and elasticities are missing. Free-active-enzyme clamping restores only a restricted steady-state linear elimination; sensing/clamp stability and actual total enzyme cost f+1^T h remain unresolved.

Producer200 constructed complex-balanced fixtures,exact sign/saturation counterexamples,one finite step and algebra checks are synthetic. KPP/digital adjoints,SPSA,ECM and established physical backpropagation/linear elimination are strong matched comparators. Charge full reaction-list validity,q acquisition,conjugate dynamic range,n readouts,m outputs,precision,settling,consumables and all uncontrolled chemistry. No useful matched end-to-end advantage or historical priority.

Conditional optically maintained CdS-alizarin recombination hypothesis, distinct from N767 chemical-fuel chemomotor. Published inverted recombination and kinetic components are material footholds; field derivatives, actual terminal dipole/orientation, proposed-host kinetics and complete-device negative real admittance remain unmeasured. No new observed power source, prototype, efficiency/noise/lifetime advantage or readiness promotion.

No chemical-fuel interface jointly qualifies N767 terminal charge, barrier contrast, bandwidth and isolation. In a symmetric Marcus construction gamma=D/Lambda and k=K exp[-(D-Lambda)^2/(4Lambda kBT)]; stronger inversion has a kinetic penalty, with restricted gain-bandwidth maximum at D-Lambda=sqrt(2Lambda kBT). Terminal q=-integral Delta rho*psi_weight and capacitance must derive from the SAME device electrostatic boundary problem.

Material pivot uses600nm ligand excitation G->X->C->G in CdS quantum-dot/alizarin, supplied by LIGHT.400nm dot excitation accesses a different triplet pathway. QD450 source components are .996/ns at44% and .219/ns at56%,driving magnitude1.51eV. Primary supplementary tables visually checked at intake. Static two-population interpretation is sensitivity analysis only; biexponential decay does not identify a generator. Published hexane kinetics do not transfer as fact to a viscous host.

Differentiated vibronic fit gives a~-partial_D log k~5.98/eV,not the fixed-interface electric-field derivative. Required a_eff*mu_z=partial_E log k_rec-partial_E log R includes FORMATION response. Coupled continuum dielectric sphere nominal mu_eff1.4601 e nm gives q~.0014601e across1um,not electron-scale terminal charge. Assumed dielectric constants/hole position,hard-wall omission of finite-barrier tunneling,ligand and polaron effects are not first-principles material qualification.

Restricted orientation model requires tau_r>1/(k*a*kBT) for some negative reaction-plus-rotation band. Individual source components require~6.5ns/29.7ns. Rigid-sphere hexadecane estimate~80.5ns is not charge-orientation lifetime; surface hole migration and changed solvent kinetics remain. Equal-pump static mixture weak-pump effective rate~.333/ns differs from .561/ns amplitude average.

Post-formation zero-field optical pulse then matched +/-small voltage marks recombination separately from field-controlled formation, with dark-step and optical-population references. Conditional1% pairs/0.30ns wait predicts~7aC/V delayed negative charge peak and~15nA/V initial population current. Applied step supplies energy; this diagnostic is NOT an autonomous power test. Subnanosecond/GHz readout and rejection of prompt capacitance are charged.

Conditional100x100um,1um,1mM,1% occupation at90MHz gives C~.183pF, reaction+rotation ReY~-5.43nS,max additional loss tangent~5.24e-5,54.3pA at10mV,incrementalRF~.272pW versus MINIMUM productive absorbed600nm pump6.67mW(~66.7W/cm2). Same geometry sets mixture real permittivity. Ideal resonatorQ~19100 is unacquired. These are instrument targets,not device predictions; whole physical loss must be included.

For independent immobile populations,one-sided S_I/(4|ReY_pop|)=1/a,noise-to-gain temperature ratio~1940K,not sample temperature or complete amplifier added noise. More particles/coupling also increase population noise. Complete illuminated device ReY<0 at constant pump/zeroDC,followed by independent reflected RF gain or growing passive-resonator energy after seed removal,are required. Negative dark-subtracted change or negative imaginary capacitance is insufficient. Device losses cannot be subtracted; leads may be de-embedded.

Physical gain,field slopes,leakage,orientation,thermal/optical damage and reliability remain UNKNOWN. Primary Marcus evidence is known physics; chemical inductance and optical maser/RF conversion are prior art. Compare optical source+RF electronics/masers,not fuel cells after this energy-source pivot. Source36 diagnostic groups and local reruns test calculations only. Under CJ^T=HD+M,positive C,D and invertible native/conjugate Jacobians, ideal lambda0=-D^-1 H^-1 C a is exact for the chosen objective IFF M lambda0=0. The exact objective-covector space has dimension n-rank M. M=0 is unnecessary for one objective, but its whole-operator stability theorem cannot be reused when M!=0.

With Q_r=y_prime*y_prime^T-y*y^T,choose any exact basis k_l of ker S and stack Z_l=sum_r k_lr Q_r. W=ker stacked Z is EXACTLY the set of covectors annihilated by every stationary-current defect for all j in ker S. An ideal measured lambda0 in W certifies this objective,without unknown current magnitudes. This all-ker-S condition is stronger than the physical current set and can be conservative or zero. Exact rational preprocessing/fill-in and n-component finite readout are charged.

The source wrong-sign network has W=span(0,1). Its linear objective -3A+4B returns exact lambda0=(0,1) even though M=diag(2,0) is nonzero. The original A+3B/5 still fails; no safe useful biochemical target is thereby acquired. For an approximate ell,xi=J^T ell+a=C^-1[M ell+HD ell+Ca],lambda-ell=-(J^T)^-1 xi,and b^T(lambda-ell)=xi^T R_N b. No residual,conditioning constant or projection experiment is supplied for free.

Orient nonzero baseline currents to known A>0; on A-s.h>0,set rho=(1-exp(-A))/(exp(y.h)-exp(-A+y_prime.h)),sigma=exp(t),e_prime=sigma e rho. Direct mass action yields j_prime=sigma*j and stationarity,with fixed flux ratios. log rho has Hessian x/(1-x)^2 ss^T>=0,x=exp(-A+s.h). Thus e_prime<=cap and sum w_kr e_prime_r<=E_k,w>=0,are convex in(h,t). Linear objectives of log concentrations/log common scale and convex domain/affinity margins are allowed.

This is an exact subfamily of stationary controls and an ECM-compatible specialization,not all steady-state gate designs. No arbitrary flux selectivity,unknown saturation,lower gate floor,exact coupled-budget convexity,global convergence,uniform practical bit/runtime bound or scientific speedup is claimed. Zero-current channels require s.h=0 and separate exp(t-y.h) gate rule. Uncertain thermodynamics produces a residual requiring additional acquired response/current bounds.

Finite internal Fraction diagnostics cover strict objective-specific relaxation,retained wrong-sign failure,9 projected-residual identities,4 cycle scales,a zero-safe-space network,3 hidden kinetic models*2 scales with caps/two budgets,18 PSD direction checks and zero-current handling. These are new small exact fixtures,not general proof verification or physical results. Bounded operators on separable complex Hilbert spaces, a>0, and an actually supplied/proved comparison T*T<=g_a(TT*+BB*). A separate subunital positive row recursion has a unique bounded positive fixed point and source-generated approximants. Conditional operator mathematics only; no KLS theorem, acquired interacting-system source comparison, tensor-rank bound or scientific speedup.

For F(X)=g_a(Phi(X)+P), g_a(t)=t/(1+at), Phi(I)<=I and P>=0, the source proves ||F(X)-F(Y)||<=g_a(||X-Y||), unique X*, monotone iteration from0 and 0<=X*-X_k<=I/[a(k+1)]. A positive subsolution A<=F(A) satisfies A<=X*, not A=X*. Finite rank P gives support in acquired source-word spaces W_k; D_k and Gram/apply/precision cost remain paid.

For the scalar paired comparison, f_a(A)<=TT*+BB*, f_a(t)=t/(1-at), compact B forces compact T. The minimum source rank over an assigned positive singular-square list and variable polar factor equals sup_x #{j:x<=1/lambda_j<x+a}. The source constructs a padded forward shift; it does not preserve a pre-existing operator, locality or physical dynamics. N775 gives a stronger finite-dimension joint rank/budget realization from classical inverse-eigenvalue machinery.

B in S_p implies T in S_max(p+2,2p), with sharp constants: ||T||_(p+2)^(p+2)<=2||B||_p^p/(pa) for p<=2 and ||T||_(2p)^4<=||B||_p^2/a for p>=2. Normal diagonal and nonnormal harmonic-shift examples force the two exponents. Finite-rank B does not imply Hilbert-Schmidt T.

The product spectrum A e_alpha=(|alpha|+2)^-1 e_alpha requires scalar source rank binom(n+m-1,m) on degree-m cutoffs, yet standard symmetric row shifts realize it with one vacuum source and n channels. Generated dimension remains binom(n+k-1,n). Free-word branching yields compact A with no finite Schatten class. Neither small initial source rank nor channel count supplies a low-cost representation.

An outside residual epsilon I leaves essential singular-square floor [epsilon+sqrt(epsilon^2+4epsilon/a)]/2; arbitrarily small positive residual cannot certify compactness or bounded unresolved multiplicity. Inside-source perturbations have the different minus-root formula. Source note credits the comparison form to arXiv2610.07728v2 §7.1; the full preprint KLS claim is not a premise or validated result. The recursion has classical Riccati/Kalman ancestry.

Finite diagnostics are not universal proof, interval certification, novelty review or physical evidence. New source-rank/TT and decision-certificate deductions are separately labelled integration-derived in N775.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Source finite four-site driven hard-core throughput model with three persistent phases, nine admissible actions, uncertain density interactions and calibrated acquisition/control promises. Reports expected regret<9.418554e-5 and good-event control regret<3.085217e-6, while every phase identifier under the same hard total unknown-link exposure pi/4 has some failure>0.01103116. Separately labelled integration deductions extend protected sensing and acquisition-only detuning tolerance, not many-body payoff computation or hardware validation.

The source changes N768 infinite-chain second-moment D to finite open-device stationary throughput J=kappa Tr(n3 rho_ss). Three phase values are load-bearing. Density interactions remain in all70 neutral operator coordinates for six robust response families. Exact rational rounded-inverse and full polynomial-residual bounds cover the interaction box and actuator errors. Nine actions are three phase commands times drains{2,4,8}; optimality and regret are relative to that menu, not all possible controls.

A minimal empty-intersection family of acceptable-action sets reduces worst-case unacceptable-action selection exactly to state exclusion for a fixed acquisition class. This is an elementary use of established quantum exclusion/decision theory. The trine probe has nuisance-null one-excitation dynamics and analytic minimax POVM dual; a payoff ordering also proves the chosen drain optimal among the nine fixed-probe actions.

All identifiers share hard TOTAL unknown-link exposure<=pi/4 across preparations, discarded attempts, branches and parallel specimens. The pairwise Hamiltonian difference has half spectral range sqrt3 on the full four-site space. Bures-angle contraction bounds every adaptive/ancilla-assisted identifier by [1-sin(sqrt3*pi/4)]/2>0.01103116 on some phase. An integration-derived multiway bound strengthens some-label failure to (2/3)[1-sin(sqrt3*pi/4)]>0.01470821. These standard distinguishability arguments do not bound all decision-aware estimate-then-act policies, alternate access sources or longer exposure. No exponential time advantage.

No-observation randomized nine-action policy has worst-case expected regret>0.01600972. Physical assumptions include unknown-link isolation, phase persistence, fast calibrated known controls/readout and aggregate probe total variation<=1/2000. Optional calibration costs2621440 shots and1310720 native time; accepted-bad bounds are UNCONDITIONAL, with no uniform lower bound on acceptance. Stationary throughput has no acquired settling-time deadline guarantee.

New integration report proves a guarded local sensor/readout block can decouple from an arbitrary finite-density background for supplied density monomials of degree>=2. Reset a guard hitting mixed monomials with exactly one active site, freeze particle transfer across the block/guard boundary, and prepare one active excitation. With bounded interaction degree/range this is constant local size after a charged scan; actual switching, preparation, noise model and detuning calibration remain requirements. Global payoff certification remains unprovided.

New integration report also bounds anti-trine bad-action change from acquisition-only differential detuning delta(t) by [integral|delta(t)|dt]^2/6, using first-order cancellation and CPTP contraction. It supplies no protection if that detuning alters the operational payoff. General occupation-pair null-code search is NP-complete for the explicitly larger positive1/2-local diagonal-template class; no hardness is asserted for the protected empty-guard class.

Scratch producer exact reconstruction/corruption rejection, fresh benchmark and calibration replay passed; original code/witnesses preserved. Source Linux peak135588KiB is a reported measurement. On this macOS replay ru_maxrss is bytes; the producer field named KiB is retained as raw data and explicitly reinterpreted, not multiplied by1024. New proofs/checks are internal and remain externally unreviewed.

N774-phase-controlled-lattice-pumping-and-direct-force-identifiability | A conditional lattice-loop pump has a sharp control-energy bound and a matched direct-force falsifier
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Conditional independent-ion periodic Markov chain with separately driven site splitting u and directional saddle difference v. Oriented K beta-alumina is a candidate specimen, not an identified atomistic implementation. Source transport/symmetry/elastic-control bounds and new direct-force falsifier are restricted mathematical results; correlated hopping, actual material response, useful transport, retention and manufacturing advantage are unvalidated.

Rates have instantaneous zero cycle affinity without direct force, while driving work remains paid. Exact unwrapped displacement is Delta x=-(a/2)oint tanh(beta v)dp. Harmonic small controls produce a phase-odd orientation term proportional to lambda^2/(lambda^2+omega^2)sin(phi), plus a phase-even finite-lag term. Constant u or identically zero v gives no periodic-state pumping in this force-free model. THz instantaneous rates and the measured memory-to-lambda identification are unacquired.

Bilinear bulk inversion parity rules out two odd IR coordinates alone without inversion breaking; an even/odd pair still requires full point-group allowance. Joint coupling A and same-specimen stiffness K give E_el,min(y)=y^T(AK^-1A^T)^-1y/2. Spectral coincidence and separately favorable slopes/materials do not supply independent control. Direct internal/external fields, damping and absorbed energy are retained.

One loading/unloading excursion gives |Delta x|/a<=tanh(beta V)tanh(beta U/2). Balanced algebraic99% factors at300K require U=.1547615928eV,V=.0773807964eV, not measured minima or achieved yield. A stipulated10nm modulation retaining90% for1hour needs D_off<=7.41337e-23m^2/s under passive Fickian diffusion. Pumping alone supplies neither retention nor spatial addressability; charge balance and boundary chemistry remain gates.

New independently derived competing mechanism: a spatially uniform zero-mean force on a midpoint-saddle chain with v=0 and u0!=0 reproduces the ENTIRE leading phase-odd one-pole response by matching its amplitude. Thus phase reversal plus that rolloff cannot identify a structural pump. For two specifically acquired bilinear channels and r=omega/lambda, four phases give Delta x=A sinphi+B cosphi, Cg=A+rB and Cd=r^2A-rB. Arbitrary memory, force phase/geometry, contacts and additional mechanisms break this identification.

New sharp quadratic-control bound: M=AK^-1A^T and mean stored elastic energy Ebar imply |Delta x_odd|<=pi*a*beta^2*p0(1-p0)*[lambda^2/(lambda^2+omega^2)]*Ebar*sqrt(det M). Equal orthogonal stiffness-normalized controls attain the coefficient. The corresponding speed upper bound is maximized at omega=lambda under this budget. Stored elastic energy is not wall energy. Rank-one in-phase controls can still produce finite-rate phase-even rectification; only the leading geometric term is forced to vanish.

Source toy ODE replay passed30 pump cases,two nulls and8 energy fixtures. An independent constant-rate propagator implementation checks41 cycles,thermodynamic work/entropy,matched direct-force false positives and8 sharp bound fixtures plus160 random controls. Floating diagnostics are not interval or atomistic validation. The LLTO duty-cycle arithmetic additionally treats0.78%/mW as a stipulated1mW reduction and does not establish correspondence between different measured observables.

Exact family: on clock tensor L tensor R with d=2^m, one product source s and partial-isometry propagator V map s to a clock-marked m-Bell-pair vector e then kill e. Source-word dimension stabilizes at2; X*=|s><s|/2+|e><e|/3 has ordinary rank2 and operator Schmidt rank d^2. Any operator-Schmidt-rank R approximation has Hilbert-Schmidt error>=sqrt(1-R/d^2)/3. Error<=1/6 needs R>=3d^2/4. This refutes a generic source-word-to-TT implication, not N764 physical targets or all circuit representations.

For bounded positive Y and acquired eta>=||Y-F(Y)||, ||Y-X*||<=[eta+sqrt(eta^2+4eta/a)]/2=:R_a(eta). Identity examples are sharp. A target norm error e universally requires eta<=a e^2/(1+ae). The same Phi=Id,P=1/2 admits scalar subsolutions A0=0 and A1=1/2 with opposite optimal binary actions. Given only the comparison data, randomized worst-case regret is at least1/2. Thus an upper comparison cannot acquire two-sided task values. An acquired nonnormal defect Q>=TT*-T*T,Q>=0 gives a(T*T)^2<=BB*+Q. Summable Q^(1/2) then yields T in S_(2p) from B,Q^(1/2) in S_p, with the report explicit constants. N776-spectral-matching-and-finite-hopping-current-certificates | A universal phase law matches kinetic edge transport and gives restricted finite-hopping current certificates
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Finite fixed-particle occupation model with real diagonal D, baseline hop-coherence damping eta>0 and separately applicable actual-D phases. The supplied symmetric NIG law achieves a97% weak-hopping edge-rate guarantee and reversible-form comparisons. New internal proofs give an all-hopping absolute current floor for uniform periodic hopping and a volume-uniform competitive ratio only in the noninteracting staggered class. No general interacting97% actual-current theorem or physical advantage.

The supplied CPTP independent-increment phase law has psi(w)=(32/25)[sqrt((15eta/4)^2+w^2)-15eta/4]. At fixed finite volume and weak hopping, q=2epsilon^2|Txy|^2 gamma/(gamma^2+Delta^2), gamma=eta+psi(Delta). It obtains .97q*<=q<=q* for the independent-edge optimum gamma*=max(eta,|Delta|). Common reversible Dirichlet forms, capacities, gaps and Markov-additive transport inherit their precise comparisons; arbitrary first-hit probabilities and nonequilibrium currents do not. The universal symmetric-Levy edge ceiling .972848925... is class-specific, not an arbitrary-control limit.

Finite local-gap cutoff W and relative loss delta admit an instantaneous compound-Poisson realization with rate O(W/delta) and logarithmic absolute phase action. This assumes symmetric instantaneous phases, an actual separate D actuator, calibrated bandwidth and local gaps. Compilation, pulse duration, drift, switching, field strength and total energy remain charged. If this same legal actuator can cancel D coherently, cancellation dominates the kinetic oracle; a prohibition cannot be invented to rescue an advantage.

New finite-current theorem: for a uniform hard-core ring at fixed K, alpha=K(n-K)/[n(n-1)], physical current epsilon J0, and |hop gap|<=W>=eta, [T,J0]=0 yields kappa_Q>=.97 epsilon^2 t^2 alpha/W at every epsilon>0. The pulse variant inserts(1-delta). Only hopping-coherence resistance enters the variational proof, so an extensive full-channel approximation is unnecessary for this certificate. The independent review also supplies a parity-free accretive-resolvent proof, allowing uniform Peierls flux when the same commutator and gap assumptions hold. This is a finite Green-Kubo quadratic form, not measured conductivity or proof of general hydrodynamic limits.

For even n>=6 with staggered on-site detuning Delta and no density interactions, an exact balanced-current residual has norm squared8Delta^2 t^4 alpha. Consequently1<=kappa_Q/kappa_kin<=1+4epsilon^2t^2Delta^2/[eta gamma(gamma^2+Delta^2)]<=1+4(epsilon t/eta)^2. The matched law therefore achieves .97/[1+4(epsilon t/eta)^2] of the best actual current among symmetric common-D phase laws with the same coherent H and eta; finite pulses insert(1-delta). Explicit Fourier closure gives this restricted scalar thermodynamic limit. This does not extend the competitive ratio to arbitrary disorder/interactions or coherent cancellation.

The exact Fourier strong-hopping limit instead permits matched/baseline current ratios approaching eta/gamma_M, hence arbitrarily small as detuning grows. A saved diagnostic gives .008084749677 at its stated parameters. The original product-dimer all-observable reduction obstruction also survives. General interacting balanced-corrector acquisition, weighted commutator residuals and cost/rank control remain open. Negative material continuation of conditional N774, with separately derived passive harmonic-work bounds and finite controlled-Markov endpoint certificates. The supplied packet acquires neither a K-beta control pair nor retained repair. New matching-law rare-yield construction is a kinetic first-hit falsifier, not a finite-hopping irreversible quantum capture theorem.

Bulk D6h allows E2g Raman times E1u IR in-plane polar response but forbids E2g times A2u as that bilinear current. A C3-invariant occupied basin has zero linear scalar E2g gradient; defects can break this premise. Raman-modulated direct electromigration has the same allowed angular tensor. The new potential family has identical well phonons and relaxed barriers while changing the mode-constrained control rank, so those measurements cannot acquire the N774 site/saddle map. Conditional pumping and the prior direct-force falsifier remain valid.

Linear one-carrier continuity/Poisson decay is Dchem k^2+sigma/epsilon. The10nm,90%,one-hour requirement remains2.92668e-5/s; neutral Dchem<=7.41337e-23m^2/s or, at zero diffusion, dielectric relaxation>=34168s. This is a constitutive-model requirement, not a no-go for trapping, compensation or reactions. Uniform transport does not write a composition pattern. Na-beta THz-current prior and AgCrSe2 driven simulations do not validate K-beta retained writing.

New sharp bound uses actual harmonic q=C(omega)f and absorbed passive damping W=pi omega q*Gamma q. With site/path rows g,h, H=(gh^T-hg^T)/(2i), accessible signed area per work is exactly the generalized eigenvalue interval of(C*Gamma C)^(-1/2)C*HC(C*Gamma C)^(-1/2)/(pi omega), when the stated force set is available. It refines N774 stored-energy geometry. One input channel can enclose a loop via differential phase lag while allowing only one orientation; a loop is not independently reversible control. Selected damping work is not wall energy, and amplitude/damage constraints can prevent attaining the extrema.

New adaptive theorem: every legal finite-state generator sharing an acquired committor q preserves eventual target yield under arbitrary predictable switching if absorption completes. At finite time the invariant is captured target mass plus remaining q-weighted transient mass. Finite-pulse conditional yields can change by censoring even under a common clock. General residual identity DeltaP=E integral(L_t q)(X_t)dt yields additive error<=delta E tau under its stated stopping assumptions. A relative rare-yield guarantee instead requires a q-tilted exponential-moment certificate; the separate written h-transform proof makes that stronger acquisition explicit.

A bounded-degree leaf-chain realizes the ACTUAL source NIG matching law: eta1, D=0 on path/target and2 on bad leaves, squared hopping1/2 and2. Oracle slow-time rates are1; matched bad rates are exactly c=4100/4181 and path rates1. Dirichlet matrices satisfy cQ1<=Qc<=Q1 and cI<=Qc<=(c+4)I, yet h0(c)/h0(1) grows exponentially with length. Thus even uniformly conditioned close transport forms cannot supply relative rare repair yield. Source explicitly excluded arbitrary first-passage transfer, so its theorem is retained. Physical absorbing/capture operations and size-uniform finite-epsilon reduction are additional gates.

A2026 primary cold-annealing SiC comparator reports98–100% electrical recovery and distinguishes oxide/interface damage from carbon vacancies. Its10V times7–10A account conflicts with adjacent<48W text; matched energy needs clarification. No low-temperature selective carbon-vacancy repair mechanism or measured retained endpoint was acquired. Source replay, exact committor/recurrence fixtures and harmonic diagnostics are internal algebra/model evidence only.

Supplied finite h0,h1 on active A and collar C; arbitrary finite R and common Hermitian K on CR, containing no changed active terms. Source unrestricted ground-energy endpoint characterization is separately extended to nonnegative integer charges at fixed Q using strongly charge-preserving channels and a graded universal environment class. No practical electronic-structure advantage or realistic-environment convergence theorem.

For unrestricted common environments, L(h0,h1)=max_UCP Phi lambda_min[h1-(Phi tensor id)h0] exactly equals inf(E1-E0); the upper endpoint is-L(h1,h0). Source minimax, fixed-marginal channel reachability, duality and a finite penalty environment prove completeness in closure. R dimension<=(dim A)(dim C) suffices to approach endpoints, while matrix/SDP costs remain exponential in active spin count. All changed terms and active-boundary couplings must be supplied in h_j; this is not a hidden environment acquisition oracle.

The four-spin strong-boundary motif has a rational unrestricted interval[-3/4,-.22421], with explicit source near-extremal collar. A kagome patch instead admits a common ferromagnetic collar with positive response, giving the sharp robust interval[-3/4,+1/4] in its universal class. A favorable actual antiferromagnetic example cannot determine a universal sign. Exact CP/residual and rational environment certificates replayed; floating optimization is not substituted for exact certificates.

New fixed-charge completeness theorem restricts each Kraus operator to commute with N_A (equivalently fixes charge projectors); covariance alone is insufficient. The local residual is checked on charges<=Q. Charge-compatible purification plus grouped fixed-marginal reachability and block-Slater duality constructs charge-conserving approaching environments of dimension<=D_Q. This explicitly allows arbitrary finite nonnegative charge multiplicities and unrestricted K; it is not the theorem for a preassigned material collar, non-Abelian spin sector or a bounded/local environment class.

Exact failure of an unsafe chemical transfer: in the same four-spin motif at total down-spin count Q=2, K=100(2I-N2-N3) gives Delta_Q>=61/388>0, despite the negative full-space interval. Independent diagonalization gives+.24997423865347 as a diagnostic. The repaired universal fixed-Q interval is exactly[-3/4,+1/4] in closure. Imposing a sector changes the output task; it is not evidence that more correct information worsens the same inference.

New charge-aware SDP still has Choi dimension sum_q d_q^2; for k binary spins this is binom(2k,k), a polynomial factor reduction of an exponential representation. Fixed-charge physical model errors, realistic environment restrictions, region-size convergence and matched bootstrap/correlated-electron baselines remain unacquired. Integration-derived sufficient finite-temperature certificates for supplied local channel residuals and arbitrary finite common environments. Exact singlet-channel entropy minimization sharpens one explicit bound. Sector-safe versions require strong charge preservation. No complete finite-temperature converse, efficient generic entropy-gain oracle or material thermodynamic calculation.

If h1-Phi(h0)>=cI for Heisenberg UCP Phi with state adjoint Lambda, then for tau=kBT>0 every compatible common environment satisfies F_tau(H1)-F_tau(H0)>=c-tau log||Lambda(I_A)||. The proof uses scalar Jensen in an eigenbasis and trace/eigenvalue monotonicity, without assuming operator monotonicity or operator convexity of exp. The local penalty is independent of environment dimension/norm. A sharper sufficient bound is c+tau inf_rho[S(Lambda rho)-S(rho)], using entropy gain and data processing.

For the explicit two-spin singlet-cooling channel at q=1/2, convexity plus U(1) times U(3) twirling reduces minimum entropy gain to H2(x/4)-H2(x)-(3x/4)log3. Its exact minimizer y=x/(1-x)>0 solves y^3(4+3y)=27, and s=-log(1+3y/4). The rational bound y<59/40 therefore yields Fstrong-Fweak<=-(5-sqrt13)/8+tau log(337/160), certifying a strict sign for tau<.23399645... in native exchange energy. Decimal thresholds are diagnostics, not outward interval certificates or Kelvin/material predictions.

Dropping the thermal penalty is false: a two-level reset-channel certificate with h0=diag(0,2),h1=I/4 has ground c=1/4 but negative free-energy change at tau1. Reset-to-ground d-level families approach c-tau log d, proving the general norm penalty worst-case sharp. The source stronger rational c=.22421 also gives conservative-.22421+tau log4. These results concern the full-space task; original singlet cooling does not automatically preserve fixed charge.

For strong charge-preserving Kraus maps the same trace proof applies inside a fixed total-Q sector, with kappa_Q the largest available charge-block adjoint norm. Noncommon model errors enlarge bounds by eta0+eta1. Exactly common environment errors cancel, while common active errors leave E-Phi(E) unless an acquired fixed-error algebra removes them. A cap mesh on Lambda(I)<=kappa_cap I approximates the best norm-certificate family to e+tau h; it neither makes the joint score an SDP nor removes exponential active dimensions.

Independent exact symbolic residual/adjoint-norm reconstruction, sharp reset families, cap-mesh fixtures and finite random environments support the written proofs. Entropy gain/local passivity/channel ordering have established prior art; same-team review and finite partitions do not certify mathematical priority, physical validity or a civilization-enabling capability.
