Supplied complete hidden-affine triangular Boolean rank class with bounded total degree d and exact chosen-pair comparisons. Complete compact decoder, inverse and uniform arbitrary-prefix samplers are acquired. A new recognition lower bound compares against arbitrary permutation comparators; a standard repeated-comparison wrapper handles its explicit conditional noise promise. No general nonlinear learning or acquired real target.

For unknown invertible affine u=Lx+c and actual significance-ordered q_i=u_i+g_i(u_<i), deg(g_i)<=d, a translation exposes one actual coordinate via1+C(x,x+v). Random-match tournaments find the next significance coordinate, prefix interpolation acquires its polynomial, and one linear response row shrinks the suffix subspace. Stored acquired basis V and prefix polynomials compile exact rank/inverse and uniform prefix sampling with no additional comparisons, avoiding an exponential rank table and rare-prefix rejection.

The Las Vegas expected comparison count is D+6binom(n,2), D=sum_(j=0)^d binom(n,j+1). Capping each tournament contest at T=ceil(log2(P/beta)) match attempts returns an exact decoder or UNKNOWN with probability<=beta and maximum D+(2T+2)P comparisons. The information lower bound D gives leading query optimality for fixed d>=2, not for d1 or variable degree, runtime, storage or noisy access. Class and exact comparison access are supplied; ranks, labels, affine map, toggles and conditional samplers are acquired.

Source reports six same-teacher quadratic cases through64bits, with53,746 one-bit comparisons and15.12s acquisition at64 including its memoized dense teacher. This integration reruns only the six bounded receipt groups, including compact n8/n12, not the original n64 test. Independent new small cases check complete ranks/inverses/prefixes. Source preparation,2nQ transmitted bits,Q returned bits, dense teacher/cache work, D+n^2 logical model bits, algebra, randomness, checking and unprofiled interpreter memory remain separately charged.

New exact recognition obstruction: for1<=d<=n-2, certification against arbitrary permutation comparators needs exponentially many comparisons in its stated two-sided testing contract. Swapping an unqueried adjacent last-bit rank pair changes only that comparison, while a coordinate gains affine-invariant degree n-1 outside the promised class. This does not refute efficient promised learning or approximate/far-from-class testing; it prevents silently treating the exact class promise as cheaply acquired.

The standard noisy wrapper repeats each of at most B noiseless adaptive calls under a known full-history conditional correctness bias>1/2. Majority error is bounded using conditional Hoeffding/Azuma and a union bound; randomness/oracle failures and UNKNOWN remain distinct. Persistent or adversarially correlated comparison errors without that conditional promise are outside the theorem. The exact bounds and own finite fixtures are in the separate proof, with historical novelty unestablished.

Complete quadratic polar-toggle flags are equivalent to the hidden triangular class; partial flags do not imply completion, as a four-bit exact counterexample shows. Partial-flag median/correction methods, joint quadratic radical-fiber sampling and minimal-monomial conditional acquisition conjecture retain their separate source scopes, costs and unresolved status. Classical triangular permutations and lexicographic preference elicitation are strong prior; the exact hidden-affine comparison interface and practical advantage remain UNKNOWN.

notices.clarification: The four resubmitted core files are byte-identical to published N780 and are not a new discovery. A separately preserved later wave adds exact fixed-degree partial-flag witness compilation, degree-promised model validation and persistent directed bad-item robust acquisition. Degree, fixed-tail/flag and corruption promises remain supplied; robust Monte Carlo wrong/UNKNOWN guarantees differ from the exact complete-class zero-semantic-error theorem. Current n16 and full-cube replays and final same-source RM controls are finite evidence, not universal advantage. The exact general capped bound remains D+(2T+2)P; its bare O(n^(d+1)) simplification needs fixed beta or a suitable growth restriction on log(1/beta). Degree-promised validation does not acquire the degree promise or contradict exact arbitrary-oracle recognition. See the new audit for guards, losses to controls, total source/bit costs and precise scope.

notices.clarification: The continuation minimal-monomial conjecture S_p<=m Pr(F!=0), equivalently W<=m k for fair bits, is exactly refuted: g(OR4(A)-OR4(B)) has m=k=30 and W=1024>900 in every nontrivial finite abelian group. Growing/tensor OR families rule out every fixed multiplier and give an all-group lower exponent above1.12197. A paired-literal binary-matroid construction raises the lower exponent to log2(1+sqrt(2)) for GF(2) and groups with a nonzero order-two element; no such per-group claim is made for odd-order groups. A separately proved group-safe dyadic/support-dependent repair survives, including an all-group m^2 fallback. These are proposal-cost bounds for the named mixture; factored OR/matroid examples have easy direct samplers after their representation is supplied. The decoder and arbitrary conditional-sampling problem remain intact. Historical open-conjecture wording is retained as history; a source paired-literal arithmetic typo is explicitly corrected in the new proof.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Source-derived conditional reduction for explicit rational robust-sign schedules contained in orthogonal blocks of fixed rank, plus a specific executable product of an inherited2D controller. Depends on an inherited arbitrary-schedule existence theorem and external analytic inputs at a distinct pinned source; candidate proof and selected original source files are preserved, not externally validated. No general efficient variable-rank compiler, physical controller or strict advantage over DP/greedy.

In the action-then-adaptive-scalar-drift game, exact orthogonal blocks of rank<=fixed r reduce to independent local clocks. Rational rounding, positive margin and finite backward universal-noise DP compile a causal controller with radius O((1-gamma)^-3 sqrt d), polynomial in explicit horizon/input and1/(1-gamma), with degree depending on r. Runtime is not polynomial in variable r or log inverse margin. The general existence theorem used to prove radius-doubling termination remains an inherited unreviewed dependency, not newly validated here.

The source compiler executes coordinate-support blocks; its weighted rational orthogonal-subspace extension is a written proof/design. Exact connected components/rational dot products can acquire the structural decomposition from supplied directions, while unknown transverse errors or hidden rotated physical interfaces require separate acquisition. Feedback scalar accuracy and pulse/reading costs are explicit.

A separate all-time factorized operation reuses the byte-preserved inherited2D periodic table and one local phase per block, yielding radius3sqrt(k) under the stated scalar and sensor error budgets. This avoids enumerating the high-dimensional product. Source reports5,351,160 chosen-action checks for the inherited table and51,195,620 for a different finite4-pulse certificate; these large checks were not repeated by this integration. The exact Euclidean selector counterexample is among the six bounded replay groups.

An explicit corner defeats separate component signs for a direction spanning blocks. A monotone affine-box lifting representation forces nested physical zonotopes; m recurring rays imply perimeter>=4m and radius>=2m/pi, even in the plane. A separate exact two-round Euclidean fixture rejects convexifying winning prefix sets. These are representation-specific obstructions, not general controller complexity lower bounds or proof that a new selector-closed construction is impossible.

The consequential missing operation is an efficient branch-specific representation preserving distinct future recourse and every prefix. Standard safety DP, orthogonal decomposition and error feedback remain comparators. No acquired hardware, general arbitrary-schedule compiler, mathematical priority or civilization capability is established.

notices.clarification: The continuation minimal-monomial conjecture S_p<=m Pr(F!=0), equivalently W<=m k for fair bits, is exactly refuted: g(OR4(A)-OR4(B)) has m=k=30 and W=1024>900 in every nontrivial finite abelian group. Growing/tensor OR families rule out every fixed multiplier and give an all-group lower exponent above1.12197. A paired-literal binary-matroid construction raises the lower exponent to log2(1+sqrt(2)) for GF(2) and groups with a nonzero order-two element; no such per-group claim is made for odd-order groups. A separately proved group-safe dyadic/support-dependent repair survives, including an all-group m^2 fallback. These are proposal-cost bounds for the named mixture; factored OR/matroid examples have easy direct samplers after their representation is supplied. The decoder and arbitrary conditional-sampling problem remain intact. Historical open-conjecture wording is retained as history; a source paired-literal arithmetic typo is explicitly corrected in the new proof.

body:
N783-retained-repair-qualification-and-carrier-reward-certificates | Excitation-preserving repair needs acquired carrier survival and retained reward, beyond a repair committor
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Negative qualification of a proposed hBN excitation-preserving repair chain, plus conditional full-state Markov reward certificates. No defect-to-healed reaction, surviving outgoing excitation, chain kernel or retained lattice repair is acquired. New adaptive reward bounds and countermodels assume an explicit full configuration/carrier state and a defined retention horizon.

The proposed operation D+X -> D* -> H+X-prime is a physical hypothesis. Excitation-preserving molecular triplet chains already exist in primary literature, so that principle alone is not novel. No hBN Stone-Wales healing path with an outgoing excitation was computed or observed. Final Hamdi2020 model inputs kISC approximately100/s, radiative lifetime2.4ns and vertical energy4.53eV imply eta=3/12500003, about2.4e-7, and about4,166,667.67 absorbed photons per triplet under the stated relaxed optical cycle. The3.024pJ optical loading value excludes wall energy and is only as reliable as those model inputs.

For no-chain terminal99% yield the optimistic damage ceiling is eta*y/99, about2.424e-9 per absorbed photon when y=1. The unsaturated fluence coefficient1.39265e-11/(sigma_D*y)J/cm2 does not acquire the unknown absorption cross-section or healing yield. The final primary optical-cycle account also predicts continued UV photoionization of the triplet into a dark state: loading and propagation hazards cannot be assigned independently. A studied2025 UV center was identified as a carbon dimer; it does not identify the proposed Stone-Wales carrier or rule out all such defects. Beam/gas controls demonstrate probe-induced chemistry, not optical repair.

New restricted construction uses a full carrier/configuration substochastic kernel P^u with retained reward r^u, damage d^u and cost c^u. For a fixed policy with spectral radius below1, expected cumulative reward is (I-P)^-1 r. A nonnegative potential satisfying r^u+P^u v<=v bounds reward for arbitrary adaptive policies under the stated integrability/stopping conditions. A residual epsilon*b adds epsilon times expected total b; r^u-lambda*c^u+P^u v<=v gives a cost-aware bound. Counts are valid retained rewards only when credited effects cannot later be revoked through the assessment horizon; otherwise the configuration and terminal reward must be modelled explicitly.

Countermodels retain the same first-repair committor q=1 while chain gain varies from1 to1000; identical first-repair and immediate survival marginals can also give gains9 versus.9 when the outgoing carrier type differs. N777 eventual-hit invariance therefore does not acquire repeated repair gain. With at most one newly retained repair per encounter, termination probability at least delta and per-encounter reward at most ymax, G<=ymax/delta. Then Phi=eta*G>1 requires delta<eta*ymax. A finite accessible set of M distinct repair sites gives G<=M and requires at least4,166,668 sites at y=1 under these optical assumptions. These are conditional inequalities, not measured hBN parameters.

A homogeneous independent zero-loss95% assay would require12,482,220 verified events to certify loss below eta at this nominal value; that is a particular assay calculation, not a universal acquisition lower bound. An adaptive repair/damage ratio bound and hidden-carrier observational equivalence further specify what must be measured. Endpoint counts and clocks alone cannot establish electronic rather than chemical/thermal propagation. Outgoing-state fingerprints and calibrated interventions are required. Producer arithmetic and independently written exact/finite reward fixtures passed; no atomistic or physical validation, novelty clearance or civilization-enabling mechanism is established.

Acquire legal finite-time filters/correction/support with rigorous generator errors, and a useful global or compressed finite-window escape certificate including conditioning and all inverse/control/reset costs. body:
N784-coherent-energy-descent-completion-and-local-preparation-obstructions | Coherent completion makes energy descent exact while locality and finite-window escape govern preparation
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Finite-dimensional supplied-H downward-filtered jump completion with exact all-state energy monotonicity, separate acquired-control reductions and explicit slow/trapped examples. New approximate local-rigidity, strict local-minimum and finite-window escape results have their own proofs. Exact faithful-Schmidt local-channel rigidity has established prior art and is credited as known.

A strictly downward jump can heat coherent states: H=diag(0,1,4), B=|0><1|+|0><2| and psi=(-3|1>+|2>)/sqrt10 give drift+1/5. Source C_mn=sqrt(E_n-E_m)B_mn and Hermitian G_nn-prime=(i/2)sum_m[(sqrt(x)-sqrt(y))/(sqrt(x)+sqrt(y))]conj(B_mn)B_mn-prime complete the generator exactly to L*(H)=-C-dagger*C. The example becomes-1/10; separate jump channels instead give-13/10. The star correction lower bound is entrywise sharp, not an optimum for control work, circuit depth or cooling rate.

The reservoir-only exact universal correlation kernel2sqrt(omega_i*omega_j)/(omega_i+omega_j) has full rank at distinct positive frequencies; that is a representation-rank statement, not a demand for simultaneous independent reservoirs. Fourier/native inverse-control reductions charge their access, ancilla reset and approximation. Exact one-sided spectral filtering cannot have finite time support. A generator diamond error eta changes energy drift by at most spectral width times eta/2. The inverse Pauli acquisition formula additionally needs a distinct NONIDENTITY candidate set and its actual K; traceless H alone does not exclude I. Source bytes are preserved, with this qualification recorded; the source tested set already uses nonidentity weights1 through2.

Known strong-local-passivity rigidity: if the unique ground state has faithful A marginal rho_A>=sI, any strictly A-only CPTP operation satisfying Phi*(H)<=H is the identity channel. Frey--Funo--Hotta2014 equations9--11 already contain this exact result. The native Hamiltonian evolution may remain for a Lindblad generator; the claim concerns the local operation, not identity of the full native evolution. New quantitative bound with gap Delta and Phi*(H)<=H+epsilon I gives diamond(Phi,Id)<=min(2,2sqrt(2epsilon/(Delta*s))), with a sharper stated fidelity form. Thus local action distance d_act requires epsilon>=Delta*s*d_act^2/8. Gap and marginal conditioning must be acquired.

A strict classical local minimum is also fixed by every energy-safe channel or generator whose allowed operator span maps that state only into its k-local neighborhood. For a single channel with Phi*(H)<=H+epsilonI, approximate safety bounds the one-step escape probability by epsilon/Delta_local. A generator drift allowance instead bounds the initial escape rate and needs a separate time budget. The Ising droplet threshold for strict downward moves is min(n,floor(2J/h)+1), whereas merely nonheating moves use min(n,ceil(2J/h)); the equality case must not be conflated. The source near-degenerate star has rate17epsilon^2/32 plus higher terms despite ground gap1; the source k-local Ising state is trapped. A supplied collective nucleator/growth toy charges its multispin support and channels and faces the direct known global-spin-flip comparator.

A full-rank instantaneous dissipation bound Q>=a(H-E0) is sufficient but not necessary. The new exact finite-dimensional closure is time-integrated: all states converge to the ground subspace in population iff some finite T and0<a<1 satisfy Gamma_T=(H-E0)-exp(TL*)[H-E0]>=a(H-E0), for an energy-safe CPTP semigroup. It yields energy contraction(1-a)^floor(t/T) and population error divided by the acquired positive gap. This reformulates the required escape certificate; computing a global semigroup or bounding T may remain exponentially hard. Degenerate ground subspaces do not imply convergence to one fixed density. Same-team derivation and finite checks do not establish an implemented many-body cooling advantage.

body:
N785-moment-certified-impurity-extrema-and-shared-bath-design-contrast | Quadratic-bath moments give exact impurity extrema and a restricted shared-bath contrast certificate
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Finite number-conserving interacting impurity coupled linearly to a genuinely quadratic environment; grand-canonical bath-subtracted ground/free energies. Signed-band first moments and symmetric-band squared moments are distinct supplied interfaces. New same-bath design counterexamples and finite-positive-temperature sensitivity certificate do not acquire moments, physical Gaussianity or a certified correlated reference solver.

For signed bath bands h=sigma*A, a<=A<=b, supplied W=V*V-dagger and T=V*A*V-dagger determine compatible mean and endpoint baths. For coupled rank r_b on a band, the mean uses r_b modes and the endpoint bath uses at most2r_b modes; coupling rank and bath-mode count are distinct. Ground impurity energy is bounded sharply between endpoint and mean baths for arbitrary stated impurity interactions. Negative-energy modes require the filled bath reference subtraction. Prescribed geometry, bath dimension or fixed total charge changes this compatible environment class. These extrema are information-class statements, not a generic electronic-structure solver.

The symmetric-bath theorem instead supplies pair mass W and squared-energy moment S. Matrix inverse Jensen/chord bounds give Gamma_low<=Gamma_true<=Gamma_high. Self-adjoint Liouvillian/CAR causality gives0<=-ImG(iomega)<=(omega I+Gamma)^-1 because bath commutators are exactly linear. Integrating physical bath interpolation gives the sharp interaction-uniform width R_beta=(2/beta)sum_n>=0 logdet[(omega_n+Gamma_high)/(omega_n+Gamma_low)]. The zero-temperature integral is attained by a free resonant impurity. A separate certified reference value is still needed to locate an interacting energy.

The exact source24-bin flat-channel certificate is.00400824083758<R0<.00400824083759 per native bandwidth D, twice this for its two independent channels. The1eV substitution is illustrative and not a copper material parameter. The65536 one-body-mode square-lattice test is numerical; no2^98 reference Fock space was solved. Matrix moments/offdiagonal couplings are not a density-of-states acquisition. The statistical scalar normalized-sample/total-mass promise does not supply a matrix spectroscopy protocol, and the source million-sample experiment still exceeds twice its exact width. Acquisition experiment output remains source-reported and was not rerun in this intake.

New shared-bath counterexample: W=I2,S=I2/4 admits all-low and all-high extremal baths that both tie designs H_A0=10n1 and H_A1=10n0. A mixed bath with the same coupling and same moments gives contrast>7/40, while exchanging channels gives<-7/40. Single-design extremizers therefore do not jointly extremize a difference; the source explicitly disclaimed that transfer. Its one-radius contrast allowance is worst-case sharp over impurity pairs even with a common bath. No universal zero-temperature reduction follows from using shared data.

For finite beta>0 and the SAME bath/coupling with only H_A changing, center their difference to norm delta (half spectral diameter). Gibbs relative entropy/Pinsker and a retarded Green/Duhamel bound yield xi(omega)=min(1,delta*(2beta+4/omega)*(1+norm(Gamma_high)/omega)). The new uncertainty allowance is the minimum of R_beta,2delta and (2/beta)sum xi*logdetratio; it can be smaller at high temperature/small perturbation and needs no correlated Green function to bound its width. Equal moments give an explicit omega^-6 tail; statistical unequal-mass envelopes need different tails. Actual reference energies still require certified solves, and arithmetic/tails must round outward for a machine certificate. No chemistry, runtime or civilization-enabling advantage has been established.

Internally derived finite-dimensional information boundary: for every fixed k, all specified vacuum correlations with at most k creations and k annihilations fail to determine a grand-canonical coupled design sign. Hidden interaction order is k+1. A separate supplied normal-ordered order-p promise plus complete labelled sector operators up to p reconstructs the bath by standard CAR algebra with explicit sharp error amplification. No two-body/material impossibility or efficient physical tomography theorem.

For k>=1 take r=k+1 bath modes. H_quad=sum n_i and H_hidden=sum n_i+(-r+1/(8r))*product n_i have the same unique vacuum ground and identical Hamiltonian restrictions through bath charge k. Every vacuum multi-time word with at most k creation and k annihilation fields therefore agrees for all times and labelled linear combinations. An r-particle probe distinguishes them. This concerns vacuum low-order access, not finite-temperature spectra, strong pumping or unbounded-order measurements.

With one impurity d, common rank-one coupling.5*(d-dagger*c1+hc), a=r/[2(4r^2+1)], compare H_A1=n_d and H_A0=(2r+1)n_d-aI/2. The quadratic bath has contrast+a/2. In the hidden bath the fully occupied spectator sector has a2-by-2 design1 block of determinant-1/8 and a rational trial energy at most-a; every design0 block is positive before its constant. Thus the hidden contrast is at most-a/2 with the SAME bath/coupling for each pair of designs. A data-only binary chooser must err with worst-case probability at least1/2, or abstain; its worst expected regret is at least a/4. This proof generalizes the source non-Gaussian qualification rather than contradicting its quadratic theorem.

The counterexample uses an r-body interaction of normO(k), a design levelO(k), and gap/action marginO(1/k). No bounded two-body/local material claim follows. A known fixed joint charge Q<=k makes the hidden term vanish; this closes that specific ambiguity by changing to a certified sector task, consistent with N778. The charge restriction, vacuum preparation and acceptable model class are not inferred from the spectra.

Positive boundary: supply a number-conserving normal-ordered bath body-order bound p<=n and full operator matrices H[q] on labelled q-particle wedge spaces for q=0..p. Recursively subtract lower lifts to obtain U0=H[0] and Uq=H[q]-sum_(ell<q)dGamma_ell^(q)(Uell). Pure q-body monomials are matrix units on sector q, so this uniquely reconstructs H throughout Fock space. Complete complex vacuum propagator derivatives determine H[q]-E0I, with absolute E0 separately needed. Peak positions, traces or intensities do not provide those operators, and low-order data cannot justify the order promise or an omitted-tail norm.

The positive lift obeys norm(dGamma_q^(N)(X))<=binom(N,q)*norm(X), sharp for X=I; the normalized lift is UCP. Coefficient errors epsilon_q propagate as sum binom(N,q)epsilon_q; restriction errors delta_q give epsilon_q<=delta_q+sum_(ell<q)binom(q,ell)epsilon_ell. A justified fixed total Q replaces full-Fock N=n by at most min(n,Q). Dense supplied storage is sum binom(n,q)^2=O(n^(2p)) for fixed p; precision and acquisition are charged, and p growing with n is exponential. This uses known normal-order ingredients and supplies a Hamiltonian, not a non-Gaussian ground solver. N787-finite-mark-collision-sampling-and-transient-information-cost | Finite marked dependencies give an ideal all-time collision sampler while transient resolution retains an information cost
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Spatially homogeneous unit-rate isotropic-cutoff Maxwell equation in3D with supplied centered Gaussian scale-mixture initial sampler on known[a,b]. Exact rejection theorem requires b<3a/2 and ideal real/random access; broader full-law approximation has explicit TV error. New iid-output transient testing and measured-energy late-time approximation have distinct acquisition/output contracts. No spatial/reactive/path simulation, finite-bit certification or practical solver dominance.

For the stated radial Gaussian mixtures, the nonlinear collision law closes on V -> B*V1+(1-B)*V2 with uniform B. A shared k-mark genealogy integrates out nonseparating branches and uses at most k-1 effective splits,2k-1 nodes and k initial draws, independent of collision time. It exactly estimates each latent moment; replacing shared marks by independent initial draws is wrong. Bounded Poisson/Fourier estimators are absolute observable or signed-density queries, not yet samples.

Under0<a<b<3a/2, a randomized Laguerre series yields a uniformly bounded unbiased density-ratio query W against a Gaussian proposal, with acquired positive lower envelope ell and finite integral I=int q/ell. Huber2016 is a credited load-bearing linear Bernoulli factory. Rejection then gives one exact ideal velocity with at most19*C^2*I expected signed queries and C proposals, uniformly in t. The theorem has unbounded worst-case work and substantial bracket constants. Initial latent sampler,exact-real primitives,time/input encoding,output bits and all acquisition remain charged. The floating prototype is not exact for a continuous distribution; literal discrete-versus-continuous TV is1.

For arbitrary0<a<b, the n-mark Gaussian-mixture output has TV error at most sqrt(15/2)*Var(V0)*(1-exp(-t/3))/(4a^2*n). Source moment ODE and recursive/time-relaxed Maxwell solvers are strong baselines; the moment reference here is extremely cheap. Ideal exact sampling compared with full genealogy enumeration is a restricted algorithmic comparison, not a universal solver lower bound or a molecular capability.

New proof uses exact Gaussian overlap to obtain chi-square(f_t||G_mu)<=B_info*exp(-2t/3), with an explicit support/variance constant when max(mu-a,b-mu)<mu. Any equal-prior decision from N independent OUTPUT velocities that distinguishes the transient from equilibrium with average error<=1/4 needs N>=(log2/B_info)*exp(2t/3). A quartic radial moment statistic matches the exponential order with conservative constants. This does not bound a model-aware solver given moments or the latent sampler; it refutes transferring per-output work to transient-resolution cost.

A separate positive approximate interface uses charged independent initial-velocity energy measurements and a median-of-means estimate of mu, then produces G_mu_hat after a proved late-time threshold. Its conditional one-output TV and calibration-failure budgets are explicit; M joint outputs pay M times the per-output tolerance, and a shared random calibration does not give unconditional independence. A general signed-density converter exposes exactly what N687 lacks: pointwise density-ratio queries,known positive envelope,integrated cost and expected-to-hard-cap conversion. That bridge remains candidate. Two producer replays and independent finite tests passed; historical priority,bit costs and consequential advantage remain open.

Finite beta>0 and the same conserved sector for an arbitrary interacting coupled reference H and additive diagonal label interventions V. Inputs are its actual Gibbs label histogram,calibrated label-changing norm/kinetic information and errors. Source trace bounds and new activity/binary-compression/shared-latent certificates are conditional finite-information results; no reference equilibrium acquisition,ground-energy algorithm or real-material design decision is supplied.

Let D=sum P_i H P_i,T=H-D and p_i=Tr(P_i Gibbs_beta(H)). Acquire1<=ZH/ZD<=C from microscopic block norms g_ij or a kinetic expectation tau=Tr(rho T)<=0. With u_i=exp(-beta*v_i), A=p.u and L=min{w.u:0<=w<=p,sum w=1/C}, the full-system free-energy change lies in[-log A/beta,-log L/beta], intersected with the perturbation range. The mass-removal calculation is small after acquisition and covers strong diagonal shifts, including unknown non-Gaussian host response. Actual coupled equilibrium,diagonal intervention and conserved ensemble are essential; bare bath spectra are a different input.

The source sharp scalar-block partition envelope,confidence LP and exact conditional sign certificate are preserved. Its eight-site Hubbard control has sector dimension3136 and was fully diagonalized;30000 counts are simulated,not laboratory data. The rational certificate coverage>99.5% is conditional on declared Gibbs/readout/sector/coupling assumptions. No hard host was solved by avoiding that validation calculation. Classical reweighting,trace inequalities,charge sensing,AFQMC/embedding and recent constant-impurity algorithms are credited baselines; strongest matched physical/computational performance remains untested.

New same-input activity identity is log(ZH/ZD)=beta*a-D(rho||pinch rho)-D(pinch rho||rho_D), a=-tau. A binary POVM and norm K>=||T|| give log ratio<=beta*a-f(a/K), f(x)=log2-H2((1+x)/2). The confidence-safe exponent maximizes this concave function over acquired activity bounds; a one-sided endpoint is not generally valid. For binary labels, a new explicit UCP compression also uses the acquired population p: d_p(x)=H2(p)-H2((1+sqrt((2p-1)^2+x^2))/2)>=f(x), with feasibility x<=2sqrt(p(1-p)). The sharper exponent beta*a-d_p(a/K) requires no extra measurement; confidence sets must be optimized jointly. This bounded entropy improvement does not remove arbitrary uncertainty or preparation cost.

New joint design comparison retains common latent block weights. Reference C_ref may use kinetic data; each target C_j requires its own valid bound,with the unchanged microscopic T supplying a uniform graph budget. Two linear-fractional extrema become small Charnes-Cooper LPs and give contrast bounds; reference kinetic data must not be substituted for target budgets. An exact rational four-label control resolves a positive sign where separate source intervals straddle zero (finite diagnostics: naive[-.01040949,.07040956],joint[.02004970,.03995037],actual.03000523). This is information improvement in a declared control,not a chemistry benchmark or minimax characterization of quantum environments.

New fixed-charge two-body countermodel has identical stationary local histories,perfect C=1 and opposite global Gibbs design signs. Four fermion modes at pair charges(1,1) hide a bath sector; A-only probes cannot acquire its weights. With common weak bath tunnelling epsilon, signs persist while restricted local access needs time Omega(1/epsilon) to distinguish them. Fixed charge and stationary independent repeats therefore do not certify the intended equilibrium histogram. N786 remains valid: this operation acquires different loaded Gibbs information. Three inspected producer replays and separate internal tests passed; physical model/acquisition,external correctness,priority and practical advantage remain open.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.

Unqualified material-specific hypothesis: a synchronized broad electron beam converts a basis-dependent coherent velocity pattern into retained sublattice modification. Kinematic audit does not acquire the elemental-Te joint atomic/electronic state or retained-event kernel. New supplied-subspace,common-Gaussian-response and symmetric irreversible-write results have separate explicit model premises; no actual addressing,throughput,retention or advantage established.

Known recoil mechanics gives DeltaK=q^2/(2M)+q.v. A trigonal-Te radial A1 mode projects as(v,-v/2,-v/2) at its optimal azimuth. At300keV and3.24THz, one measured picometre gives about.08553eV recoil shift and.12829eV basis splitting. The source Te strongest-amplitude experiment is a3K polycrystal with optically inferred.24angstrom displacement,not a qualified single-domain trajectory. Its literal harmonic coherent energy exceeds the quoted absorbed-energy estimate by about2.11; coordinate/volume/damping inference must be reconciled. This flags input compatibility without refuting the experiment. CdTe displacement thresholds are not imported into elemental Te.

New optimal-control geometry: for acquired legal mass-weighted velocity coordinates u with kinetic budget||u||^2/2<=E and contrast rows g_i, the best worst-class recoil separation is sqrt(2E)*dist(0,conv{g_i}). A positive margin needs zero outside that convex hull. The source radial pattern is azimuth-maxmin optimal within its one mode; a hypothetical controllable zero-momentum collinear space improves margin by sqrt2 at equal cell kinetic energy. No extra Te mode/control interface is acquired by that calculation.

Finite-angle impulse averaging gives a corrected leading recoil-only phase/beam-energy derivative benchmark under common scalar response,azimuthal symmetry and dominated smoothness. Its D^(1) and baseline S^(0) are linearized coefficients; actual nonlinear observables have O(v^3) and O(v^2) remainders. A cubic response refutes the unqualified equalities. An axial beam is not an axial impulse at every finite angle, and a phase-odd yield or total damage change does not identify a unique mechanism or retained basis pattern.

If the ENTIRE response-relevant mapped states are equal-covariance Gaussians with Mahalanobis separation d and a common retained kernel, sharp ROC gives p_unwanted>=Phi(Phi^-1(p_target)-d). A restrictive scalar classical300K model at the optimistic all-coherent energy ceiling cannot meet .99/.01 single-opportunity performance; the actual source is3K and its covariance/kernel are unacquired,so this is not a Te no-go. Very large hazard ratios can be purchased in Gaussian tails at a quantified event-rate cost. Timing mixtures,neighbours and electronic state cannot be discarded to apply this scalar bound.

For a distinct acquired irreversible model with n unfinished equivalent targets,m unwanted sites and predictable global controls satisfying per-target rate r_t<=R*r_u, even ideal completion feedback has success<=product_(k=1)^n kR/(kR+m), attained by constant saturating rates. Common clocks cancel. One-target feedback thresholdR99 differs legitimately from the source fixed-dose458.2106 criterion; large parallel global fidelity pays approximately m*H_n/R error. Healing,correlated events,spatial selective control or passivation change this model and require a full retained transition law. Producer arithmetic and801 independent diagnostic fixtures passed; no physical gate was closed.

N791-local-reset-echo-comparison-and-linear-dimension-certificate | Local reset echoes validate a full-spectrum comparison with linear collar-dimension shot cost
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Producer claims plus separately labelled internal proof and finite evidence.

Finite host S tensor O with arbitrary finite interacting outside, a compiled local unitary U, R=U^dagger K1 U-K0-wI supported on the d-dimensional collar, known Rcap and J_S, Lambda=2J_S+Rcap, coherent branch access and a fixed-time null readout. The outside may retain arbitrary memory. A full-support local reset or freshly randomized local Pauli ensemble and uniform conditional apparatus error are physical inputs. No generic useful witness or calibrated device is acquired.

The producer supplies a polar-intertwiner lemma, an equilibrium-free local-reset echo acquisition theorem, phase-readout alternative, hidden-sector counterexample, model/control costs and failed scope controls. Full-spectrum eigenvalue pairing gives the same [w-r,w+r] free-energy interval for every beta>0 and ground energies. Invertibility, actual sector factorization and preservation, residual support and physical coherent branch control are essential.

New internal strengthening: the source remainder ||E(t)-I+itR|| <= Lambda t^2 ||R||/2 gives p_tau(t) >= t^2(1-Lambda t/2)^2 ||R||^2/(4d) for every outside state and 0<t<2/Lambda. Retain a maximal-absolute-eigenvalue collar eigenvector in the positive mixed-state failure sum; that eigenvector need not be known or prepared. At t=1/Lambda the denominator is 16 Lambda^2 d, improving the original d^2 certificate under the original assumptions. A rank-one uncoupled residual shows that the d factor remains necessary for this maximally mixed null-readout interface.

The original retained-memory quantum-instrument simulation has seven failures in 100,000,000 trials and was inconclusive under its original bound. With its original t=1/50, d=8, Lambda=879/50, w=1/5 and assumed gamma=1e-8, exact rational binomial domination with q_up=161/10^9 yields norm radius<71/500 and interval [29/500,171/500]=[0.058,0.342] at 99% confidence. The record remains simulated; no actual calibration or acquisition advantage is established. The separately favorable three-failure synthetic generator is unnecessary.

Fresh independent Pauli choices on ell collar qubits implement the replacement channel in the averaged conditional experiment even when the current host is correlated. This uses the established depolarizing-twirl identity, 2ell fresh random bits and local gates per trial; label preparation and uniform finite-duration control errors remain paid. Pool outcomes before conditioning on the current key. No thermodynamic cost, device access or entropy disposal is declared free.

Source local search failed on all 40 independently modified three-spin controls; a useful compact witness is not generic. Null-readout storage is O(1) counts plus circuit and confidence arithmetic, but unrestricted witness search/gate synthesis grow exponentially with collar spins. Calibration floors and total reset or twirl, controlled-U, evolution, label preparation/readout, search and checking costs remain explicit. An intermediate product-norm proof is retained as dominated exploration; the final certificate needs no new product-budget assumption.

body:
N792-covalent-isotope-fractionation-and-mixed-hazard-screen | Covalent isotope storage gives a falsifiable mixed-isotope fractionation proposal with explicit recovery limits
status=source_derived_unreviewed; Producer claims plus separately labelled internal proof and finite evidence.

Proposed electrochemical loading of a mixed H/D population onto supported graphene, selective partial oxidative stripping and separately qualified product collection. Source experimental antecedents concern reversible isotope-dependent bonding/removal; mixed-isotope hazards, inventory and product purity are not measured.

For a stripping-only interval with nonincreasing N_H,N_D, no readsorption/exchange and a uniform hazard ratio k_H<=r_max k_D, integration gives log(odds enrichment)<=(r_max-1)[-log(D recovery)]. This is elementary kinetics, not a novel theorem. Waveform changes do not evade a genuinely uniform hazard bound; exchange, replenishment, spatial heterogeneity and coadsorption interactions require a new mass-balanced model.

The proposed first go/no-go test starts from a measured surface D fraction0.10, targets fraction>=0.95 and retains>=half the initial D at room temperature with resolved isotope mass balance. It requires hazard ratio at least1+log(171)/log(2), approximately8.41785 in the stated stripping model. This is a chosen experimental threshold, not an observation or sufficient commercial-value criterion.

The reported operating coverage around1e14 atoms/cm^2 is an operating point, not a maximum storage theorem. Inventory, current and collection arithmetic expose scale costs. The source24.3pL carrier-H limit applies to one specified single-cycle liquid-collector calculation; it does not exclude multi-cycle accumulation, isotope-exchange removal or a separately measured gas/aprotic collector.

Pure-H and pure-D voltammograms and a zero-point-energy Boltzmann factor do not supply a mixed-isotope stripping ratio, recovery yield or full-cycle energy advantage. Established graphene isotope pumping and other electrochemical isotope separation remain strong comparators. No fitted physical model, new experiment, separator endurance or practical advantage is asserted.

For source m=w(s)p_s(y) and conditional transport partial_s p_s+div_y(p_s v_s)=0, the feasible current (M p_s,M p_s v_s) has divergence m. Standard primal/dual variational principles give tau0<=tau<=tau0+(1/Z)integral(M^2/w)E_p|v_s|^2 ds, with explicit physical mobility replacement. In the supplied translated interacting bath U=V(s)+U0(y-b(s)), the bath normalizer cancels exactly and no bath queries/equilibrium samples are needed after that representation is valid.

A thin path or approximate divergence fit cannot supply source conservation over the omitted domain. Gaussian overlap, hidden-gate and shortcut-plus-small-repair failures retain their narrow scope; they do not refute general preconditioning, weighted ensemble or molecular simulation.

New synthesis identifies the minimum conditional transport action as a weighted H^-1/Poisson norm and, under the stated finite reversible stationary assumptions, an integrated score autocovariance. This uses established Wasserstein/elliptic and Green-Kubo mathematics. The exact missing condition is controlled overlap of conditional-density change with slow mobility modes, with acquired tails and costs; a generic density fit or low geometric distortion does not supply it.

New exact hidden-path counterfamily has N=2^n transient vertices, known masses m_i=(N+i)/N and known path adjacency, with all conductances1 or one unknown edge conductance1/(100N^3). A factor2 certificate with wrong probability<=alpha and UNKNOWN<=delta therefore requires at least(1-delta-2alpha)N expected local-conductance queries on the base instance. The lower bound concerns that black-box mobility interface; supplied or cheaply derived calibrated generator coefficients evade it.

body:
N794-left-invariant-quartic-classification-and-closed-heat-certificate | Left-invariant quartics admit exact acoustic and moment interfaces; a closed heat certificate proves the retained non-polyconvex example quasiconvex
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Homogeneous quartic polynomials on real m-by-2 matrices, m>=2, invariant under left O(m), or the distinct nine-coefficient planar left-SO(2) class. Rank-one convexity, polyconvexity and quasiconvexity retain their full global definitions. Exact acoustic Gram certificates and compatible Fourier moments are acquired algebraically; gradient-moment completion for the full nine-dimensional cone remains unproved.

The original constructive classification proves rank-one convexity iff quasiconvexity iff polyconvexity in the left-O(m) class: F=G+gamma det(A^T A), G convex quartic, gamma>=0. It includes degenerate binary restrictions, arbitrary invertible right coordinate changes and the fact that det(A^T A) is a sum of squared minors, not itself a null Lagrangian. It does not extend to all left-SO(2) energies by reflection averaging.

For left SO(2), the source supplies nine coefficients, necessary orientation/slack bounds, and an exact 8-by-8 acoustic Gram criterion using Calderon's existing binary-biquadratic SOS theorem. Standard finite SDP duality converts universal rank-one-convex Jensen inequalities into an eight-dimensional PSD completion of nine moments. A strict feasible Gram controls dual-cone closure. Curl compatibility supplying that completion for every gradient law remains the essential general gate. Exact rational Fourier moment acquisition uses pair-frequency dictionaries with O(M^2) arithmetic operations, not a frequency-sized spatial grid; bit costs remain charged.

The retained Fstar=u^2+v^2+4w^2+(7/2)q^2-(29/10)q(u+v), where u=|column1|^2,v=|column2|^2,w=column1 dot column2,q=det A, is globally strictly rank-one convex and non-polyconvex by exact original certificates. The original source left its quasiconvexity UNKNOWN. This integration acquires a closed homogeneous-quadratic two-form and a positive rational 24-by-24 compatible-jet Gram certificate for Fstar-(83/1000)q^2. Exact identities, closure, a polynomial primitive and all positive LDL pivots are separately verified by two implementations. N740's established heat/exact-form interface plus squared-minor Jensen now proves Fstar quasiconvex internally; no formal proof-assistant or external review is claimed.

The exact heat Gram exceeds (1/500)I. In the stated full nine-polynomial basis, every coefficient perturbation of sup norm at most1/82000 preserves quasiconvexity and non-polyconvexity, with a fixed two-form and gamma. The canonical perturbation Gram has row-sum bound82; the original moment witness remains strictly negative. The Fstar Jensen gap is at least(1/36000) average|Dphi|^4; the whole cube has at least(1/72000). These are uniform analytic claims with exact supporting certificates, not finite Fourier-search extrapolations.

A separating functional rules out obtaining Fstar from positive sums of right-GL(2) transforms of the specified Bruno-Pasqualotto isotropic quasiconvex generators plus nonnegative determinant square. This is a scoped composition obstruction, not a quasiconvexity obstruction; the acquired heat certificate bypasses it. The 24 original positive Fourier searches and rejected sampled-LP candidate remain historical evidence. Further counterexample search against certified Fstar is now excluded mathematically. General planar Morrey and the full nine-coefficient completion remain open; novelty relative to older fourth-degree quasiconvexity results is unresolved.

body:
N795-completion-directed-kinetic-querying-and-finite-precision-boundaries | Kinetic completion gives sharp one-edge query rules with finite-precision extensions and exact adaptive counterexamples
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

A specified finite reversible grounded graph with known positive masses m, known possible moves, independent conductance box l<=c<=u, and A(l)>0. Objective F=m^T A(c)^(-1)m or equilibrium-conditioned mean F/sum m. A query measures one microscopic conductance, with exact or explicitly valid interval uncertainty. State/edge enumeration, masses, bounds, calibration, rate acquisition, precision and checking remain paid.

Rayleigh monotonicity gives the sharp completion interval [F(u),F(l)] within an independent edgewise box. The source proves that an exact one-edge query has its worst remaining width and ratio at an endpoint answer; Sherman-Morrison gives the exact equal-cost one-step minimax query rule. For a preselected independent-coordinate batch, a vertex among2^k outcomes attains the worst case. These do not assume a useful transport map, but the all-state representation can remain exponential. Correlated physical model families may have smaller completion sets.

New internally proved extension: a valid returned edge interval of width<=w has worst remaining width/ratio at [l,l+w] or [u-w,u]. In the source gain formulas replace Delta by D=Delta-w. A sensor with guaranteed absolute error h uses w=min(2h,Delta). Adaptive statistical intervals require conditional/simultaneous coverage and an accounted failure budget; actual rate-estimation costs are not supplied by this theorem.

Exact two-transient-state counterexamples delimit stronger extensions. Endpoint-only dynamic programming reports a two-query minimax ratio1.2691942574..., whereas the true deterministic continuous-answer game is at least1.3332116382.... A single scalar physical parameter making a rank-two update also has an interior worst answer. Factor-relative interval sensing has an interior maximum3.604048... above both end-interval values. The corrected relative-sensor rule evaluates endpoints and at most two stationary roots of a quadratic ratio derivative. None of these counterexamples invalidates the original one-edge or fixed independent-batch theorem.

All15 stored canonical rational interval certificates replayed using public inputs and query transcripts. The full fresh driver also produced15 valid enclosures, with environment-sensitive floating query order/count differences preserved. Its cold primary model used953 queries versus stored952, and its adversarial shortcut audit1096 versus stored890. The source32-system/5740-assertion checker and new24-graph/27747-assertion implementation checks passed. Exact residual checking validates the final box, not every floating argmin or historical novelty.

The benchmark explicitly represents512 softened-East transient states and2816 possible moves, with analytically supplied product masses and a microscopic generator oracle. Full acquisition plus sparse solve beats the candidate in recorded wall time. A stronger single-parent learner uses37 queries and wins on its promised class; one unqueried off-class shortcut leaves its transcript unchanged and changes the lifetime by more than11961-fold in the stored certified example. These controls and numerical warnings remain preserved. No atomistic oracle, compressed global coverage, WE/AIMMD/TAMMBER comparison or practical speed advantage is established.

N793's hidden-mobility lower bound remains intact: changing to calibrated local rate queries makes some conditional certificates executable but does not make exponentially many possible hidden gates cheap to cover. Short-time survival or two-history coherence requires an observability/tail theorem to control an equilibrium mean. A cut-current bound identifies the unacquired physical rate information that extra chart expressiveness alone cannot replace.

body:
N796-molecular-two-history-interferometry-and-erasure-completion | Two-history molecular interferometry has a concrete proposed access model and sharp erasure-completion limits
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Proposed Ca+/CaOH+ trapped-ion spatial-branch extension measuring complex L=Tr(U_B^dagger U_A rho), with branch-addressed fields, ancilla quadratures and a common physical system/environment model. Finite-width impulsive two-level calculations are ideal simulations; molecular structure, coherent branch control, pulse envelopes, Stark mixing, erasure, phase/contrast and trial costs require acquisition. No new experiment is supplied.

The packet explicitly pairs two pulse histories and retains coherent position backaction, shared-bath crossblocks, branch-field conditioning, leakage, phase-stability and complete-trial costs. The ideal Rx/Ry order swap gives L=1-2p^2+2i p(1-p) with equal final excitation2p(1-p). Opposite-order phase slots match ideal intensity exposure; this is not full cancellation of atomic/molecular dynamics or calibrated contrast. Known Hadamard/ancilla spectroscopy and ion2D-IR precedents preclude a first-measurement claim.

Primary platform review confirms cat alpha6.5(7), eta around.03 and fitted recoil visibility.52(3) as reported antecedents, not measured performance of this proposal. The source's50 completed trials/sec and chosen p=.03 are scenarios, not apparatus measurements. A laser100-kHz repetition rate does not supply full-trial rate. A source2.8-ms excited-state lifetime estimate is neither measured coherent T2 nor a verified cycle survival budget. Physical feasibility and useful nonlinear signal remain unresolved.

New exact shared-dilation theorem: with a common survival projector, full overlap L lies in the sharp disk z_survive+{z:|z|<=sqrt(q_A q_B)}. The survivor-conditioned fringe is2z_survive/(p_A+p_B), so its magnitude/phase cannot be substituted for the full overlap. Separate branch channels and survival marginals do not determine cross-history coherence; the common environmental dilation and phase relation are essential. Sharpness permits unspecified failure-space dimension and is not a claim to identify an actual bath.

Counting every erasure as a failure conservatively dominates the full-branch X-null failure probability, history by history. This can extend N791's Bernoulli-count certificate only if its original local residual, full-support reset/twirl, intended coherent echo and uniform calibration/model-error premises are also acquired. A molecular survivor fringe alone supplies none of those operator-norm premises. Zero observed losses likewise requires a conditional/iid risk assumption to predict future survival.

A common atomic phase in a cat/CNOT toy leaves Re L unchanged and attenuates Im L by cos(chi); a single scalar contrast can therefore fail. An intensity-only matched blank remains order-even in that toy. Moreover, the ideal equal-intensity identity assumes monochromatic fields or a common envelope: real counterpropagating pulses have envelopes G(t-x/c),G(t+x/c), whose instantaneous mismatch is generally nonzero even when integrated fluence agrees. Pulse propagation and full atomic echo controls are material calibration gates.

Saved numerical replay and independent analytic checks support only the ideal identities, completion bounds and specified countermodels. Molecular frequency/dipole distributions, dynamic/tensor Stark shifts, shared bath channels, full trial survival and independently attested apparatus performance remain unmeasured. A nonzero fourth connected response can arise from classical rotational mixtures, and weak fourth-order signal incurs p^-4 shot scaling; neither complexity nor quantum advantage follows.

body:
N797-sharp-quartic-slices-and-tensor-heat-completion | Sharp quartic slices admit exact heat proofs; a scalar representation barrier is bypassed by tensor channels
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Planar homogeneous quartics on real2-by2 matrices, with columns x,y, u=|x|²,v=|y|²,w=x·y,q=det A. Every background and compatible W1,4 zero-boundary/periodic gradient is quantified. Exact closed polynomial two-forms and positive heat Grams are supplied and independently reconstructed internally; external correctness and novelty remain UNKNOWN.

SOURCE RESULT: F_l=u²+v²+4w²+(7/2)q²+lq(u+v) is quasiconvex iff rank-one convex iff |l|<=kappa, where kappa is the unique root in(2.95,2.96) of48kappa^6−2545kappa^4+29712kappa²−97344=0. It is non-polyconvex for11/4<|l|<=kappa. The exact endpoint scalar6-by6 heat certificate and analytic implication strengthen N794; they do not constitute a first closure of its already established Fstar example.

For |l|<kappa, the Jensen gap is at least(1−|l|/kappa)/6 times integral|Dphi|^4. At l=−2.9, cstar≈.003123485533377 is the gap;3cstar is the norm-four subtraction coefficient. The source also proves a35-monomial coefficient l1 perturbation radius cstar with no perturbation symmetry. status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Equilibrium-source mean tau=<w,A_theta^-1 w>/<w,1> for a positive killed reversible weighted form. SOURCE RESULT: source/form comparison gives <ell,A+^-1ell>/Z_u<=tau<=<u,A-^-1u>/Z_ell without representing bath states, after valid global envelopes are supplied. The weighted reference operator is not automatically the physical generator. Arbitrary cross diffusion is excluded unless full-form domination is proved. Force samples do not supply mobility or global coefficient ranges; bounded analytic features can supply ranges only with their acquisition/preprocessing charged.

The source residual identity G=G0+R*H^-1R and coercive minorant0<C<=H give G0<=G<=G0+R*C^-1R for the represented load space. Tensor contraction/spectral counters can certify full residuals for analytic local generators without all microscopic states. A Galerkin residual alone is unsound: the saved3-coordinate projected residual is near zero while the true residual squared is.36223504.

Source replay locally rebuilds both C++17/GMP backends; supplied Linux binaries and pickles are never executed. The128-bit discrete mean interval[48731.064724447223,48745.779386242823] and128-coordinate continuum interval[11735.2473695064,11740.8172532523] reproduce exact saved bound strings. The severe-rarity ratio22.0327 remains a failure to obtain a tight certificate. Strong8/10/12-bit window baselines already reach ratios1.02170,1.00305,1.000350; nominal2^128 state count proves no practical advantage. All analytic local generators, product laws/moments and support are supplied.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED SOURCE COMPOSITION: retain the full source as a Schur load together with boundary loads. A joint PSD residual errorGamma gives a certified objective correction d0/(1−eta) whenGammaOO<=eta K0 andeta<1. Cross-error correlations are essential. Ifd0=0, the objective is exactly preserved even wheneta>=1 and the naive upper Schur matrix fails. Source mass normalization is separate; a boundary-only or one-load certificate does not cover other sources. Existing static-condensation and a posteriori principles are credited.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED NORMALIZATION: finite retained source-box closure sharp in the abstract form relaxation is Lsharp=min_box s^T A+^-1s/(1^T s),Usharp=max_box s^T A-^-1s/(1^T s). The positive Green upper problem reduces to at mostM+2 exact min-cuts, including the final certificate, forM uncertain source entries. The lower problem is convex and can have an irrational interior optimum; any rational trial field yields an exact sorted-prefix certificate. Dense Green acquisition/inversion and rational bit costs remain paid. This does not supply a dense Green kernel for the128-coordinate tensor example.

On the same16-state retained R=100 examples, coupled source normalization plus certified rational lower fields improves upper/lower ratios1.019221646→1.018894491,883.523116→44.686020346,and5528817.597→754.092906504. No bath states or new physical observations are acquired. These are relaxation certificates, not necessarily jointly attainable extrema of the source min-weight physical law; dominant-trap uncertainty is still broad.

A genuine grounded two-state reversible family proves the globalR² upper,R^-2 lower andR^4 width powers cannot be uniformly improved in the generic source/form-envelope class. Adding exact source mass to a source box creates a different optimization problem: a grounded-M-matrix resolvent reduction fromCLIQUE proves sharp correlated completion NP-hard at specified inverse-polynomial additive accuracy. It does not prove constant-accuracy hardness or universal impossibility of useful bounds; the unconstrained safe cut still applies. Fractional programming, maximum-density cuts and parametric flow are established methods; novelty of these kinetic consequences is unresolved.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Proposed Ca+/CaOH+ parked-ground-spin cat memory, momentum-coded ultrafast molecular histories and fluorescence ancilla readout. Under a coherent two-band phase-covariant pulse model, the selected optical harmonic has two second-pulse momentum coefficients. Actual full return visibility, band closure, science-reference instrument transfer, molecular response and total cost are unacquired.

SOURCE ADVANCE: parking labels in theCa+S1/2Zeeman doublet removes the leading differential scalar/vector/tensor electronic Stark term for linear light; an all-pulses transverse loaded reference tests return visibility without assuming molecular optical coherence. Actual shelving/return, spectator motion, phase and science-route transfer remain experimental gates. The ideal parking sequence uses allowed transitions; related spin-qubit fidelity is not borrowed for a large cat.

The two-band theorem allows arbitrary multilevel dynamics within two phase-charge bands: S±=exp(±ia)XE+exp(∓ia)XG,a=s/2,s=.702. Its two-port condition is about2.731 and a q2=0 consistency port differs from the all-transverse reference. A5^3 phase grid is exact only under the stated band/harmonic contract. More bands and branch-dependent open pulses require new closure/error bounds.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED CALIBRATION: two observables agree on every loaded reference phase scan but differ by.6 on a science-correlated hidden state. A scalar contrast cannot generally be transferred. Trace-norm calibration-span duality supplies the restricted quantitative alternative; uniform instrument error, factorization or adequate calibration span must actually be acquired. N791 operator-norm/full-support premises remain separate.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED IDENTIFIABILITY: r+1 phase-covariant bands produce up to2r odd momentum frequencies. For three bands, sin(3x)−[sin(3a)/sin(a)]sin(x) is an exact nonzero response invisible atx=−a,0,a. A floating physical ladder-mixture diagnostic also passes the third-port check with nonzero leakage, but it is not interval-certified. At least2r nonaliasing complex ports identify arbitrary coefficients; a proposed five-port three-band extension has condition about99.3 at the fixed cat size and unacquired optical transfer. A binomial polynomial proves exponential ill-conditioning as band count grows on a fixed narrow phase arc, scoped to that linear direction interface.

NUMERICAL QUALIFICATION: both unmodified local runtime replays fail theJ70/J80 convergence assertion; generate_reference exits0 but writes40 nonfinite scalar fields. Copied validation_results are not fresh successful receipts. The audit isolates a defaultEVR eigensystem orthogonality defect and separately repairs the scratch propagator withEVD plus finite/orthogonality/unitarity guards. The repaired copy passes and regenerates20 finite cases, with retained matmul warnings. An independent small-rotor ODE agrees within4.94e-8 operator norm. Source bytes and failed outputs remain intact; this is a numerical reference repair, not physical validation.

At the retuned reference quarter fluence, modeled|XE|≈.001783 implies about4.7e8 attempted shots or109 days at assumedC=.4 and50 complete trials/s for one coefficient. The source rounded.0018 table gives107 days. Four full-fluence pulses spend four times the energy. Phase-grid allocation is already inside totalN; no extra500-fold multiplier is justified. Reproducible replacement is allowed but reload/reset/identity/drift/loss cost remains paid. Author code and manuscript dipole conversions require convention reconciliation; no fitted coupling,T2,loss or throughput is supplied. Strong ion2D-IR and recoil pump-probe precedents prevent generic pathway-selection novelty claims.

body:
N800-full-cone-nullspace-rigidity-and-background-deflation | One-quadric closure and full-cone singular-face Jensen hold; near-face background deflation needs quantitative control
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Homogeneous quartics on finite-dimensional real spaces with positivity in directions null for one indefinite quadratic form; planar rank-one directions are det=0. A balanced law has finite fourth moment and E det X=0. All35 planar coefficients are allowed for nullspace closure; the full9 left-SO2 invariant cone is used for exceptional-class and singular-face Jensen theorems. Exact singular faces,positive-definite sectors and near-singular limits are distinct.

SOURCE THEOREM A: indefinite non-strict Finsler decomposition and quartic reciprocity give H=E D²F(X)>=0. For A in ker H, DF(X)[A]=0 almost everywhere, not just in average. The key cubic-integrability argument uses one indefinite quadratic null cone; an explicit higher-dimensional multiple-minor example prevents unrestricted transport. Consequently b=E DF(X) lies in ran H and the centered-law background minimum is c−b^T H†b/2. This is a range theorem, not a proof that the minimum is nonnegative for arbitrary determinant-balanced laws.

SOURCE THEOREMS B/C: in the full nine-coefficient left-SO2 invariant rank-one-convex cone, a balanced covariance C of rank>=3 can have singular H exactly for E={gamma(det A)²+|alpha x_C+beta y_C|⁴:gamma>=0}. The exceptional class is polyconvex. Outside it,singular H forces rank C<=2; compatible Fourier support in a two-dimensional matrix plane reduces to at most two independent rank-one phase families and Jensen holds. This proves the full compatible Jensen inequality on every exact singular averaged-Hessian face,for arbitrary backgrounds and periodic/zero-boundary W1,4 fields. It does not settle the positive-definite sector or general Morrey.

SOURCE THEOREM D: the strictly coercive polyconvex F_eta=det²+eta|A|⁴,eta=1/10000,has an explicit smooth heat-increase field. Finite-group symmetry averaging rules out every fixed constant-coefficient real matrix-valued uniformly parabolic linear flow making its FULL integrated energy monotone for every field. This does not refute a strategy that subtracts and separately controls a positive determinant-square term,nonlinear/nonlocal flows,or N740 admissible-minor-removal Q4. Tensor certificate failure must not be equated with QC failure.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED LIMIT OBSTRUCTION: for the fixed polyconvex F=det²,a smooth uniformly bounded fixed-bandwidth compatible family has C,H positive definite for every epsilon>0 and singular at zero. Its exact optimized Jensen gap tends to0 while the attained limiting gap is1/4; the minimizing background diverges like1/epsilon. Closed formulas and independent exact Fourier elimination verify the claim. A varying strictly quasiconvex nonexceptional family supplies the related nonuniformity as its strict margin vanishes. There is no negative gap or QC counterexample.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED CONTROL: if F−delta|A|⁴ is rank-one convex with known delta>0,then H>=4delta E|X|² I. A fixed35-monomial coefficient l1 bound K gives |B*|<=(K/delta)sqrt(E|X|⁴/E|X|²). This makes background search compact under charged quantitative inputs,without bounding all compatible fields or Fourier complexity. Nullspace closure also supplies the exact range hypothesis needed to transfer N798 full-source residual bounds to the remaining four-dimensional background Schur quotient.

SEPARATE CONDITIONAL STABILITY: a fixed Finsler remainder gap and the sign-gap of its determinant restriction bound one cubic component near its kernel. Constants may degenerate; these directional estimates do not close the full Schur remainder uniformly. A reduced-constraint fourth-moment illustration fails D_A C_A=Q_A and is explicitly not an actual quartic/gradient sharpness construction. Source verifier12 groups and independently rebuilt algebra/analytic criticism remain internal evidence; external correctness,priority and full-cone completion are UNKNOWN.

In the symmetric case,local generator algebra gives magnetization eigenvalue lambda=2nu/(t²+1) and a derived global complement bound gamma=nu[(1−eta)+4eta/n²]. Partition/correlation moments are computed from the recovered law,not supplied as unknown equilibrium integrals or a committor.

The discovered zero/two-wall trial sector has2+n(n−1) states. Its one-flip neighborhood is polynomial in n;the exact residual is1 outside that neighborhood,not0. The source-complete residual bound therefore retains every omitted source and internal residence contribution. At n24,t1000,the stored interval[144878.2730259796,156850.6573922623] has ratio1.08263754,with554 trial states and10178 residual-support states versus16777216 total states. Holding the entire trial fixed,the global-gap ablation has ratio287.9195;the acquired complement is the useful information.

The source proves a conservative finite-rarity relative-width bound polynomial in n and t^-2. This is a restricted integrable-family theorem,not favorable scaling at arbitrary rarity/dimension or field. At n16,t10 the ratio23.5971 fails;at n32,t1000 ratio1.31419 also fails a10% target. A root implementation recovers the source-sized law in210 weight calls versus301,and proves a265-call bound for n24. It recertifies the identical stored witness and exact endpoints. The independent tree uses its own subdivision/counts and loses to pair queries at n6. Positive heterogeneous graphs can also be acquired with O(n+m log n) calls,but the global kinetic complement remains ring-specific. Primary additive-query graph methods already offer an asymptotically linear bounded-degree baseline;this tree is not a new primitive or query-optimal.

The producer audit6818 assertions are source-reported;its hard-coded output driver was not silently run against a shared path. Independent small exact generators/LDL/residual checks support their stated scope. body:
N802-static-matched-isotope-spectral-substitution | A static-matched isotope-laminate flip gives conditional spectral substitution and explicit target-response limits
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Proposed passive h10BN/h11BN laminate reversal with identical caps and a declared linear-plate/mass-only dielectric reference. Static mechanical moments and ideal electrostatic reflection are matched while the surface spectrum changes. Actual isotope tensors,film interfaces,target loading and the target many-body response require qualification. Vacuum-reference optical contrast is neither a superconductivity prediction nor an acquired physical capability.

SOURCE PROPOSAL: the eight-layer complementary Thue-Morse isotope pair matches stretching,extension-bending and bending moments for arbitrary fixed unequal isotope stiffnesses. The ideal mass-only oscillator has isotope-independent DC permittivity,so static reflection is equal. Published endpoint reference parameters give a small nonzero DC mismatch instead. The ten-piece capped laminate and its target interfaces were not fabricated or qualified.

Reference Maxwell calculations in vacuum give approximately−13.295% signed evanescent witness contrast at1470cm^-1 and20nm height;it remains near−13.086% at sixfold damping. This is a sampled quasistatic surface proxy,not fitted loaded kappa-ET response or superfluid susceptibility. Imaginary-frequency reflection changes are much smaller. The source harmonic covariance comparison and classical mass-independence premise limit interpretations;common stiffness/coupling and actual quantum structural effects are explicit assumptions.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED DESIGN: for a physical mirror flip,isotope inventory,A_el and D_el are automatically preserved. Matching B_el for arbitrary unequal isotope coefficients requires only zero centered first moment. The smallest nonpalindromic equal-width binary pair has seven internal layers,LHHHLLH and its reverse,with the same3:4 isotope inventory. A subset-sum proof excludes n<=6. Requiring50:50 within each film or complement/Prouhet matching imposes extra constraints and changes minimality. This is an elementary design reduction,not established mathematical priority or experimental benefit.

A separate global transfer-matrix model gives about−12.600% seven-layer vacuum contrast at nominal damping,with fewer internal slabs/interfaces than the source design. Synthetic nondispersive terminal loads are stress fixtures,not the anisotropic complex temperature-dependent target. An exact statically matched spectral difference has positive and negative bands;two passive Lorentz weight functions give opposite target-weighted signs. Static matching and a local optical witness cannot infer the sign or magnitude of an unacquired target response.

The proposed first task is a nuisance-bounded dark-equilibrium comparison on kappa-ET. Its2pN/micrometre difference-in-differences target and assumed pair acquisition times are planning choices,not predictions or achieved throughput. Existing hBN/organic-superconductor and cavity experiments already supply strong scientific baselines. A positive future effect would not uniquely identify electromagnetic versus contact-acoustic mechanisms,attractive pairing or Tc enhancement.

Producer73 numerical assertions replay successfully with recorded runtime/last-digit differences. Independent elastic subset enumeration,amplitude transfer matrices and passive-filter countermodels support the restricted design/model conclusions. Actual film strain,adhesion,slip,dielectric tensor,loaded target response,systematic-error budget,reproducibility,wall-plug cost,novelty and meaningful advantage remain unacquired.

Source claims, internally derived proofs and same-team criticism remain unreviewed externally. Historical novelty, external mathematical correctness and physical capability are UNKNOWN. Exact algebra, producer replay, source hashes and validators establish only their specified scope. No civilisation-changing breakthrough is established.

Exact proof routes: updates/FH/package/spectral/README.md ; updates/FH/synthesis/spectral/DERIVED_RESULTS.md ; updates/FH/synthesis/spectral/REPORT.md
Next decisive obligation: Qualify the actual flipped/capped isotope pair with measured optical tensors,withheld-frequency/momentum tests,static/elastic/contact/strain and transfer controls. Then measure a preregistered dark target response at a full systematic and independent-pair cost budget against established same-target methods. A robust optical witness alone is not success on the material-science task.

N803-two-contact-rigidity-and-compatible-acoustic-flatness | Two-contact rigidity sharpens full-cone covariance control; actual bounded gradients exhibit quadratic covariance and quartic acoustic flatness
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Full nine-coefficient left-SO(2)-invariant homogeneous planar quartics, rank-one convexity, determinant-balanced covariances and actual periodic/zero-boundary gradients. Two-contact positivity, an explicit polyconvex exception, nonlinear shear changes of variables and finite-profile concentration are distinct from universal quasiconvexity. New acoustic/covariance flatness is exhibited by smooth compatible gradients; no negative compatible gap is supplied.

SOURCE STRUCTURE: a balanced covariance of rank at least two can have singular averaged Hessian exactly for the explicit polyconvex class P2=E union {a|Ar|^4+|alpha x_C+beta y_C|^4:a>=0}. This sharpens N800's rank-three threshold; it does not classify all polyconvex quartics. The proof includes rank-one distinguished backgrounds and singular upper blocks. Outside P2, two independent rank-one acoustic contacts already force positive Hessian sum. A compact local modulus mu_F(s)>0 then gives a covariance coercivity bound depending on mass and angular spread; efficient exact acquisition or a uniform power law is not asserted.

SOURCE LIMITS: a fixed exactly certified non-polyconvex G admits full-rank compatible concentrating gradients with H_rho>0 approaching nonzero singular H0, and cubic Schur loss tending to80089/21313530>0. Fourth moments stay bounded but are not equiintegrable; c also carries a concentration defect. The actual optimized gaps remain positive. This complements rather than supersedes N800's fixed-polyconvex bounded fixed-bandwidth construction. A separate bounded determinant-balanced noncompatible law already appears in source section8; its rediscovery is not counted as integration novelty.

SOURCE OPERATION: remaining semidefinite rank-two tangent contacts are trace-free determinant-preserving shears, with cubic invariance along the radical. An exact nonlinear volume-preserving coordinate map straightens a finite contact profile. The transformed energy has correlated spatial coefficients, so replacing them by an average would be unjustified. Finite disjoint-profile gluing retains a computable concentration defect and is superadditive in optimized gaps; standard quadratic duality does not settle internally resonant profiles.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED FLATNESS: a concrete normalized pair of rank-one matrices for G gives mu_G(s_e)<=O(s_e^4), excluding every lower bound c s^alpha with alpha<4. The corresponding determinant-balanced covariance has lambda_min H/(M2 tau^2) tending to5/78, tau=1−lambda_max(C)/tr(C). Actual smooth periodic gradients realize this covariance with uniform gradient bounds and growing integer Fourier frequencies; a small extra-mode construction makes C full rank while preserving the limit. Thus compatibility alone cannot improve this coercivity scaling to a power below two. These constructions have b=0 and positive energy, not a quasiconvexity counterexample.

EVIDENCE: the source twelve-group exact verifier replays; separate analytic criticism and independent exact acoustic/covariance/gradient checkers delimit scope. General positive-Hessian Jensen, compatible equiintegrable limit control, historical priority, external proof review and full planar Morrey remain open.
