Finite binary models with a globally pairwise energy law, positive degree-at-most-two attempt polynomials, known elementary reversible heat-bath form and reaction target. Original-potential downhill interrogation recovers unknown kinetic supports if preparation/holding preserve the intended conditional clock. Modular reference comparison and complete residuals avoid a supplied invariant Glauber slow space; no physical molecular oracle or global structural-class certification is acquired.

SOURCE ACQUISITION: for local energy ratio r and downhill rate d, the specified law gives a=d(1+r)/max(1,r), with a/2<=d<=a. Empty/single/pair context Mobius differences recover each degree-two attempt polynomial separately from the energy graph. At n18,172 exact configuration weights and2772 exact downhill-clock readings recover the declared law. Unknown support is recovered within a supplied degree bound; the prototype caps learned support at10 and tabulates it exponentially. Preparation, resetting, clamping, intrinsic mobility and finite precision are paid obligations.

SOURCE COMPLETION: graph-derived local blocks retain all local modes; acquired energy and kinetic interaction contrasts give C<=A<=R_m R_k C globally. The complete equilibrium source and actual normalization are retained in rational residual certificates; a separate two-load certificate covers a represented point preparation. The n18 examples use three64-state local models versus262144 global configurations, with heterogeneous/frustrated interactions and an exact nonlinear single-spin nonclosure witness. Modularity, bounded block size and cross-term representation are resources, not a general molecular theorem.

CANONICAL DECISION: the equal-energy A/B models have identical all-zero-context clock readings but different recovered context mobility. Source intervals separate B_lower/A_upper>1.54685216; deterministic supplied error bounds retain>1.53899. The example sufficient physical dwell protocol costs about9.6e20 model-time units before reset/clamping, not a necessary lower bound or experimental speedup. A dense18-bit preflight leaves at least108 cross edges and comparison R_m>=2^108 for every admitted partition, so the current route refuses compilation rather than resolving strong collective gating.

REPLAY FAILURE AND SEPARATE RECERTIFICATION: unmodified audit_reverse.py FAILS exact endpoint equality on fresh platforms. Source NPZs retain numeric response tensors but omit the historical local alpha vector. Fresh high-precision112-bit exact supersolutions validate each stored scalar alpha, and the retained response then rebuilds old endpoints exactly. This is a new certificate for the old scalar, not recovery of the missing historical vector or a passing original audit. Fresh rational full-state comparison is tighter; the source matched end-to-end full solver was faster,3.26s versus6.58s at a1.05 ratio goal. The raw local K is nonsymmetric;weighted L2 self-adjointness and a positive-inverse spectral-radius argument validate alpha. A separate correction preserves the worker frozen proof's inaccurate Euclidean-symmetry wording.

INFORMATION LIMITS: exact cubic-clock perturbations evade all degree-two probes, and a preparation-control countermodel preserves observed downhill readings while changing the free response. Finitely many exact positive-shift Stieltjes responses can coincide while the zero-shift lifetime diverges. These reject unrestricted transfers, not the correctly promised source theorem. Fourteen thousand five hundred seventy-six producer assertions are source-reported staged evidence, not newly replayed independent theorems. Strong tensor/MTTA prior art and unexecuted WE/TAMMBER/AIMMD comparators remain explicit.

body:
N805-recoverable-compliance-gating-and-spatial-path-control | A conditional recoverable compliance gate has exact switching paths and a sharp distinction between homogeneous stability and global spatial control
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Supplied scalar coexistence sextic and adjustable positive quartic gate plus conjugate field; local elastic elimination assumes zero preload and a realizable control port. A finite-lattice mixed local/shared quartic functional is a mathematical architecture. Actual compatible elastic kernels, finite-temperature selection/retention, finite-time losses, material constitutive parameters and work-recovery efficiency remain unacquired.

SOURCE PATH: f0=a q^2/2−b q^4/4+c q^6/6 with b,c>0,a=3b^2/(16c) and qB^2=3b/(4c) factors nonnegatively. Engage a quartic gate, traverse the convex tilted landscape, and remove it with h=u qB^3. Tangent compensation/Bregman positivity certifies global minima. Local spring elimination gives u(K)=2alpha^2 C K/(C+K), with a saturation and preload-dependent quadratic correction. The equal-free-energy ideal stroke returns the circulated control work; it is not a thermodynamic cycle, refrigeration performance or free erasure.

SOURCE SPATIAL OBSTRUCTION: a mean-only clamp matches the homogeneous quartic but has transverse curvature−a/15 at U=b. Positive elastic energy or a PSD kernel in q^2 does not ensure convexity in q. The primary material preprint itself uses nonlocal compatibility-projected elastic kernels. A genuinely sitewise quartic gate plus PSD gradient coupling is sufficient in the model; the device realization is not supplied.

INTEGRATION-DERIVED GLOBAL PATH: for theta U sum_i q_i^4/4+(1−theta)U(sum_i q_i^2)^2/(4N), at U=b a sharp all-N global-equilibrium path threshold is theta*=0.16725804894398. It follows from an exact scalar tangent-gap decomposition and a cubic algebraic minimizer. This lies between homogeneous linear stability at0.03175416 and entire-functional convexity at0.35450278. At theta=.1, an exact32-site state has lower energy despite every homogeneous Hessian being positive. PSD gradient coupling preserves the sufficient global path; lower-threshold failures depend on size/coupling. At equality there is no size-independent strict margin.

FINITE-TIME/NOISE QUALIFICATION: an overdamped scalar traversal has dissipation at least zeta qB^2/tau. Restoring both controls returns a symmetric coexistence Gibbs distribution, not a unique high-confidence positive phase. body:
N806-contact-cubic-compensation-and-moving-schur-obstruction | Compatible cubic compensation controls fixed contacts; moving Schur directions remain the decisive obstruction
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Full nine-coefficient left-SO(2)-invariant rank-one-convex homogeneous planar quartics and actual mean-zero periodic/zero-boundary W1,4 gradients. Exact contact cubic and cross-Hessian compensation, fixed contact-plane Jensen and their analytic hypotheses are distinct from all-background quasiconvexity. The nonrotational sufficient criterion separately states its polynomial, Hodge and multiplier assumptions.

SOURCE MECHANISM: at a rank-one acoustic contact (A,R), the cubic average is controlled by sqrt(E D2F(X)[A,A]) times ||X||4 ||Y||4, with Y transverse to R; the cross-Hessian bound carries the corresponding transverse L2 factor. Full contact classification and differential mixed-derivative interpolation are load-bearing. This closes the earlier fixed-direction strong-L4 loss issue and gives a relative L2/L4 contact-plane Jensen neighborhood for arbitrary contact-plane background. Smooth compatible concentration proves the L4 endpoint cannot generally be weakened to p<4.

INTEGRATION GENERALIZATION: a nonnegative quadratic majorizing defects(c,d-lambda*a), a homogeneous cubic restricting to kappa*a^3 on its kernel, and partial_b^2 C=0 imply the same compensation without rotational symmetry. Explicit projection and geometric-mean symbol conditions extend the sufficient criterion to some other differential constraints. They are substantive hypotheses. A compatible resonant b^2*c family is n^-2 while the proposed weakened RHS is O(n^-3); wave-cone intersection alone is insufficient. A cubic det(X)*X11 vanishes on one-wave rank-one matrices yet has nonzero resonant average.

ALL-BACKGROUND GATE: eliminating the positive complementary Hessian block yields h*=h-k^T D^-1 k and a reduced cubic. A conditional near-contact all-background theorem holds when h*=0 or h*>=theta*h. Exact bounded compatible rank-two fields have H>0 but h*/h tends to0, so that comparison is not automatic. Exact compatible concentration makes the minimizing background diverge while the transverse relative L4 size can be arbitrarily small. Both families retain positive optimized gaps. A separate resonant rank-three family has reduced loss tending to0, supporting no universal claim.

EVIDENCE AND LIMITS: source nine-group contact and twelve-group predecessor replay, separate analytic reconstruction and independent exact compatible Fourier/concentration checks. Finite symbolic checks do not verify the analytic interpolation theorem. The reduced-residual inequality relative to h*, concentration-stable all-background positivity, full planar Morrey, external proof review and historical priority remain open.

body:
N807-bounded-nonlinear-corrections-and-observation-channel-compiler | Certified nonlinear corrections supply a noisy observation channel with nested cost and a hard node cap
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Supplied nonlinear forward model, evaluable predictor, globally certified enclosure and coefficient bounds, fresh exact diffusion/branching primitives and full acquisition cost. A fixed finite observation list gives iid whole correction vectors with |E_i|<=h_i and mean u_i-v_i. The target is a declared positive-noise Gaussian joint law, not a noise-free solution or unknown physical uncertainty distribution. Exact-real theorem, node ceiling, finite-bit law certification and physical model validation are separate.

SOURCE QUERY OPERATION: tangent-resummed predictor correction has bounded unbiased random-tree outputs under global enclosure and derivative-subcritical certificates. Finite polynomial and stated sinh regimes are covered; expected tree work is finite and pointwise concentration follows in the ideal model. An uncentered independent-product quartic representation has divergent absolute expectation; this rejects that representation, not all methods. The executable uses ordinary floats; an inward-rounding/guard-tolerance gap is recorded and no continuous-TV implementation is certified.

INTEGRATION OBSERVATION COMPILER: X=E/sigma with R=||h||2/sigma exactly supplies the existing N722/FORS bounded-iid unknown-mean oracle. It samples N(u_vector,sigma^2 I) in full joint TV epsilon_g with at most2e^2*m expected acquisitions. The predictable-request argument charges tree output/work correlation correctly. Known positive-definite covariance requires paid whitening; unknown unnoised directions and adaptive point lists do not inherit this interface. FORS is the established matched sampler; no new sampler-architecture priority or advantage over it is claimed.

HARD COST CERTIFICATE: conditional frontier inequalities z E[product_children t(child)|history,state]<=t(state), z>1,t>=1, give E z^N<=t(root). Explicit outer proposal, Poisson and tree caps cost at most delta in fallback TV. At two points, h=1/8,sigma=1/4,epsilon=1/20, exact rational parameters m60,K67,Jcap22,ncap105 give a ceiling18572400 PDE nodes/output. The 8000-output floating diagnostic used8947919nodes total,zero aborts; neither those moments nor FFT agreement certify continuous-TV correctness or bit/endpoint cost.

REPRESENTATION EXTENSION: an event-first resolvent-tilted nonuniform envelope and weighted positive progeny certificate give an exact finite two-state bounded sampler even though every constant global tube criterion fails and one type has mean offspring9/8. The root rational t,z witness adds an exponential node tail. Continuum normalizers, tilted endpoint access, global inequalities and their complete costs remain unacquired; N804 alpha vectors are not supplied for this different operator.

ADJUDICATION: on a coupled synthetic8D quartic, an equally informed deterministic sparse Fourier correction already has error radius.009292725<.01 and an interval-evaluated answer; sampler timings are diagnostics only, and the huge MLP theorem-bound count is not a lower bound or executed comparison. A Gaussian-mixture calculation refutes an attempted randomized bump lower-bound extension: one query has TV O(d^-1/4) on that independent-coordinate family with nonvanishing mean. The generic Lipschitz baseline remains O(sqrt(d)/epsilon), not closure of N687 or R16. Original mistaken interval notation and separate correction are retained.

body:
N808-conditional-hydraulic-isolation-and-shunt-response-assay | A passive hydraulic isolation model has a conditional shunt assay and explicit noise/work limits
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Steady reciprocal unbiased wet laws with actual K,G>0,C^2<KG and a measured complete passive dry terminal admittance. The composed hydraulic matrix and circuit topology are conditional models. Common-temperature classical Gaussian/FDT, ideal waveform/load and isolated-shunt invariant-wet-law hypotheses are additional stated contracts. No complete neutral-liquid transducer or hydraulic isolator was built or measured.

SOURCE COMPOSITION: eliminating electrical ports gives H=K-C(G+Y)^-1 C and the exact skew congruence. For invertible C, skew rank transfers but amplitude does not. A grounded three-contact chiral topology gives H12=0 when g-=0 and nonzero forward response additionally requires g+>0 and nonzero wet couplings. Its optimal-load ceiling is eta<=eta_c(Z1)eta_c(Z2)/4<=1/4; simultaneous matching need not be achievable for unequal converters. This is topology specific, not a universal isolator bound. A lossless gyrator has equal bidirectional magnitudes.

ACQUIRED EFFECTIVE TARGET: a known isolated passive shunt t*u*u^T under invariant wet matrices gives Delta H(t)=t*F/(1+t*q), q>0,rankF<=1. If F!=0, baseline plus two distinct positive levels identify(q,F); a third tests the prediction. One-level passive ambiguity, one-sided visibility cancellation and a direct-effect counterfeit precisely delimit attribution. Standard Sherman-Morrison/Kron algebra is prior; no hidden component reconstruction, physical assay or cost win is established.

NOISE/WORK QUALIFICATION: complete wet/contact elimination gives Sxi=kBT(H+Hdagger) at a single classical equilibrium temperature. Exact unilateral passivity implies |H21|^2<=4ReH11ReH22, and the specified ideal Gaussian known-waveform experiment has SNR^2<=2Win/kBT. At the noisy maximum-power load in the memoryless DC model, SNR^2=eta*Win/kBT. Finite-band transfer, Gaussian likelihood, bath temperatures and stability/ergodicity qualifications remain explicit. Passive shunt heat is already paid by signed net hydraulic input; the original worker energy paragraph is corrected separately to prevent double counting.

ORIGINAL EVIDENCE: the archive named in the supplied note was later found and frozen with a supplemental intake. Copy-first replay returns six symbolic labels,1000seeded4port diagnostics and40804grid points, with tiny platform float differences; only five labels have direct symbolic assertions. Written and independent algebra support the factorization. These are model checks, not molecular simulation or experiment.

PHYSICAL GATE AND COMPARATOR: primary flow-induced electronic signals, including zero longitudinal bias glycerol/graphene, do not supply same-device steady bidirectional K,C,G. Strong coupling/flow tunnelling are theoretical or simulated, not measured material constants. Active acoustic signal isolation and ionic electrokinetic pumping are different operations. Useful throughput,bandwidth,noise,lifetime and complete installed cost versus conventional isolated pump/valve/sensor control remain UNKNOWN.

Centered determinant-balanced finite-fourth-moment laws relatively close to R0 in both L2/L4. All affine backgrounds, no amplitude cap or nonzero moment floor. Tangent rank-two remainder and general large-transverse fields excluded. Prove a concentration-stable compatible estimate on the reduced moving numerator relative to the actual Schur denominator at rank-two tangent contacts, or construct an exact compatible negative optimized gap. For global leftSO2 quartics prove compatibility-to-nine-moment PSD completion or an exact separating compatible profile. Independently validate the new multi-constraint theorem and acquire a nontrivial application of its extra local PSD certificate.
body:
N809-moving-transverse-quartic-stability-and-normal-regression | Moving covariance and acoustic frames give all-affine quartic stability near a simple transverse contact
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

Full35-coefficient homogeneous rank-one-convex planar quartic; fixed unit rank-one R0 with F(R0)>0, simple acoustic null A0, rank-three PSD Finsler remainder with kernel R0. Centered determinant-balanced finite-fourth-moment laws relatively close to R0 in both L2/L4. All affine backgrounds, no amplitude cap or nonzero moment floor. Tangent rank-two remainder and general large-transverse fields excluded.

SOURCE THEOREM: covariance maximization on detR=0 gives exact normal regression E(sY)=-(E detY)JR/(2|JR|^2)=O(E|Y|^2). Move the simple acoustic least eigenvector and a uniformly feasible Finsler remainder with R. This controls the actual Schur denominator. Regress the complete pure-line cubic before inversion; the fully minimized gap differs from F(R)[m4-2m3^2/(3m2)] by O((delta2+delta4)m4), hence is at least eta E|X|^4. This closes N806 all-affine control only in the simple transverse sector.

CONDITIONAL GENERALIZATION: for a regular constant-rank intersection of quadrics, stationarity puts z in the Jacobian row space and balance gives J_R z=-E Phi(Y); a bounded pseudoinverse supplies the same O(v) regression. Full Schur elimination additionally assumes a continuous local multi-Finsler PSD remainder coercive transverse to R and simple acoustic gap. Higher rank-one minors have regular geometry and gradient moment balance; automatic PSD-plus-minors or arbitrary A-free transfer does not follow.

DECISIVE NEGATIVES: a five-cycle quadratic form is nonnegative on its common quadric null set but has no PSD-plus-constraints decomposition. A tangent rank-two remainder admits centered bounded determinant-balanced near-line laws with negative affine trials tending to -3/4; they are not compatible gradients. Fixing a test direction before Finsler/averaging repairs an exposition ambiguity without changing the theorem.

COMPATIBLE TESTS AND LIMITS: an exact resonant triad has fitted R=e12, H>0, reduced h*/epsilon^4→10385/144, reduced cubic/epsilon^3→-25/2, positive optimized gap→219/4 and optimizer of order epsilon^-1. Output rotation collapses the stale-frame ratio while moving quantities remain invariant. Cutoff/dilution supports a concentration stress test, not a universal estimate. Convex law mixing/exact disjoint gluing are safe; overlapping profile decomposition remains missing. Nine-moment PSD completion is still the full leftSO2 global gate. No Morrey closure or external proof/priority certification.

Specified positive massive lattice local-drift anchor model with stationary adapted source/coupling and paid forcing moments; regular finite-temperature chi(i eta), eta>0. Alternative finite-H observation assumes Gibbs preparation, bounded Hermitian A with known a>=||A||, CP filter A/a and calibrated f(H) energy readout. SOURCE NEGATIVE: fixed r full-spatial anchors give local normalized Fourier discrepancy D<=rB/(alpha sqrtN) and raw second moment <=2D/sqrtalpha+D^2. Temperature dependence disappears in the stated long-target limit. Audits preserve source-independence, centering, absolute-moment and conventional massive continuum normalization qualifications. Original paper update is reconstructed at equation level; authors code/raw data and finite-coupling figures were not replayed; exact KMS contours/nonlocal boundary corrections are outside the no-go.

STRONGER OBSTRUCTION AND CONSTRUCTIVE TEST: geometry gives D_A(v)=sum_a B_a(K^-1|v|)_a, while stationarity alone does not imply covariance cancellation. For any exogenous mask fraction f and independent centered symmetric source, the plane-wave first derivative is -c0(1-f)/(2kq^2), below the finite-beta tadpole in the long-target limit. Engineered correlated Y=sX0 with s^3=[c_beta/c0-(1-f)]/f supplies the exact missing first-order cross-moment; full mask gives C1=-c_beta K^-2/2. Sparse source sixth moments grow as f^-2, c_beta acquisition is paid, and covariance becomes quadratic in lambda under fixed full-mask external forcing. An exact scalar comparison already fails at order2; this is not a full thermal repair.

BOUNDED RESPONSE OBSERVATION: Gibbs energy readout→CP filter A/a→energy readout yields raw mass p_n|A_nm|^2/a^2. The folded output 2a^2|Delta|tanh(beta|Delta|/2)/(Delta^2+eta^2), zero on failure, is unbiased for regular chi and lies in [0,a^2 min(beta,1/eta)]. It is Rao-Blackwellization of the equally informed signed output. The error certificate charges trace prep, instrument TV, bad-label probability and resolution with Lip<=min(beta/eta,3/eta^2); f(H) Kraus is stronger than merely commuting in degenerate spaces. Unbounded observables need a separate acquired tail/clipped-filter gate. Local balance alone does not acquire disconnected Gibbs sector masses.

EVIDENCE/COMPARATOR: root64-state noncommuting fixture identities, independent same-team analytic critic and exact degeneracy/sector witnesses support only stated scopes. Corrected interval-checked finite spectra match six Euclidean values,M1 and static chi but differ at eta1 by0.03389783995911704735; ||A|| is about6.45, not1. Original precision-misaligned instance and append-only correction retained. Exact compact signed Euclidean averaging off Matsubara is impossible, while Mutzel-Tilloy positive-functional bounds already provide an approximate comparator. Local LR plus separately certified thermal marginals and global KMS/Liouville identities do not supply free Gibbs preparation or a many-body cost advantage. Dimensionless pulse example is a reduced mathematical model, not acquired ZnS coefficients. Target-local structural/fault/boundary/slip and retained functional assays are required. T-center conditional preparation regimes remain separate from useful multi-emitter output.

SOURCE AUDIT: common scalar mobility only changes clocks in the admitted autonomous glide model. Nonproportional class response is an actuator lead, not proof of reaction selection. The supplied partial Burgers pair forms a nonzero perfect product, and opposite annihilation may retain plastic shear. Published electric motion and 350C optical gating cannot be combined as an acquired room-temperature control set. No useful new physical operation was established.

SCOPED CONSTRUCTION: a full network/carrier/heat/pinning/noise/reaction/history generator gives a committor-defect policy test; common-committor invariance is already N777 prior. An exact one-flux coupled-velocity/capture-disk witness has dark→light reach a compatible target, reversal hit a competing residual sink, and every constant flux lose. Values are illustrative, stress direction restricted, retained endpoint not simulated. Same-network selection/retention/calibration is the missing physical map.

MEASUREMENT AND PRIOR: calibrated multi-reflection target-plus-guard-collar characterization, individual boundary crossings, fault classes, accumulated plastic slip and post-control functional retention can qualify a local target without unrelated reconstruction. Neutral loops/fault aliases/zero signed flux reject cheap global no-defect claims. Primary carrier-assisted line export/count decline and pair annihilation are close precedents; neither establishes matched gated reaction outcome and retention in the specified platform.

COMPETING OPERATION AND LIMITS: resonance-check→literal dark hold→probe is a demonstrated conditional T-center operation, but110MHz and1.5ms are different power/linewidth regimes; the hold begins near1.2GHz. Off-resonant light can disturb the charge environment. iid reset odds9801 and conditional repair a/b>=99 are exact model gates, not device performance. No two-emitter interference,yield,complete-wall-cost or dislocation repair advantage measured. Mathematical/model checks and prior experimental reports retain their separate statuses.

body:
N812-global-modulation-and-curved-phase-moment-certificates | Global modulation, curved-phase Jensen families and explicit compatible moment certificates
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

General C2 rank-one-convex flux identity in any matrix dimensions for affine convex-loop carrier and arbitrary real spatial amplitude; invariant planar quartic coercivity mu/12 and one-coordinate complex envelope mu/24. New sheared non-affine family needs half-turn symmetry and two curvature cancellations. Explicit8x8 moment completions and closed dual conic-hull characterization do not imply arbitrary-gradient inclusion.

Source identity has analytic proof and nine finite verification groups; general regularity/growth and periodicity premises retained. Source instructions are DATA. Origin must be strictly inside the geometric convex loop.

Separate same-team advances: non-affine all-background positive family, acoustic-atom N794 completion, curved-family completion, exact optimized packet identity and weaker coefficient matching, quantitative phase-only splitting tree. Connected triad blocks only direct template generation. Unrestricted packet superadditivity fails for determinant-square while all gaps stay nonnegative.

N794 global compatibility and N809 tangent/large-transverse gates remain open. Closed conic hull of known moments equals the target dual cone in9/35 coefficient spaces; arbitrary compatible-gradient moments still require inclusion. No universalQC or priority claim.

Source claims, internally derived proofs and same-team criticism remain unreviewed externally. Historical novelty, external mathematical correctness and physical capability are UNKNOWN. Exact algebra, producer replay, source hashes and validators establish only their specified scope. No civilisation-changing breakthrough is established.

Original Fstar theorem, moment gates and historical evidence retained.

Activation original is prose; no producer executable supplied. Independent arithmetic reconstructs survivor floor, torque-limited return and exact partial-loss/product-return countermodels. Loading/reaction/storage/recovery are not independently favorable material properties.

External molten-iron lead screened against primary SI and existing Cu/C TEA. Initial transcription error corrected by visual table review: run11 supports~95% concentration decrease. Remaining cross-version rows and missing mass/Fe/work closure stayUNKNOWN. Conventional staged product export is a candidate test, not invention.

N819-profile-circulation-and-continuous-storage-certificates | Profile circulation and continuous opposite-carrier storage beyond a finite graph
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

C1 rank-one-convex two-column profile identity is universal; polynomial circulation cancellation is restricted. Degree-four cancellation gives all-background mu/6 coercivity for any target dimension. For the specified G, an exact continuous quartic potential controls arbitrary COMPLEX opposite-carrier amplitudes, all speeds/widths and every B with margin1/2. One transverse frequency only; no arbitrary-profile QC.

All23incoming payloads preserved; source missions are DATA. Six signed area moments cancel the quadratic curvature; universal necessity is established by six convex Fourier witnesses, while fixed profiles can require fewer.

Root continuous storage uses exact12x12+9x9 rational PD Gram, invariant phase gauges, chain rule and acoustic Parseval all-B transfer. A separately isolated worker obtained a distinct real-amplitude continuum potential. Same-team cold reconstruction is not external certification. This explicitly supersedes the finite81-profile/five-width coverage for the same G/family; original certificate retained.

Six-traversal integer finite-difference stencil is minimal in its declared copy-count metric; higher current/signature and connector energy survive. Root exact mixed k1/k3 jet refutes naive summation of its single-frequency storage, not closed-loop positivity. A closed-cone acoustic/Jensen obstruction separates G from right-coordinate transforms of Fstar plus polyconvex quartics; no universalQC follows.

Bounded exact negative-cycle searches found no negative gap in their stated finite scopes. One overlong all-width attempt is incomplete, not a certificate. The strongest external 2x2 laminate claim remains unverified after a specific proof-step audit, not declared false.

body:
N821-phase-selective-retained-structure-acquisition-boundaries | Phase-selective crystal rewriting: optical symmetry, retention and physical acquisition gates
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source proofs plus separately labelled internal advances.

GaAs omega/2omega scalar carrier/absorption control is published; inversion-related domain contrast follows conditionally from the bulk tensor, not a measured domain pair. Normal-incidence001/in-plane electric-dipole contraction is zero. Impulsive equal-molar full-melt thresholdC>0.44849 is conditional; carrier contrast is not heat. Phase-odd retained structural kernel, yield, cost and scaling UNKNOWN.

Copied producer arithmetic replays byte-exactly; independent Decimal/Fraction/tensor checks support only the stated model. Sustained heating/unequal patches/nonthermal or boundary-local routes escape the bulk melt assumptions; none is granted favorable material parameters.

Symmetric mobility can coarsen without selecting polarity. Conditional detailed-balanced phase-odd bias can select finite-horizon structure in exact model calculations; the structural bias and rates are not acquired from the optical signal. Model simulations are not laboratory verification.

Matched retained comparators already exist: capped GaAs/Si annealing reduces APB density, template bonding/regrowth fixes a desired polarity pattern, and FeLiNbO3 photovoltaic optical writing retains domains with material-specific screening/dose costs. These do not establish coherent phase-selected GaAs writing.

N830-nonlocal-compensation-rigidity-and-critical-trace-storage | Universal compensation needs nonlocal nonlinear selection; strict heat certificates supply critical-trace storage
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Smooth finite jets give exactly determinant-affine support; no universal coefficient-linear selector exists even with arbitrary nonlocal profiles. A supplied strict QC margin gives full strong-critical Lipschitz storage. Full invariant cone and historical novelty remain UNKNOWN.

Exact statement: For all smooth periodic U,V and a smooth finite-jet density, differential domination at B exists iff F has a determinant-affine support at B. On V9 no finite-valued coefficient-linear selector dominates all rank-one-convex energies. If F-epsilon|A|^4 is independently QC, W1,4 incoming-action storage is finite and locally Lipschitz at all B. Fstar entry action -7/120 proves weak-critical and finite-measurement limits.
Assumptions: Unconstrained smooth periodic profile means and all smooth velocities; density globally smooth on a fixed finite jet space.; No-linear selection is universal over the full invariant cone, finite valued, with arbitrary positive strip durations.; Positive critical-storage theorem requires independently established strict quasiconvexity; the N794 Fstar premise remains internally derived and externally unreviewed.
Proof spine: Uniform Euler L1 bound, high-jet oscillations and total-derivative order descent.; Translation-orbit averaging; even slow tilts and odd cubic degeneration contradict a negative open strip.; Strict bulk gluing and bounded critical trace extension control all incoming durations; exact oriented concentration blocks weak/Fourier closure.
Costs: Analytic existence, not a finite representation or certified evaluation algorithm. Tail acquisition, coefficient precision and infinite-dimensional variational optimization remain paid/UNKNOWN.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Exact polynomial coefficients and existing strict heat certificate are supplied. A critical tail or stronger regularity budget is needed for controlled Fourier approximation.
Obstruction and failure scope: The incoming required-supply infimum cannot prove unknown QC without an independent lower bound; finite smooth jets and universal coefficient-linear selectors are refuted certificate classes.
Comparator: Classical null-Lagrangian/storage machinery and Bruno-Pasqualotto heat/exact-form method are prior art; OpenAI Math tree/Gram proofs lack the needed compatible profile representation.
Missing lemma or service: A constructive nonlinearly coefficient-dependent critical storage or incoming-action lower bound for the still-uncertified acoustic cone.
Actual reading/review depth: Root reconstructed the selected proofs and strict heat conversion; independent same-team adversarial reconstruction found no remaining decisive gap. Finite symbolic checks are separate; external correctness and priority UNKNOWN.

New internal fixed-direction positivity/uniqueness and weak-dual extension, shear/product family coercivity and exact reduced-phase obstructions. No full invariant-cone quasiconvexity or historical originality claim.

Exact statement: For real rank-one-convex homogeneous quartic F with mu>0 and fixed planar n in W1,4, every positive-mass nonnegative amplitude minimum is attained, unique and strictly positive in the interior. Positive boundary or torus gives an attained L4/3 flux dual with L1 divergence and exact boundary pairing. Sheared theta=ky+g(x), k nonzero integer, and complex product maps satisfy E F(Du)>=mu/(1+2*cuberoot(3))^3 E|Du|4. Antipodal amplitude/factor symmetry extends the specified families to all affine backgrounds.
Assumptions: Bounded connected Lipschitz planar domain or connected flat torus; real homogeneous quartic rank-one convexity with explicit strictly positive rank-one minimum mu; fixed direction n in W1,4 and admissible nonnegative amplitude trace.; Global unweighted weak-dual attainment requires torus or strictly positive continuous boundary amplitude. Zero boundary retains positivity/uniqueness but exact r=x example rules out this flux-class attainment.; Shear/product estimates require planar left-SO2 invariant F and their exact compatible phase/product hypotheses; all-background extension additionally requires the stated antipodal cancellation.
Proof spine: Signed scalar variational minimum, density perspective, coercivity with rough L1 potential and logarithmic Morrey estimate give positivity; strict interpolation gives uniqueness.; Fenchel equality and Euler equation yield constant weak residual; nonzero boundary retains weak normal pairing. Mass-value is C1, no smooth optimal flux implied.; Conditional density averaging and two scalar-column Jensen/Picone steps invoke the pinned one-coordinate envelope; weighted Holder/Minkowski upgrades to full coercivity.; Exact common-boundary amplitude-minimized phase nonconvexity, false general averaging and failed determinant support/cubic-only estimates isolate the remaining global sign.
Costs: Existence and residual stopping bounds do not give a finite certified optimizer or runtime. Actual coefficients, phase-gradient K budget, flux residual and topology/boundary conditions must be supplied or acquired; lower bound -C(K8+K4)M is not uniform Jensen sign.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Exact compatible map/direction and polynomial are supplied mathematical objects. A large target translation preserves full difficulty; finite profile tests and small phase do not acquire the unrestricted phase lower bound.
Obstruction and failure scope: Unrestricted all-phase sign remains open; zero-background normalized phase infimum is0 or-minus-infinity. Full amplitude elimination still leaves nonconvex phase value; general averaging fails even for convex F.
Comparator: Picone/hidden convexity, Sobolev logarithmic positivity and Fenchel duality are established machinery. Primary Harnack and OpenAI Math proofs inspected without importing unsupported sign/priority. Pedregal positivity-span implication remains a precise feasibility obligation, not a claimed paper refutation.
Missing lemma or service: A compatible bound for the full soft-operator cubic plus quartic action, or an exact negative compatible periodic/affine-boundary witness for the undecided G energy.
Actual reading/review depth: Root read and reconstructed decisive analytic sections; separate same-team adversarial derivations and exact finite checks recorded, including rough extension. External correctness and novelty UNKNOWN.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Sharp declared scalar-inventory control bound and common-filter identification; joint-mixture/history moment bounds with paid precision. Synthetic constructions only; no real chemical closure or advantage.

Exact statement: For xprime=a(1-x)-b(t)x, r=b(t)x and fixed mean bbar, V_p=x-p logx with p=(a/(a+bbar))^2 bounds cumulative reward by T*a*bbar/(a+bbar)+endpoint storage, pathwise for adaptive controls. Ideal fast duty switching attains the cyclic supremum; an available equally priced intermediate rate is an exact comparator. Two empty-initial-state kinetic transients with common stable LTI detector have Laplace ratio (b1/b0)(s+k0)/(s+k1), identifying kinetics from three nondegenerate samples under the declared premises. Joint pulse/history moments give sharp outer utility bounds only within an acquired complete response class.
Assumptions: Known positive scalar loading a; declared binary control rates/cost/occupation constraint, same inventory/reset and paid endpoint/storage; finite switching/detector costs retained.; Common causal stable LTI detector, zero initial detector memory, background removed, known empty inventory, common time axis, distinct poles, nonzero finite-window Laplace values and bounded tails; conditioning paid.; Heterogeneous moment dual uses complete correlated type tuple, compact response class and appropriate strong-duality qualification. Type-addressable duty optimization is a relaxation; common unknown nuisance and cross interactions are not separated without evidence.
Proof spine: Exact convex storage square gives adaptive bound and exposes steady-library failure.; Rational transfer ratio cancels only a common filter; independent gains/drifts or unobserved tails break identification. Absolute DC gain/utility remains uncalibrated.; Generalized joint moment dual supplies declared-class upper witness; sparse factor coverage gives conditional composition with paid residual coverage.; Coefficient l1 precision amplification can make a tighter calibration42.06times costlier at the same synthetic decision threshold. Arbitrary unseen-history spike defeats unrestricted finite closure.
Costs: Charge complete pulse histories, correlated mixtures, detector/initial-state calibration, tails, endpoint inventory, switching/energy/reset and exposure allocation. Finite numerical LP tightness is not lower acquisition cost; no equal-information advantage established.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Acquire joint type/history responses and common nuisance premises; one-mode steady data, separate marginal intervals and a fitted common response class do not supply them.
Obstruction and failure scope: Real material response class, unseen history/cross modules, calibrated absolute utility, uniform uncertainty and cost-boundary closure are unacquired.
Comparator: Optimized constant intermediate control where legal, dynamic inventory-aware control, standard generalized moment/LP and system-identification methods, matched complete calibration costs.
Missing lemma or service: An experimentally justified uniform response/residual class and a held-out decision-changing upper witness cheaper than the strongest equally informed alternative.
Actual reading/review depth: Incoming synthetic thermal counterexample and new storage/ratio/moment proofs reconstructed by root and separate same-team review. Finite checks and initial failed numerical stopping retained; no experiment.

N843-finite-horizon-irrational-phase-state-complexity | Sharp finite-horizon stochastic memory law for a fixed irrational phase
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

For one fixed computable irrational phase alpha=(sqrt(5)-1)/2, kept the same throughout the horizon, and terminal probabilities p_k=(1+cos(2 pi alpha k))/2, the preserved result concerns the minimum number of states in an arbitrary homogeneous stochastic model that approximates every terminal probability through horizon T at one fixed positive error 0<epsilon<1/4. The model receives the same wait command at each step and one terminal read; that readout receives only the evolved state and is not additionally handed k or an external lookup table. The source gives matching Theta(T^(1/3)) bounds. At exactly zero error the source gives T<=N_alpha(T,0)<=T+1 by a separate argument. An ideal qubit produces the probabilities exactly by repeated rotation and one final measurement.

The lower-bound mechanism uses stochastic positivity to control an approximate unit-modulus eigenvector, force an approximate phase return, and combine a resolvent estimate with a finite Fourier witness and the Diophantine return bound. The upper construction mixes two cyclic shifts at a continued-fraction denominator. The independent same-team audit and root reconstruction are preserved as distinct evidence.

External mathematical correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. No new physical demonstration or complete-resource advantage is established. The cited internal checks establish only their recorded bounded scope.

N844-finite-abelian-subgroup-sampler-and-implementation-boundaries | Conditional subgroup-query bound with cyclic-ring prototype and no measured speedup
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

For a finite abelian group G, strict triangular layer depth c, parent bound k, m requested coordinates and Haar-reset probability s, the source derives E Q <= (lambda(G)m/s) sum_{j=0}^{c-1}(1+lambda(G)kc^2/s)^j with lambda(G)=Omega(|G|), under its uniform-mask containment and independence conditions. This is an expected fresh-category bound, not a finite worst-case runtime guarantee. Acquisition, address, circuit and subgroup-bit costs remain charged.

The executable prototype is an exact HNF/local callable sampler for cyclic Z/MZ. It does not establish a general finite-abelian implementation. For prime powers, base-p digit layers already embed the output class into N610. For mixed-prime CRT, independent component runs are not justified when forcing couples components; joint category and cross-component forcing must be preserved. In the matched root replay, fewer fresh events did not offset HNF overhead. No new output class or practical advantage follows.

N845-event-conditioned-isotope-renewal-with-unclosed-physical-gates | Event-conditioned isotope renewal in an ideal model with decisive physical gates open
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

The corrected blind fixed-dose result assumes one deterministic common cumulative fluence at each attempted site and unconditioned occupied output. It gives q*=p sigma_L/[p sigma_L+(1-p)sigma_H], while allowing vacancy-dependent refill timing. An independent bounded-adaptive counterexample shows why that bound cannot be extended to outcome-dependent stopping.

The ideal renewal operation screens one fresh atom to fluence d and observes either ejection or survival. Ejection triggers fresh refill and restart; a survivor is accepted and protected. Under the stated independent refill and fixed local-rate model, accepted heavy composition is q(d)=p exp(-sigma_H d)/[p exp(-sigma_H d)+(1-p)exp(-sigma_L d)]. At planning p=.01109 and central 95 kV cross sections sigma_L=56.6 mb and sigma_H=2.1 mb, the nominal 90% calculation gives EXPECTED costs of about 105 attempts, 104 refills and 1.959e13 target electrons/nm^2. Retry and dose tails are unbounded; finite caps reduce yield. These are conditional expectations at those inputs, not a general 90% cost. The 0.298 J/nm^2 value is incident kinetic energy per addressed area. The same-atom event, reset, repaired-site rate and protection interfaces are not jointly obtained. CVD/post-growth isotope methods remain substantial incumbents.

External mathematical correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. No new physical demonstration or complete-resource advantage is established. The cited internal checks establish only their recorded bounded scope.

N846-optical-loss-attribution-and-saturable-bucket-boundary | Optical loss flags do not identify target absorption; focusing result is conditional
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

A total photon-loss flag measures extinction from the accessible interface. It does not reveal which unobserved internal sink received the energy. The source gives two target/parasitic sink assignments with the same accessible passive instrument, including under adaptive external control, and a one-port resonator counterexample in which total loss falls while a target absorber takes positive power.

A separate positive two-finite-power construction is conditional: it assumes 0<a<b and (ab)^(1/3)(a^(1/3)+b^(1/3))<=1. After a fixed unitary target-plane map, a thin homogeneous saturable mask with acquired response and complete collection yields a convex loss deficit whose ideal full-control maximum concentrates delivered power into one mode. Variable delivery, phase-only control, powers outside the convexity condition, incomplete collection and response history invalidate broader interpretations. Existing nonlinear-bucket focusing and iTRAN are strong comparators. Only synthetic model checks were run.

External mathematical correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. No new physical demonstration or complete-resource advantage is established. The cited internal checks establish only their recorded bounded scope.

N847-dual-rail-erasure-monitor-prior-art-boundary | Dual-rail erasure monitoring proposal bounded by existing SWS and delayed-check results
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

The preserved dual-rail proposal adds a continuous occupancy monitor to the temporary coupler rail during the SWS cavity controlled-Z gate. The source report states that loss during the cross-Kerr interaction leaves the target with an unknown partial controlled phase before the final erasure flag. A delayed flag alone does not identify the accumulated phase.

The approximately 8 ns timestamp target is a small-angle phase-error budget derived from the interaction rate and a target error threshold; the corresponding average gate infidelity is quadratic in the residual phase, not a first-order infidelity budget. It is not an observed monitor resolution. The cited continuous-monitor result is on a transmon dual-rail device and uses an integration window far longer than this target; it does not demonstrate timing correction on the cavity SWS path. Published delayed checks are a strong same-task comparator. Which-path information, monitor loss/backaction and full-circuit matched costs remain decisive gates. Primary experimental credit stays with the authors of the underlying experiments.

External mathematical correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. No physical demonstration of the proposed coupler-inclusive monitor is preserved; established SWS and transmon experiments remain prior evidence. The cited internal checks establish only their recorded bounded scope.

contract.provides: Dual-rail loss provides a known erasure sector, and the 2026 cavity SWS CZ is positive prior evidence. Loss during its coupler-target cross-Kerr can leave a correlated unknown partial phase even when a final erasure flag is known. The proposed coupler-inclusive monitor requires about an 8 ns event-time uncertainty for a stated small-angle phase-error budget whose infidelity contribution is quadratic in residual phase; the cited continuous-monitor experiment used a much longer integration window on a different transmon platform and does not demonstrate that timing for the SWS cavity path. Which-path dephasing, monitor-induced loss/backaction, full-circuit performance and matched cost remain open. Credit primary experimental authors; no new capability or quantum advantage is claimed.

N852-accessible-stiffness-and-lifetime-transport | Accessible mechanical supports and complete lifetime transport
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Internal conditional mechanical/network theorems and synthetic falsifiers; physical capability NOT_ACHIEVED.

Exact statement: The legal PSD support map exactly characterizes finite common-host barrier shifts and capped support body. A finite two-port design meets useful-down/two-damage-up signs impossible for every rank-one support. In a complete absorbing event network, well-energy changes cancel from cumulative event output before failure, while a continuation-weighted saddle derivative gives the correct local legal-support objective. Empty-state damage, hidden heterogeneity, missing saddle responses and finite entropy/prefactors can reverse a proposed advantage.
Assumptions: Classical common H>0, actual full-rank attachment U, zero-preload S≥0; full PSD family or explicitly capped body is actually fabricable only if separately acquired.; Fixed finite a.s.-absorbing CTMC, initial distribution and jump/terminal rewards; all damage channels included; fixed prefactors and stated saddle/well exponential rate family.; Hard horizons, external clock rewards, memory, loading and hidden heterogeneity lie outside row-time-change invariance unless explicitly modeled.; No physical transition-state forces, complete damage network or same-regime hBN intervention acquired.
Proof spine: Whitened compliance gives exact Q map, finite inverse/caps and positive-part support dual; three-sign counterexample separates rank-one from rank-two.; Row factorization cancels wells from committors and total jump output; Bellman identity cancels well term from lifetime derivative.; Continuation advantage weights every useful/damaging saddle response; legal Q geometry supplies a local intervention criterion.; Exact empty-state damage, same-well/opposite saddle and pooled-hidden-type constructions refute incomplete information transfer.
Costs: Installation free energy/stiffness budgets computed under common-host model, not full fabrication cost; rare-channel slope precision cost1/(δ²kE). Pay all controls, reset, environment, damage, material loss and lifetime acquisition.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Legal attachment and saddle/continuation responses must be measured; complete well response and baseline barriers are insufficient. Primary transport/kinetic studies demonstrate their own regimes, not this combined mechanism.
Obstruction and failure scope: No proof of best full lifetime yield exceeding rank-one, unconstrained support or equally informed dynamic controls; finite yield need not be concave; component coexistence remains unacquired.
Comparator: Rank-one and rank-two legal matched supports, random controls, standard dynamic optimization and established stiffness-dependent kinetics with identical data/cost.
Missing lemma or service: Same-regime acquired useful/damage saddle response, hidden-history model and complete accepted-output advantage.
Actual reading/review depth: Root reconstructed load-bearing analytic arguments and exact identities; complementary workers constructed/reviewed isolated approaches, then compared results. Same-team review, exact polynomial proof, bounded fixtures and primary experimental evidence retain distinct scopes. External correctness, formal verification and priority UNKNOWN.

N853-laplace-positivity-convolution-and-dependent-kernel | Laplace-positivity criterion with an adaptive dependent kernel and strict product boundary
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

Let E be a real Banach space, C subsetneq E a closed convex cone with nonempty interior, e in int(C), and T a compactly supported continuous linear E-valued distribution on R^m with T(1)=e. With L_T(g)=T_y(exp(g·y)), the source-reported theorem makes strict interior positivity L_T(g) in int(C) for every real g equivalent to existence of either (i) a scalar probability measure with every exponential moment whose convolution with T is C-positive, or (ii) a strictly positive smooth density p in the all-exponential-moment, all-derivative-integrability class for which T*p is pointwise C-valued. Pointedness is not required. In the matrix PSD cone this is L_T(g) positive definite at every g. Semidefinite transform positivity with zeros is insufficient.

There is no quantitative lower margin assumption on L_T. Under strict positivity, an adaptive construction selects a smooth radial strictly log-concave p=Z^(-1)exp(-V), with every exponential moment, so the normalized output M=T*p is pointwise interior-positive and its value tracks p(x)L_T(grad V(x)) within any specified relative cone error 0<epsilon<1. The construction uses the margin on each gradient ball; it does not give a finite-cost kernel compiler.

The producer proof and root reconstruction preserve a smooth compact signed scalar example with L_T(g)>0 everywhere but valleys below exp(-exp(r_n^2)); any positive regularization forces cumulant growth at least exp(r_n^2)-O(r_n). It therefore excludes every fixed two-tail bound C exp(-c|x|log|x|), for every c>0, while the adaptive all-exponential-moment construction still applies. This tail-class separation is carried by the producer proof and root reconstruction, not the independent consequence report, and is an analytic construction rather than a numerically resolved valley.

For Qp=p+partial_x^2 partial_y^2 p, the Laplace symbol is 1+g_x^2 g_y^2>0. The explicit radial strictly log-concave p proportional to exp(-5 rho log rho), rho=sqrt(1+(x^2+y^2)/25), satisfies Qp >= 0.1832635445963654... p > 0 everywhere and integral Qp=1. Every strictly positive C^2 product density with all exponential moments fails to make Qp nonnegative, and every nondegenerate Gaussian, including correlated/translated Gaussians, fails. Dependence changes positivity while both one-dimensional marginals and covariance stay fixed; E_Q[X^2Y^2]=E_p[X^2Y^2]+4.

Positive convolution multipliers are established mathematics. The exact Diamond–Essén (1978) theorem text was not retrieved, and the accessible Katkova–Vishnyakova result is related but does not settle this scope. Priority and external correctness remain UNKNOWN. No general efficient decision procedure, finite-precision sampler, physical operation, or complete-resource advantage is established.

External correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. Root reconstruction, independent construction and bounded diagnostics are source-preserved internal evidence; they are not external review or formal verification.

N854-scalar-control-response-acquisition-and-weak-anchor-boundary | Generic scalar control-response acquisition with exact robustness obstructions
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

For a fixed linear apparatus with A(u)=A+P diag(u) P^T and scalar readout f(u)=c^T A(u)^(-1)b, assume all queried inverses exist, the rank-one actuator laws and their independence are calibrated, the plant/source/detector are fixed across calibration and reuse, applied control values are known, and settling/reference reset are stable. For generic coefficients, two distinct permissible positive actuator values plus the reference identify the entire future diagonal-control response map from Q(m)=(3m^2-m+4)/2 scalar configurations for m>=2 (three for m=1), up to a weighted-transpose ambiguity that preserves every allowed prediction. It does not reconstruct A or support changed sources/detectors or coupled controls. Genericity excludes algebraic exceptional sets; it is not a uniform noise-robustness theorem. A strictly binary actuator is insufficient for this stated schedule.

Two exact limitations are retained. First, the fixed-anchor schedule has no uniform robustness: exact weak-anchor examples hide an unqueried interior triple, with arbitrarily faint generic calibration separation. Second, for even m>=4, two strictly dissipative plants can agree under every intervention changing fewer than all m controls while differing on a collective response; at m=32 the two named actions are oppositely ranked. One full-support measurement separates the pair. No exponential query lower bound is claimed. Synthetic ternary and other finite checks do not establish a physical acquisition or model-fitting advantage; measured-model wave control, Virtual VNA and a 2026 read-once-determinant learner are comparators.

External correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. Internal calculations, receipts, and source reports establish only their stated scope. No physical capability or complete-resource advantage is claimed unless explicitly stated as prior art.

N855-radial-pauli-compiler-and-exact-projection-variance-cost | A direct one-shot compiler realizes the supplied radial Pauli POVM, but classical postprocessing and an exact-law variance bound delimit its information value
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied kernel and internal direct compiler are scoped mathematical claims. External correctness and historical priority are UNKNOWN. No physical capability or advantage is established.

SCOPE AND INPUT. For a qubit, let a normalized rotation-covariant POVM on R^3 have density M(x)=u(r)I+v(r)n·sigma with r=|x|, n=x/r, u(r)>=|v(r)|, and 4 pi integral_0^infty r^2 u(r)dr=1. On zero-u radii set a(r) arbitrarily; elsewhere put w(r)=4 pi r^2u(r) and a(r)=v(r)/u(r). These are the exact hypotheses for the compiler; no gamma form or all-linear Fourier identity is needed for the postprocessing statement. The all-linear identity is an additional exact-law condition used in the variance result below.

DIRECT COMPILER. Draw r~w and n uniformly on S^2 independently of the state rho=(I+s·sigma)/2. Make one projective measurement of n·sigma with result b in {+1,-1}, where P(b|n,rho)=(1+b s·n)/2. Set n0=bn; draw an independent sign epsilon with E[epsilon|r]=a(r), i.e. P(epsilon=-1|r)=(1-a(r))/2; return X=r epsilon n0. The pushforward direction n0 has density (1+s·n0)/(4 pi), and after the sign channel the direction at radius r has density (1+a(r)s·n0)/(4 pi). Thus the volume density is w(r)(1+a(r)s·n)/(4 pi r^2)=u(r)+v(r)s·n=Tr[rho M(x)]. This realizes exactly the given POVM in the ideal continuous-sampling model with one projective qubit shot.

STATISTICAL DOMINATION. Let Y be the outcome of the ordinary covariant spin POVM with density (I+y·sigma)dOmega/(4 pi); its state law is (1+s·y)dOmega/(4 pi). The compiler's output is a state-independent Markov postprocessing K of Y: independently draw r~w and epsilon with mean a(r), then output x=r epsilon y. Hence P_rho^X=P_rho^Y K for every qubit state rho. The covariant spin experiment Blackwell-dominates the radial output for every state-inference decision problem using this measurement interface. This is stronger than the variance comparison: the radial format cannot add state information, even if a downstream estimator is nonlinear. This statement is limited to the stated measurement experiment; it does not compare distinct physical access interfaces or claim a general estimator lower bound.

SUPPLIED RECIPROCAL-GAMMA INSTANCE. The user-supplied Pauli triple uses p(x)=C/Gamma(2+|x|/2) and a positive kernel M(x)=u(r)I+v(r)n·sigma with integral exp(i t·x)M(dx)=p_hat(t)exp(i t·sigma) for every t in R^3. The direct compiler above applies to this positive kernel; the kernel and its positivity argument were supplied, not newly established by N855. For Z~p, let I2=integral_0^infty t^2/Gamma(2+t)dt and I4=integral_0^infty t^4/Gamma(2+t)dt. Then C=(32 pi I2)^(-1), and the isotropic coordinate variance is s_p^2=E[Z_1^2]=4I4/(3I2) ~= 7.63991732090103. The POVM output is unbiased for the Bloch vector and has Cov_rho(X)=(1+s_p^2)I-ss^T. A one-copy random-Pauli shadow reports Y_sh=3b e_J, J uniform in {x,y,z}, with Cov(Y_sh)=3I-ss^T. Thus for this specified gamma output and these specified unbiased vector estimators, the radial output covariance exceeds the shadow covariance by (s_p^2-2)I ~= 5.63991732 I (raw coordinate second moments at rho=I/2: about 8.63991732 versus 3). The same covariance holds for the unbiased 3Y estimator from the covariant spin POVM. Quadrature figures are high-precision numerical diagnostics, not interval-certified values. The pointwise Blackwell domination above, rather than this special variance gap, is the general negative conclusion for state inference.

EXACT-LAW VARIANCE CONSTRAINT. For every radial mean-zero scalar noise Z on R^3 with finite coordinate variance s^2 and every normalized positive qubit POVM M satisfying the operator identity integral_R3 exp(i t·x)M(dx)=phi_Z(t)exp(i t·sigma) for all t in R^3, one has

    s^2 >= 2 + 64/(27 pi^4) = 2.02433418015925... .

This is a necessary noise-variance bound for exact common scalar additive noise in every real projection. Proof spine: differentiate the identity at zero to obtain first operator moments sigma_j and E_{I/2}|X|^2=3(1+s^2). Positivity with |x|I-x·sigma positive gives 3<=E_{I/2}|X|, whence s^2>=2 and E(|X|-3)^2<=3(s^2-2). On I/2 the radial characteristic is phi_Z(t)cos(t); at t0=pi/2 it vanishes, while isotropy gives E[sinc(t0|X|)]=0. Since sinc(3t0) has magnitude 2/(3 pi) and |sinc'|<=1/2, Cauchy-Schwarz yields 2/(3 pi)<= (pi/4)sqrt(3(s^2-2)), giving the displayed bound. The covariant 3Y estimator has effective coordinate noise variance 2 but fails this exact projection-law condition (its characteristic is sinc(3t), nonzero at pi/2).

BOUNDARY. The displayed lower bound is nonoptimal. It is not a minimizer proof, a universal variance optimum, or a sample-complexity lower bound for arbitrary nonlinear estimators. It applies only to radial, mean-zero finite-coordinate-variance noise and positive normalized qubit POVMs satisfying the stated exact all-t operator identity. The gamma variance gap is for the specific supplied density and the specified one-copy vector estimators; do not promote it to a universal gap for all estimators or all exact kernels. No arbitrary-tuple or higher-dimensional compiler is established.

IMPLEMENTATION GATES. The compiler assumes exact draws from w, uniform continuous axes, evaluation of a(r) in [-1,1], and ideal projective rotations/readout. No certified CDF, inverse-CDF or rejection sampler, bit-complexity bound, finite-resolution POVM error bound, or hardware calibration is supplied. The compiler does not remove state preparation, random-axis control, readout, radial preprocessing, or precision costs. Numerical radial quadrature gives CDF about 0.99655446 by r=12 and 0.99999887 by r=20; these are diagnostics only, not certified tail bounds. A finite digital implementation must state its output bins and bound the induced POVM error; a discrete grid is not automatically close in total variation to the continuous law.

PROVENANCE. The gamma density and Pauli positivity argument are user-supplied. The direct compiler was proposed in the root frozen derivation and independently reconstructed in the Capital transfer note. Covariant spin POVMs are established prior art. Claim status stays source_derived_unreviewed; external correctness, novelty, priority, finite-precision efficiency, and physical capability remain UNKNOWN.

N856-isotope-sequence-and-gated-graphene-qualification-boundaries | Isotope-sequence and gated-graphene results bounded by measured interfaces and prior art
Status: source_derived_unreviewed. Mission status: NOT_ACHIEVED.

Three distinct subclaims are preserved, with primary-author credit and no transfer between apparatuses.

**Cu-ZIF-gis isotope sequence.** Loading, closing, cooling, and thermally releasing hydrogen isotopes is experimentally studied prior art (Jung et al., 2025, Nature Communications, DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-56649-5). A proposed additional feed-free purge must satisfy a quantitative bound: under the two-species, no-re-adsorption/no-exchange model, for positive Λ_D, doubling retained D/H odds while retaining at least 90% of captured D requires cumulative unwanted/desired escape exposure ratio Λ_H/Λ_D >= 7.578813. Zero D loss with positive H escape is the infinite-ratio limit. The existing mixed-feed breakthrough and single-gas data do not supply a same-bed mixed-feed fractional-release/receiver balance or full-cycle recovery/energy advantage. This is a stop/measure boundary, not a newly qualified separator.

**Graphene hydron capture/release.** Soong et al. (2025, Nature Communications, DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-65771-3) demonstrate reversible hydrogenation/deuteration, isotope-dependent potential shift, and about 10^14 hydrons/cm^2. Their isotope substitutions use separate proton and deuteron electrolytes, not a mixed-feed separator. At the reported density, even granting all-D occupation, the upper capacity is 3.3445 micrograms D/m^2 per fill; product collection, mixture selectivity and turnover are not established.

**Independent gated-graphene active-control precedent.** J. Tong et al. (2026, Nature Communications 17, 4873, DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-71147-y) report double-gated/twisted-bilayer graphene with signed-field and carrier control that selects the reacting layer while controlling proton transport in that device. Tong et al. (2024, Nature 630, 619–624, DOI 10.1038/s41586-024-07435-8) established independent field/density control in double-gated monolayer graphene. These are established experiments and original-author contributions, not Astra results. They support active control in the reported graphene apparatus; they provide no transferred coefficient or demonstrated operation in hBN, a battery, or the isotope-separator routes above. The tBLG report also describes substantially lower proton current than its monolayer comparator; this is cross-paper, not a matched head-to-head result.

No new isotope-separation capability, complete-cycle energy advantage, battery/hBN transfer, or priority claim is established. The newly compiled scope/transfer synthesis remains unreviewed; the cited papers are preserved as published prior evidence with their original-author credit.

External correctness and historical priority remain UNKNOWN. Internal calculations, receipts, and source reports establish only their stated scope. No physical capability or complete-resource advantage is claimed unless explicitly stated as prior art.

N857-critical-tail-regularization-and-convex-moment-domains | Sharp scalar positive regularization: universal tails, exact Pauli optimum and domain extensions
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Incoming regularization programme plus separately attributed root-selected internal endpoint/domain/noncompact results. This draft does not assert external correctness, priority, efficient implementation or physical measurement capability.

Exact statement: For each m>=2 and R>0, one smooth radial strictly log-concave all-exponential scalar density positively regularizes every bounded self-adjoint m-tuple, on every Hilbert space, with ||sum u_j A_j||<=R|u|, and attains the largest eventual radial tail-envelope fixed offset b*=log[2/(R(m-1))]-1 in p(x)~C exp[-r/(2R)(log r+loglog r+b*)]. At that sharp offset the lower relative margin tends to zero in remote tails; the separate basic-endpoint epsilon sandwich must not be imported. Separately, for Mhat(t)=nuhat(t)exp(i t.sigma) for all three normalized Pauli observables, every radial positive scalar finite-variance law has covariance v I with v>=v*=23/9-2/[9(4K+2)], where K=integral_1^infinity h0, h0=1 on [0,2], and 2(s-1)h0'(s)+h0(s)+h0(s-2)=0 thereafter. Centering and rotations give tr Cov(nu)>=3v* for arbitrary scalar laws. Positive renewal attains v*; smooth spatial densities have the same infimum without attainment. Its multiplier obeys [3/(2080 sqrt2)]/(1+k^2)<=phi(k)<=2/(1+k^2), hence scalar convolution is H^s(R^3)->H^(s+2)(R^3) isomorphic. Separately, compact Banach-cone distributions admit precisely the proved open convex finite-MGF domains, and weighted-tempered (W) distributions admit the stated noncompact all-exponential criterion. As a separately identified classical boundary, an exact all-linear positive POVM representation with compact scalar noise exists for a bounded self-adjoint tuple on an arbitrary Hilbert space if and only if the operators commute pairwise. For each fixed valid exact representation, compact noise and compact outcome support are equivalent; commuting tuples may still have noncompact representations. This is an internally reconstructed short corollary of Uchiyama 1993 Theorem 7, with two direct internal proofs, not a historically new all-Hilbert-space theorem or foundational breakthrough.
Source-reported status: UNKNOWN: mixed incoming producer and internal research statuses remain in their exact cited originals; no aggregate producer status inferred.
Assumptions: Endpoint: finite m, R>0, bounded self-adjoint tuple with the exact norm-ball contract; 0<epsilon<1 and the proof-specified sufficient scale.; Domain theorem: compactly supported real Banach-valued distribution, closed proper cone with nonempty interior, T(1)=e interior, and open convex D containing zero with transform interior on D.; Noncompact theorem: the full weighted (W) distributional seminorm hypothesis and T(1)=e; do not substitute arbitrary temperedness or all-noise exclusion.; Sharp offset: m>=2 and the exact universal radial eventual-envelope contract, with finite multiplicative constant; no uniform relative epsilon margin at that offset.; Pauli optimum: all three normalized coordinates, exact full scalar-convolution identity, positive scalar law/POVM and finite variance. Attainer is singular like 1/r; smooth subclass nonattainment is separate.; Compact-noise characterization uses the full exact all-linear multiplier identity and normalized weak POVM. Bounded noise in one direction plus all positive exponential moments in a second direction forces the corresponding commutator to vanish; finite Fourier-grid accuracy does not supply those tilted moments.
Proof spine: Endpoint Duhamel two-denominator estimate and analytic relative-error expansion; moment addendum and root/operator audits.; Anisotropic dual barrier, bounded primal mollification and exact moment-domain argument; separate finite-domain cross-audit.; Weighted distribution extension and noncompact positivity construction; retained scope correction and geometric-renewal counterexample.; Full transverse Clifford moment block plus separated exact second-order remainder attain the largest fixed offset; offset audit is explicit.; Positive renewal construction and positive adjoint dual certificate establish the Pauli optimum; full dual audit rather than finite LPs.; Root two-sided global Fourier bounds and separate Sol audit establish the Sobolev/inversion consequence.; Bounded first tilted outcome moment forces separated spectral blocks to vanish (root/Astra proof); an independent Phragmen-Lindelof/Liouville proof and exact Uchiyama 1993 Theorem 7 receiving comparison establish the known-machinery boundary.
Costs: Sufficient sharp-offset scales are extremely conservative (R=1,m=3: log10 L about 175, not a necessary lower bound). Charge acquisition, construction, preparation, finite-bit sampling and calibration. Fourier inverse amplification grows quadratically with cutoff, squared statistical amplification quartically. Raw Pauli report second moment v*+1≈3.533767 exceeds 3 for standard unbiased 3n. No complete implementation advantage follows.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Incoming prose is supplied; original producer ZIP absent. New internal proofs/reviews are separately attributable. Operator/margin data and physical measurement access are not acquired by theorem existence.
Obstruction and failure scope: Sharp-offset relative lower margin vanishes remotely; finer corrections/prefactors remain unclassified. Weighted (W) cannot be replaced by arbitrary temperedness. The corrected noncompact example excludes all-exponential, not arbitrary probability noise. Optimal Pauli measurement is Blackwell equivalent to ordinary covariant spin and creates no extra quantum information. Exact compact scalar noise cannot regularize a noncommuting tuple under the complete all-linear identity. This does not rule out ordinary bounded joint measurements with weaker marginals or paid finite-output approximations.
Comparator: Weyl/Wigner, Husimi and known positive convolution remain prior machinery. Covariant spin is an information-equivalent Pauli comparator with lower standard-report second moment. Katkova-Vishnyakova, Vervaat and unresolved Diamond-Essen/fulltext comparisons prevent priority clearance. Uchiyama 1993 Theorem 7 already implies the all-Hilbert compact-noise characterization as a short corollary; historical novelty is not claimed for that theorem, and priority of the exact compact-smearing wording remains unresolved.
Missing lemma or service: Independent external proof and exact historical-priority review; calibrated finite-bit sampling/measurement and complete matched costs. No optimizer uniqueness or finer tail law is inferred.
Actual reading/review depth: Root read/adjudicated the named full analytic chains and receiving audits; exact frozen versions are cited. Finite arithmetic/replay is distinct; external correctness/priority UNKNOWN.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Supplied finite-generator mathematics and root-selected conditional certificates, countermodels and oracle-specific rare-tail obstructions. Finite checks remain distinct from analytic proof and acquired physical rates.

Exact statement: For a supplied finite stopped absorbing CTMC, retained initial support, positive cause committor c and p=mu c>0, endpoint Doob conditioning yields alpha_r^c=1+(Q_RI G c_I)_r/c_r and V_c=(2/p) sum_{i in I} eta_i (G c_I)_i. Conditional survival and directional-covariance bounds give the stated joint deadline/cause and finite-halfspace certificates. Original retained-state marginal and fixed-occupation weighted supermodularity survive in their exact time-error scope; general signed-reward variance has a counterexample to such an extension. Fixed finitely many moments/Laplace derivatives do not certify general relative deadline tails. In the specified rare-branch family p=M^-3, every mixture of scalar Esscher tilts retains the proved ordinary likelihood-ratio second-moment obstruction; this is not a lower bound on arbitrary analytic estimators or altered acquisition oracles. Weighted nonnegative cause-clock sums retain their exact fixed-weight supermodularity; worst-cause maxima do not. The explicit signed-reward counterexample raises residual variance from 6 to 8 on retaining a state.
Source-reported status: UNKNOWN: mixed incoming producer and internal research statuses remain in their exact cited originals; no aggregate producer status inferred.
Assumptions: Finite supplied generator with the target stopped, retained initial support, finite discarded Green operator and exact reward/cause definitions.; Zero-committor states removed before division; conditional probability p and any requested tiny conditional survival require scope-matched relative accuracy.; Supermodularity fixes original occupation weights and concerns the stated unsigned time-error objective; general signed reward objectives are separate.; Finite-summary obstruction applies to the named bounded list of linear statistics; Esscher result applies to the stated scalar-tilt mixture and ordinary likelihood-ratio estimator class.
Proof spine: Stopped-clock martingale and Green identities; exact marginal and weighted supermodularity argument.; Endpoint Doob transform, conditional clock/covariance, common-row-clock incompatibility and joint probability bands.; Explicit signed-variance and finite-summary countermodels; phase-type interpolation and scalar Esscher-mixture obstruction with charged native acquisition.
Costs: Charge eliminated/reduced factorizations, fill, committor/reward solves, retained-state selection, precision and reduced distribution evaluation. Unknown rare branch probability p costs native gateway information; the stated observation lower bound is order p^-1 epsilon^-2 log(1/delta) on its exact oracle. Supplied normalizers, rates or selective channel control change the access contract.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Q, rewards, causes and p are mathematical supplied inputs unless separately measured. Conditioning does not acquire rare branches, physical rates or a Markov model. Exact tilt normalizers can reveal p and cannot be treated as free native observations.
Obstruction and failure scope: One ordinary row clock need not preserve all cause-conditioned means; finite summaries and scalar Esscher mixtures do not generally repair relative rare tails. Signed-reward variance does not inherit the time-error supermodularity guarantee.
Comparator: Given the same complete generator and access, compare with exact positive-semigroup/phase-type computation, exponential-mixture formulas for the star family, matrix-exponential actions, exact Schur/renewal kernels and established Doob/state-dependent importance sampling. No end-to-end superiority established.
