N861-mh-independent-dependent-noise | Exact independent MH noise costs and a certified dependent trace enclosure
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Existence and cost of positive scalar regularization for a fixed symmetrized Margenau–Hill reporting identity. The independent dichotomic theorem and arbitrary-dependent unit-Pauli enclosure have different quantifiers. No improved quantum information or acquired instrument is claimed.

Exact statement: Let A=aU,B=bV with a,b>0 and bounded self-adjoint involutions on any complex Hilbert space, [U,V]!=0. There exist independent positive scalar laws of finite variances v1,v2 and a normalized POVM satisfying Mhat(s,t)=nuhat1(s)nuhat2(t)(exp(isA)exp(itB)+exp(itB)exp(isA))/2 at every real s,t exactly when v1>0,v2>0 and v1*v2>=||[A,B]||^2. Every such pair is attained; for positive weights w1,w2, min(w1*v1+w2*v2)=2*sqrt(w1*w2)*||[A,B]||. For arbitrary dependent finite-covariance scalar laws regularizing the unit orthogonal Pauli MH kernel, C*=min tr Cov(nu) is attained and lies in [3.1763613,3.1763622]. Its exact value and a symbolic optimizer remain UNKNOWN.
Source-reported status: Independent theorem: internally derived and survives same-team analytic audit. Dependent trace enclosure: exact rational computer-assisted certificate, exact value UNKNOWN. External correctness, priority and physical/practical capability UNKNOWN.
Assumptions: The independent theorem is existential over admissible laws; a specified pair of laws is not characterized by its variances alone.; Independence is required for the product frontier; atoms and singular measures are permitted, means are unrestricted.; The dependent interval concerns the unit orthogonal Pauli pair and normalized trace; it is not an arbitrary weighted physical-trace theorem.; Both contracts require the full Fourier identity at every real frequency, not only low moments or a finite grid.
Proof spine: Reduce positivity to likelihood contrasts eta_j and the exact operator inequality 1-eta1^2-eta2^2+(1-delta^2)eta1^2*eta2^2>=0, delta=||[U,V]||/2.; A one-shift likelihood-ratio domination lemma gives Var(nu_j)>=2*a_j^2*(eta_j^-2-1); global-mean residue disintegration handles arbitrary Borel laws and classifies equality.; Two-sided geometric laws on 2aZ and 2bZ attain every independent feasible pair; weighted AM–GM gives the optimum.; For dependence, disintegrate over R^2/(2Z^2), retain the between-fiber covariance cost, apply rational infinite-lattice SOC duals and exact interpolation across all means, and certify an infinite geometric-tail upper law.
Costs: The explicit N=10 upper POVM has 484 oriented Bloch vectors / 242 antipodal binary measurement types, with at most one projective qubit measurement per copy plus classical labels. Its exact ideal noise sampler uses <224 unbiased random bits in expectation; the antipodal-pair choice uses <226 before the binary POVM. Algebraic visibility coins terminate almost surely; exact labels/runtime are unbounded. Catalog preparation, calibrated axes, rotations, physical copies, finite precision, energy and reset are separate supplied/unknown resources. No acquired device is certified.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: The dichotomic operator architecture, a,b and commutator norm are supplied mathematical inputs. The unit-Pauli dependent problem is normalized. Norm acquisition, physical calibration, access to a state and actual measurement hardware are not supplied by the theorem. The finite resource construction additionally assumes calibrated Pauli axes, fresh identical qubit copies, unbiased random bits, exact ideal rational arithmetic and selected-axis projective measurement access; those physical resources are not acquired by a table proof.
Obstruction and failure scope: The independent product constraint cannot be transferred to arbitrary dependence. Conversely the dependent interval does not identify C* exactly. Independent Gaussians of variance 3 each have product 9>4 yet fail MH positivity, so the feasible-pair theorem is not a variance-only law test.
Comparator: Independent normalized unit-Pauli covariance trace minimum is 4 versus the dependent enclosure [3.1763613,3.1763622]. Ordinary unbiased joint measurements reach trace 2 under their weaker contract. For the explicit dependent upper law with exact covariance trace C_explicit, n-copy trace MSE for two Pauli means is (2+C_explicit-r_z^2-r_x^2)/n, strictly worse than separate equal-copy projective allocation (4-2r_z^2-2r_x^2)/n; the difference is (C_explicit-2+r_z^2+r_x^2)/n>0. C_explicit is not the unknown optimum C*.
Missing lemma or service: Exact C* and a symbolic optimizer remain open. The ideal finite measurement/sampling realization is now explicit, but physical calibration/acquisition/finite-precision costs are unacquired. No advantage for the two Pauli means can be claimed against the supplied separate-allocation comparator; another operational task requires its own matched comparison.
Actual reading/review depth: Integration drafting read the author theorem/proof and same-team audit statements and decisive passages; the dependent quantifier audit and current exact-verifier receipt are separately attributed. Root reconciled the exact final certificate versions. This integration worker performs no independent mathematical certification. Root final analytic read receipt and six copy-first replay receipts are available separately; their scope is internal proof reconstruction and bounded arithmetic/software checks.

The sharper lower endpoint is 19854624776291/6250745000000; the displayed upper law has trace 3911259954946061065911894562429/1231364609261368746876606814187. These are enclosures, not an exact formula for C*.
The simpler six-weight dependent construction has trace 2819/765<4 and already refutes extension of the independent minimum to all dependent laws.
The independent four-sign statistical equivalence has not been automatically transferred to dependent cap tables; their finite-type realization uses more outcome types. Clipping any exact unbounded report requires a separate approximation contract.
Finite-label overflow coarse-graining has state-independent probability <=2*(1/5)^(K+1). It is a positive finite POVM but does not preserve the exact full scalar-convolution characteristic. If the pair law has TV error eta and implemented Bloch vectors have sup error delta, the complete output TV error is <=eta+delta/2 before overflow handling.
The explicit finite-copy Chebyshev contract n>=(2+C_explicit)/(failure_probability*epsilon^2) is sufficient and conservative. It is not an optimal copy rate or physical calibration certificate.
Incoming bounded ordering result, separately reconstructed: for arbitrary bounded self-adjoint A,B on any Hilbert space, a positive scalar noise with every exponential moment can regularize the exact symmetrized MH characteristic into a normalized POVM iff [A,B]=0. For the ordered product exp(isA)exp(itB), any scalar probability noise can do so iff [A,B]=0, using local nonvanishing of its characteristic and POVM Hermitian symmetry. These do not contradict finite-variance independent geometric regularizers, whose exponential domains are bounded, or the distinct unbounded Weyl ordering in N862. The loadbearing arbitrary-H operator lemma is classical Uchiyama 1993 Theorem 1; first publication of this precise MH formulation remains uncleared, not new root invention.
The prior bounded full-Weyl theorem N857 is preserved as a different ordering contract; the exact Pauli comparison refutes transferring its all-exponential existence theorem to MH ordering.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

A specific countably infinite separated-Pauli architecture with one common exact scalar regularizer. This uses the full Weyl characteristic exp(i(sA+tB)), distinct from the MH ordering in N861. The moment claim concerns scalar noise; global output operator Laplace bounds are not supplied.

Exact statement: On H=direct_sum C^2, let A_n=c_n I+a_n sigma_z with a_n>=1 and a_n->infinity, arbitrary real c_n, and B_n=b_n sigma_x with bounded real b_n. Set r*=liminf_n(-log|b_n|)/a_n, with -log 0=+infinity. For every 0<R<=infinity, one common scalar probability law whose MGF is finite on the open centered ball D_R yields a normalized strongly countably additive POVM with Mhat(s,t)=nuhat(s,t)exp(i(sA+tB)) for all real s,t iff R<=r*. A smooth positive radial strictly log-concave law can have exact finite moment domain D_R. Thus the critical OPEN ball is attained when 0<r*<infinity; individual boundary moments for arbitrary laws remain unclassified.
Source-reported status: Same-team analytic reconstruction reports PASS for the stated separated family, including critical open-ball attainment; formal verification, external correctness, priority and physical capability remain UNKNOWN.
Assumptions: The separated block architecture, bounded B and global exponential coupling bounds/cutoffs are mathematical inputs.; The same noise must work for every block and every real frequency; no finite-truncation inference substitutes for this.; Normalization/countable additivity are strong/weak POVM statements; no operator-norm countable-additivity or global bounded output MGF is inferred.; The radius is the scalar noise domain. Arbitrary shifts c_n need not give positive A, thermal trace or finite-energy hardware.
Proof spine: Compress to exact reducing blocks and justify real moments by compact-distribution cutoff/dominated-convergence arguments.; A positive tilted moment matrix gives transverse variance >= b_n^2[sinh(2s*a_n)-2s*a_n]/(2*a_n^2*s^2); one finite common tilted variance forces R<=r*.; Preserve commuting endpoint densities in the high-gap estimate, using their geometric mean to retain the sharp b*exp(Qa) factor; handle low gaps by a quantitative local Laplace estimate.; Choose global cutoffs for interior slopes and one delayed radial convex potential; its curvature and all-block positivity bounds yield one common law, including the critical open ball and all-exponential case.; Assemble bounded smooth block densities into normalized strong POVM effects without asserting a norm-integrable density or global output exponential moments.
Costs: Countably many certified global exponential-tail bounds, potentially enormous delayed thresholds and sufficient width L, exact unbounded output support and infinite-dimensional control are charged. No efficient finite-bit sampler, finite cutoff error guarantee, physical device, variance optimum or matched advantage is proved.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Exact a_n,b_n,c_n and certified bounds sufficient to choose every global cutoff are supplied/derived. Finitely many observed gaps, smooth commutators or finite moments do not acquire those global tails.
Obstruction and failure scope: C-infinity smoothing is insufficient: a_n=n,c_n=2n,b_n=exp(-sqrt(n)) gives bounded trace-class commutators at every fixed order and a trace-norm smooth orbit, but r*=0 and no scalar noise with a nonzero exponential neighborhood can satisfy the identity. Scalar MGF finiteness also does not provide bounded global output exponential-moment operators.
Comparator: For this architecture only, norm-holomorphic orbit continuation has maximal open strip half-width r*/2, and all-exponential scalar regularization is equivalent to a norm-entire orbit. The sphere/projection kernel and analytic-element machinery have established antecedents; sharp global sufficiency is an internally audited candidate, not cleared priority.
Missing lemma or service: Individual boundary moments, arbitrary unbounded pairs, finite-bit sampling/acquisition, finite hardware and operational advantage remain open. A whole infinite vertical strip is not obtained merely by a family of attainable ellipses.
Actual reading/review depth: The current author statement and decisive necessity/global-construction/topology passages are used together with the same-team adversarial reconstruction. Root finalized exact pins/ranges; this worker does not independently verify the infinite proof. Root final analytic read receipt and six copy-first replay receipts are available separately; their scope is internal proof reconstruction and bounded arithmetic/software checks.

For b_n=exp(-n^2), r*=infinity and one common all-exponential law exists. For b_n=exp(-R*n+sqrt(n)), r*=R and critical open-ball attainment permits tilted transverse variance to diverge as the boundary is approached.
Independent-coordinate all-exponential noise cannot work even for one noncommuting block, because its transverse tilted variance would be constant while the Schur lower bound diverges.

N864-directional-mfpt-goal-certificate | Directional mean certificates on a supplied graph and the matched LJ38 loss
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

A finite supplied-graph singleton directional-mean theorem and a conditional source-decimal LJ38 computation. The general primal/dual output principle is classical; the case does not establish a new fast solver, physical kinetics or practical superiority.

Exact statement: For a finite connected positive-conductance graph with supplied reversible masses w, singleton source s and singleton ground t, let A be the grounded conductance Laplacian, a=e_s,b=w_off_target and T=a^T A^-1 b=E_s tau_t. For grounded trial potentials x,y and admissible residual flows f,g, define E_a=sum f^2/c,E_b=sum g^2/c,J=sum fg/c,T0=a^T y+x^T(b-Ay). Then T lies in [T0+(J-sqrt(E_a E_b))/2,T0+(J+sqrt(E_a E_b))/2]. Exact actual cycle-block decomposition makes bridge contributions exact and sums product radii only within cyclic blocks. On source-decimal LJ38 at T=0.2, singleton archive 1->7, the candidate certified run took 18.437943 s versus 15.995550 s for the strongest executed equally certified classical incumbent: a decisive matched loss on this case.
Source-reported status: Finite supplied-graph theorem survives same-team audit after preserved API/scope corrections. Actual full-source model case executed; candidate NOT_ACHIEVED competitive new power and loses matched certified classical incumbent. External correctness, priority and physical capability UNKNOWN.
Assumptions: All masses/conductances and graph topology are supplied or loaded and paid; physical landscape/model uncertainty is not acquired.; The theorem has one actual ground. Target sets must be wired to one ground, parallel edges retained, self-loops removed and cycle blocks recomputed.; Residual flows must have the claimed divergences; trials must be finite and exactly grounded. Cached topology/blocks are validated, not trusted.; The scientific enclosure uses outward source-decimal coefficient bands and directed arithmetic; default binary64 graph scope is narrower.
Proof spine: Expand T=T0+r_a^T A^-1 r_b and express the remainder through the weighted-gradient orthogonal projection P. The reflection norm ||2P-I||<=1 supplies the corrected half-product interval.; Carry all coarse masses, retain forest routing information and restore deleted-edge residual flows; a small quotient alone does not determine a directional mean.; The weighted cycle space splits orthogonally across actual multigraph biconnected edge blocks, giving exact bridge contributions and local cyclic error radii.; Directed Decimal coefficient/residual/flow arithmetic and an exact Machin-series enclosure for 2*pi produce an arithmetic-conditional HTST-time interval.; Independent same-team audits repaired ungrounded-vector and forged-block API defects and the mass-band-only scope label. Matched classical positive graph transformation uses the same output verifier and beats the candidate.
Costs: All n masses and m conductances are loaded; forest selection costs O(m log m), residual/tree/block passes O(n+m), and quotient sparse factorization, fill, precision and two RHS are paid. The candidate end-to-end wall time is 18.43794325001363 s; certified classical is 15.995550333987921 s. Charging both the same model phase gives 16.42997366700729 s for classical versus 18.437943 s for candidate. Archive download/extraction and interpreter/import startup are outside these source-table clocks; physical acquisition/model uncertainty remains outside certification.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: The full hosted archive has 100,000 minima and 138,888 saddle rows. The requested endpoints lie in the explicitly conditioned 71,887-state component with 122,971 individual nonself saddle edges and 119,853 distinct pairs. Source decimals, symmetry orders and T=0.2 are supplied model data. IDs 1 and 7 are singleton minima, not an acquired whole-basin partition or an exhaustive physical landscape.
Obstruction and failure scope: Two-terminal capacity misses the occupation numerator. Even identical contracted mass/conductance data can hide an unbounded internal 1/d lifetime term. Arbitrary-cluster localization and old bridge blocks after multiple-row grounding are invalid. The final case loses the strongest equally certified classical method; certification is reusable by that incumbent. No deadline/CDF/rare-tail or physical uncertainty guarantee is supplied.
Comparator: General corrected primal/dual equilibrated-flux output bounds and positive graph transformation are established primary-source machinery. The strongest executed classical certified source-decimal pipeline finishes faster and with a much narrower interval. Approximate float64 timings are retained separately and not relabeled certified.
Missing lemma or service: Any practical opening must remove dominant acquisition/precision work, prove useful small-core guarantees on harder cyclic families, or justify a different access contract. Physical rate uncertainty, unseen transitions, basin semantics and first-passage tails remain unresolved.
Actual reading/review depth: The current finite-graph proof and explicit countermodels are read with the final same-team scope audit and current candidate/classical summary receipts. This worker does not rerun the scientific benchmark or certify the full 71,887-state model independently. Root final analytic read receipt and six copy-first replay receipts are available separately; their scope is internal proof reconstruction and bounded arithmetic/software checks.

The candidate reduced-LJ HTST interval is [490944.57003532629...,491952.82089312207...]; the classical interval is centered at 491461.58361026397337... with far smaller certified width. These model-time quantities are not wall-clock seconds.
Root auxiliary-terminal synthesis: adding conductances lambda*w_i from a new terminal and retaining a positive three-terminal transfer coefficient g_as gives N_lambda=g_as/lambda and N_lambda<=N<=(1+lambda B)N_lambda, B=sum w_i r_i for supplied resistance-path upper bounds. Together with capacity this bounds the mean, but relative control of a small offdiagonal coefficient is an additional receiving operation and may require enormous precision.
The local certificate can reject a wrong contraction even when it creates no useful compression. No generic small-core guarantee, acquisition reduction or exclusive certification advantage is inferred.
The executed mean-to-deadline countermodel has M=10^6, delta=10^-12 and exact mean 1000001 both before and after mean-preserving reduction. At T=100 the reduced survival is 0.9999000050998232 versus original closed-form survival 9.999999999989997e-13, ratio about 9.999e11. Closed-form/expm evaluations here are finite-model checks, not rounding-certified molecular predictions.
A separate positive hybrid contract retains full branch mass for an exact mean and original core clocks plus branch-entry hazards for a deadline envelope. For the one-boundary scalar fixture at T=20, exact rational outward arithmetic encloses survival in [2.06115362243855782796594038015582097637580727559910369297224e-9,2.06215362243649567434354510755392579019408818365315195792445e-9], endpoint ratio <1.000486, while returning exact mean 1000001 separately. At T=100 its relative interval is useless. This classical coupling/killing interface is not a new algorithmic advantage or a claim for LJ38 tails.
Incoming exact capacity/flux result is retained as an attributed supplied-data theorem: after deleting edges D with S=sum_D c_e and contracting connected terminal-separated clusters along a forest F with r=sum_F 1/c_e, reduced terminal capacity C_H gives C_H/(1+C_H*r)<=C_G<=C_H+S. The clipped Dirichlet upper trial bounds deletion error by S; lifting the reduced unit electrical flow through forest paths charges at most r in resistance. Equilibrium reactive flux is C_G/Z and controls the singleton roundtrip E_s tau_t+E_t tau_s=Z/C_G, not either directional mean or a passage tail. All masses/conductances are supplied/paid and no nonreversible or physically complete landscape inference follows. Producer Ising runtime and the named missing end_to_end_4x5.json are not replayed; this round's LJ38 computations have separate provenance.

body:
N865-dissolution-physical-operation-gate | Dissolution cooling remains gated by an unacquired physical operation
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

A source/evidence audit and proposed same-platform discriminator, not a fabricated material interface, experiment or device. The bulk dissolution response and published coupled caloric devices are prior-art evidence with their original cost boundaries.

Exact statement: NO_NEW_PHYSICAL_OPERATION_ACQUIRED. The acquired NH4SCN bulk hydrostatic dissolution/precipitation experiment does not supply the selectively reactive, load-bearing nonhydrostatic contact needed by the proposal. A timed export to an isolated reservoir is a proposed escape from common-solution competition, but no same-platform interval between contact dissolution, export and competing precipitation has been measured. Park device development pending that interface. Visible retreat alone cannot establish retained inventory, positive cold heat or a restored material/solvent/geometry cycle.
Source-reported status: NO_NEW_PHYSICAL_OPERATION_ACQUIRED; device development parked. The export/regrowth discriminator is proposed only. External correctness/priority, new physical capability and matched practical advantage UNKNOWN.
Assumptions: Use the same material, temperature/stress regime and full cyclic state; no calcite kinetics, assumed coating/selectivity or component splicing is transferred.; Distinguish bulk measured temperature response from designed/modelled refrigeration-cycle performance.; Count retained/exported inventory separately from gross dissolution and all precipitation; include warm regrowth and restoration.; Preserve all thermal/electrical inputs, pumping, positioning, separators, solvent loss, damage, regeneration and lifetime boundaries.
Proof spine: Acquire/read primary-source and calculation receipts; classify measured bulk response separately from the missing loaded-contact operation.; The proposed isolated export changes the common-solution hypothesis but leaves a measurable competition with exposed-face or exported-nucleus precipitation.; Under a restricted constant-partial-enthalpy cold-stroke model, Qc approximately Delta_h_diss*n_retained-W_contact-E_other_cold; with W_contact approximately sigma*v_s*n_gross, positive cooling requires retained/gross>(sigma*v_s+E_other_cold/n_gross)/Delta_h_diss. Calibrated calorimetry must replace this approximation for acceptance.; A restored three-reservoir cycle obeys Qc*(T0/Tc-1)<=Qs*(1-T0/Ts)+W_electric+exergy_other. Hot-source heat, work or consumed resources cannot be hidden.; Published coupled caloric devices supply actual source-reported controls, but their measured duty and accounted input do not establish a new Astra operation or matched incumbent advantage.
Costs: No NH4SCN contact parameters or measured duty/COP are assigned. Published external-source film results report 2.09 mW at zero lift, 1.27 mW at a 0.5 K cold drop and zero-lift accounted electrical COP 3.17e-4 including positioning; controller/idle power is not established as a complete wall-plug measurement. The hot source is about 130 C. Work recovery assumptions and active-material specific powers cannot be transferred into a salt-device full cost.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Primary source pages/SI/source-cell arithmetic and acquisition provenance are recorded by the physical worker. This worker uses those research receipts; no new physical measurement, fabrication, spending or external correspondence occurred. The necessary salt loaded-contact/export/regrowth response remains unacquired.
Obstruction and failure scope: Bulk hydrostatic pressure response does not establish selective loaded-contact dissolution. Isolation may occur after exposed-face precipitation, or exported nuclei may continue growing. Regrowth may fail to restore crystal geometry/composition and solvent inventory. No matched refrigeration advantage is computable without a measured same-platform complete cycle.
Comparator: At milliwatt loads use an electric thermoelectric control with identical load/sink/package leaks; heat-driven controls also match source temperature and heat flux. Industrial comparisons need a complete efficient vapour-compression comparator. Published NiTi duty, zero-lift maxima and ideal recovery boundaries remain separate; unmatched GEA ratings are context only, never a ratio.
Missing lemma or service: Acquire the material interface and restored cycle before device development. External validation of a new operation, matched advantage, readiness and historical novelty remain UNKNOWN; no new physical operation is acquired.
Actual reading/review depth: Integration drafting read the worker decision, interface/cycle balance and scoped comparator-cost notes. Published paper details remain attributed to that acquisition audit; this worker performs no physical validation or independent metering. Root final analytic read receipt and six copy-first replay receipts are available separately; their scope is internal proof reconstruction and bounded arithmetic/software checks.

A published heat-actuated SMA/elastocaloric film closes a different material cycle and is prior art. It does not acquire the missing salt interface, and its positioning/hot-source inputs must stay charged.
High-force recovery tests using disc-spring stand-ins do not grant that recovery at a different refrigerator frequency, load curve or temperature. Fatigue cycle counts do not themselves establish a service lifetime.
The proposed pulse test is an acquisition gate, not a demonstration, prototype or automatic spending authorization.

N866-effective-storage-value-computability | Effective storage values for the certified Heat18 quartic with explicit impractical costs
status=source_derived_unreviewed; external mathematical validation and priority remain open.

Exact statement: For the particular certified Heat18 quartic G, constant affine B and finite-Fourier endpoint U with computable coefficients and certified enclosures, a terminating procedure encloses unrestricted signed adjusted required-supply storage p_B(U) to any requested absolute error. General critical endpoints additionally require a supplied effective strong W^(3/4,4) approximation and the certified bounded-ball modulus. This is not uniform recovery from finite observations.
Assumptions: Certified d1=4897/5000,d2=5103/5000 and gamma=1/2500000; normalized transverse measure; effectively specified B and U; certified endpoint entry budget; arbitrary moving intermediate means; finite incoming paths. General endpoints need paid effective strong-tail information.
Proof spine: Coercivity bounds near-minimizer gradient energy; a terminal low-energy slice and finite mean ramp truncate duration. Pad a periodic loop, apply the certified global heat operator, subtract exterior action, and repair exact endpoints. Heat-created Fourier tails yield a compact feasible coefficient box. With grid bounds gminus,gplus, grid gap gerr, horizon gap hN and spatial error eS, the interval is [gminus-gerr-hN-eS,gplus]. No minimizer is assumed.
Costs: For U=(cos y,sin y), B=0, width 0.01: sufficient N=10^22, delta=10^-6, heat time=10^-40, K=10^44, coefficient radius=10^21, mesh=10^-640, dimension d=2(2K+1)^2 approximately 8e88, log10 grid cardinality <662d approximately 5.296e91. These are sufficient upper budgets, not complexity lower bounds. No grid enumeration, objective evaluation or storage-value enclosure was executed. Input precision, coefficient integration and interval-evaluation work remain charged; total bit/runtime/energy cost is not measured.
Supplied/acquired information: Computable endpoint/affine coefficient enclosures and certified entry/tail budgets are supplied mathematical data, not acquired by finite physical measurements.
Scope: Finite-horizon fixed endpoints, mean-fixed paths and free-terminal-mean q_B^N are distinct problems. The spatial proof uses fixed endpoints and a slightly enlarged duration, certifying unrestricted storage only. Global periodic heat does not imply fixed nonconstant Dirichlet heat monotonicity. The artificial free mean never replaces the specified mean in the unadjusted affine correction DG(B):(mean(U)|0).
Comparator: Fantuzzi–Fuentes 2024 establishes variational discretization/moment convergence but finite SDP lower bounds of discrete upper bounds are not automatically continuum bounds. Classical cyclodissipativity, turnpike slicing, heat localization and effective compact extrema are credited. No historical novelty or performance advantage is established.
Missing operation: A useful continuum approximation and globally certified lower bound at manageable resolution; independent external analytic review remains open.
Actual reading/review depth: All supplied horizon/spatial proofs, source-derived proof audits, prior-art comparisons, resource account and three own verification scripts were read. The three exact scripts are replayed in isolated copies by validate_intake.py. Supplied literature-reading statements are attributed; no new external mathematical review or independent literature audit is asserted.

Source-derived proofs and audits remain externally unreviewed. Exact arithmetic replays verify only their finite algebra and resource inequalities; external mathematical correctness and historical priority are UNKNOWN. No practical runtime, executed storage-value computation, physical technology, practical superiority, full-quartic-cone theorem or general Morrey resolution is claimed. PR97's newly exposed ROC ray is not covered.

Homogeneous quartics F=alpha H+beta u^2+gamma j^2+delta uj on real 2x2 matrices. For K the full 9D left-SO(2)-invariant ROC cone, K intersect{D2F(I)[e12,e12]=0} is an exposed face whose linear span is this 4D coefficient space. QC equivalence below is for its entire delta<=0 half, rather than the full 9D cone.

Exact statement: For every real alpha,beta,gamma,delta, F is ROC iff P=[[6beta+delta,delta],[delta,gamma]] and Q=[[8alpha,delta],[delta,2beta+delta]] are PSD. For every such tuple with delta<=0, F is QC at every affine background iff ROC iff P,Q are PSD. When P,Q are PSD and delta<0, put rho=(6beta+delta)/delta<-2, lambda=delta^2/(6beta+delta), mu=gamma-lambda>=0 and nu=alpha-delta^2/[8(2beta+delta)]>=0; then F=lambda J_rho+mu j^2+nu H. Each J_r for r<-2 is QC, non-PC and extreme in the full 9D invariant ROC cone; the r>0 sharp branch is ROC/non-PC but QC remains UNKNOWN. Sharp rays are exposed within the contact face and nonexposed in the containing cone, with minimal exposed face cone{J_r,j^2}. For delta<0 and nu>0 the Jensen gap is >=(4nu/1875) integral|Dphi|^4. The original Heat18 G has nu=9/8 and improved lower constant 3/1250, exactly 6,000 times the old 1/2500000; this yields a compatible improved sufficient N866 storage horizon budget, without computing a storage value. For every sharp r>0, no fixed real constant strongly parabolic output-matrix linear operator admits a pointwise nonnegative quadratic closed-form corrected heat density, without an SOS restriction. The Peano tangent reduction excludes the corresponding smooth adaptive local class. Finite positive generation by invariant heat-certificate quartics plus arbitrary PC addends is also impossible; this does not refute QC.

At delta=0 it reduces to alpha,beta,gamma>=0.; All-affine QC means every bounded planar Lipschitz domain with W0^(1,4) perturbations; periodic and specified zero-end strip contracts require the stated extension/transference argument.; Universal certificate positivity is for each fixed r<-2 with positive finite diffusion; no uniform-in-r constant or sharp-boundary positive Jensen margin is inferred.; Extremality/nonexposure refer to the full 9D invariant ROC cone; extremality in the unrestricted quartic cone remains unproved.
Proof spine: Acoustic contact forces five independent constraints and the 4D linear span; two direct acoustic tests force P,Q PSD.; Exact conformal square completion proves all sharp J_r ROC on r<-2 or r>0, and positive rho/lambda decomposition proves the entire two-LMI ROC cone.; The universal-negative rational Gram/form identity has an invertible4+4+2+2 congruence; all 12 rational LDL pivot functions and every raw exported denominator have exact whole-branch signs.; For every fixed r<-2, closed-form Stokes plus relative heat energy/Gaussian decay/W1,4 approximation proves J_r QC. The exact positive decomposition closes all delta<=0.; Rank-one PSD images establish invariant extremality. The support coefficient atI is forced to r+2 and its cubic support gap proves all-sharp non-PC. Acoustic duality proves nonexposure/minimal exposed face.; Exact fourth-power Bregman identity and proved complex L4 Beurling norm<=sqrt24 give margin4nu/1875. The same unchanged G receives gamma=3/1250 in N866; exact budget arithmetic verifies N=10^17 at 0.001.; The positive-input dual contradicts an actual compatible jet; exhaustive output averaging and the independent flat-contact Hessian identity force the only surviving skew coefficient to zero.
Costs: Exact coefficient reconstruction, rational matrix arithmetic and symbolic sign proofs are paid. The two LMIs give a small decision criterion within this explicit face, not a general quartic QC algorithm. Interior coercivity is explicit; no positive boundary margin, practical storage solver or physical implementation is inferred.

Obstruction and failure scope: Below the alpha floor, an explicit acoustic direction is negative. The previous fixed-source/fixed-support continuation failure was scoped and is not an obstruction to this new regenerated certificate. H subtraction and (a-d)^4 subtraction are impossible at the sharp floor; this does not exclude every pure-fourth-order Jensen gap.
Comparator: Bruno-Pasqualotto supplies the established heat/exact-two-form method and a double-rotation theorem. The present one-sided invariant anisotropic family requires its own applicability proof. The two-LMI acoustic theorem and sharp QC interval are separately compared; no historical priority is cleared. An independent exact argument excludes the standard GL-transformed double-isotropic quartic/finite-positive-combination explanation for the sharp rays; this is a scoped transfer obstruction, not priority clearance or proof that no literature implication exists.
Missing lemma or service: External correctness/priority remain open. QC of the positive-delta half/sharp r>0, other invariant contact strata, unrestricted extremality and a positive sharp-boundary pure-fourth Jensen gap remain UNKNOWN. No practical storage solver or physical capability is acquired.

N868-smooth-quasilinear-tangent-obstruction | A smooth quasilinear escape reduces to the forbidden constant tangent
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Homogeneous quartic polynomials F on R^(m x n), nondivergence quasilinear operations u_t=sum C^{ij}(Du)u_ij with C continuous at zero, and local all-compatible-Hessian positivity after a quadratic-Hessian null correction whose coefficient functions have a second-order Peano expansion.

Exact statement: If P_C(A,H)+N(A,H)>=0 for every A near zero and every compatible Hessian H, with the canonical P_C from one integration by parts and locally null N, then there is a globally null homogeneous A^2-H^2 density N2 such that P_{C(0)}(A,H)+N2(A,H)>=0 for every A,H. In the planar two-output case, freezing C and adding the exact bridge P_C-E_C=d eta_C gives a closed homogeneous-quadratic two-form certificate. Consequently the inherited FV exposed quartic, whose certificate is excluded for every constant strongly parabolic operator, also excludes every such continuous-at-zero adaptive operator with strongly parabolic tangent. Separately, for exactly the old FV quartic, no determinant-support lambda(A) with a second-order Peano expansion at 0 can make F(A+H)-F(A)-DF(A):H-lambda(A)detH>=0 for every local A,H. Thus no C2-at 0 selection, polynomial minor support of any degree, SOS-polyconvex certificate of the cited forms or convex polynomial lift of any degree exists. Ordinary PC and QC remain UNKNOWN.

Root-final curation preserves the cited evidence without changing this evidential status.
Assumptions: F is a homogeneous quartic polynomial; N is a quadratic polynomial in compatible Hessian entries and has a coefficientwise second-order Peano expansion at zero.; N integrates to zero for every affine background and compact smooth perturbation staying in its coefficient neighborhood; positivity is pointwise on all jets, not only along one solution orbit.; The tangent theorem needs no ellipticity; the specific FV exclusion uses strongly parabolic C(0). No solution existence, long-time relaxation or boundary-value theorem is assumed.; The canonical density is P_C=sum F_(alpha k,beta l)(A)H_(beta,lk)G_alpha(A,H). Variable C(A) cannot simply be inserted into the constant E_C formula.
Proof spine: At A=0 the PSD null quadratic vanishes on spanning pure Hessian symbols, so N0=0; two-sided scaling removes N1.; Divide local positivity at tA by t^2, freeze C(tA) at C(0), and use the Peano remainder to get the global tangent inequality.; Scale both background and perturbation and divide the null integral by t^4 to prove full nullness of N2.; For frozen coefficients, the explicit cubic one-form eta_C satisfies P_C-E_C=d eta_C; the planar null classification supplies the other closed form.; Compose with the actual all-constant-operator FV separation rather than inferring non-QC from heat-certificate failure.; For the separate determinant-support obstruction, homogeneity reduces a Peano selector to a global quadratic one; all 10 coefficients reduce under exact symmetries to alpha det+beta(u-v). Acoustic contact forces alpha+(6/13)beta=3968/39. Two integer cuts U,L have the exact positive-combination contradiction 549747U+23660L=-141446461664/81.
Costs: This is a proof-class reduction and exact symbolic audit, not a faster PDE solver or algorithm. Any flow existence, precision, convergence, relaxation or physical realization costs would need a separate operation contract.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: The polynomial, coefficient family, nullity and all-jet inequality are mathematical premises. No measurement or physical nonlinear evolution is acquired. The inherited FV no-go is pinned as a separate proof premise.
Obstruction and failure scope: A smooth strongly parabolic variable-coefficient example has integral(P_C-E_C)=3*pi^2*t^5, so the naive variable E_C substitution fails. Singular/angular non-Peano corrections, degenerate tangents, nonlocal/higher-jet mechanisms, time dependence and restricted-orbit positivity remain outside the root theorem. A C1,1 angular null example lacks a Peano second jet but does not prove cone enlargement.
Comparator: The fixed tangent operator is the comparator within this local certificate class. Classical null-Lagrangian/minor/closed-form machinery is credited. Ordinary variational/PDE proofs and nonlocal estimates remain available outside the declared operation.
Missing lemma or service: QC and ordinary PC of the old FV exposed quartic remain UNKNOWN. No automatic regular determinant-support selection from ordinary PC is available; the proved support-selector exclusion explicitly requires a second Peano jet at 0. External correctness/priority and any purported singular/angular/nonlocal escape remain open.
Actual reading/review depth: Curation worker read the cited current proofs and scoped reviews; arithmetic receipts are attributed to their producing/auditing roles. Curation performs reference/hash/range validation and does not independently certify scientific truth.

The planar null classification extends to arbitrary output dimension and continuous coefficients with distributional closedness. Higher spatial dimensions have representation gauges; the dimension-general blow-up works directly on densities and does not copy a unique planar two-form representation.
Strong parabolicity alone does not make every convex quartic dissipate under an arbitrary nonscalar output generator. The universal convex-quartic pointwise-certificate preservation boundary is scalar-output anisotropic heat. This does not forbid a nonscalar generator matched to one particular integrand.
The determinant-support theorem is a distinct certificate restriction, independently audited for the same unscaled FV polynomial. Ordinary PC permits an irregular angular support selection; no automatic C2/Peano selection is proved. The separately explored higher-jet discussion is not imported as a completed N868 theorem.

Indexing, hashes and deterministic checks establish only their recorded integrity scope. Scientific review and capability gates remain open.

Restricted positive-RC impedances with a common positive series inductance and 19-mode baseline, known zero incremental initial state, the supplied 58-point 0.01–904.7 Hz EIS row with an assumed 0.1 mOhm component box, and bounded incremental-current/time-domain voltage observations.

Exact statement: An exact positive-RC pair Z_+=B+2A*delta/(s+delta), Z_-=B+2A*delta/(s+2delta), A=125 mOhm and delta=pi/2000 per second, satisfies the same actual 58-row EIS box and has Q_1000 respectively in [266.16089938984990,266.16089938985000] and [187.72905369456885,187.72905369456890]mOhm. Its step difference is d(t)=A(1-exp(-delta*t))^2 and impulse difference g=dprime>=0. Every |i|<=Imax waveform on [0,H] has separation <=Imax*d(H). With i(0)=0 and |iprime|<=Imax/rho, the exact optimum is the maximum ramp/plateau, with K(H,rho)=rho^(-1)*integral_(max(0,H-rho))^H d(v)dv. For deterministic adaptive strategies and bounded voltage error epsilon_V, informed-segment minimax absolute Q_T risk equals d(T)*min(1/2,eta/K), eta=epsilon_V/Imax. Randomized extension requires the erratum causal current-reactive error adversary. A separate real-data continuum gate rejects transferring the common stationary positiveRC/zero-initial-relaxation/equal-opposite-current contract to all 92 acquired paired pulse records: cell 001 requires endpoint increment discrepancy>=1.512182 mV; across 92 the minimum/median/maximum floors are 1.077329/1.622747/2.027710 mV. This is a conditional model-discrepancy lower bound, not a measured noise confidence allowance or cause diagnosis.

Internal derivations, finite checks and same-team review are separately attributed; external correctness, historical priority, formal verification, empirical confirmation and physical capability remain UNKNOWN. Root-final curation preserves the cited evidence without changing this evidential status.
Assumptions: Known causal linear incremental model and zero initial increment; arbitrary prehistory, finite-amplitude nonlinear cell behavior and model discrepancy are separate.; eta is a new symbolic time-domain noise interface, not inferred from the EIS box or measured instrument uncertainty; use consistent mV/A=mOhm units.; The all-waveform lower bound covers deterministic finite sequential strategies or well-posed deterministic causal feedback. Randomized statements require causal current-reactive corruption; no oblivious fixed-noise randomized bound is claimed.; Exact minimax equality is for the supplied convex hard segment with known baseline; it is only a lower bound for the larger EIS-feasible class.
Proof spine: The common baseline/inductance cancels, and direct algebra produces a nonnegative impulse difference with exact quadratic early cancellation.; Convolution positivity proves the exact peak/slew induced separation over every bounded waveform; no input/time grid is a premise.; The midpoint transcript supplies admissible bounded errors in both worlds, including deterministic adaptation; the erratum specifies the stronger adversary for randomization.; A ramp endpoint plus feasible-interval midpoint achieves the informed-segment lower bound.; Exact Fractions verify every observed component and positive RC mode; directed interval strings enclose target values and duration thresholds.
Costs: Charge current amplitude/slew, experiment horizon, source/readout energy, initialization/rest history, calibration, drift, reset and model qualification. The hypothetical eta=0.1 mOhm known-pair critical times are about 25.9881 s without a ramp restriction and 26.4866 s for rho=1 s; these are not measured acquisition times or full-class identification guarantees.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Original impedance.mat,pocv.mat,pulse.mat files totaling6217033 bytes were newly acquired with upstream MD5 verification; cell 001 EIS agrees exactly with the supplied CSV. Pulse voltage/time arrays and source protocol metadata are available. No actual current trace/per-cell capacity calibration or common initial-relaxation guarantee is present. Fetching published measurements is distinct from performing hardware acquisition or validating the finite-amplitude governing model.
Obstruction and failure scope: The full 70 EIS row already rejects the tighter positive-RC model: its real ordering violation forces >=0.515 mOhm uniform component error. More general passivity or nonlinear response does not automatically restore prediction. Additional measured pulse/POCV histories can change the interface; the lower bound is not claimed against such added information.
Comparator: Give multisine, binary, chirp, closed-loop and optimal input designs all admissible bounded currents and the full voltage record. Brown-Grabovsky extrapolation, set-membership input design and hybrid time/frequency identification are strong established comparators. No real-cell failure or practical superiority is inferred. The actual pinned hybrid-drt source was executed with its pinned Mittag-Leffler dependency. Charge+EIS strict/flexible fits give held-out discharge max errors3.9277/3.9964 mV and EIS residuals0.1739/0.1678 mOhm; these exceed the 0.1 mOhm deterministic box and are not certified same-box countermodels. No superiority follows.
Missing lemma or service: Missing calibrated time-domain eta, actual current/slew/time, aligned initial-state/rest/temperature record and a justified governing-model discrepancy bound. Full-model uniqueness, historical novelty and physical improvement remain unestablished.
Actual reading/review depth: Curation worker read the cited current proofs and scoped reviews; arithmetic receipts are attributed to their producing/auditing roles. Curation performs reference/hash/range validation and does not independently certify scientific truth.

For H=10 s, the full-path voltage separation is at most Imax*0.030362450172885497 mOhm. If eta>=0.01518122508644275 mOhm, both models can give the same observed path, forcing worst-case absolute Q_1000 error at least 39.21592284764051 mOhm and preventing certain classification at 200 mOhm.
The verifier display defect found during audit was corrected in directed decimal strings before the package freeze; author/auditor receipts preserve that correction history. The exact feasible pair and its error bounds are independent of the exploratory joint LP as a proof premise.
The newly acquired originalMAT row resolves the historical one-cell transcription limitation without altering the supplied source report. The paired gate follows from Q increasing/concave and the sign of earlier positive-pulse memory; unknown initial relaxation, unequal actual currents, finite ramps or state dependence can invalidate its premises. It rejects promotion under that common-state contract rather than diagnosing non-passivity.

Supplied irreversible set-valued failure CTMCs stopped at the kth failure, 1<=k<=n, with count-reference rates b_s>0 and local nonnegative residuals a_i(x)=b_s/(n-s)*(1+eta_i(x)), 0<=eta_i<=beta/n. The reference conditional path law and its preparation are explicit prerequisites.

Exact statement: Let E={tau_k<=T}, h=P0(E)>0, p=P(E), M=(1+beta/n)^k<=exp(beta), and B=max b_s. The full stopped likelihood L=product(1+eta_i)*exp(-sum DeltaA_s*Delta_s) satisfies 0<L<=M, p>=h and E_Q0 L=p/h. Independent real-jump Bernoulli factors and uniform-alive-label Poisson marks accept a Q0=P0(.|E) path with probability L/M, producing exactly P(.|E) in the exact-real/reference-sampler model. Expected proposals <=M and expected local residual queries per accepted path <=M*(k+beta*B*T/n). hL has relative second moment <=M; Bernoulliized MhY has no statistical advantage over hL. For bounded beta these bounds hold at macroscopic k and complete k=n.

Assumptions: All b_s, residual oracle/representation, component labels, horizon and nonnegative envelope are supplied and valid on every queried state; no repairs, hidden jumps or unmodelled channels.; Exact conditional reference draw and exact Poisson/Bernoulli/exponential primitives are assumptions for the ideal exact-path theorem; a fixed finite uniformization cutoff is approximate.; General uniformization pays B*T and O(kJ) recurrence arithmetic/storage, not a strongly polynomial guarantee in the binary length of arbitrary huge horizons/rates.; The new dense residual numerical fixture is n=k400, rho1 common acceleration, beta=2, T=1/5. It is distinct from the source rho2/distinct-baseline model and the thermal-avalanche target.
Proof spine: Complete stopped-path densities include the holding exponent and no post-stop survival factor.; Fresh unit-exponential coupling gives p>=h for arbitrary positive count rates, without a monotonicity premise.; Poisson thinning realizes the aggregate holding factor through local residual queries; independent rejection gives the exact conditional law and cost bound.; Conditional virtual-event count is dominated by k+Poisson(BT); auxiliary tail conditioning has an explicit target mass/TV bound.; The implemented fixture separately budgets rational count truncation, dyadic-time functional coupling, integer interval exponentials and fixed-N empirical Bernstein confidence.
Costs: Read/generate and store the supplied dense matrix in O(n^2); n=400 uses 160000 int64 entries/1280000 bytes. A direct-weight path costs O(k^2) interaction arithmetic plus count/label sampling, sorting and interval kernels. Each local eta query can cost O(s) dense interaction reads. Reference DP, precision, random bits and source-model acquisition remain charged. General stiffness can reproduce inverse-rarity cost: k=2,T=1,b0=epsilon,b1=1/epsilon gives h~epsilon while BT=1/epsilon. The fixed 512-bit exp kernel is fixture-specific and eventually has a zero lower endpoint for increasing nT.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: No physical rates or dense interaction matrix are acquired. Arbitrary eta tables can have exponential input; a unit local oracle is an explicit access contract. The reported numeric interval is for one declared synthetic rational model, conditional on iid fair bits and exact integer arithmetic; a seeded PRNG establishes replay only.
Obstruction and failure scope: Negative residuals, growing beta, invalid envelopes or unacquired reference models break the guarantee. Dyadic time grids have TV distance one from the continuous path law; use a functional coupling rather than relabeling them exact. One-level avalanche conditioning had zero successes in both probes and does not establish useful relative efficiency; stationary reversible module machinery has incompatible assumptions.
Comparator: Permutation Monte Carlo with conditional holding-time integration is a same-information Rao-Blackwell comparator and has no greater variance for probability output. Direct hL weighting dominates Bernoulliization in variance. Classical Doob bridges, uniformization, Feynman-Kac/Poisson killing, conditional Monte Carlo and zero-variance reliability methods are credited; no optimized matched advantage is shown.

Two explicitly separate acquisition contracts: partial-resolved closed-span ZnS/GaP loop response, and a supplied accretive binary-chain plant with one signed detector plus newly allowed independent control-port source injections. Mathematical intervention and measured material access remain distinct.

Exact statement: For the supplied m-bit accretive chain family, calibrated independent source injection at each control-port direction and one unchanged signed detector recover all bits with m probes in known order or at most m(m+1)/2 in unknown order; the nonzero probe magnitude is >=4/5 and the recovered original-source action yields >=1/2. Passive diagonal-load access does not supply this new oracle. For the dislocation model, acquired reproducible outward/inward branch responses imply d=integral(A_out-A_in)dell and d_DL+d_LD=d_DD+d_LL; phase swapping reverses displacement only with additional branch symmetry. Fixed-light stress-dependent ratios can pump, and closed shape cycles retain positive dissipation. No required physical acquisition occurred.
Source-reported status: source_derived_unreviewed. Internal derivations, finite checks and same-team review are separately attributed; external correctness, historical priority, formal verification, empirical confirmation and physical capability remain UNKNOWN. Root-final curation preserves the cited evidence without changing this evidential status.
Assumptions: Port theorem uses the supplied restricted chain-family promise, independently calibrated source directions/gains, stable unchanged plant/load map, and signed amplitude; it is not arbitrary-plant recovery.; Loop kinematics uses a fixed shape family, translation-invariant loading, equal/opposite net endpoint forces and acquired positive response branches; sharp diagonal mobility bounds do not extend to arbitrary coupled mobility matrices.; Dislocation full screw arm is Zn30+S30 and mixed Zn arm Zn30+Zn90; shared Zn30 invalidates assumed generic arm selectivity.; Published regimes, partial motion, absorption peaks and calculated barriers cannot be multiplied together into an unmeasured same-loop operating window.
Proof spine: Forward substitution derives h_j=(1-2s_j)*epsilon/(epsilon+u_j)*product_later r_s(u); already-matched later bits yield constant sign contrast.; Known-order reverse probing and unknown-order unresolved-port rounds recover bits with explicit worst-case query budgets; norm/leakage/direction and repeat-noise costs are separate.; The derivative identity df/du_j=-(c^T M^-1 p_j)(p_j^T M^-1 b) proves why passive load dithering does not reveal a guaranteed strong local-source response.; Loop center/span elimination gives the exact branch integral and four-cycle identity; explicit stress-dependent constitutive laws refute universal fixed-light null claims.; Positive glide-energy metric, force-limited throughput and dead-time accounting prevent unit displacement per excursion from implying output or efficiency advantage.
Costs: Port acquisition pays O(m) source/detector norms and O(m^2) actuator norms in the constant-margin normalization, inverse-polynomial calibration, control leakage O(m^-3), raw repeats, source routing, settling/reset, plant disturbance and readout energy. For loops, charge all heating/cooling, optical/electrical preparation, actuation, imaging interruptions, failed/pinned loops, dissipation, sink qualification and restored device function.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Port records are synthetic; no raw configuration-labelled calibrated hardware response package is acquired. The ZnS/GaP experiments supply source-reported regimes and partial evidence, but no same-loop four-branch response, safe return stroke, full-arm direct-drive servo or retained defect-export endpoint.
Obstruction and failure scope: Intensity-only port probing loses the sign already at m=1. Generic exact binary identifiability can demand exponential symbolic work and does not defeat noisy lower bounds. Both dislocation arms share a potentially responsive partial; Zn90 spectral selectivity at 350C is unmeasured, and the calculated GaP gap permits substrate-generated carriers. Permanently pinned full arms forbid closed-span translation.
Comparator: An equally informed competitor gets the same added port sources and sign procedure. Random joint raw fitting beats two-anchor fitting on all 12 supplied paired full tables (median full-table RMSE0.000759163 versus0.006522924). VirtualVNA/multiport methods and phase calibration are stronger instrument comparators. Loops must beat optimized stress-only, constant-light, direct-field, thermal and spatial-stress controls at matched accepted output and complete costs.
Missing lemma or service: Missing actual independently drivable control ports with unchanged specimen, calibrated signed readout, stable repeatability/model adequacy; missing same-loop complete-arm response matrix and safe contraction or direct-drive span servo. No technological benefit, physical validation or historical novelty is established.
Actual reading/review depth: Curation worker read the cited current proofs and scoped reviews; arithmetic receipts are attributed to their producing/auditing roles. Curation performs reference/hash/range validation and does not independently certify scientific truth.

The exact binary-response theorem removes the strictly binary obstacle for generic exact acquisition only. It first enumerates formal responses and uses potentially expensive field elimination; ambient genericity does not automatically certify a reciprocal or other restricted physical subclass.
The useful alternative dislocation lead is a net signed electric drive plus shape-force feedback, conditional on both complete arms moving safely and acquired forces. Published reversible charged-partial motion is a mandatory comparator and does not supply whole-loop transport, defect annihilation or lifetime-qualified device output.

Real homogeneous quartics F=alpha H+beta u^2+gamma j^2+delta uj on 2x2 matrices, H=((a-d)^2+(b+c)^2)^2, u=a^2+c^2, j=det A; existence of finite alpha after deleting that coordinate.

Exact statement: Some finite alpha makes F ROC iff some finite alpha makes it all-background QC iff either delta=0 with beta,gamma>=0, or delta!=0, gamma>0, 6beta gamma-delta^2+delta gamma>=0 and 2beta+delta>0. For q=r(r+2)>0, the exact universal isotropic construction supplies a finite c(r) with P_(c(r),r) QC and, for alpha>=c(r), Jensen gap >=4(alpha-c(r))/1875 times integral|Dphi|^4. Every finite P_(alpha,r) with r(r+2)!=0 is ordinarily non-polyconvex, even allowing arbitrary nonsmooth nonpolynomial convex lifts. The same local obstruction survives every everywhere-finite C3 correction flat through degree three at I. On the nonzero curved projected boundary, finite QC completion exists while finite ordinary-PC completion does not. QC at the positive sharp floor remains UNKNOWN.

Assumptions: Every bounded planar Lipschitz domain, every affine background B and every W0^(1,4) perturbation; periodic analogue.; Projection quantifies existence of one finite real alpha independent of B and the perturbation; it is not equality of individual alpha fibres.; Ordinary-PC theorem uses an everywhere-finite integrand smooth near I; cubic-flat extension uses the stated local C3 jet.
Proof spine: Direct acoustic tests force the projection inequalities and rule out r=-2 for every finite alpha.; Universal rational identity and 6+4+8 quotient/Schur construction are positive on both unbounded q>0 branches.; Exact-form Stokes, relative heat decay and density imply all-background QC; a separate nonnegative det^2 Jensen term completes the general projected triple.; Ordinary lifted support forces slope r+2; the support gap along diag(1,-r-1) is -r(r+2)t^3/3+O(t^4), independent of finite alpha at cubic order.
Costs: At rational r the sufficient compiler uses finite exact rational matrices of order at most18, with no optimization oracle. Coefficients and conditioning can grow near r=-2; no optimal alpha or general bit/runtime/energy bound is claimed. All arithmetic, input reading and exact certificate checks are charged.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Quartic coefficients, source JSON and parameter are supplied mathematical data. The positive r=1 export is 62385H+j^2+uj with at least4/1875 reserve margin, not acquired material response or a useful numerical solver.
Obstruction and failure scope: The nonclosed projection limit r=-2 has a genuine acoustic obstruction and unavoidable necessary alpha divergence. The compiler is nonsharp. Non-PC is not non-QC; no strict-interior PC classification follows.
Comparator: Pinned N867 already proves the optimal negative sharp floor and all delta<=0 fibres. Its sharper result is retained; classical strict-LH completion is inherited and misses persistent contacts.
Missing lemma or service: Positive sharp-fibre QC, exact full nine-dimensional QC classification, strict-interior ordinary-PC classification, external review and historical priority remain open.
Actual reading/review depth: Supplied theorem statements and independent reconstruction proofs read, including both Schur bounds, analytic QC passage and all-alpha ordinary-PC support proof. Prior negative sharp proofs and current notices read; this curation does not add another independent audit.

N873-nonshear-projection-and-degenerate-flat-completion | A nonshear completion projection and a supplied-certificate degenerate-flat compiler
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Left-SO(2)-invariant real homogeneous quartics on 2x2 matrices; the exposed ROC contact face at (I,e11), plus a separate sufficient compiler in the full nine-dimensional invariant space.

Exact statement: For every real k,ell,m, some finite alpha makes alpha H+k w^2+ell vj+m v^2 ROC iff some finite alpha makes it all-background QC iff (k=ell=0,m>=0) or (k>0,L=ell+2m>0,D=2km-k ell-ell^2>0). ROC plus the contact equality gives the four-dimensional span; contact alone does not. Separately, any invariant quartic G=T(A,A,A,A) admits the sufficient completion if a supplied lambda makes Q(X)=D2G(I)[X,X]/2-lambda det X PSD and T(I,Z1,Z2,E)=0 for every Z1,Z2 in kerQ and every E. With Q nonzero, supplied positive kappa on kerQ-perp and tensor bound M, alpha_*=401296M^2/kappa+(9391/4)M suffices; extra nu H gives4nu/1875 margin. If Q=0, flatness forces G=cH and convex completion is explicit. Failed admission means UNRESOLVED_BY_THIS_COMPILER.
Source-reported status: Root-adjudicated internal research, source_derived_unreviewed. Source claims, original deductions, executable checks and same-team independent reviews remain distinct. External mathematical correctness, formal verification, historical originality and physical capability remain UNKNOWN. Hashes and software checks establish only their recorded integrity scope.
Assumptions: All-background bounded-Lipschitz W0^(1,4) and periodic gradient contract.; The contact-stratum description assumes rank-one convexity or quasiconvexity as well as D2F(I)[e11,e11]=0.; Full-space theorem assumes exact supplied lambda, PSD quadratic support and the quantified two-kernel-vector cubic flatness; it is sufficient only.
Proof spine: Acoustic stationarity yields codimension-five contact span; direct conformal tests give k>=0,L>=0,D>=0.; Actual rank-one acoustic curves exclude nontrivial L=0 and D=0 equality boundaries for every finite alpha.; Transverse PSD support and cubic flatness control the full Taylor remainder; classical CR L2/L4 estimates let H absorb it at every B.; The joint generalization handles arbitrary kernel rank, the Q=0 case and a fixed-dimensional rational admission compiler with eigenvalue-free kappa.
Costs: Rational lambda, coefficients and reserve are supplied and their numerator/denominator bit lengths are charged. Principal-minor, kernel and flatness checks use matrices of order at most4 and at most35 monomials; fixed rational expressions have O(n) bit size and polynomial total bit work for n-bit rational inputs. Finding lambda is separate. Corrected exact JSON parsing preserves decimal/scientific rationals and rejects pre-parsed floats/nonfinite/boolean inputs; initial rounded-input failure and code are preserved. Large sufficient alpha is a conservative proof cost, not an optimum or practical algorithm claim.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: The independent stratum construction and independent stratum audit are distinct. GENERAL_FLAT_COMPLETION is a subsequent root/worker joint extension and must not be counted as independent corroboration. No physical inputs or devices are acquired.
Obstruction and failure scope: The trace of A^-1R distinguishes the nonshear contact from the old shear contact under invertible two-sided transforms. At sufficient alpha the entire nonzero-background contact set is sQtheta,rQtheta e11, excluding equality to a single shear-contact transport; positive sums and limits are not excluded. Known QC sharp J_r fails the compiler cubic-flatness predicate, proving the predicate is not necessary.
Comparator: The classical Iwaniec-Kristensen strict-LH completion framework is credited; persistent rank-one contacts violate its strict premise. The independent audit reconstructs degenerate sufficiency directly.
Missing lemma or service: Least alpha, full eight-dimensional projected boundary membership, necessity of the general admission predicate, other nonzero-trace contact-angle strata and an efficient lambda-finding procedure remain open.
Actual reading/review depth: Independent stratum construction/audit and subsequent independent general mathematical audit read. Final implementation addendum and parser v2 correction read; corrected compiler SHA bb0cea71e048eccac401a91288b17d7ed1ce7d705250d52dfc29addc71d21433 has76 independent passing assertions. Contact-only and supplied-lambda qualifications retained.

An explicit admitted quartic is113325063H+w^2-vj+(3/4)v^2. It has all-background Jensen margin at least1/1125 times integral|Dphi|^4 and F(I)=-1/4, so it is non-PC. The large coefficient is sufficient only.

body:
N874-determinant-energy-and-positive-branch-operation-limits | Determinant energy defeats constant second-order operations; sharp positive QC remains open
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Exact limitations of specified smoothing, scalar-potential projection and positive Burkholder-superposition operations; they do not classify QC.

Exact statement: For planar vector maps, L u=sum C^{ij}u_ij with real constant output matrices and C^{ij}=C^{ji}: L=0 is the only homogeneous second-order operator universally tangent to all rank-one gradients. Every nonzero such L has a smooth compact compatible map with negative integrated determinant-square dissipation, excluding every correction that has universally zero integral and makes that same density pointwise nonnegative. For the coercive real strongly-parabolic subclass, one common compact datum u0=(f,f^2), f=x1+x1x2 near0, satisfies detDu0=0 and determinant velocity4 C11_22>0; E(0)=Eprime(0)=0 and E grows at positive times. C1 autonomous C(u,Du) has the corresponding near-zero obstruction conditional on classical evolution. Separately, scalar-component constrained-potential projection can increase sharp J_r energy for every r>0, and well-defined positive invertible Burkholder superpositions plus a ROC remainder cannot represent J_r. Sharp positive QC is UNKNOWN.
Source-reported status: Root-adjudicated internal research, source_derived_unreviewed. Source claims, original deductions, executable checks and same-team independent reviews remain distinct. External mathematical correctness, formal verification, historical originality and physical capability remain UNKNOWN. Hashes and software checks establish only their recorded integrity scope.
Assumptions: Ordered spatial sum includes2C12 partial12; no output symmetry is required.; Strong parabolicity means the real symmetric-symbol coercivity a_alpha Cij_alpha,beta a_beta xi_i xi_j>=lambda|a|^2|xi|^2, lambda>0, rather than an eigenvalue-real-part substitution.; Compact smooth planar maps or smooth periodic maps; state-adaptive corollary assumes classical solution, initial differentiation and finite energy.; Burkholder exclusion assumes positive measure and absolute integrability near I,I+-t e12, with a ROC remainder; no external Burkholder-QC theorem is assumed.
Proof spine: Exact compact curve-image jets give nonzero determinant velocity; differentiating v_s=u0+sLu0 gives strictly negative integrated same-operation dissipation.; Three local scalar jets force all12 effective constant operator coefficients to vanish under universal rank-one tangency.; A compatible periodic first-variation construction makes scalar-row projection raise positive J_r energy; at r=1 a positive-radius disk has an exact gap.; Every invertible Burkholder term has strict relative-shear quadratic variation while J_r has only fourth-order shear variation; positivity and Fatou rule out the stated representation.
Costs: Finite symbolic differentiation and coefficient/rank checks establish the stated algebra; semigroup/compactness/Fatou arguments are written analytic proofs. No faster PDE solver, finite-dimensional QC test, convergence rate, physical implementation or cost advantage is supplied. Nonzero nonparabolic L has an algebraic dissipation witness without an evolution-existence claim.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Operator coefficients, compatible test maps and quartic coefficients are supplied. No experimental operation is acquired. The preliminary external sharp Beurling paper is AUDIT_RECONSTRUCTED_NOT_ADMITTED; all completion margins retain the established nonsharp sqrt(24) bound.
Obstruction and failure scope: Determinant square remains PC and QC. No-null-repair excludes only corrections with both universal zero integral and pointwise positivity for the same dissipation. State adaptation does not cover explicit x dependence, divergence-form substitution, lower-order compensation, singular/degenerate coefficients, nonlocal rules or auxiliary states. Projection counterexamples do not refute the actual scalar lemma.
Comparator: Separate determinant-Jensen addition already succeeds in the completion proof and is outside universal monotonicity of one flow. Classical scalar projection contracts matching convex radial scalar energies; determinant-coupled vector energies require a different argument.
Missing lemma or service: For every compatible periodic V, with A=<J_r(V)>,c=<DJ_r(V)>,K=<D2J_r(V)>/2, positive sharp QC is equivalent to PSD [[A,cT/2],[c/2,K]], or c in rangeK and cT Kdagger c<=4A. No proof for all V or compatible negative witness exists.
Actual reading/review depth: Output-matrix proof read through common-datum, algebraic no-null-repair, universal tangency, adaptive and dimension scopes. Projection/Burkholder written proofs and all-background moment reduction read; finite searches classified separately.

body:
N875-chemical-axis-order-volume-identification-and-physical-gate | Order-weighted scattering does not identify volume-axis writing; conditional sharp bounds
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Conditional moment identification for Fe/Ni chemical-axis proposals, with physical stress writing and same-domain rewrite unacquired.

Exact statement: Under the additive corrected scattering model, M=integral nnT dV, f=traceM and W=integral S^2 nnT dV are distinct targets. Fixed x/y populations of volume1/2 with S=(4/5,2/5), then swapped, have unchanged M and total intensity while normalized intensity contrast changes by6/5. For unrestricted unit axes and supplied0<s<1 with s<=S<=1 plus acquired W and f, the exact identified set is s^2M<=W<=M, traceM=f; spectral atoms of P=(W-s^2M)/(1-s^2),R=(M-W)/(1-s^2) attain every feasible pair. Known finite axis support instead requires the exact m_i,w_i mixture LP. At s=2/5,f=1 the two-arm volume contrasts are[0,21/25] and[-21/25,0], so their difference can be0 despite intensity difference6/5. Without a uniform floor but0<S<=1, fixed-W feasibility additionally requires equal supports; dropping that condition gives joint-pair closure when W varies, not closure of a fixed-W fiber. No retained physical axis write or same-specimen rewrite is acquired.
Source-reported status: Root-adjudicated internal research, source_derived_unreviewed. Source claims, original deductions, executable checks and same-team independent reviews remain distinct. External mathematical correctness, formal verification, historical originality and physical capability remain UNKNOWN. Hashes and software checks establish only their recorded integrity scope.
Assumptions: Scattering-to-W must be independently validated: additive intensity, absolute scale, angular/satellite integration, structure factors, absorption and contamination controls.; The same included ordered material supplies f, W and a valid local common lower order floor; aggregate published S values do not supply that floor.; Unrestricted support is required for spectral sufficiency; known allowed axes, per-parent masses, indivisible variants and shared-domain coupling require their own constraints.; f>0 is required for Q=M/f; with f=0 normalized texture is undefined.
Proof spine: Exact unchanged-domain counterexample separates order intensity from volume orientation even at fixed phase volume and total intensity.; Two PSD matrices P,R prove sharp positive-floor attainability without requiring commutation; diagonal pinching and rational water filling give exact endpoints.; Independent final audit reconstructs the theorem and fixes joint-closure versus fixed-fiber scope; root v4 incorporates the correction.; Nuisance rank/conditioning and angular missing-mass bounds specify which measured channels could supply W; conditional site-label and extraction contraction arguments identify missing physical control.
Costs: Charge precursor synthesis, gas throughflow versus net inventory, loading at reaction temperature, repeated nitrogen insertion/removal, furnace time, milling/classification/coating if used, rejected fractions, load transfer, beamtime over energies/angles, references/calibration, local-order bounds, registration, damage/mass balance, retention and reset. No acquired full energy, throughput, price, cycle life, yield, spectral condition number or matched advantage is available. The3x3 SDP is post-supplied-information computation.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Root v4 is a conditional information operation, not an acquired tensor. No raw stress-to-retained-axis response, validated W interface, same-domain rewrite or useful magnet benchmark was acquired. Primary plots and applicant patent reports remain source-attributed evidence; inaccessible fulltext and raw-data limits remain explicit.
Obstruction and failure scope: A volume-tensor change can also arise through selective ordering, phase growth/destruction, replacement, grain/particle motion or loss. Label-preserving nitrogen-only cycles cannot change fixed metal-order labels, but reconstructive nitrogen-assisted mobility is outside that no-go. Planar texture does not imply a specified in-plane axis.
Comparator: Applicant-reported mechanical treatment of N-rich precursor before denitriding, epitaxial oriented NITE islands and direct stress/field-assisted ordering are close established/source-reported comparators. Broad nitrogen-assisted retained texture is not a new capability claim. Film texture, theoretical-density powder magnetic figures and a hypothetical bulk rewrite are not one demonstrated regime.
Missing lemma or service: Acquire and validate same-specimen f,W,local order or a common floor, supported-axis model, nuisance conditioning and missing angular mass; then separate same-domain reorientation from population replacement and demonstrate repeated orthogonal retained writes with complete costs.
Actual reading/review depth: Root v4, current20-check receipt, independent final addendum and actual false-positive/identified-set proofs read. Source-attributed evidence and acquisition contracts read; no new experimental validation was performed.

These are complete internal proofs of their conditional information claims. Physical acquisition is a separate open obligation. No technology record or gate is promoted.

Indexing, hashes and deterministic checks establish only their recorded integrity scope. Scientific review and capability gates remain open.

These do not prove a constant gamma_r>0 uniform over all affine backgrounds and all compatible gradients. No general zero-margin sequence is constructed and no storage transfer is established.
