N877-global-h-completion-projection-and-finite-range-test | Full invariant finite-H ROC/QC projection with an exact finite range test
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

The full nine-dimensional real left-SO(2)-invariant homogeneous quartic space V on real 2x2 matrices, with H=((a-d)^2+(b+c)^2)^2 and the eight-dimensional quotient V/span{H}.

Exact statement: For every G in V, a finite real alpha with G+alpha H rank-one convex exists iff a finite real beta with G+beta H all-background quasiconvex exists. Alpha and beta may differ. QC quantifies every bounded planar Lipschitz domain, every affine B and every W0^(1,4) vector perturbation, with the periodic analogue. Finite membership is equivalently the exact block-range predicate: there exist five real Gram parameters with C_G(z) positive semidefinite and ker C_G(z) contained in ker B_G^T. The projected cone is nonclosed.
Source-reported status: Root version-2 theorem is internally unconditional with separate equation-first contact and global analytic coverage audits. Generic constructor: 363 exact assertions; independent contact audit: 31 exact groups; global audit: 40 exact groups. These counts have separate finite scopes. source_derived_unreviewed.
Assumptions: Real homogeneous degree-four integrands; left SO(2) invariance only.; Completion is existence after deleting H; no equality at the same coefficient is assumed.; Compatibility and the stated zero-boundary or periodic W1,4 test class are retained.; Classical finite complex L4 Beurling estimate, plus the pinned exact shear/parallel completion results.
Proof spine: At I, D2H vanishes; a nonnegative conformal acoustic form is either strict on unit rank-one directions or has a nonzero contact.; Orthogonal conjugation preserving H and the full QC test maps every contact to trace-free shear, parallel e11 or finite nonzero oblique (t,1) tensor e1.; The oblique stationary span, forced support and explicit boundary gradients exhaust all weak coefficients; its strict support receives the pinned flat compiler.; Classical strict absorption and pinned exact shear/parallel theorems cover the other cases, giving one finite coefficient for every B/domain/test.; The exact acoustic lift and PSD block-range criterion decide finite ROC membership; the independently proved quotient equality transfers that membership conclusion to QC completion.
Costs: The supplied rational oblique-contact compiler uses fixed matrices of order at most four and fixed quartic expressions with polynomial bit work in the rational input length. The full block-range predicate can require exact algebraic scalar isolation/kernel computation; no tolerance-based PSD implementation or optimal fixed-alpha QC solver is supplied. Near t=1, ell=m=1, k=1/2+eta, every completion needs alpha >=1/(32 eta)+13/80+47 eta/200; a sufficient coefficient has the same inverse-eta order. Precision, conditioning and contact acquisition remain charged.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: The theorem is mathematical for arbitrary real coefficients. Rational supplied-contact data are computational inputs; a general contact/strictness finder and acquisition of coefficients are separate. No missing ZIP or preliminary stronger paper is a proof premise.
Obstruction and failure scope: The coefficient may need to change and diverges approaching excluded boundary classes. Acoustic SOS alone is an ROC certificate. It supplies no fixed-alpha QC assertion, planar Morrey resolution or physical operation.
Comparator: Iwaniec-Kristensen supplies classical strict homogeneous completion. The two-sided isotropic Bruno-Pasqualotto claim has stronger symmetry. Pedregal v5 claims broader 2x2 ROC/QC equivalence; the dedicated primary audit constructs exact compatible maps and a permitted mold whose set-valued image is empty for every input weight, refuting its stated universal-mold nonempty-image step. This source proof is not admitted as a premise; the counterexample does not decide the broader conjecture or every alternative mold.
Missing lemma or service: No internal contact-coverage lemma remains missing in the independently audited existence theorem. External proof review, historical priority, least-alpha QC, and an implemented general exact admission service are separate outstanding obligations.
Actual reading/review depth: Curation read the current entry/composition/continuity, scoped notices, generic necessity/sufficiency, orthogonal glue, independent derivation and full coverage audits, the block-range proof, and pinned shear/parallel/flat theorem ranges. It did not rerun inherited certificate arrays.

The incoming sharp-negative theorem substantially repeats pinned N867. Its missing certificate arrays may differ from those pinned earlier; claim overlap is not byte or coefficient identity. The new current advance is the full H-projection coverage and the finite range interface, with classical/inherited credit retained.
After one finite QC completion, an added reserve nu H gives the uniform numerical margin 4nu/1875 for every compatible test. This changes the integrand and supplies no global margin for an unchanged sharp J_r.
The primary-proof audit is a scoped inventory/correction, not a standalone major-theorem card. It uses l=1 periodic nodal arrays u=[[0,4],[2,3]], v=[[1,0],[0,2]] and a permitted paired-interface subtree. All proposed input/output fractions give U=(4,a), a in [-8,-4], and V=(8,b), b in [4,8], so det(U,V)>=48 and T(t) is empty for every t in Theta_1. Kakutani nonemptiness fails for that stated universal-mold construction; planar ROC=>QC remains undecided.

body:
N878-sharp-negative-partial-uniform-margin-and-concentration-gates | Partial uniform margins for sharp negative quartics and the remaining concentration gate
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

For each fixed real r<-2, J_r=alpha H+beta u^2+j^2+r u j with alpha=3r/[8(r+2)] and beta=r(r-1)/6. Restricted compatible classes are distinguished from the open all-affine pure fourth-order bound.

Exact statement: On every rectangular torus, periodic W1,4 maps with phi2,x=0 satisfy Gap_B(phi)>=alpha/24 integral|Dphi|^4 for every affine B. On one fixed rectangular torus, or compact gradients supported in one fixed bounded subset of R2, normalized L4 gradients with uniformly integrable fourth-power densities satisfy liminf Gap_(t_n I)>=alpha when |t_n| tends to infinity. The latter uses the contact cubic estimate |ell(q)|<=C_r sqrt(m(q)) ||q||4 n(q). The full all-affine uniform gamma_r>0 remains unresolved. The independently audited fixed-profile full-affine slow-fast limit is at least alpha/3. The constant-rate critical target-logspiral class has one positive angular margin for every real frequency and angular profile at fixed r; normalized long-annulus consequences hold at zero/fixed B. These do not cover general changing radial shapes or growing effective backgrounds.
Source-reported status: Restricted T and C/U analytic results pass an independent internal audit after a whole-plane interpolation-domain repair (8 exact supporting checks). Fixed-profile slow-fast and all-frequency target-logspiral exclusions also pass a separate analytic audit (16 exact supporting groups). The general all-affine uniform margin remains UNRESOLVED. source_derived_unreviewed.
Assumptions: Fix r<-2; no branch-uniform constant is claimed.; Triangular theorem requires periodic compatibility and phi2,x=0 on a rectangular torus.; Contact-ray theorem requires L4 normalization, fixed finite-measure support/domain, uniform integrability and the exact scalar contact ray t_n I.; On R2 the mixed-Hessian interpolation lemma additionally requires D2f in L4, excluding f=xy polynomial ambiguity.
Proof spine: Apply the inherited rank-one quartic Bregman bound at the x-conditional and then y-conditional levels; use |w+m|^4<=8(|w|^4+|m|^4).; Remove the contact defect through a bounded elliptic right inverse; compatibility yields a scalar Hessian potential.; Mixed-Hessian interpolation at exponent 8/3 controls the troublesome cubic, giving the necessary ell^2/m rate.; The determinant null identity and uniform integrability upgrade transverse L2 convergence to L4 and leave the pure-shear limiting energy alpha.
Costs: The triangular margin is explicit, alpha/24=r/[64(r+2)]. Contact-ray constants are fixed-r analytic bounds, with no effective profile-decomposition algorithm or whole-domain storage grid. Finite splitting-depth bound alpha/(3N^3) deteriorates with depth. All storage endpoint, horizon and spatial costs stay at the pinned receiving contract.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: The quartic and inherited certificate are supplied mathematical capital. Normalization/UI/contact-ray hypotheses must be established for each admitted sequence; they are not inferred from numerical minima, fixed-profile examples or strict individual positivity.
Obstruction and failure scope: Fourth-power concentration, affine directions approaching contacts with unbounded transverse offsets, changing profiles and unbounded compatible hierarchy remain outside the proved classes. Scalar quadratic entropy alone loses orientation and cannot establish the margin.
Comparator: The pinned N876 rank-one, strict-individual and angular results are inherited. The new triangular estimate admits some rank-two maps and the UI theorem excludes a growing-contact escape. Neither improves the unchanged N866 same-G storage input without a full numerical uniform sharp-J margin.
Missing lemma or service: A compatibility-preserving profile decomposition or a different argument that controls every concentration bubble, transverse affine offset and quartic residual, or an actual compatible normalized zero-margin sequence.
Actual reading/review depth: Curation read the complete T and C/U proofs, the domain repair and independent analytic audit, the complete slow-fast/logspiral construction and separate analytic audit, and the exact N866 receiving hypothesis.

The whole-plane f=xy counterexample invalidates the initially broader mixed-Hessian wording. The corrected D2f in L4 condition is already met by the downstream potential, so the application survives. The correction must remain visible alongside the original version history.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Declared conservation/capacity models for Li, Na and Cl across a specified membrane cut, with both external reservoirs and all hidden/auxiliary inventories; separate supplied finite-graph and stochastic phase-kernel models.

Exact statement: For total hidden Li/Na inventory at each endpoint at most B, Qobs=(dR,Li-dR,Na-dL,Li+dL,Na)/4 differs from true crossing exchange X=(JLi-JNa)/2 by at most B/2; this is sharp. A simultaneous assay/source-error radius eta gives X>=Qhat-eta-B/2. body:
N880-positive-sharp-calibration-and-conformal-elimination | Positive sharp singular calibration and exact conformal reductions
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Unchanged positive sharp J_r on real 2x2 matrices, r>0, periodic or zero-boundary W1,4 compatible tests.

Exact statement: The exact Gram/determinant calibration proves strict QC at every singular background and an explicit open full-rank cone for every r>0. At r1 it gives fourth-order margin 1/32 on singular backgrounds. At I and diag(1,-1), nonlinear acoustic-shear elimination has an attained unique convex inner optimum and an exact outer inequality equivalent to the corresponding conformal QC. A separate attained scalar-row divergence-free stress dual is equivalent at I. The universal outer inequalities and all-affine positive sharp QC remain OPEN.
Source-reported status: Internally derived/reconstructed scoped theorem and exact evidence; external correctness and historical priority UNKNOWN. Internal analytic proofs, exact finite checks, acquired primary evidence and source claims remain distinct. External correctness, historical priority, physical acquisition and practical advantage are UNKNOWN unless explicitly scoped otherwise; all new high-impact claims remain source_derived_unreviewed.
Assumptions: Exact unchanged coefficients alpha=3r/[8(r+2)], beta=r(r-1)/6; no extra H.; All compatible W1,4 tests, no orientation or finite-bandwidth promise.; Every quotient criterion quantified Q>0; Q0 handled separately.; Mean-zero L4 dual quotient and W2,4 Hessian potential when that representation is used.
Proof spine: Exact general-r PSD calibration and integrated determinant cancellation.; Compatible shear decomposition; joint convexity, direct-method attainment and conjugate elimination.; Separate row-convex stress dual; exact compatible Fourier falsifier and analytic failed-class exclusions.
Costs: Theorems quantify continuum functions. Inner scalar root closures require acquired slice integrals and precision. No affordable universal optimizer or coefficient-acquisition oracle supplied.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Original pasted/detailed reports supplied; missing producer verifier/ZIP not replayed. Exact new proofs/checks preserved.
Obstruction and failure scope: Supporting calibration fails at I. Scalar/cofactor and simultaneous-two-shear shortcuts fail; exact stronger Fourier constant8/3 is false, while its actual Jensen energy is positive.
Comparator: Classical null-Lagrangians, Fenchel/direct method and rank-one convexity; two-sided isotropic and degree-one-root transfers fail their hypotheses. Existing finite-H completion may change the coefficient.
Missing lemma or service: Prove or violate the all-compatible outer source/stress-cost inequality, then address other r and nonconformal backgrounds.
Actual reading/review depth: Load-bearing source derivations and countermodels reconstructed by distinct assigned investigators; parent adjudicated their assumptions and read decisive proofs. Same-team checks are not independent external validation.

At r1 a separate mixed singular margin 1/44 is stated; the full-rank ratio cone is sigma2/sigma1<=1-sqrt(sqrt13-3). No positive all-affine theorem or Morrey resolution follows.
The rational compatible diagnostic has ratio 0.693155287785>2/3 but actual optimized Jensen energy 0.233568631102>0.

Source claims, internal proofs, finite checks and same-team review remain unreviewed externally. External mathematical correctness, historical novelty and physical capability are UNKNOWN. Indexing, hashes and deterministic checks establish only their recorded integrity scope. Scientific review and capability gates remain open.

Internally reconstructed asynchronous 4D toric sweep; completed CPTP correctors, exact code initialization, one fixed perfect decoder, independent sparse Poisson locations.

Exact statement: Conditional on the universal location-only simultaneous Pauli-history certificate, arbitrary supported CPTP faults sharing a finite persistent bath factorize as Id_L tensor Lambda_B on every good schedule, including joint entangled inputs, and give joint-input diamond error <= 2 p_bad. For the specified signed GKSL catalog, CPTP uniformization is exact iff D is PSD, a lies in range(D), and r >= Gamma + tr(C) + a^* D^+ a, where D^+ is its Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse. For diagonal Pauli floors, with the stated zero-rate range convention, the exact minimum is sum_i gamma_i + sum_i h_i^2/gamma_i. Within the modewise floor/proposal family, common-cap spatial box and single-global-ellipsoid optima are 2 max_c sum_(i in S_c) epsilon_i and 2 max_c sqrt(sum_(i in S_c) b_i^2), respectively.

Assumptions: 4D geometric local support, specified compatible sizes, exact correction/initialization/readout.; Fresh exogenous state/outcome-independent location law; arbitrary finite shared bath only at charged locations.; Signed catalog includes required K/anticommutator directions and actual range conditions.; Coefficient box versus one acquired global ellipsoid are distinct contracts; all support incidence charged.; LSS/HT probability imports and completed-generator distinction retained.
Proof spine: Classical location-only simultaneous certificate, under named imports.; One fixed decoder corrects the operator span; bath coefficients retain chronological noncommutativity.; Normalized Choi block/range proof yields exact supported proposal budget and optimal floors.
Costs: All rates, center multiplicities, supports, coefficient conversions, deliberate floors, preparation/correction/readout/reset charged. Huge coarse constants supply no useful threshold. Bounded-density3D edge range Omega(L^1/3); faithful graph-minor routing additionally Omega(L^9/2) sites.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: 29 authored located-capital proof files separately preserved. HT primary acquired; original LSS full theorem pages inaccessible. No physical bath/architecture/noise bounds acquired.
Obstruction and failure scope: Memory-only Choi floor cannot absorb arbitrary continuous shared-bath Hamiltonians. Missing catalog product directions defeat every rate. A native bath supplies floors only where strictly positive rates are justified.
Comparator: Knill-Laflamme/operator-span and Poisson/Choi tools are established; shifted-jump identity has Shang-Franca Eq4 prior art. Primary sweep/Gibbs/qLDPC/coherent comparators have different precise interfaces; historical priority UNKNOWN.
Missing lemma or service: External proof review of asynchronous classical universal event; useful constants and an acquired architecture. Continuous bath coupling requires a separate operation.
Actual reading/review depth: Load-bearing source derivations and countermodels reconstructed by distinct assigned investigators; parent adjudicated their assumptions and read decisive proofs. Same-team checks are not independent external validation.

Source lifetime claim is min(2,A L^4(1+kappa T)e^-cL), all T, under its model. Quantum steps do not reprove this probability estimate.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Original voltage-box/fixed-power algebraic model, including a separately stated connected passive endpoint-current embedding.

Exact statement: A normalized rational degree-four functional satisfies full M2, all original voltage localizers/equality multipliers, complex embedding and 36 scalar voltage-bound products, but its lower reciprocal cut is exactly-897/10000. Therefore original unaugmented real order 2 does not universally contain the lower cut; the explicit degree 6 certificate makes order 3 sharp in this stated class. Localized current upper bounds lower the sufficient order to 2. No selected complete electrical-instance separation or solver advantage follows.
Source-reported status: Internally derived/reconstructed scoped theorem and exact evidence; external correctness and historical priority UNKNOWN. Internal analytic proofs, exact finite checks, acquired primary evidence and source claims remain distinct. External correctness, historical priority, physical acquisition and practical advantage are UNKNOWN unless explicitly scoped otherwise; all new high-impact claims remain source_derived_unreviewed.
Assumptions: xu=yv1;1<=x²,y²<=4;1/64<=u²,v²<=64; all equality multipliers through degree 4.; Full complex-as-real 45x45 matrix; real M2 rank 13; all 8 localizers PD.; Passive pathx--w--t--y, w=x-u,t=y-v, positive unit conductances and explicitly broad interior voltage boxes.; Interior powers, branch/generator/operating constraints are additional, unverified hypotheses.
Proof spine: Degree4 upper and degree 6 lower polynomial identities.; Exact rational full relaxation feasibility and negative lower cut.; Invertible passive network pullback and original-bound preordering checks.
Costs: Exact finite Fraction/Bareiss/LDL arithmetic. Two direct 2x2 Hermitian cuts versus larger fourth-moment interface; full separation/setup/conditioning/dual certification/runtime/memory costs unmeasured.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Recovered exact PGLib blob and changed-generator version receipts; missing original decision ZIP not replayed. No commercial solver installation or network OPF run.
Obstruction and failure scope: Pseudo-moment is not a physical feasible point. Scalar current bounds do not furnish current localizers. No all-level extension/nonliftability or named stronger-incumbent claim.
Comparator: Full/sparse moment-SOS, current-localizer augmentation, QC/RLT/OBBT and certified conic/MILP baselines retain equal-information access.
Missing lemma or service: Test full pinned instance and matched strengthened solver with verified dual lower bounds and same feasible upper reference.
Actual reading/review depth: Load-bearing source derivations and countermodels reconstructed by distinct assigned investigators; parent adjudicated their assumptions and read decisive proofs. Same-team checks are not independent external validation.

The exploratory SDP was optimal_inaccurate and is not evidence for an optimum. Final exact rational witness establishes only the separation.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Primary dynamic Pd acetylene hydrogenation data and a proposed post write fresh-carbon cohort experiment; no new laboratory run.

Exact statement: Original SI/workbooks reproduce conditional ethane ratio .2211756904, equivalent suppression 7.766125527s and 2.484329497 events/Pd. A separate 10s/1s V/I trace integrates to.278055400742 J; optimum 10s/.1s waveform energy remains unavailable. Pulse/sham before fresh labelled feed with common read/chase and complete fate can exclude direct old product purge/conservative delay, but electronic memory remains nonidentified by exact hidden H/transport/retention countermodels.
Source-reported status: Acquired primary evidence and internally derived conditional causal test; experiment remains unperformed. Internal analytic proofs, exact finite checks, acquired primary evidence and source claims remain distinct. External correctness, historical priority, physical acquisition and practical advantage are UNKNOWN unless explicitly scoped otherwise; all new high-impact claims remain source_derived_unreviewed.
Assumptions: Conditional carbon balance, calibrated label attribution/exposure and complete chase closure for causal theorem.; Acquired workbook aggregates are not raw chromatograms/site inventory.; Separate waveform, throughput, stability and electrolyte regimes not combined.; Finite-record missing tag/error allowances applied before interpreting a fresh cohort effect.
Proof spine: Acquire exact original primary workbooks/SI and rederive condition-specific flux/work.; Prove conditional fresh cohort purge/delay exclusion with finite-record bounds.; Construct hidden state countermodels; compare strongest source product regimes separately.
Costs: Switching/generator/feed/gas/solvent/heat/separation/reset and replacement costs remain distinct from recorded terminal VI. Complete matched useful output and lifetime costs unmeasured.
Supplied/acquired information boundary: Original Xu SI/Fig2/Fig6 workbooks and separate 5kHz trace acquired. Wang article/SI acquired; 200h at 2sccm is not 100sccm two-cell regime. Optimum waveform work, raw chromatograms and common-regime cohort intervention not acquired.
Obstruction and failure scope: HiddenH, reactive transport, retained fresh product and local exposure remain observationally equivalent to electronic state. Trace saturation and source caption/condition inconsistencies persist.
Comparator: Old carbon tracer/SSITKA/subsurface H-C primary work; Wang Chem 2026 continuous polymer-grade product comparator. Generic isotope technique novelty STOP.
Missing lemma or service: Execute calibrated preadmission pulse/sham fresh cohort common read/chase; acquire complete fate/exposure and matched optimum switching work/useful product costs.
Actual reading/review depth: Load-bearing source derivations and countermodels reconstructed by distinct assigned investigators; parent adjudicated their assumptions and read decisive proofs. Same-team checks are not independent external validation.

No physical operation, calibrated transient kinetic model or useful technological advantage was acquired. External fulltexts/workbooks/raw arrays remain outside public Git; sanitized hashes/URLs and authored analysis preserved.

Source claims, internal proofs, finite checks and same-team review remain unreviewed externally. External mathematical correctness, historical novelty and physical capability are UNKNOWN. Indexing, hashes and deterministic checks establish only their recorded integrity scope. Scientific review and capability gates remain open.

Fixed sigma>0; exact periodic gradients; nonzero homogeneous degree m>=3; finite 1<p,s<infinity; alpha/p+(m-alpha)/s=1, 0<alpha<=m.

Exact statement: With weights b0,a1,c2,q2, the signed and absolute estimate has a finite constant iff the smallest exact monomial weight is >=2alpha. Universal uniformly integrable near-kernel little-o holds iff that weight is >2alpha. Degree-two signed estimates require quotient by the full gradient determinant. A corrected finite-frequency compiler constructs compatible exclusions; a fixed homogeneous double-characteristic pencil transfers by conditioned linear changes.
Proof spine: See exact hash-pinned analytic derivations, independent receiving audits and separately scoped finite certificates below.
Costs and information: Continuum exact-gradient estimates do not supply a sharp solver or acquired physical parameters. Rational witness enumeration is exponential; full conditioning, precision, acquisition and reset costs remain charged.
Comparator/originality: Classical interpolation, Hodge/null-Lagrangian/SOS tools and primary predecessors are credited; no historical novelty clearance.
Failure and missing obligation: Seek scope-matched external review and closest priority; no optimal admissible constant or endpoint theorem supplied. The target alpha3/2 uses L6 and does not discharge the sharp L4 inequality.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Unchanged J_r for every r>0, every real s, periodic phi=(F(x)+H(y),g(x,y)); arbitrary W1,4 F,H and unrestricted compatible W1,4 g. A broader stress-conservation class is quantified at its fixed r,s.

Exact statement: Exact nonlinear row stresses and rational positive Gram identities prove Jensen gap >=5r<|Dphi|^4>/[4096(r+2)]+r*s^2<a^2+c^2+d^2>/[512(r+2)] for every r>0. The separate r1 certificate gives the stronger bounds 1/256 and s^2/128. The stresses are divergence-free for the stated two-profile first potential. A one-phase nonseparated example has prior qualitative triangular-support coverage. Exact general mixed sources and a reserve-floor falsifier are preserved; no unrestricted positive-core QC theorem follows.
Proof spine: See exact hash-pinned analytic derivations, independent receiving audits and separately scoped finite certificates below.
Costs and information: Continuum exact-gradient estimates do not supply a sharp solver or acquired physical parameters. Rational witness enumeration is exponential; full conditioning, precision, acquisition and reset costs remain charged.
Comparator/originality: Classical interpolation, Hodge/null-Lagrangian/SOS tools and primary predecessors are credited; no historical novelty clearance.
Failure and missing obligation: Construct a nonlocal or richer correction controlling the exact general mixed-source pairing against the full Gram budget, or exhibit a compatible negative Jensen field. Seek external review/priority. Separation cannot be silently removed.

Internally derived/reconstructed analytic arguments and exact finite checks are separate. All new high-impact claims remain source_derived_unreviewed. External correctness, historical priority, physical acquisition, formal verification and practical advantage are UNKNOWN. Metadata, Git integration and same-team agreement do not establish those statuses.

body:
N894-peak-constrained-control-and-fixed-refresh-minimax | Peak-constrained control and exact singleton refresh minimax
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Exact ideal finite-dimensional parity model; public fixed slots, independent private fair toggles, initial seed/final inverse; known norm envelope, syndrome-preserving baseline; arbitrary finite bath or fixed bath large enough for saturation. Physical finite-width controller not acquired.

Exact statement: Incoming constrained exponential-kernel certificate is reconstructed, with the uncapped optimizer attributed to classical capacitary/execution prior art. Equal-action N-slot placement exactly minimizes singleton worst-case error Q_N=1-cos^(2(N+1))(min(a/(N+1),pi/2)); a bath of dimension N+2 attains it. The original-Walsh shared-bath receiving product retains squared-action gap factors, not an unproved product of sine improvements. At a<pi the Poisson certificate obeys a sinc-squared actual minimax sandwich and is asymptotically sharp. For constant envelope, 0<a<=pi/4 and integer N>=1, fixed slots strictly beat every Poisson schedule in actual ideal worst-case endpoint error at matched mean internal flips N/2; instantaneous slots and bounded continuous rates remain different control classes. An explicit finite-a known-H counterexample rejects actual-error optimality of the certificate optimizer. Actual flips average N/2, with bits, endpoint wrappers, support and physical residual costs additional. Random DD is established prior art; exact theorem priority remains UNKNOWN.

Information and costs: Exact model/proof/source premises only; supplied information, independent acquisitions, analytic arguments and finite checks remain separate. Actual control, residual precision, acquisition/recovery/reset and strongest equally informed comparator costs remain charged in the cited proofs.

Failure / next operation: Independently review the analytic exact minimax; prove/refute joint finite-action sine factors or qualify a complete finite-width private controller with true support, covariance, residual/reset and matched useful memory output.

Source claims, analytic proofs and same-team checks remain source_derived_unreviewed. External correctness, historical priority, physical capability, formal verification and empirical confirmation are UNKNOWN. Finite replay, hashes, agreement and Git integration do not certify those properties.

For each fixed r>0, unchanged J_r, periodic W1,4 first/second potentials, all real scalar conformal backgrounds sI. Canonical separated projection Pi f has R=||D Pi f||4>0; no profile/frequency cutoff.

Exact statement: An explicit delta_r>0 depending only on r gives E_r(f,g,s)>=alpha(R^4+||Dg0||4^4)/2+mu s^2 A(f,g)/2 when ||D(f-Pi f)||4<=delta_r R, for every compatible g and real s. Exact compatible acoustic projection plus inherited separated reserve and credited cubic compensation removes the incoming nonzero-horizontal-derivative restriction. Every nonconstant separated center, including H(y), has an actual ball of radius delta_r||Dh0||4/5. Delta=1/40000000 is sufficient at r=1. A restricted discriminant margin follows. Same-g fixed-fraction domination fails at pure vertical anchors and is not asserted. No constant-anchor neighborhood, unrestricted mixed-source or all-affine quasiconvexity is proved.

Information and costs: Exact model/proof/source premises only; supplied information, independent acquisitions, analytic arguments and finite checks remain separate. Actual control, residual precision, acquisition/recovery/reset and strongest equally informed comparator costs remain charged in the cited proofs.

Failure / next operation: Externally review exact analytic/provenance/priority scope; extend the acoustic discriminant beyond the relative separated tube or produce an actual negative compatible field. Finite Fourier diagnostics and a constant-anchor scaling assertion cannot replace the missing theorem.

Original unbounded and cap162 eight-site open 2x4 Schloegl process, all50 initialization, literal all<=15 first-hit target, h=1e-4 local statement; deadline1 continuation separately unresolved. Immutable binary64 arrays contracted exactly as dyadics.

Exact statement: Stopped upward-count/death-count domination proves actual first-slab target probability<1e-65; root rational bound4.221480587e-68. Weighted and constrained saved paths therefore have tiny scalar target error despite failed complete forward certificates. The original target output5.553737834e-10 exceeds the chosen cap-subtracted interior allowance. Constrained residual lower bound does not lower-bound actual state error. Same-total actual continuation states separate backward weights by>0.0100215 at remaining1e-4, excluding an accurate uniform total-only receiver there. Backward resolvents accept infinity-bounded Frobenius residual without forward sqrt-dimension loss, but an acquired useful eight-site backward path/time sandwich is missing. Bounded pair computation tests the receiving operation and shows that its spatial closure is already too loose; no deadline1 original probability or advantage is established.

Information and costs: Exact model/proof/source premises only; supplied information, independent acquisitions, analytic arguments and finite checks remain separate. Actual control, residual precision, acquisition/recovery/reset and strongest equally informed comparator costs remain charged in the cited proofs.

Failure / next operation: Acquire one complete exact-generator spatial/backward TT resolvent residual and tight deterministic-deadline sandwich, with terminal receiver, sinks, rounding/compression, original cap allowance and equally informed computational comparison. Short target accuracy cannot validate propagation of an inaccurate state.

N897-equal-duty-catalysis-model-and-causal-acquisition | Equal-duty catalysis model and causal acquisition
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Supplied/freshly matched Xu duration-grid point estimates and separately acquired dense10s/1s terminal trace; fixed shared positive mode rates and comparable actual exposure are conditional mathematical premises, not measured across the grid.

Exact statement: Every nonnegative parallel mixture of N887 scalar suppression modes preserves the increasing-period ethane trend, opposite the duty10 grid. This conditionally rejects that shared family while preserving its valid single-waveform nonidentification theorem. Sensitivity thresholds do not acquire uncertainty or matched actual exposure. A fixed three-configuration mechanism reverses the sign but has poor quantitative fit. Sequential randomized scheduled-pulse omission plus fresh cohort/common read identifies a finite history-dependent effect without claiming global reset, subject to acquired recovery/exposure/background bounds and complete product/work costs. Dense terminal overshoot/charging and known prior withdrawal experiments prevent promotion to a new physical operation.

Information and costs: Exact model/proof/source premises only; supplied information, independent acquisitions, analytic arguments and finite checks remain separate. Actual control, residual precision, acquisition/recovery/reset and strongest equally informed comparator costs remain charged in the cited proofs.

Failure / next operation: Acquire randomized fresh-cohort common-read control, retained exposure failures, complete cohort fate/useful ethylene/work accounting and valid simultaneous uncertainties. Park positive scalar-mode fitting; a finite useful causal effect under matched actual exposure is the next decision-changing result.

Source claims, analytic proofs and same-team checks remain source_derived_unreviewed. External correctness, historical priority, physical capability, formal verification and empirical confirmation are UNKNOWN. Finite replay, hashes, agreement and Git integration do not certify those properties.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Finite shared bath/reference, fixed commuting parities and cross-even norm-bounded interactions, prescribed exact isolated pinches; no selected-record feedback or physical controller inferred.

Exact result: Incoming sine product closes synchronized finite-action history/endpoint bounds with sharp sink witnesses and the one-unpinched receiving case. New arbitrary-schedule history effect is bounded by min over synchronized anchor subsets of product_Q(anchor) product_C(outside), including the product_C baseline; C=min(1,sum_gap sine_squared). Exact staggered example improves .5184 to .425088. Full asynchronous product_Q remains OPEN. Broad absorbing-history lift preserves action but not factorized Walsh structure. Exact entire isometries refute a norm-only proof shortcut, not a causal theorem. Classical sine prior retained.

Information and costs: Full declared assumptions and acquisition, floor, support, reset, residual and comparison costs are retained in the cited proofs.

Next decisive operation: Prove the causal asynchronous survival tensorization or construct a fully legal causal counterexample, retaining all-input parity, chronology, norm and unconditional effect; separately acquire finite-width private control.

Source-derived and same-team analytic work remains source_derived_unreviewed. External correctness, historical priority, physical capability, formal verification and empirical confirmation are UNKNOWN. Hashes, finite checks, agreement and Git integration do not certify those properties.

N899-fixed-known-operator-compiler-and-sharp-minimax | Fixed known-operator compiler and sharp minimax
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Specified finite-dimensional square operator dictionary and fixed coefficient envelopes; actual fixed Lindblad floors installed before unknown scalar coefficients; scalar Markovian generator, charged patch unions.

Exact result: Two-unitary polar dictionaries and five-Kraus unitary edges avoid a dense Pauli coefficient conversion for known directions. Jump replacement admits rate4a epsilon+epsilon² when the PSD piece charges the full dictionary union; pairwise alternative4a epsilon+2epsilon². Exact affine Pauli optimum is4a epsilon for epsilon<=a, else(a+epsilon)². Collision-free edge/product-drift catalog optimum is sum(2M+2sqrt(M²+u²)). Actual single-face m-axis correction rotations have exact fixed-center optimum stated in the proof; a common-postrotation-invariant four-action floor costs4kappa sin theta0. Generic Choi criterion is inherited N881, not a new discovery. Unknown norm-only directions, arbitrary diamond balls, perfect apparatus and original-generator robustness are not inferred.

Information and costs: Full declared assumptions and acquisition, floor, support, reset, residual and comparison costs are retained in the cited proofs.

Next decisive operation: Externally review exact minimax proofs; acquire one actual correction/noise dictionary, uniform remainder and implementable floor with full support/incident rates, or change uncertainty information before seeking rates below proved optima.

Source-derived and same-team analytic work remains source_derived_unreviewed. External correctness, historical priority, physical capability, formal verification and empirical confirmation are UNKNOWN. Hashes, finite checks, agreement and Git integration do not certify those properties.

Unchanged J_r, r>0, W1,4 periodic compatible fields in exact plane U=0,c=-h b; rational characteristic slopes on square torus or separately adapted rectangular torus; no amplitude/concentration restriction.

Exact result: Complete plane classification yields independent characteristic profile derivatives and a positive-square all-r quartic interaction. A four-atom zero-mean/zero-determinant law has unbounded discriminant and negative relaxed energy, but is not compatible and is not a quasiconvexity counterexample. Scalar Hessian inequality(17), and the general U coupling, remain OPEN.

Information and costs: Full declared assumptions and acquisition, floor, support, reset, residual and comparison costs are retained in the cited proofs.

Two routed O(1/n)-resistance channels remain conditional, with noise/switching/current/rail/settling unacquired. Perfectly floating unused terminals admit an O(1)-action ordinary baseline, while leakage and charging grow with terminal count. No hardware advantage.

body:
Ordinary loss yields a Husimi-law predictor for sparse complete records

STATUS | source_derived_unreviewed
REPORTED STATUS | Source-reported proof and exact finite benchmark; not independently validated in this integration. Novelty UNKNOWN; physical acquisition NOT_ACQUIRED; general speedup NOT_ESTABLISHED.
EXACT CLAIM | For arbitrary physical initial density operators, number-conserving hopping/density interactions, ordinary equal pure loss at a fixed rate d>0, and calibrated sparse observation with detected fraction O(theta), the canonical physical Husimi law gives a finite positive predictor for the complete permitted record under the same implemented feedback policy, with explicit truncation, tail, event-mass, grid/particle, numerical and calibration costs.
PROOF SPINE | A backward-effect argument starts from the physical Husimi law and avoids derivatives of the preparation amplitude. Ordinary loss bounds accumulated nonlinear sensitivity and the remaining count budget. The result predicts classical records; it does not reconstruct the quantum state from a classical mixture and does not claim an exact positive diffusion.
LIMITS | Grid cost is O_m((1+R/delta)^(2m)); particle needs can depend exponentially on the record alphabet. Mean energy alone gives no uniform O(theta) bound. Initial Husimi weights and phase reference require a fresh calibrated acquisition. The generic bound can be vacuous on the source's exact nonlinear benchmark and is not an economical many-mode theorem.
EXACT BENCHMARK | The separate source reports an outward exact-arithmetic certificate for a two-mode open-Kerr first-port record: TV from the correctly damped nonlinear limit <=0.000538488; TV from the old phase clock >=0.072192509; TV from the unchanged weak-bath predictor >=0.280862244. Equal pooled count-path laws for Kerr-on/off models are also reported, while marked first-port records separate them. These are finite model calculations, not laboratory data; no historical novelty is claimed.
DISTINCTION | The older P1 weak-bath result is N927. It uses theta-scaled bath rates and a different purification/amplitude-distribution contract. This result fixes the loss rate independently of theta and uses a physical Husimi law. It does not invalidate, generalize, or inherit the earlier assumptions.
NEXT OBLIGATION | Independently reconstruct the proof and certificate, acquire the initial law and detector calibration, and test the complete bound and cost on a physical system.
BOUNDARY | External correctness, priority, physical acquisition, and practical advantage remain UNKNOWN or NOT_ESTABLISHED.

# P2 returning-mediator isotope intervention: mass witness and motif limit

**Status:** `source_derived_unreviewed`. The report's analytical and model results were not independently reconstructed or experimentally validated in this integration. Mission status remains `NOT_ACHIEVED`.

**Scope:** One consolidated P2 route record covering the 16:41 conditional returning-mediator permutation/pilot and the 17:44 follow-up. The later source adds a common force/scattering model and full-spectrum mass witness, and explicitly withdraws the small pristine-graphene motif's optical response as a material-device justification. It does not validate the earlier swap chemistry or invalidate its conditional combinatorial scope.

## Source-reported result

For a stationary, time-reversal-invariant nuclear state, a position-dependent electron-scattering operator (A(R)), and the complete signed nuclear energy-transfer spectrum, the 17:44 report gives

\[
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} E S_A(E)\,dE
=\frac{\hbar^2}{2}\sum_i\frac{\langle|\nabla_i A|^2\rangle}{M_i}.
\]

This includes energy gain, energy loss and all phonon orders; it is not a centroid of a selected peak. The explicit potential term cancels from the double commutator, but the expectation still depends on the nuclear position distribution. The report also gives a thermal-harmonic second moment and says it checked the moments against a thermal quantum oscillator. Neither calculation was independently checked here.

Under the source's fixed-force, in-plane harmonic graphene model (300 K; 288/800-atom periodic cells; published Perebeinos–Tersoff force matrix; coherent pupil and Lobato–Van Dyck carbon scattering factor), the specified two-label rearrangement predicts about +7.8% and −7.2% full-moment changes at the two moved labels, with about +0.08% at unchanged site (b). The corresponding model optical-band centroids shift about +2.05, −2.09 and +0.677 meV. The last values are one-phonon model centroids in 145–210 meV, not all-background experimental spectra. The reported reader assumes 60 keV, 32 mrad convergence, a 12 mrad detector at a chosen 110 mrad offset, 28 meV resolution and unit efficiency; the calculation is not experimentally calibrated and omits several physical contributions recorded in the source intake.

## Material correction and cost

At (b), the two-label centroid change is 0.6766 meV versus 0.7364 meV for a single stationary label with a spatial scan. Thus most of the visible shift survives without the second label; the connected four-spectrum effect is much smaller. The report's ideal counting-noise-only comparison requires about (2.9\times10^{12}) primary electrons per spectrum, about 18 hours each or 74 hours total at 7 pA, before background, drift, preparation and survival costs. The source explicitly withdraws the small motif's optical response as a device justification. Single-isotope vibrational response is not the proposed new operation; the possible distinction is controlled post-assembly intervention and verification.

The proposed operation retains a 24-exchange closed Si route over (a,b,f), followed by a 16-hop parking path to about 2 nm from the intervention. Reported ideal counts are 72 exchanges for before/edit/after ending parked, 88 with Si returned to its start, and 128 for before/edit/undo/reference ending parked. These exclude failed attempts, recovery, initial isotope identification, registration and imaging. No successful physical operation or transfer probability is established.

The source estimates (8.9\times10^9) primary electrons per mass-moment spectrum (about 3.4 minutes at 7 pA; about 13.5 minutes for two changed sites before/after) and peak fluence (1.2\times10^{10}\,e/\text{Å}^2) per spectrum. These are model-based counting estimates, not calibrated identification probabilities or safe-dose limits. Energy-window truncation, energy referencing, coherent probe halo, electronic background, detector statistics, structural survival and the full visited isotope inventory remain consequential.

## Boundaries

- The 16:41 source's nine-site reachability and pilot remain conditional on the fixed honeycomb direct-swap model and reduced-model assumptions; this follow-up provides no branch-resolved carbon-transfer chemistry.
- The 17:44 return has no code/data attachments or outputs. No independent proof check, code execution, external prior-art audit or physical experiment was performed.
- A three-site read does not certify the full path inventory. Faithful transfer, adatom/refilling branches, wrong-isotope replacement, recovery/loss, parking halo and survival through spectroscopy remain unknown.
- The isotope-readout idea has prior art. The source's claimed novelty is limited to its finite coherent-probe/detector calculation and retained transfer operation; historical priority is `UNKNOWN`.
- This record does not establish a usable isotope writer, phononic or thermal-material advantage, physical capability, or practical advantage. The long-term goal remains paused.

**Evidence:** exact selected returns, capture/selection receipts, and intake analysis are listed in the canonical status sidecar and source manifest. See `frontier/dossiers/N931.txt` and `python3 frontier/retrieve.py dossier N931`.

The expectation still depends on the nuclear position distribution. In the specified 300 K in-plane harmonic graphene model, the two-label configuration yields conditional full-moment and one-phonon centroid shifts; at unchanged site b the 0.6766 meV two-label centroid shift is largely reproduced by the 0.7364 meV single-label spatial-scan comparator. The source withdraws that small motif as a materials-device rationale. Model predictions and operation counts are not acquired physical results.

N932-xh1-partner-state-gated-chemical-coupling | Partner/state gating gives a conditional cross-coupling bound and an unacquired reactor proposal

**Status:** `source_derived_unreviewed`. The selected XH1 report's derivation, synthetic checks, literature comparisons, rate examples and energy estimates were not independently reconstructed or externally reviewed here. No executable code or experimental data was supplied. Mission status remains `NOT_ACHIEVED`; the long-term goal remains paused.

**Scope:** One chemical-transformation research unit about partner-selective radical coupling and a proposed reusable molecular compartment. The rate bound applies only to its freely mixing, elementary mass-action model with the same local kinetics throughout. The compartment, state switching, orthogonal gates, rates and yields are proposed or synthetic; no physical combined reactor or matched experiment is reported.

## Source-reported selectivity bound

For the report's freely mixing radical model,

\[
r_{AB}=k_{AB}ab,\qquad r_{AA}=\tfrac12 k_{AA}a^2,\qquad r_{BB}=\tfrac12 k_{BB}b^2,
\]

it derives the integrated desired cross-selectivity bound

\[
S_{AB}\leq \frac{k_{AB}}{k_{AB}+\sqrt{k_{AA}k_{BB}}}.
\]

The derivation is conditional on the stipulated local mass-action rates applying throughout. Equal cross- and homocoupling coefficients give a 50% ceiling in this model; reaching 99% by kinetic discrimination alone requires \(k_{AB}\geq99\sqrt{k_{AA}k_{BB}}\). This is not a universal chemical-synthesis limit: preassociation, catalysts, persistent radicals, heterogeneous interfaces and other mechanisms can leave the model's assumptions.

The report says it ran four synthetic feed schedules with equal A/B inputs, equal reaction coefficients and first-order loss 0.05; the best desired fraction was 50%, while alternating or sequential feeds did worse. The code and inputs were not attached or independently executed in this intake.

## Proposed mechanism and model comparisons

The proposed reusable molecular compartment separates precursor loading, a reactive state, and leaving-group/product release. In a simple equimolar, fixed-degeneracy equilibrium example, the report estimates that an 11.4 kJ/mol preference gives 99% occupancy. With \(M\) competing alternatives, it gives the illustrative scale \(RT\ln[99(M-1)]\), about 22.8 kJ/mol for 100 alternatives and 34.2 kJ/mol for 10,000. These are model calculations, not universal energy requirements; photon fractions and other physical mechanisms differ.

A one-knob confinement model is reported to fail as a monotone design rule: if stronger confinement slows productive fragmentation and escape together, its synthetic rates produce a finite optimum. For the report's example, the yield rises from 12.9% to 31.5% and then falls at higher confinement. This is a limitation of that rate dependence, not a no-go for molecular cages.

The proposed alternative uses orthogonal reaction-state gates. For the stated synthetic case \(q=0.99765\) and target 0.99, the report requires \((1+\beta)(1+\epsilon)\leq1.00773\) and reports a model yield of 99.07%. Its example assumes an escape-rate reduction from about \(6\times10^9\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}\) to \(6\times10^6\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}\), while the productive coupling rate is about \(10^9\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}\). No such rates were measured, and the report leaves open whether partner identity can be retained without suppressing bond-forming motion.

## Comparator, decisive test and costs

The source compares the proposal with substrate-paired photoactivated complexes, iron-porphyrin/carbon-nitride radical sorting, persistent radical pairing on Ag(111), molecular cages, and kilogram-scale nickel cross-electrophile manufacture. These are report-referenced comparisons only; this intake did not audit the cited literature. Its revised novelty claim—independent reaction-state switching and partner memory—remains unestablished.

The proposed discriminator is isotope crossover between two equivalent labeled precursor pairs. Under the report's ideal mixture model, the mismatched-product fraction is \((1-m)/2\); vary the mixing-to-illumination delay and compare the same conditions with and without a host, using time-resolved absorption and product-isotope analysis. This is a proposed experiment, not an acquired result.

The report estimates 268 kJ/mol incident photon energy per product at 450 nm and model yield 0.99071; at an assumed 30% wall-plug efficiency, that becomes about 894 kJ/mol electrical input for illumination alone. A 10 mM host operating at 1 M/h would need about 101 cycles per host per hour, or roughly 36 seconds per cycle. These are illustrative estimates and omit synthesis, separation, host recovery, heating and other process costs; no practical advantage follows.

## Relation to existing claims and open interfaces

This is a separate radical-coupling model, not a transfer of N769's reversible elementary mass-action relocation result. The XH1 report itself notes that transient or irreversible intermediates fall outside that earlier result's assumptions. N782's model-transfer warning also applies as a comparison: favorable rates from incompatible environments cannot be assembled into a demonstrated physical advantage. These topical relations do not modify or validate either existing claim.

Open interfaces include independent derivation of the integrated bound under exact kinetic assumptions; source and prior-art review; measurement of partner association and state-switching rates in the same substrate/host regime; a matched isotope-crossover experiment with product identity and yield; and complete process-energy, throughput, reuse and separation costs. No controllable reactor, high-selectivity synthesis, novelty, physical capability, or practical advantage is established.

**Evidence:** The exact XH1 rendered return, capture receipt and selection receipt are listed in the current status sidecar and source manifest. See `frontier/dossiers/N932.txt` and `python3 frontier/retrieve.py dossier N932`.

contract.provides: For r_AB=k_AB ab and r_AA=(1/2)k_AA a^2, r_BB=(1/2)k_BB b^2 under the report’s same-local-kinetics-throughout premise, the source derives S_AB <= k_AB/(k_AB+sqrt(k_AA k_BB)); equal coefficients give 50%, and 99% by kinetic discrimination alone requires k_AB >= 99 sqrt(k_AA k_BB). This is not a universal synthesis limit. The reusable compartment and orthogonal reaction-state-gating examples are conceptual/synthetic, not measured. The reported isotope-crossover test remains proposed. Correctness, priority, physical feasibility and advantage remain UNKNOWN.

body:
N933-ultra-harmonic-gravity-pulse | A harmonic gravity-gate pulse is source-reported; compatible hardware and noise remain open

**Status:** `source_derived_unreviewed`. The Ultra return reports a constructed pulse and algebra checks, with an independent Sol review reported by its source. This intake did not independently derive the equations, inspect the cited review, perform an external prior-art audit, or acquire a physical experiment. No new physical capability is established.

**Scope:** One conditional two-probe harmonic-oscillator gravity-gate model and its pulse/noise comparison. The result assumes a compatible spin force, equal harmonic traps, stable quadratic coupling, endpoint-flat control, and an idealized mechanical model. The required low trap frequency, force, isolation and noise conditions have not been demonstrated together.

## Source-reported pulse construction

The serialized return gives

\[
H_m=\sum_{i=1}^2\left(\frac{p_i^2}{2m}+\frac12m\omega^2x_i^2\right)+Kx_1x_2,
\qquad H_{\rm int}=-f(t)(Z_1x_1+Z_2x_2),
\]

with \(K=2Gm^2/r^3\), \(\kappa=K/m\), and the stability condition \(|\kappa|<\omega^2\). Writing \(L_0=\partial_t^2+\omega^2\), the report selects an endpoint-flat trajectory \(u\) with \(u,u',u'',u'''=0\) at both endpoints and sets

\[
f(t)=m\bigl[L_0^2-\kappa^2\bigr]u(t).
\]

It reports conditional oscillator responses proportional to \((L_0u,-\kappa u)\) and \((-\kappa u,L_0u)\), and the phase

\[
\theta_{ZZ}=-\frac K\hbar\int_0^T\bigl[(L_0u)^2-\kappa^2u^2\bigr]dt.
\]

The claimed factorization is \(U_{\rm probes}\otimes U_m(T)\): it disentangles the probes from the mechanics, but does not return an arbitrary mechanical input state to itself. Literal return requires the stated stationary-initial-state premise. A \(\sin^6(\omega t/2)\) pulse is reported to join force and slew smoothly to zero.

## Noise result and physical benchmark

For continuous independent stationary high-temperature Ohmic baths, the source reports

\[
|\theta_{\rm sym}|\leq\frac{\epsilon}{4}\sqrt{\Gamma_1\Gamma_2},
\qquad \epsilon=\frac{\hbar|K|}{m\gamma k_BT}.
\]

This is a scoped noise comparison, not a separability theorem for all inputs or bath models. The worked benchmark is hypothetical: mass 5.6 micrograms, separation 200 micrometres, force about \(9.27\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm N\), and a 14-second ideal \(\pi/4\) loop. Even granting a quality factor \(Q=2.6\times10^7\) at an unmeasured low trap frequency, the source estimates \(\epsilon\approx3\times10^{-9}\), leaving no credible gate regime under that Ohmic model.

The source notes that a rare-collision alternative may avoid a Gaussian-diffusion approximation, but supplies no acquired platform with the required isolation/force model. Higher-order Newtonian thermal terms also remain unresolved. Compatible spin force, trap frequency, force duration, isolation and measured noise are unacquired.

## Prior work and status boundary

The source cites Plato, Rätzel and Wan (2023) on arbitrary-force geometric gates ([paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2209.12656v2)) as strong prior work that limits novelty. Its own report claims no new physical capability. The citation and review are preserved as source claims; neither received an external audit in this intake.

This result remains conditional on its harmonic model and exact control assumptions. A real platform would need to demonstrate the required spin-dependent force, trap frequency, stability and isolation simultaneously, then measure the relevant bath/noise regime and compare the achieved phase and full gate cost against established alternatives. None is supplied here. Mathematical correctness, historical priority, physical feasibility and practical advantage remain `UNKNOWN`; the fresh-capital mission remains `NOT_ACHIEVED` and its long-term goal remains paused.

**Evidence:** The complete selected Ultra return, including its root answer and embedded support-return material, is preserved byte-for-byte. See `frontier/dossiers/N933.txt` and `python3 frontier/retrieve.py dossier N933`.

contract.provides: Within the source’s stable equal-frequency harmonic model, endpoint-flat control gives a conditional oscillator response and a ZZ phase, with probe/mechanics factorization but not arbitrary mechanical-state return. The scoped continuous independent stationary high-temperature Ohmic comparison gives |theta_sym| <= epsilon sqrt(Gamma_1 Gamma_2)/4. Its hypothetical benchmark assumes unmeasured force, low trap frequency, quality factor and isolation; the estimated epsilon is about 3e-9 under the granted Q. Rare-collision conditions and higher Newtonian thermal terms remain open. Mathematical correctness, novelty, physical feasibility and advantage remain UNKNOWN.

body:
A correlated entrance mixture supports a reusable reaction-event interface

STATUS | source_derived_unreviewed
REPORTED STATUS | The P3 continuation reports a reusable interface for event-time, event-identity, and post-event state distributions, plus an executed finite case with a correlated entrance mixture. Proof and numerical artifacts are present in the selected packet; they are not independently audited or replayed in this integration.
EXACT CLAIM | The continuation reports a reusable event interface: 73 guarded rules, a two-state controller, and 24 heterogeneous two-state components are handled without building 33,554,432 global configurations. In the executed one-opening case, a 256-component positive mixture represents the correlated post-event entrance law with reported total-variation error below 3.774e-9. A later event probability differs when the true correlated entrance is replaced by product marginals.
PROOF SPINE | The report supplies an exact filter for changing reaction interfaces and a controlled entrance approximation for finite local CTMCs. Its finite example retains a positive mixture of component product laws after the observed event; correlations from the common event time remain relevant to later predictions.
LIMITS | The strongest executed case is a narrow one-opening class; it is not a general scalable reaction simulator. Rare-event conditioning needs a nonzero denominator lower bound. The source files and reported calculations were not independently audited or replayed here. The reported theorem does not erase renewal, lumping, or network-free prior art.
SCOPED DISTINCTIONS | A later continuation develops reusable post-event correlated entrance information; it does not establish the earlier report's historical execution or validate it.
NEXT OBLIGATION | Independently audit the proof assumptions, reproduce the correlated entrance and later-event calculation from the pinned source, then compare costs and accuracy against renewal, lumping, and network-free approaches.
BOUNDARY | Correctness, formal verification, historical priority, physical capability, empirical confirmation, and practical advantage remain UNKNOWN, NOT_CERTIFIED, or NOT_ACQUIRED as applicable.
EVIDENCE PATHS | Exact selected source paths, SHA-256 hashes, line ranges, and source scope are recorded in frontier/cards/N938-p3-correlated-entrance-reusable-interface.json. Read the pinned source version before applying the statement.

body:
Local bath feedback leaves residual response; the matched comparison shows no advantage

STATUS | source_derived_unreviewed
REPORTED STATUS | The selected Ultra checkpoint and later local-only addendum report bath-mediated logical-record erasure using own-port/own-spin feedback without broadcast. The addendum changes the residual expression and must remain a later source version. A later warm/compact matched comparison reports that a cold no-receiver case has stronger retained entanglement than the hot-receiver case at the same target phase, so the tested model does not show an advantage.
EXACT CLAIM | The local-only addendum reports that own-output homodyne plus own-spin feedback removes the dominant response without broadcast, while leaving a residual cross-response. Proof:positive noncommuting words length k have embedding counts between binom(m,k) and binom(m+k-1,k),low-degree ratios exp[-k0²/m,k0²/(2m)],both norm tails<=2^-k0<=alpha lambda/64;no cancellation. body:
N966-quantum-channel-conditional-sld-order | Conditional Umegaki order for quantum channels is equivalent to complete equal-reference SLD order
status=source_derived_unreviewed; source internal audits are accepted only at exact version and scope through a knowledge review overlay. External correctness/priority, physical evidence and practical advantage remain separately scoped.

EXACT CLAIM
For arbitrary finite-dimensional quantum channels P,Q with the same input, the uniform conditional Umegaki relative-entropy order with constant c is equivalent to the complete equal-reference SLD metric order with the same c. Taking Q to be identity identifies the conditional Umegaki contraction coefficient with the complete equal-reference SLD coefficient.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
Finite-dimensional channels, arbitrary finite references, faithful states and faithful baselines; output supports are restricted to effective support and finite boundary cases use common faithful regularization.

BOUNDARIES
No equality with complete equal-reference Umegaki for arbitrary quantum channels follows. The N675 source contributes only its selected Section 2 saturated-reference filter; hardness and compiler claims remain unreviewed.

PRIOR ART AND TRANSFER LIMIT
The coherent-qubit SLD-to-BKM integral is prior work by Hirche, in Quantum estimation, channel orders, and private capacity, arXiv:2610.03706v1, Proposition 3.5 / Eq. (3.18). The conditional reference-score gauge, saturated-reference reverse filter, and state-pair interpolation in this result are distinct receiving steps. The integral alone supplies no general positive equal-reference Umegaki witness.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Finite-dimensional operator and relative-entropy calculations; no physical implementation is claimed.

NEXT OBLIGATION
External priority and any extension beyond the stated finite-dimensional contract remain open.

status=source_derived_unreviewed; internal acceptance is bound to an exact content version and review scope.

EXACT CLAIM
For a finite-dimensional channel N, a fixed arbitrary finite reference R, and a >= 1, the reference-adapted Gibbs functional has the exact variational identity sup_X log Phi(X) = sup_rho F(rho). For each faithful X, the Gibbs state Y = exp(G_X)/Phi(X) is a positive input witness, and a violation transfers between the entropy and exponential formulations without a min-max swap. The alternating update X -> N(Y) is monotone under the stated premises.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
Finite-dimensional channel; fixed finite reference R; a >= 1; normalized faithful X on the effective output support, with boundary states obtained by faithful approximation.

BOUNDARIES
This is an equivalent positive-state reformulation and witness transfer. It does not prove the W3 target, classify all stationary points, or make monotone ascent a global certificate. No complexity, speedup, novelty, or acquired experiment is established.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Matrix logarithms and exponentials, reference dimension, conditioning, and stopping tolerances are real resources. No universal complexity guarantee is given.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Use the identity for exact witness transfer or a bounded search; any global upper bound still requires an independent certificate.

N980-wh3-gibbs-ascent-suboptimal-basin | The Gibbs ascent has a strictly suboptimal attracting basin for 2 < a < 4
status=source_derived_unreviewed; internal acceptance is bound to an exact content version and review scope.

EXACT CLAIM
For the W3 Gibbs update at parameter 2 < a < 4, the product fixed-point manifold has an open locally attracting basin although its objective is strictly below the maximally entangled witness. At a = 3, the retained exact interval certificate gives a faithful witness gap greater than 1.03 nats. Therefore monotone ascent and smooth convergence are not global certificates. At a = 2, this comparison is not a disproof: the product and maximally entangled boundary values tie.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
The exact local-basin theorem uses the W3 channel and source parameter range 1 < a < 4; strict suboptimality relative to the maximally entangled input holds for 2 < a < 4. The faithful interval witness is the stated a = 3, epsilon = 1/100 case.

BOUNDARIES
This does not disprove the a = 2 squashing target or prove a general Blahut-Arimoto failure theorem. The exact interval certificate supports the faithful a = 3 gap; the open basin is proved analytically in the source.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
The interval output certifies a stated finite logarithmic gap; it is not a runtime or global-search certificate.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Any use of ascent for the a = 2 target needs a separate global bound or proof excluding other basins.

N981-wh3-werner-gibbs-separatrix | A faithful Werner stationary point separates two W3 Gibbs-search basins at a = 2
status=source_derived_unreviewed; internal acceptance is bound to an exact content version and review scope.

EXACT CLAIM
On the exact normalized Werner family, the W3 update at a = 2 is x_next = sqrt((x^3 + 2)/3). It has a product fixed point x = 1 and a faithful correlated fixed point x = 1 + sqrt(3). The latter is a full stationary point with objective sqrt(3)/6, below the 1/3 target; it is not a local maximum. The exact separatrix explains why different search starts can enter different basins, but proves no global upper bound.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
Finite-dimensional W3 update restricted to the normalized Werner invariant family for its exact scalar dynamics; full stationarity at the correlated point follows from the stated self-consistency.

BOUNDARIES
The Werner curve does not classify the full state-space dynamics. The stationary point is not a local maximum and does not contradict the proposed bound. The unrestricted W3/qutrit target remains open.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Exact one-variable algebra only; no algorithmic novelty or practical search advantage is claimed.

NEXT OBLIGATION
A global proof must control states outside the Werner invariant family and all phase-bearing directions.

N983-wh3-pinching-coherence-obstruction | Physical pinching can increase the W3 entropy objective, even with uniform marginals
status=source_derived_unreviewed; internal acceptance is bound to an exact content version and review scope.

EXACT CLAIM
The physical 2+1 pinching map is not a monotone reduction for the W3 entropy objective. A faithful coherence perturbation gives a local BKM quotient above 1/2; one exact interval result is 0.5659667... at epsilon = 1/100, and a stronger example keeps both input marginals exactly I3/3 with quotient 0.7182625... at the same epsilon. This refutes the pinching proof step, not the W3 entropy target.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
The source's faithful baselines and physical cross-sector tangents have vanishing reference partial trace; for sufficiently small nonzero perturbation the states remain faithful and retain the stated marginals.

BOUNDARIES
The coherence gain can consume the block theorem's safety margin, but the source does not show that it exceeds the margin or violates the target. This is a counterexample to a half-contraction/pinching mechanism only.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Exact local BKM metric formulas plus interval enclosures at epsilon = 1/100; no physical experiment is involved.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Any global argument using block pinching must account for both the finite block slack and the coherence gain.

N984-wh3-rank-four-dimension-uniform-boundary | Rank-four boundary violations are excluded uniformly over finite reference dimensions
status=source_derived_unreviewed; internal acceptance is bound to an exact content version and review scope.

EXACT CLAIM
For arbitrary finite reference spaces R_n, faithful normalized X_n on C^3 tensor R_n, and states xi_n with rank xi_n <= 4, if ||X_n - xi_n||_1 tends to zero then limsup Tr exp[2(W3 tensor id)(log X_n) - I tensor log (X_n)_R] <= 1/3. Equivalently, each fixed positive gap above 1/3 has a dimension-uniform positive trace-distance from all rank-at-most-four states. The source gives existence, not an explicit or effective modulus.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
The Gibbs-dual boundary argument with active reference dimension at most 12, combined with the exact rank-four Kraus-span trichotomy and the source's prior dimension-uniform rank-three boundary proof.

BOUNDARIES
This excludes only neighborhoods of rank-at-most-four states. It does not prove the unrestricted faithful inequality, provide a computable delta(epsilon), or rule out rank-five or higher boundary mechanisms.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Dimension-free compactness and entropy-continuity argument; the modulus is nonconstructive. No hardware or computational advantage is established.

Rank-five and higher boundary mechanisms, including arbitrary coherence and product directions, remain unresolved.

N985-wh3-rank-five-schmidt-aligned-product-direction | A rank-five Schmidt-aligned product-direction class obeys the W3 entropy bound for every Schmidt spectrum
status=source_derived_unreviewed; internal acceptance is bound to an exact content version and review scope.

EXACT CLAIM
For every normalized qutrit Schmidt vector psi = sum_i sqrt(p_i)|ii> and every off-diagonal Schmidt-basis product vector eta = |jk>, j != k, every state rho supported on span{psi,eta} satisfies S(rho) - 2 S((W3 tensor id)rho) + S(rho_R) <= -ln 3. The exact homogeneous resolvent certificate covers all nonnegative Schmidt weights. It closes this aligned rank-five support mechanism only.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
The two-dimensional support is generated by one Schmidt vector and one off-diagonal product basis vector in the same Schmidt coordinates; any phase of the logical coherence is removed by a diagonal local unitary.

BOUNDARIES
It does not cover arbitrary superposed product vectors u tensor w or every rank-five kernel space. No nonunitary filtering is used as an entropy symmetry. The global W3/qutrit target remains open.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
A finite exact symbolic certificate records the cleared-denominator identity and a square term plus nonnegative remainder. The checker was not replayed during intake.

NEXT OBLIGATION
General full-Schmidt-plus-arbitrary-product directions and unrestricted higher-rank boundary states remain open.

body:
N986-p1-acquired-gamma-root-filter | An acquired gamma-root filter has finite-horizon and anytime whole-record guarantees

STATUS | accepted internally at the exact mathematical scope/version bound by knowledge/reviews/A986-p1-xh1-selected-scope.json. This source-exposed review is not blind, a scientific-program replay, finite-bit end-to-end execution, novelty, physical capability or practical advantage.

EXACT CLAIM
Under the supplied CIR model, thermal initialization and complete aggregate count-time interface, a positive acquired gamma-root filter pays explicit Bernoulli-to-Poisson reset errors. Finite-horizon pruning bounds the joint count-record/terminal-radius law with logarithmic expected retained-factor count. A different summable anytime schedule bounds the entire count-record law with logarithmically growing expected factor count. Neither result bounds worst-case bits or conditions uniformly on rare histories.

SOURCE-REPORTED INTERFACE
Let S follow dS = kappa(m nu - S)dt + sqrt(2 kappa nu S)dW from the supplied thermal Gamma(m, rate 1/nu) law. The observer receives every fine aggregate-count time with known predictable efficiency 0 <= c_t <= c_max and intensity c_t S. It does not receive the latent radial path. For a Gamma-mixture posterior with common rate beta and index PGF P(z), beta' = kappa beta - kappa nu beta^2 + c_t; an observed count updates P_+(z) = z[mP(z)+zP'(z)]/(m+P'(1)). The exact finite-polynomial filter and its CIR/gamma-mixture ingredients are established prior art.

ACQUIRED ROOT OPERATION
Represent P(z) = exp(lambda(z-1)) product_j(1-p_j+p_j z), with lambda >= 0 and 0 <= p_j <= 1. The stored state is beta, lambda and the finite Bernoulli-factor list. A count is processed from these known parameters by a real-rooted secular equation with monotone intervals; no unknown posterior is queried. Count interlacing creates at most two fresh lifetime tags, while every inherited p-factor decays at least as exp(-kappa elapsed_time). Replacing a known Bernoulli(p) factor by Poisson(p) preserves positivity and the represented conditional first moment and pays TV(Bernoulli(p),Poisson(p)) = p(1-exp(-p)) <= p^2.

FINITE-HORIZON GUARANTEE
For the same predictable control functional in the exact and shadow processes, pruning factors at tag age L = kappa^-1 log(1/tau) gives
  TV(law(Y_[0,T], S_T), shadow law) <= 2 c_max m nu T tau^2,
  E[M_t] <= (2 c_max m nu/kappa) log(1/tau).
The expected factor-count bound also holds when the algorithm is driven by the true physical count record. For 0 < epsilon < 2 c_max m nu T and T,c_max > 0, choosing tau = sqrt(epsilon/(2 c_max m nu T)) in (0,1) makes the joint full-count-record and terminal-radius error at most epsilon and gives E[M_t] <= (c_max m nu/kappa) log(2 c_max m nu T/epsilon). These are bounds on expected stored real parameters, not total bits or worst-case work; an external long-history controller's memory is separate.

ANYTIME GUARANTEE
With a per-tag threshold tau(b)^2 = [epsilon/(2 c_max m nu t0)](1+b/t0)^(-2), where t0,c_max > 0 and 0 < epsilon < 2 c_max m nu t0, every finite record horizon jointly with its terminal radius has TV error <= epsilon, and the count-record laws on the full infinite time axis also have TV <= epsilon. The expected stored roots grow only logarithmically in time:
  E[M_t] <= (2 c_max m nu/kappa)[(1/2)log(2 c_max m nu t0/epsilon) + log(1+t/t0)].
This differs from fixed tau: fixed tau has time-uniform expected size but a finite-horizon error growing with T. Neither theorem gives constant worst-case memory or rare-history conditional error.

PRIOR ART AND CREDIT
The exact CIR gamma-mixture filter and dual-process methods are established work: Leijdekker–Spreij (2008, arXiv:0802.1407); Papaspiliopoulos–Ruggiero (2014, arXiv:1305.4571); Kon Kam King et al. (2023, arXiv:2310.00599). The scoped contribution is the acquired positive real-root factorization, tag lifetime accounting, paid reset and resulting entire-record/expected-memory bounds. No priority claim is made.

BOUNDARIES
The filter requires complete fine aggregate count times. A binary nonempty-bin record already leaves the Poisson-times-Bernoulli class because its PGF has an uncancelled pole; unexposed event times cannot be inserted. The stationary scalar CIR count process has infinite exact linear predictive Hankel rank, so a scalar physical state does not imply a finite exact linear filter. The result does not predict port marks, interferometric/coherence observables, the full quantum state, or arbitrary controller memory. Rare bursts can exceed the expected-size bound. Root, event-time and likelihood precision and work remain charged; no finite-bit end-to-end record certificate follows from floating diagnostics.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Expected retained real-parameter count is not a bound on total bits, root-solving work, event-time precision or arbitrary external policy memory. All compared laws use the same predictable control functional. Multi-bin floating diagnostics elsewhere in the report are not an outward end-to-end certificate.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Before finite-bit execution, certify rate integration, likelihoods, count times and root/sampling error together. A port-sensitive extension needs separate angular/coherence closure, not an invented fine record.
